mobs.Name: demon lord
mobs.LongDescription: The demon Lord stands here, looking for fresh souls to enslave.
mobs.Description:
The demon before you, used to be one of the empires greatest gatherer 
of souls and is therefore now a Lord. He is now a commander of the 
soulhunters. He looks almost like a human, but with slightly abnormal 
features.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks at you with the eyes of burning hatred.;
%10 growl

mobs.Name: demon spawn
mobs.LongDescription: The spawn of a demon is here, developing into horror.
mobs.Description:
Something...stands before you. Something, that doesn't seem to be a 
fully developed demon. You can actually see how it grows and shapes 
itself into something evil.

mobs.Name: demon lord
mobs.LongDescription: The bony Lord of the dead, is looking out for the living.
mobs.Description:
The Lord of the dead is the demon in charge of the other side. He 
is the one, who summons the unholy and forces it into the bodies of
the dead. He is a really thin and pale character. No doubt, he still 
holds powerful magic.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote orders a pile of bones to rise.;
%10 emote picks up a femur and begins to chew on it.

mobs.Name: demon mistress
mobs.LongDescription: A thin lady-like demon is here, commanding the dead.
mobs.Description:
The mistress of the dead is the real ruler among the dead. She's the 
one with the real power over death and life. She's very thin, but you 
can see strong and wiry muscles moving beneath her skin. Oh, she's 
almost naked.

mobs.Name: shadow demon death
mobs.LongDescription: Shadowy death haunts the darkness.
mobs.Description:
Death darker than night is the best, and maybe only way to describe 
this demonic being. It is a master assassin among demons, and not many 
are strong enough to stand up to this expert murderer.
mobs.ActionScript: %%50 emote fades into the dark.

mobs.Name: demon daemonette
mobs.LongDescription: Viciously the daemonette stalks towards you.
mobs.Description:
These...beasts, are extremely fierce and dangerous. They attack all 
living, and not even their own kind are quite safe. They seem to be...
female demons, but you can't be sure. Even the Dethguards avoid the 
daemonettes. Their bloodlust is total.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 kill daemonette;
%15 emote sniffs at the air.

mobs.Name: demon soulhunter figure
mobs.LongDescription: A quick figure sneaks around in the shadows.
mobs.Description:
This, quite small demon, is one of the soulhunters. The soulhunters 
gather souls on their raids among the living. Usually they are all 
dressed in black, and carry black bags. They occasionally sniff at the 
air, trying to find a trail to a fresh soul.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote sniffs at the air.;
%1 yell Isss that a fresssh sssoul I sssmell!?

mobs.Name: demon lord crimson red man
mobs.LongDescription: A red magnificent looking beast of a man.
mobs.Description:
The crimson Lord is a brutal character. He, or whatever it is, is 
all red...bloody red! This is the one that leads the demon armies into 
battle, to command and to conquer...or die trying. Failure doesn't 
exist other than in the minds of the weak.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%90 close gate;
%90 close throne

mobs.Name: demon warrior guardian
mobs.LongDescription: A chaotic warrior is on guard here.
mobs.Description:
This powerful being in front of you, used to be one of the Dethguards. 
It was elevated to the rank of chaos guardian because of long and evil 
service, dedicated to the emperor.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote moves to stand in your way.;
%10 emote assumes the fighting stance of true chaos.

mobs.Name: demon lord blob
mobs.LongDescription: A large and extremely repulsive blob.
mobs.Description:
The Lord of disgust is a truly repulsive being. He is covered with 
dirt, trash and green slime. He drools all the time, and he stinks 
like...no, it is even worse!

mobs.Name: mistress demon blob
mobs.LongDescription: A filthy small vibrating blob slithers across the floor.
mobs.Description:
She's really disgusting, at least you think it is a female. Dirty and 
disgusting, quite repulsive. Smells like a week old corpse. She's 
propably rotting as well...and enjoying it!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote rolls out a huge tongue and catches hundreds of flies.;
%10 burp

mobs.Name: demon bloodthirster
mobs.LongDescription: A truly magnificent character, covered by a huge red cloak.
mobs.Description:
The being in front of you, is one of the most wicked ones in the demon 
Empire. This is the absolute master of utter terror. Stories tell of 
it draining its victims of all blood as well as sanity.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote smiles at you, revealing #Rbloodred#N fangs.;
%10 emote enjoys a drink of blood.

mobs.Name: guardian demon tormentor
mobs.LongDescription: A tall, leatherclad daemonette.
mobs.Description:
The guardian of pain is tall and skinny. She's all dressed in 
tightfitting leather. She would be quite beautiful, if it hadn't been 
for the deep scars in her face. She used to be one of the daemonettes, 
but she was considered to dangerous to her own ranks and was placed 
here as the head tormentor.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote sniffs at the air and turns slowly towards you.;
%10 bash

mobs.Name: demon reaper murderer
mobs.LongDescription: A murderer, dressed to spread death and sorrow.
mobs.Description:
The demonic dark reaper is one bizarre character. All dressed up in 
dark flowing robes, it performs the ancient and most evil of rites, to 
please the Emperor - Living sacrifice!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote performs a sacrifice to the honor of the Emperor.;
%10 emote throws a body into the pit.

mobs.Name: figure plaguebearer demon
mobs.LongDescription: A almost tiny spideresque figure, scurries around on the floor.
mobs.Description:
This, quite small character, is almost completely black except for 
some white lines in its face. As it begins to move, you notice how it 
becomes more and more white, just to become black again. Then you 
understand...it is covered with flies, thousands of black flies.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote chokes on a fly.;
%10 emote orders the flies to bug someone else.

mobs.Name: Dethguard champion demon guard
mobs.LongDescription: A large guard with huge muscles is on duty here.
mobs.Description:
This is the champion of the Dethguards. The winner of their contests, 
of who is to become the Emperor's champion - Their leader!
It has extremely large muscles, and is dressed in what seems to be a 
complete suit of chainmail.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 flex

mobs.Name: Dethguard demon guard
mobs.LongDescription: A heavily built guard is on duty here.
mobs.Description:
One of the fierce and feared Dethguards. These are the Emperor's guard 
of honor. It's quite difficult to imagine a demon with honor. The 
Dethguards are dressed in a complete suit of chainmail which gives 
them at least some protection.

mobs.Name: demon knight
mobs.LongDescription: A brightly shining demon is here, leaning on a huge warhammer.
mobs.Description:
A very big and brightly shining demon. It seems to have quite an armor,
but then you notice that it is naked. It has so bright skin, it looks 
like it is wearing heavy silvery armor.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote lifts up the warhammer, and begins to walk towards you.;
%20 say Puny mortals...

mobs.Name: warrior avenger
mobs.LongDescription: A radiant warrior is here looking for his family.
mobs.Description:
This warrior, is absolutely drenching you with goodness. You feel his 
power and sadeness. His family was captured by the soulhunters, and 
put through an eternity of pain. He went on a lone crusade against the 
demons, trying to find his family. He is still searching and will do 
so until he finds them...or dies.

mobs.Name: emperor demon
mobs.LongDescription: The Emperor is here, relaxing in his personal chamber.
mobs.Description:
The Emperor, the ruler of almost all demons. It's only the Empress 
and her vicious daemonettes who don't do as he orders. He is quite big,
and large red wings can be seen on his back. As he grins, you see sharp
fangs glimmering in the light.

mobs.Name: demon empress
mobs.LongDescription: The Empress is here performing evil rites.
mobs.Description:
The Empress is a very tall and skinny female demon. She used to be 
one of the daemonettes, but was considered to powerful to remain a 
simple daemonette. Power, is all that counts here. She's dressed in 
dark red robes, with magic symbols painted all over it...and herself.

mobs.Name: wind
mobs.LongDescription: A strong howling wind haunts these halls.
mobs.Description:
A wind full of sheer terror. You can't see anything, but you feel a 
very strong presence. You hear terrible cries from all around you, but 
you see nothing...Nothing!

mobs.Name: wind
mobs.LongDescription: A strong howling wind haunts these halls.
mobs.Description:
A wind full of sheer terror. You can't see anything, but you feel a 
very strong presence. You hear terrible cries from all around you, but 
you see nothing...Nothing!

mobs.Name: demon death darkness
mobs.LongDescription: Pitch black darkness surrounds you.
mobs.Description:
Pitch black darkness, that's all there is. Occasionally, you think you 
see a face in all that black. A grim looking face, swirling around in 
that darkness. This is as evil as it possibly can get.

mobs.Name: morph demon
mobs.LongDescription: A small demon is here, transforming into something else.
mobs.Description:
This is a morph demon. They are experts when it comes to disguise 
yourself. Propably because they can change color and shape as they 
want. They are pretty small when they look as they are supposed to.

mobs.Name: zombie
mobs.LongDescription: The living dead shambles towards you.
mobs.Description:
The living dead...zombies...Well, they don't seem to be quite dead 
just yet. Rotting and decaying bodies that live, eh? These are the 
pets of the mistress of the dead.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 bash

mobs.Name: Cremator demon
mobs.LongDescription: A really fat demon is here, glowing with heat.
mobs.Description:
No one really know what the cremator is for. The only known fact, is 
that it really loves fire and heat. The cremator is quite fat, and it 
seems to be naked except for a scorched leather apron.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 emote sinks a screaming gnome into the lava.

mobs.Name: demon soulhunter
mobs.LongDescription: A quick figure sneaks around in the shadows.
mobs.Description:
This, quite small demon, is one of the soulhunters. The soulhunters 
gather souls on their raids among the living. Usually they are all 
dressed in black, and carry black bags. They occasionally sniff at the 
air, trying to find a trail to a fresh soul.

mobs.Name: human mchoro mhaeren
mobs.LongDescription: A grim looking human stands here surrounded by an aura of evil.
mobs.Description:
The human man before you, might be the only non-demonic being that the
demons respect and maybe even follow. Mchoro Mhaeren made killing and
torture a sport. A hobby to keep him warm in the cold winternights.
He is quite tall and very thin, but you are fairly sure he is as fast
and as deadly as a viper.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote grins and says 'Death...is here...';
%10 emote whispers quietly '...destruction from within...'

mobs.Name: human prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A crazy looking human stands here dressed in torn rags.
mobs.Description:
The prisoner has gone through quite a lot of beating. His clothes are
torn to shreds, hardly covering him at all. Not that he seems to mind.
Fear and pain has driven him over the cliff of sanity. Now he just
walks around, muttering and whispering words.

mobs.Name: dying fairy
mobs.LongDescription: A tiny fairy lies here, barely breathing.
mobs.Description:
A tiny fairy in extremely bad shape. You feel wrath boiling up within
you as you see that her wings have been...plucked. She's bleeding a lot
and you don't think any healing could help, it has gone to far.
She looks at you with pleading eyes..'Please put me out of this misery'
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks at you with tearful eyes.;
%20 sob

mobs.Name: beaten dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A short and very badly beaten dwarf wanders around here.
mobs.Description:
The dwarf in front of you is very short, even for a dwarf. He is in a
very bad shape, since the demons seem to have been beating him a lot.
His left eye is badly burnt, showing only a black charred hole.
His beard has been burnt as well...actually, it seems like they've 
been roasting him.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote grunts weakly.;
%10 emote stumbles on a rock and falls down to his knees.

mobs.Name: impaled gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A small impaled gnome has been left to die here.
mobs.Description:
The gnome in front of you, is wearing a expression telling of extreme
pain and fear. A large stake has been driven through him. It's a
miracle that he still is alive, but it's not a act of goodness to let
him live like this. You wonder if magic is all that is keeping him up?
All just to keep him hurting.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 emote groans loudly as the stake moves.;
%10 emote weeps softly. Tears flow down his cheeks, marring his soul.

mobs.Name: mutilated elf woman
mobs.LongDescription: A tall fair skinned woman sits here, trying to regain her strength.
mobs.Description:
The elven woman seems to be very young. She is bleeding a lot from 
hundreds of scratches, and bruises marks her suffering. She is dying,
but propably welcomes death with open arms. Death is freedom here,
while life, is death!
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote whispers to herself.

mobs.Name: demon lord
mobs.LongDescription: The demon Lord stands here, looking for fresh souls to enslave.
mobs.Description:
The demon before you, used to be one of the empires greatest gatherer 
of souls and is therefore now a Lord. He is now a commander of the 
soulhunters. He looks almost like a human, but with slightly abnormal 
features.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote inhales deeply, just to blow foul smelling gas at you.;
%10 growl

mobs.Name: demon lord
mobs.LongDescription: The demon Lord stands here, looking for fresh souls to enslave.
mobs.Description:
The demon before you, used to be one of the empires greatest gatherer 
of souls and is therefore now a Lord. He is now a commander of the 
soulhunters. He looks almost like a human, but with slightly abnormal 
features.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote grins viciously, saliva dropping on the ground, sizzling..;
%10 growl

mobs.Name: demon lord
mobs.LongDescription: The demon Lord stands here, looking for fresh souls to enslave.
mobs.Description:
The demon before you, used to be one of the empires greatest gatherer 
of souls and is therefore now a Lord. He is now a commander of the 
soulhunters. He looks almost like a human, but with slightly abnormal 
features.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote beckons you to come closer, as bolts arc from eye to eye..;
%10 growl

Dethguards are dressed in a complete suit of chainmail which gives 
them at least some protection.

mobs.Name: warrior bartender elysium
mobs.LongDescription: The old warrior listens intently to tales of battles lost and won.
mobs.Description:
The old warrior has long since retired, but gladly serves drinks 
here at the clan's bar.  He is always here, whenever he is needed.
The faint points of his ears and delicate bone structure betray
his elven origins as surely as his leathered skin and knowledge of 
the forest do his years as a ranger.

mobs.Name: tomb guardian warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A tall warrior stands here, proudly guarding the fallen.
mobs.Description:
A tall warrior, clad in a finely woven chainmail shirt. As you look
upon the guardian, you feel how feelings of pride fill him. Proud to
guard the tombs of the fallen heroes. The ones who turned the events
of the battle into their favor.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote raises his head and stares straight ahead.;
%20 emote raises his fist and says 'Honor the Fallen ones.'

mobs.Name: deathknight knight
mobs.LongDescription: A ragged old knight wanders around here.
mobs.Description:
A ancient knight in very torn clothes. You can barely make out the
sign of his family. A grim looking raven over a burning field. Then all
of a sudden he turns to face you. You get quite a shock as the hollow
eyes of the man looks you over.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 groan;
%30 moan

mobs.Name: deathknight knight
mobs.LongDescription: A bony knight is here, swaying in the wind.
mobs.Description:
This very thin character is having obvious problems standing straight
in the strong wind. You wonder how long before it topples over. Then
all of a sudden, a strong gust of air blows in from the north, and the
knight falls to the ground. You reach out to give a hand, but as a
skeletal hand reaches out to grab it, you pull back in sheer fear.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote sways unsteadily in the wind.;
%5 emote catches the wind and crashes with a loud KAKAKABOOM!

mobs.Name: deathknight knight wyneh
mobs.LongDescription: A very thin and fragile looking knight wobbles around on unsteady legs.
mobs.Description:
A extremely thin looking knight stands in front of you. Torn clothes
and ruined armor is what he is wearing. He, since you recognize his 
herald as Sir Wyneh's. A black rose on a snowcovered field. But, he
died a long time ago. Songs have been sung about his heroic death.
Then he removes his helmet, revealing a skeletal head with empty eye
sockets staring back at you, filling you with fear.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote removes his helmet and glares icily at you.;
%30 emote stares coldly at you, leaving you shivering with fear.

mobs.Name: deathknight knight lord gaheen
mobs.LongDescription: A tall knight, exudes power and ancient evil.
mobs.Description:
A tall broadshouldered knight all dressed up in well kept armor. He 
looks you over carefully and fear takes hold of you, as the eerie
hollow eyes of the deathknight fall upon you. Lord Gaheen, a legendary
warrior, who fought for days in the front line, and fell beneath foul
necromancer magic. Now, he walks the earth again, 'thanks' to the same
magic that killed him.

mobs.Name: necromancer character
mobs.LongDescription: A black clad character is chanting wicked hymns to awaken the dead.
mobs.Description:
A night black cloak covers this character. You can't see anything
beneath the cloak, except for a pair of eyes that seem to glow with a
fierce red color from time to time.

mobs.Name: necromancer character man lord
mobs.LongDescription: A grim looking man, dressed in black cloaks, grins wickedly at you.
mobs.Description:
A grim looking man dressed in black cloaks, covered with golden runes.
As he sees you, he looks amused. Probably thinking you are pathetic.
Then all of a sudden he stands up, stretches his arms straight up
towards the sky, and shouts some guttural words. Lightning strikes his
fists, and he begins laughing. You start looking for a way out...

mobs.Name: graverobber thief
mobs.LongDescription: A thin crooked thief is sneaking around here, digging for the dead.
mobs.Description:
A thin looking character, with a very crooked back. You wonder, if the
back is a result of carrying lots of corpses and coffins. Where ever
something glimmers, the thief is as well. Checking for valuables.
Digging here and there, trying to find a corpse...a treasure.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote begins digging for treasure.;
%30 steal gold mourner

mobs.Name: graverobber thief looter
mobs.LongDescription: A small thief stalks the area, looting the dead.
mobs.Description:
A small thief with a thick hooded cloak covering its face. Where ever
something glimmers, this thief will be checking for valuables. Looting
the dead, stealing their treasures, thinking 'They are dead, so they
won't need it.'
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote loots a corpse, while giggling happily.;
%30 steal gold mourner

mobs.Name: vampire man
mobs.LongDescription: A tall man stands here, gazing towards the sky.
mobs.Description:
A tall man with a clean shaved head, all dressed up in black flowing
robes. A peace fills you, but at the same time fear fills you. He
raises his head, looks you over and smiles. You try to turn and run,
but fear paralyzes you. In the faint moonlight, his fangs glimmer and
you feel a terrible cold seep into you.

mobs.Name: beast
mobs.LongDescription: A large beast is preying on victims here.
mobs.Description:
A large beast, best described as a hybrid of a bear and a cobra. A very
long body that trails behind the huge 'upper' body. Two large muscular
arms, covered with fur. And claws, lots of long lethal looking claws.
Not to mention the fangs...

mobs.Name: priestess
mobs.LongDescription: A priestess wanders around here, sanctifying the area.
mobs.Description:
A white clad character. A priestess judging by the holy symbols painted
on the clothes. Wandering around, giving blessings and sanctifying the 
battlefield.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote blesses you.;
%30 say May The Creator protect the fallen.

mobs.Name: monk
mobs.LongDescription: A brownrobed monk watches the field, wondering 'Why?'.
mobs.Description:
A monk with thick brown woolen robes. Hands are up in the sleeves and
he moves slowly while reciting holy scripts and incantations. But
still, you admire this man of peace, who can remain so calm in such a
wicked place.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 say You are forgiven, my friend.;
%30 say Walk in peace, my friend.

mobs.Name: cleric woman
mobs.LongDescription: A woman stands in front of you, smiling warmly at you.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the clerics who attend the blessings, keep up the wards
that keep evil away from this battlefield. She is wearing grey-white 
robes, and a small holy symbol is hanging around her neck. A soft glow
seems to shroud her.

mobs.Name: paladin warrior priest
mobs.LongDescription: A shining warrior priest watches you intently.
mobs.Description:
A paladin! One of the warrior priests. One, dedicated to destroy evil,
to live by and uphold the laws. Master in fighting, adept in magic.
Seeker and destroyer of evil.

mobs.Name: knight guardian
mobs.LongDescription: A grim looking knight is on guard here.
mobs.Description:
A knight with highly polished armor is here, looking grim and proud at
the same time. This is a guardian of the shrines. A guardian of the
altars where visitors may pray. Nothing but death could stop him from
performing his duty.

mobs.Name: bard man
mobs.LongDescription: A thin but very handsome man is here, reciting poems.
mobs.Description:
A red embroidered cape is wrapped around the handsome young man before
you. A small lute can be seen strapped across his back. A bard you
think. A bard, who has come here to write stories for the world.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote recites some poetry.;
%30 emote sings a soft song for the fallen.

mobs.Name: priest highpriest
mobs.LongDescription: Blessed by the gods themselves, The High Priest protects the fallen.
mobs.Description:
A feeling of purification washes over you as you look upon this man.
A soft blue glow can be seen around him, this old man with the warm and
very comforting smile. He is the high priest, the one who blesses and
sanctifies all the tombs every day.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 smile;
%30 emote looks at you, and smiles warmly.

mobs.Name: mourner man
mobs.LongDescription: A man is kneeling here, crying in his hands.
mobs.Description:
A mid age man, who is full of sadness and pain. Crying, letting his
tears fall on the ground. Soothing his pain. Trying to forget AND
remember the lost one.

mobs.Name: mourner woman
mobs.LongDescription: Clutching her fists, the woman screams in pain and sorrow.
mobs.Description:
A old woman, torn apart by grief and sorrow of the one she lost here.
A close family member perhaps. At least, someone who was very close to
her. Tears roll down her cheeks and only time will ease the pain.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 cry;
%30 emote shouts out her pain and sorrow.

mobs.Name: zombie man dead
mobs.LongDescription: A very decayed man, shambles around here.
mobs.Description:
It's a small miracle this...'thing' actually lives. At least, when you
consider how decayed it really is. Bones can be seen sticking out
everywhere and worms are crawling all over it.

mobs.Name: zombie woman dead
mobs.LongDescription: A woman is rotting right before your eyes.
mobs.Description:
It's a small miracle this...'thing' actually lives. At least, when you
consider how decayed it really is. Bones can be seen sticking out
everywhere and worms are crawling all over it.

mobs.Name: dracolich undead dragon
mobs.LongDescription: A huge undead dragon is resting here.
mobs.Description:
Not a single bit of flesh can be seen on the huge skeletal body of the
long dead dragon - The Dracolich. A being created by powerful magic,
to hold and wield powerful magic.

mobs.Name: king man el'egainon
mobs.LongDescription: A man wearing a fancy coat, and a nice looking crown is praying here.
mobs.Description:
King El'Egainon, Ruler of a far away kingdom. He lost his only child
in the battle. And at once, you wonder, how old are they?
The battlefield is ancient, what does that make them? He is wearing a
very nice looking crown and coat, cleary stating him as a rich and 
important man.

mobs.Name: tomb guardian warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A tall warrior stands here, proudly guarding the fallen.
mobs.Description:
A tall warrior, clad in a finely woven chainmail shirt. As you look
upon the guardian, you feel how feelings of pride fill him. Proud to
guard the tombs of the fallen heroes. The ones who turned the events
of the battle into their favor.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote raises his head and stares straight ahead.;
%20 emote raises his fist and says 'Honor the Fallen ones.'

mobs.Name: rat
mobs.LongDescription: A giant rat is here chewing on some bones.
mobs.Description:
This looks like an ordinary rat, but it is far much larger.  It's red eyes
don't show nothing but hunger.

mobs.Name: skeleton
mobs.LongDescription: A skeleton scrambles slowly around here.
mobs.Description:
The skeleton still have parts of old dirty clothes on it, but the flesh
seems to have long ago vanished.

mobs.Name: necro necromancer
mobs.LongDescription: A necromancer is here looking for spare parts.
mobs.Description: Black robes cover him or her.  You can't be sure which in the dark.

mobs.Name: zombie
mobs.LongDescription: A zombie smells your living flesh and shambles towards you.
mobs.Description: Rotten flesh and old molded clothes covers this foul evil creature.

mobs.Name: ghoul
mobs.LongDescription: A ghoul that hates living things is here waiting.
mobs.Description: Rotten flesh and old molded clothes covers this foul evil creature.

mobs.Name: troglodyte trog
mobs.LongDescription: A large troglodyte pounces on you from behind a stone!
mobs.Description:
An ugly troglodtye with large yellow teeth stands here, preparing to make you
into a meal for the whole family. He eyes your weapons and armor greedily.

mobs.Name: lieutenant trog troglodyte
mobs.LongDescription: A troglodyte lieutenant stands here, ording others about.
mobs.Description: He is in complete control here.

mobs.Name: cave spider
mobs.LongDescription: The cave spider hangs nimbly from the webby roof.
mobs.Description:
The spider's hard exoskeleton is covered with an oily substance that keeps its
sticky webs from clinging to it. It is large and quite dangerous looking.

mobs.Name: trapper
mobs.LongDescription: A gigantic trapper engulfs you from the floor below!
mobs.Description: It looks exactly like the floor it mimics.

mobs.Name: troglodyte trog evil
mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte attacks you with a yell!
mobs.Description:
He is dirty, and covered in grime and dried blood, some of which is apparently
his own. He doesn't look particularly well fed, but would like to take this
opportunity to improve that situation.

mobs.Name: troglodyte guard trog
mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte guardsman defends his post from all invaders.
mobs.Description:
They guard their post diligently, fighting off all who would attack their
homeland and pose a threat to the survival of their people. Each is armored
and carries a sharp weapon.

mobs.Name: troglodyte teen trog
mobs.LongDescription: The young troglodyte rests here between training sessions.
mobs.Description:
He looks at you with alarm. He isn't sure whether he should stay and fight, or
run. He scrambles for his weapons, just in case...

mobs.Name: troglodyte adolescent student trog
mobs.LongDescription: The young troglodyte is bashing his fellows with abandon.
mobs.Description: He looks at his battlemaster, who urges him to slay you.

mobs.Name: troglodyte trog battlemaster
mobs.LongDescription: The battlemaster screams at his pupils to attack, then assaults you himself.
mobs.Description:
He is extremely large, and is covered with battlescars. His armor is nice, and
is finely polished, as is his sword, which is sharp and wicked looking.

mobs.Name: troglodyte trog clansman
mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte clansman cries for aid as he defends his homeland.
mobs.Description:
He looks like an ordinary troglodyte, about six feet tall, weighing slightly
less than two hundred pounds. He is well armored, and carries a sharp weapon.

mobs.Name: troglodyte trog clansman
mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte clansman is here, foraging for food.
mobs.Description:
He looks like an ordinary troglodyte, about six feet tall, weighing slightly
less than two hundred pounds. He is well armored, and carries a sharp weapon.

mobs.Name: tunnel rat
mobs.LongDescription: There is a tunnel rat here, running for its life.
mobs.Description:
It is trying desperately to avoid becoming a troglodyte meal, like others of
its kind. It edges away as you approach.

mobs.Name: troglodyte cook trog
mobs.LongDescription: A troglodyte cook is here, slaving over an pot of tunnel rat stew.
mobs.Description:
She looks at you as if you would make an excellent addition to the stew. Given
the large knife she brandishes at you, you think she just might do it, too.

mobs.Name: troglodyte shaman trog
mobs.LongDescription: A troglodyte shaman is here, mumbling incantations.
mobs.Description:
She curses you, lifting aloft the small humanoid skull around her neck. The
incantations spewing from her mouth send shivers down your spine.

mobs.Name: troglodyte chief trog
mobs.LongDescription: The great chief of the troglodytes is here, regarding you dispassionately.
mobs.Description:
He is the largest troglodyte you've ever seen. He is covered with battle scars.
He looks at you with resignation, and slowly pulls out his great sword for
battle.

mobs.Name: golgar god
mobs.LongDescription: Golgar, the mighty god of the troglodytes, prepares to smite you.
mobs.Description:
This lordly figure is like a troglodyte, only on a larger scale. He must be
twenty feet tall. Golgar wears no armor and holds no weapon - his skin looks li
from solid granite. You feel a tremendous urge to grovel in supplication before
but this is slightly weaker than your urge to run in terror.

mobs.Name: troglodyte clanswoman trog
mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte clanswoman is here, crushing bone to paste.
mobs.Description: She doesn't appear to think much or your company.

mobs.Name: troglodyte matron trog
mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte matron is here, watching over the young.
mobs.Description: She would kill you just for *thinking* about touching one of the little ones.

mobs.Name: troglodyte clanswoman trog
mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte clanswoman is here, getting some needed rest.
mobs.Description: She looks annoyed and frightened at your intrusion.

mobs.Name: troglodyte young trog
mobs.LongDescription: The young troglodyte is annoying the adults here.
mobs.Description: It ceases all such activity when you enter, and attacks you dutifully.

mobs.Name: troglodyte infant trog
mobs.LongDescription: The infant troglodyte is here, waddling around and acting cute.
mobs.Description: It's too young to understand the concept of killing.

mobs.Name: lieutenant trog troglodyte
mobs.LongDescription: The chief's lieutenants snarl and attack.
mobs.Description: They hope to impress their leader with your swift destruction.

mobs.Name: troglodyte trog clansman
mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte clansman jumps up from his nap with a yell!
mobs.Description: He doesn't seem to like having been interrupted.

mobs.Name: hatchling dragon baby
mobs.LongDescription: A dragon hatchling is here, chewing on a bone.
mobs.Description:
This small dragon hisses at you as you enter the room.  Although it is only a
few feet long, its sharp teeth make you think twice about petting it.

mobs.Name: draconian
mobs.LongDescription: The Draconian is standing here.
mobs.Description:
This horrible creature is a bizarre cross between a man and a dragon.  He 
has black scales and a seven foot wingspan.  He scowls at you and hefts his 
spear as you enter the room.

mobs.Name: master
mobs.LongDescription: The lord of this crypt is here.
mobs.Description: He doesn't look happy to see you.

mobs.Name: man mage wizard
mobs.LongDescription: A man is here, studying some books.
mobs.Description:
A powerful looking mage is standing in this room studying his spells.  You are
surprised at the fact that he is human, and realize that he must be very
powerful to have been accepted by the creatures which live here.

mobs.Name: cleric draconian
mobs.LongDescription: A Draconian is here, deep in thought.
mobs.Description:
A Draconian stands here, dressed in simple robes.  Around his neck you 
notice a golden medallion in the shape of a five headed dragon.

mobs.Name: king draconian
mobs.LongDescription: A Draconian wearing fine clothes is here, pondering his greatness.
mobs.Description:
The king of the draconians sits here on a golden throne.  He looks as 
though he could crush your head with a single blow.  Yet you sense that he 
is controlled by a greater power.

mobs.Name: concubine draconian
mobs.LongDescription: A concubine is resting here.
mobs.Description:
This is a concubine of the king.  She is lounging here, wearing nothing at 
all.  You find yourself strangely repulsed as she draws a knife and 
prepares to defend herself.

mobs.Name: bodyguard draconian
mobs.LongDescription: A bodyguard is here, staring at you menacingly.
mobs.Description:
This creature has devoted its life to defending the king.  Your intrusion has
not pleased it.

mobs.Name: tiamat dragon
mobs.LongDescription: A five headed dragon hisses at you as you enter this room.
mobs.Description:
You see before you the master of this Tower, Tiamat.  She frowns at you as she
prepares to make you pay for your insolence ... with your lives!

mobs.Name: dragon red
mobs.LongDescription: A red dragon is here, contemplating your existence.
mobs.Description:
This huge red dragon dominates the chamber.  As you turn to flee, he grins at
you and invites you to stay ... forever!

mobs.Name: dragon black
mobs.LongDescription: A black dragon is here, laughing at your insolence.
mobs.Description:
This huge black wyrm laughs at your puny weapons.  You realize that he is not
going to roll over and die for you.

mobs.Name: dragon white
mobs.LongDescription: A white dragon is here, waiting for you.
mobs.Description:
This dragon towers over you.  Recalling your previous experiences with white
dragons, you are not afraid.  She smiles at you and says 'I think you will find
me a greater challenge than my offspring.'

mobs.Name: dragon green
mobs.LongDescription: A green dragon is here, looking distraught.
mobs.Description:
This huge beast appears to be the most directly related to the draconians. 
She looks at you with sorrow in her eyes and says 'You have slaughtered my 
children.  Prepare to die.'

mobs.Name: hydra
mobs.LongDescription: A hydra is here, blocking the doorway.
mobs.Description:
A hydra is here, guarding the entrance to a sealed vault.  You have the feeling
it isn't happy to see you.

mobs.Name: slave human
mobs.LongDescription: A Human slave is here, hard at work.
mobs.Description:
He looks like he's under a lot of stress.  He would probably like it if you
left him alone.

mobs.Name: zombie draconian
mobs.LongDescription: A Draconian zombie is here, staring at nothing in particular.
mobs.Description:
This used to be one of the warriors of this tribe.  He was denied his final
rest, however, and now guards this corridor tirelessly as a zombie.

mobs.Name: dragon phase
mobs.LongDescription: A Phase Dragon is darting around the room.
mobs.Description: This small dragon looks like he's up to no good.

mobs.Name: fool draconian
mobs.LongDescription: A Fool is here, making fun of you.
mobs.Description:
This dragon man looks VERY foolish, dressed in a green and blue striped 
suit.  As you enter the room, he points at you and laughs.

mobs.Name: queen draconian
mobs.LongDescription: A Female Draconian sits, here, looking very important.
mobs.Description:
This draconian looks VERY busy as she orders her slaves around.  You think 
it might be a good idea to leave her alone.

mobs.Name: attendant immortal shopkeeper DOPclan
mobs.LongDescription: The Immortal Attendant lives only to serve you.
mobs.Description:
The Attendant is humanoid in shape, with sallow grey skin, and
large black eyes. He looks at you with a mixture of awe and 
fear. He has been brought across space and time by the rulers 
of the #MDragoons #wof #CPhos#N to serve their clan for eternity.

mobs.Name: gargoyle soldier garg
mobs.LongDescription: A Gargoyle soldier watches you fiercely.
mobs.Description:
He's big, tough and mean.  His wingspan is at least 10'
making him look even more mean.

mobs.Name: gargoyle guard male
mobs.LongDescription: A gargoyle stands here patroling the castle.
mobs.Description:
His deep red eyes make you want to back off, it looks
like he doesn't have to answer to anyone.

mobs.Name: female gargoyle garg
mobs.LongDescription: A busty gargoyle in torn clothes struts seductively here.
mobs.Description: She has long black flowing hair, and is very well proportioned.

mobs.Name: rat osquip
mobs.LongDescription: A giant six-legged rat creeps around here.
mobs.Description:
It's ugly, it's big, it's got big teeth, and six legs.
But worst of all it looks hungry.

mobs.Name: corpse rotting dead undead
mobs.LongDescription: A cellmate's corpse rises again.
mobs.Description:
Once the body of an unfortunate prisoner, who met his doom,
and is now a blue-faced, rotting corpse.

mobs.Name: giant tarantula spider
mobs.LongDescription: A tarantula of immense proportions drops down in front of you.
mobs.Description:
One of the ugliest tarantulas you've ever seen, with
long black-orange hair, and two big fangs.

mobs.Name: demona female gargoyle garg
mobs.LongDescription: Demona, leader of the Gargoyles stands here overlooking her minions.
mobs.Description:
With fiery red hair, and a dazzling evil grin, Demona,
is a knockout killer.

mobs.Name: spider tarantula small
mobs.LongDescription: A hairy tarantula crawls by your feet.
mobs.Description:
The tarantula is as big as your foot and has eight
eyes looking at you!

mobs.Name: satan satanic small
mobs.LongDescription: A little satanic creature tries to claw you!
mobs.Description:
It looks like the ones you'd find in hell but this
one could give you a thrashing.

mobs.Name: elder garg gargoyle
mobs.LongDescription: A wise looking gargoyle sits in the corner.
mobs.Description:
His scars prove he was once a magnificent warrior.
Now he looks old and frail.  But with age comes wisdom.

mobs.Name: gremlin
mobs.LongDescription: A dirty evil looking gremlin is leashed to the wall here.
mobs.Description:
The gremlin is purely evil and snarls at you.  You should help it by ending its
life.

mobs.Name: skeleton bones
mobs.LongDescription: A Skeleton attacks you!
mobs.Description:
It is a humanoid undead. Made of bones and wearing torn and dirty clothes.
It has no eyes but can still see even in the dark. The monster is like a
machine with only one intent... to harm all that is living.

mobs.Name: vampire vamp
mobs.LongDescription: A Vampire grins evilly at you with sharp white fangs.
mobs.Description: This is a vampire, a poweful undead that drinks the blood of its victims.

mobs.Name: vladamir vampire vamp count
mobs.LongDescription: Count Vladamir grins evilly at you with sharp white fangs.
mobs.Description:
This is a the master of vampires, Count Vladamir. He wears a cloak of
black that he uses to hide his features. He is tall and muscular. Driplets
of blood drop from his white fangs.

mobs.Name: wraith
mobs.LongDescription: A Wraith is here.
mobs.Description:
This undead is more shadow than anything else. It is so black that you
can not make out its features.

mobs.Name: swordwraith
mobs.LongDescription: A Wraith is here.
mobs.Description:
This undead is more shadow than anything else. It is so black that you
can not make out its features. This is the undead form of an evil Paladin.
He also wears armor and wields a sword.

mobs.Name: skeleton warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A Skeleton with sword in hand, attacks you!
mobs.Description:
This collection of walking bones has a sword in its hand that it is waving
at you!

mobs.Name: ghoul
mobs.LongDescription: A Ghoul is here.
mobs.Description:
This foul smelling creature barely notices that you are here and doesn't
seem to care.

mobs.Name: ghost
mobs.LongDescription: The ethereal Ghost is here.
mobs.Description:
You can see right through this undead.
 Your weapons pass right through it too.

mobs.Name: zombie
mobs.LongDescription: A Zombie stands here.
mobs.Description:
The zombie is a foul looking undead creature.  It wears wormridden clothes
and has various maggots, worms, and flies crawling all over it.  Its mouth is
sewn shut.  Its eyes are wormridden empty sockets that still seem to find you
in the dark.

mobs.Name: zombie guardian
mobs.LongDescription: The Zombie Guardian stands here.
mobs.Description:
This putrid looking undead is covered with all sorts of maggots and worms.
He wears a pendant of some sort about his neck and holds what looks like an
hourglass in one hand.

mobs.Name: spectre
mobs.LongDescription: A Spectre is here.
mobs.Description: This ghost like undead attacks as soon as it sees you.

mobs.Name: graverobber
mobs.LongDescription: A Graverobber hides in the shadows.
mobs.Description:
This grubby human carries a shovel and hooded lantern. He is searching
the graveyard for the largest gravestones where the richest corpses lie.

mobs.Name: general patton
mobs.LongDescription: General Patton is here.
mobs.Description: The war hero.

mobs.Name: fat fryer
mobs.LongDescription: A Fat Fryer stands here.
mobs.Description:
This cleric stands ready to bless all who enter here. He is a jolly fat
man with balding pate and a short beard. He holds a bottle of ale in one
hand and a mace in the other. A key is thrust under his belt.

mobs.Name: dracolich
mobs.LongDescription: A Dracolich is here.
mobs.Description:
This undead creature is the animated remains of a large dragon. Most of
its former flesh and hide is gone to reveal its white bony skeleton.

mobs.Name: igon lich
mobs.LongDescription: The Lich Igon is here.
mobs.Description: What a nice lich.

mobs.Name: steel spike
mobs.LongDescription: A steel spike.
mobs.Description: It seems to move as if it were alive.

mobs.Name: mummy
mobs.LongDescription: An undead mummy lies here.
mobs.Description: He is very pretty wrapped in toilet paper.

mobs.Name: nameless hero
mobs.LongDescription: The Nameless Undead Hero walks the earth.
mobs.Description:
This undead creature was once a great hero but now she roams the graveyard
and protects all the graves therein. To her you are an intruder.

mobs.Name: wyvern
mobs.LongDescription: A monstrous wyvern slowly circles just above your head.
mobs.Description:
This huge winged creature looks really menacing as it circles only inches
above your head, flapping its wings and squawking very loudly.

mobs.Name: goblin
mobs.LongDescription: A mountain goblin is wandering around mumbling to himself...
mobs.Description:
You see before you a small and twisted creature with knotted muscles and
disgustingly green skin.  Doesn't look like the type you'd invite to dinner.

mobs.Name: ogre gang member
mobs.LongDescription: A member of the Ogres wanders about here.
mobs.Description: He's lived a life of violence ever since he was little.

mobs.Name: troll gang member
mobs.LongDescription: A member of the Trolls wanders about here.
mobs.Description: He wants to rid the world of every last Ogre gang member.

mobs.Name: gang leader
mobs.LongDescription: The gang leader is not pleased you found his hideout!
mobs.Description: He's risen to be leader through brute force and cunning leadership.

mobs.Name: bruiser
mobs.LongDescription: A big, mean bruiser is looking for limbs to break.
mobs.Description: He's 6'6" 245 pounds and enough muscle to bash your head in.

mobs.Name: doll
mobs.LongDescription: A gang doll looks naughty and nice.
mobs.Description: She's a beauty (ok in RELATIVE terms) but you better not touch!

mobs.Name: patrolman patrol man
mobs.LongDescription: A patrolman is trying to keep the peace.
mobs.Description: He'd rather be at the local pub then out here with these nasty kids.

mobs.Name: vandal
mobs.LongDescription: A vandal is spray painting pro-gang slogans on the wall here.
mobs.Description: He has a wary eye and a fine hand for art.

mobs.Name: dog pit bull pitbull
mobs.LongDescription: A vicious pitbull is foaming at the mouth in rabid anticipation.
mobs.Description:
You get a nice close look at him while he's tearing at your throat.
His fangs are blood-stained from hearty meals of ... steak?!

mobs.Name: adjudicator romemob
mobs.LongDescription: An adjudicator is watching the games intently.
mobs.Description:
The adjudicator is a retired gladiator.  Scars cover all exposed
parts of his body.  Although he is getting on in years, he remains
healthy and fit.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 peer

mobs.Name: scorekeeper romemob
mobs.LongDescription:
A scorekeeper places another marker on the stone as the horses pass the
turning point.
mobs.Description:
The scorekeeper is a young man of about twenty-five years of age who is
very intently watching the race.  As the horses past the easternmost
point of the racetrack, he places another marker up where everyone can
see it.  After seven laps, the race is done.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 pose

mobs.Name: tribune romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Representing the poorest of Romans, the tribune fights for their rights.
mobs.Description:
A man of medium height with blond hair, green eyes, and a very white
toga worn over a deep blue tunic, the tribune has an honest face.  This,
you think, is a man you would trust.  Too bad you are about to stab him
in the back.

mobs.Name: spectator fan romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A spectator is filthy, half drunk and screaming his head off.
mobs.Description:
The spectator loves the blood and gore and death of the games.  He says
it's a chance for the gladiators to show their bravery and to die the
glorious death of combat.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote screams "Kill!!!!" at the top of his lungs.

mobs.Name: patrician romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A patrician looks down at you from dark gray eyes.
mobs.Description:
The patrician is dressed in fine clothes and jewelry and has a very
snobbish attitude.  While he is getting old and his hair and beard
are streaked with gray, he is by no means an easy target.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 em refuses to notice your unworthy presence.

mobs.Name: slave romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A slave busies herself with small tasks, hoping not to be noticed.
mobs.Description:
This very pretty young woman was captured when the Roman legions
subjugated her land.  She is quiet, dark, with brown hair and eyes and
very dark skin.  She is hoping to buy her freedom some day, and has
been looking about for business opportunities that won't take time from
her work.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 hum

mobs.Name: gladiator romemob
mobs.LongDescription: There is a gladiator standing here.
mobs.Description:
This well muscled man is very heavily armored and armed to the
teeth.  He lives for combat, and has become a "star" of the arena.  He
has bribed the games' patron to match him up always with someone that
he can kill, but someone who will show off his skill.  He grows rich
with gifts from admiring fans.
mobs.ActionScript: %%50 kill victim

mobs.Name: driver romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The chariot driver eyes you as if wondering how fast you can run.
mobs.Description:
You see a very slight and small individual whose whole life is
centered around nothing but horses and speed.  His only goal in life at
the moment is to get to the end of the track before anyone else.  If
that means trampling you into the dust, that is but a small price to
pay.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote yells, "Hey! You! Get outta da way!"
;%5 emote yells, "Hey! Meatballs for brains! You wanna get yourself
killed??"

mobs.Name: coach trainer romemob
mobs.LongDescription: There is a coach standing here, going over last minute strategy.
mobs.Description:
A lot of gold rides on the outcome of each race.  As long as yours is
the first chariot over the finish line, it doesn't matter if you are in
it.  The coach talks to the charioteers about how to scream around the
bend on one wheel, how to get the most out of their horses, but not
about how to stay alive in the circus.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote eyes you suspiciously, sure you are trying to steal his
strategy.

mobs.Name: healer romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The healer gives you wine to dull the pain.  This is gonna hurt!
mobs.Description:
This young man is still learning about healing.  He has studied at the
temple of Aesculpius, but was not one of the brighter students.  He
seems to have a large number of very sharp instruments on him, which
does not reassure you.

mobs.Name: herbalist romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful young woman carries herbs to help the healer.
mobs.Description:
The herbalist is a very beautiful young woman who is about 22 years
old.  She  has deep brown eyes and shoulder-length chestnut hair.
Her body is perfectly proportioned and she stands about 5' 5" tall.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Titus's shopkeeper is minding the store while he is away.
mobs.Description:
The shopkeeper is an older man in his middle to late fifties and
looks like he enjoys the quiet life.  There is a long scar running
from the edge of his mouth to his right ear, making it look like he
is always smiling.

mobs.Name: peddler romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A poor peddler is trying to support his meager existence.
mobs.Description:
The small, dirty man doesn't look very healthy.  He lives life on the
street.  He does get an occasional bath in the public baths and always
lines up for the entertainments on "public day" at the circus and the
Colosseum, but mostly you will see him wandering around, selling his
oranges, apples and hot chestnuts.

mobs.Name: page romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A page stands here, waiting to run an errand.
mobs.Description:
You see a young boy who looks very strong and very fast.  He has the
look of a scholar about him.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 wiggle

mobs.Name: plaintiff romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The plaintiff works hard to prove his case.
mobs.Description:
The son of a very wealthy senator, the plaintiff has accused the
defendant of not returning some very expensive jewelry to him after they
were no longer lovers.

mobs.Name: master romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A ticket master is looking at you expectantly.
mobs.Description:
This ticket master expects you to spend 1 gold coin to buy a ticket so
that you can enter the entertainment.  I would not attack him if I were
you!  You would most assuredly die.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say Buy a ticket!!

mobs.Name: vendor romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A street vendor sells overpriced sausages and wine.
mobs.Description:
The vendor is a scruffy looking man who isn't afraid of a fight.  His
sausages are rather stringy, but filling, and the wine is sweetly
intoxicating.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 yell "Sausages! Hot and spicy! Get your sausages while they last!"

mobs.Name: citizen romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A citizen of Rome, well wrapped in his toga, goes about his business.
mobs.Description:
At the top of the social heap, this citizen is healthy and in great
physical shape.  As you are NOT a citizen, he ignores you as a
non-person.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 stare

mobs.Name: gateguard guard romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A gateguard stands here, tending the gate.
mobs.Description:
Clad in light armor, the gateguard makes sure only the right people are
allowed into Rome.  He also strictly enforces the "no cart" policy.
The streets have become so congested that no carts are allowed within
the city walls until after sunset.

mobs.Name: soldier romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A soldier on leave is walking around looking for entertainment.
mobs.Description:
You see a member of one of the republic's elite legions.  He looks
VERY strong.  You have this vague feeling that his entertainment
isn't going to be a very wholesome activity.

mobs.Name: soldier roman romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The soldier trains hard, preparing for the summer campaigns.
mobs.Description:
A short, strong young man with deep brown hair and twinkling green eyes,
he is quite serious about his training.  When his century goes to war,
he will be required to carry heavy packs on long marches, then build the
camp at the end of a long day.  He will fight valiantly or be killed by
his own commander.

mobs.Name: guard bodyguard romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The bodyguard stands ready to die for the praetor, if necessary.
mobs.Description:
The bodyguard is dressed in the finest of armor and wields only the
deadliest  of weapons.  He is very strong and would put up one hell
of a fight.  He has been trained to be suspicious of all but the most
innocent visitors, and likely to take offense of anyone with less
than pure intentions.

mobs.Name: judge justice romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The judge takes his time consulting a lengthy scroll on law.
mobs.Description:
Neatly trimmed gray hair surrounds a weathered and not-too-wise looking
face.  The judge bought his position in return for a hefty donation to
the city treasury, and he will be well-remunerated for his work by the
cases brought before him.

mobs.Name: master scheduler romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The master scheduler keeps careful track of the trial schedule.
mobs.Description:
A studious, elderly man of Greek origin, the master scheduler has
responsibilities to keep detailed records of court cases.  He does not
like to be disturbed when he is working.

mobs.Name: slimeball slime ball green romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A green ball of slime is hanging over you, oozing downward.
mobs.Description:
There is a green ball of slime oozing from the coating on the
walls.  It appears to have a life of its own, and it appears NOT to
like intruders.

mobs.Name: Frobozz romemob
mobs.LongDescription: FrobozZ the wizard mutters to herself as she perfects a new spell.
mobs.Description:
Well, she's gone through a lot of dumb apprentices, and she's 
damned cranky.  Her knowledge of magic, both offensive and
defensive, is as legendary as her fashion sense, however.  You 
think you would be really stylin' in her robe.  I don't think 
she'd just *give* it to you, however.

mobs.Name: senator romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The senator strides about, looking important.
mobs.Description:
Well, of course, he IS important.  A man in his early 40s, he will tell
you he is in the prime of his life.  He rises early every morning to
order his household, then heads off to the office.  Afternoons are
devoted to indulgences and socializing at the baths, then the evenings
are entertaining with (important) friends.

mobs.Name: bailiff romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The bailiff keeps order in the courtroom.
mobs.Description:
Although he's not a very important man in social ranks, the bailiff is
very strong ... massively strong, actually ... and not at all afraid to
use his strength to subdue unruly spectators or others who disrupt the
orderly proceedings in this courtroom.

mobs.Name: defendant romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The defendant pleads her case without much hope.
mobs.Description:
During her lengthy love affair with the unprincipled son of a wealthy
senator, he gave her many valuable pieces of jewelry, as is the custom.
Now, having found another lover, he wants the expensive items returned.

mobs.Name: jupiter romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Jupiter, King of the Gods, smiles benignly at his worshipers.
mobs.Description:
He is the strongest of the Gods, and certainly no easy mark!  His
powers transcend the plane of the physical, and could easily kill an
unprepared mortal.  Yes, even you.

mobs.Name: Venus romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Venus, the Goddess of Love and Beauty, ignores your unworthy presence.
mobs.Description:
The most beautiful woman you have ever seen stands before you.
Actually, she towers over you.  Perfectly proportioned, yet at 10'
(over 3m) tall, she is also the largest woman you have ever seen.  And
perhaps the strongest.

mobs.Name: Mars romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Mars, the God of War and State, is resting here.
mobs.Description:
Husband to Venus and father of Rhea Silvia, mother of the founders of
Rome, Mars watches over this training field for Rome's soldiers, and he
accepts frequent tribute from them.

mobs.Name: Mercury romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Mercury, looks out at you slyly from under his wrinkled brow.
mobs.Description:
God of tradesmen and thieves, and Jupiter's messenger, Mercury's priests
and priestesses have grown quite wealthy on the tithes of roman
businessmen and traders.  Once a year on the 12th of August a portion of
this wealth is returned to the citizens in the form of a banquet.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Frobozz's shopkeeper is here, minding the store.
mobs.Description:
The shopkeeper is an older man in his middle to late fifties and
looks like he enjoys the quiet life.  There is a long scar running
from the edge of his mouth to his right ear, making it look like he
is always smiling.

mobs.Name: lion romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The scrawny tawny lion yawns, letting you see his sharp teeth.
mobs.Description:
Oooh!  The breath on this lion is enough to kill you!  He looks like he
hasn't eaten in days.  His claws are still nice and sharp, though, and I
bet he has all those great feline skills.

mobs.Name: grocer romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A grocer stands at the counter with a slightly impatient look.
mobs.Description:
A tall grocer, who moves two 200 pounds bag of flour around on his
shoulders.

mobs.Name: gardener romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The gardener glares at you as you tromp through his flower bed.
mobs.Description:
A tall, lean, fit slave with callused hands and skin brown from
countless hours in the Roman sunlight, the gardener enjoys his work.
Tread lightly and watch your step, for if you hurt his plants you'll
have to answer to him!

mobs.Name: fuller romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The fuller stares at your filthy tunic. Do you think he's a magician?
mobs.Description:
Appearances are important to those who aspire to high political
office in Rome.  And all Roman citizens do.  A toga should be
pristine, without a stain.  The men who wear them should look young,
athletic, tanned and healthy.  The fuller's job is to clean togas and
other garments to maintain that image, but it's a pretty hard job
with no soap!

mobs.Name: Norseman guards romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The tall fair Norseman stares stonily at you.
mobs.Description:
Tall, brawny and very fierce, this Norseman came to pillage and
decided to stay and work.  He is paid a hefty fee by the jeweler to
stand at the entrance to the store and frighten would-be thieves.
His size alone is a major deterrent to crime!

mobs.Name: functionary worker workers one romemob
mobs.LongDescription: One of many hundreds of government workers stands before you.
mobs.Description:
A busy little man, the functionary has a small wiry body and an air
of constant nervous energy.  His main joy in life is found in getting
in your face, and he is liable to call out the city guards if you
give him any lip!

mobs.Name: praetor petyus romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Praetor Petyus drops the white flag to start the races.
mobs.Description:
I wouldn't bother the Praetor at the moment.  He's very busy with
matters of state, and he is a very important man.  The Praetor is, of
course, tanned and fit, and well trained in martial arts.

mobs.Name: Bacchus romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The god of wine, song and fertility invites you to party on with him.
mobs.Description:
Bacchus is large, as befits a god, with an aura of sensuality about
him.  His wide forehead slopes to a long straight nose separating two
large gray eyes.  His mouth is full, curved, sensuous.  You have the
sense that this god enjoys all that he does.

mobs.Name: Vulcan romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Vulcan wields his enormously heavy hammer as if it were a feather.
mobs.Description:
Muscles hard as the iron at his forge, skin gleaming with a light sheen
of perspiration, Vulcan looks at you, mortal, indulgently.  A god of
incredible strength, he knows he has little to fear from a fight with
such as you.

mobs.Name: advisor romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The finance advisor smiles cannily at you, easily estimating your worth.
mobs.Description:
The investment advisor is a tall, elegant man, dressed in a pristine
white toga.  He is well tanned, virile, fit, the very image of the Roman
ideal.  He invites you to leave your money with him, where it will be
safely invested for you.

mobs.Name: fireman romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The many Roman fires keep the fireman always running for water.
mobs.Description:
The hot sun bakes the wooden structures that make up Rome's office
buildings and apartments, drying them as if in a kiln.  Cooking fires
and heating fires frequently throw sparks, easily igniting the building,
and the fireman is off to work again.  He is necessarily strong, and has
many scars from burns.

mobs.Name: drinius romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Drinius has found a comfy spot to read his favorite scrolls.
mobs.Description:
A student of everything, master of nothing in particular, Drinius was
the despair of his fond parents.  "Why do you always have your nose
buried in a scroll, Drinius?  Why aren't you out there conquering new
territory for Rome or something?"  But Drinius ignores them and goes his
own way.

mobs.Name: Mattias trainer gladiator romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Mattias will charge you an arm and a leg to train you.
mobs.Description:
After all, you will probably lose them anyway in the arena.  Actually,
this retired gladiator doesn't trade in limbs, but he will take your
gold to teach you how to fight bravely in the arena and, perhaps, to win
and live to fight another day.

mobs.Name: rat romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The sewer rat sniffs at the odd smells entering her home.
mobs.Description:
Long wiry whiskers twitching in disgust at the sights and sounds and
smells that humans bring to her sewer, the rat scurries about her
business.  She is a very LARGE rat, and looks like she might like to
take a bite out of you!

mobs.Name: actor romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The actor provides pleasure to the Romans, and therefore is a star.
mobs.Description:
Greatly admired and rewarded for his acting, the actor was able to buy
his freedom from his benefactor, who had him trained.  He wears heavy
masks and very stylized clothing to act in the melodramas and farces at
the theater.

mobs.Name: stagehand romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Cursing quietly, the stagehand moves the heavy props into place.
mobs.Description:
The stage props keep getting more and more elaborate every year, as the
theater vies for popularity with the more bloody Colosseum and the
racetrack.  Backdrops, heavy curtains, traps in the stage and all kinds
of gadgetry are managed by the few overworked stagehands.

mobs.Name: athlete romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The athlete is stretching his body, preparing for exercise.
mobs.Description:
Sharing the training fields with the soldiers, the athlete prepares for
a long run.  He will combine some running with some muscle building
activities designed to keep him fit.

mobs.Name: bather man romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The old man sits in the steam, moist heat invading his joints.
mobs.Description:
Coming to the baths, sharing war stories with his cronies are two
pleasures left in the life of this old soldier.  You can see his body
covered with scars, and wonder at the strength of spirit that has kept
him alive.  He is not tall, but very sturdily built, a man of great
stamina.

mobs.Name: moorish soldier romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The moorish soldier straps on his gear, preparing for battle.
mobs.Description:
As Rome has extended her frontiers, men and women of all types have been
brought to the city to serve.  In time they may earn their freedom, and
their children may become citizens.  This Moor is earning a good salary
in the Roman army.

mobs.Name: cloakroom attendant romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The cloakroom attendant will store your garments while you bathe.
mobs.Description:
A city-owned slave, this one has found an easy job.  He will not guard
your things, however he will help you remove them and fold them neatly
for you.  He is young and comely and undoubtedly has other duties than
folding togas and tunics.

mobs.Name: trainee gladiator romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The trainee swings his sword clumsily, tripping over his own feet.
mobs.Description:
Wealth or early death await this trainee in the arena.  Well, an early
death for this one if he doesn't learn to manage his sword better!  He
is poor, and has nothing except a lifetime of poverty to lose.  With
training there is hope he may win the gladiator's crown.

mobs.Name: priest romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Being a priest is a political honor as well as a religious one.
mobs.Description:
Serving the gods can be rewarding politically as well as financially.
The worshipers sacrifice gifts, and the priest gracefully accepts them
in the name of the god, of course.

mobs.Name: priestess romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The priestess goes about her duties with sure, efficient movements.
mobs.Description:
The priestess is a powerful woman in the prime of her life.  She is tall
and strong, and her skin, her hair and her eyes all glow with her
health.  She has been dedicated to the service of the god since early
adolescence, and clearly it suits her.

mobs.Name: martyr romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The martyr bravely awaits her fate, knowing in her heart she is right.
mobs.Description:
She could have worshipped her own gods as well as the Roman ones, but
she refused.  She has been sentenced to death in the arena.  A
beautiful, passionate young woman with chestnut hair and green eyes,
she will soon be torn to ribbons by a wild beast.

mobs.Name: vestal virgin romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Dedicated to goddess Vesta, the virgin keeps the hearth fire burning.
mobs.Description:
It's a career!  and a somewhat dubious honor for a noble woman to be
chosen to serve the goddess (and the republic) by keeping the fire
burning in the forum.  One of six women, she will serve for 30 years.
She will never marry.

mobs.Name: retiarius gladiator romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The retiarian gladiator fights in little more than a loincloth.
mobs.Description:
With little more than a loincloth and sandals for armor, and a net and
trident for weaponry, the retiarius has little hope of killing his
opponent.  He is hoping to be matched against someone who is weighed
down with heavy armor.
mobs.ActionScript: %%60 kill victim

mobs.Name: samnite gladiator romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The Samnite gladiator is well protected behind heavy armor.
mobs.Description:
Well polished body armor sparkles in the light, reflecting you in all
your dirt and fear.  The Samnite carries a tall oblong shield, and
wears a metal helmet with a gruesome face mask to frighten you.  It
works.
mobs.ActionScript: %%60 kill victim

mobs.Name: murmillo gladiator romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The Murmillo gladiator snarls at you from beneath his heavy faceplate.
mobs.Description:
The Murmillo gladiator is a man of average height.  He carries a tall,
square shield with a strange design in red and black.  He is well
armored, covered ankle to mid thigh in bronze, and with a helmet that
covers the lower half of his face.
mobs.ActionScript: %%60 kill victim

mobs.Name: thracian gladiator romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Carrying a light round shield, the Thracian gladiator is quite agile.
mobs.Description:
The Thracian gladiator wears light but strong leather armor, his sword
arm protected with leather wrappings.  He carries a small round shield
and wears no leg armor.  He easily dodges blows and slips quickly
behind your guard to attack.
mobs.ActionScript: %%60 kill victim

mobs.Name: consul xelfking romemob
mobs.LongDescription: As he walks, the Consul's white toga swirls about him like a cape.
mobs.Description:
This consul radiates an aura of goodness.  From the tips of his
slightly pointed ears to the tips of his toes in his comfortable
leather sandals, you sense that finally you have found a man you can
trust.  His features are elfin, his body slender and not overly tall,
but there is still a sense of inner strength about him that you cannot
help but admire.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 say It's all good.

mobs.Name: marcus lawyer romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The famous lawyer, Marcus Wallgrenus, slyly sizes you up.
mobs.Description:
This citizen is no dummy!  He knows how to move up in the Roman world.
He is an excellent advocate, willing to do what it takes to win each
case and canny enough to know what that is.

mobs.Name: faun romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A strange being, part goat, part man and GLOWING, dances in the gardens.
mobs.Description:
A freak of nature or a god?  Clearly a free spirit, and clearly happy in
the garden.  He is about your height, but has massive shoulder and arm
muscles and apparently small horns on his head.

mobs.Name: plebeian romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The plebeians toga is ragged and threadbare, but he is still proud.
mobs.Description:
Still proud of his citizenship despite his poverty, the plebeian is ever
on the look out for ways to earn a little more gold.  Thick eyebrows
meet over a long, slightly crooked nose.  His deep tan make his teeth a
startling white when he smiles, which he does often.

mobs.Name: augurer romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The augurer neatly slits the sacrificial beast from neck to tail.
mobs.Description:
A small, thin, frail man with gray hair that extends past his waist, the
augurer is a man of mystery.  One of sixteen prophets in Rome, and one
of the most powerful men of Rome, the augurer advises the political
elite on every move they make.

mobs.Name: Albertus Al ATM romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Albertus Tellus Maximus will cheerfully keep your money for you.
mobs.Description:
The banker pats his belly and smiles benignly at you.  He is a truly
immense man, and there are rumors he has ties with the Family.  He will
take your money and invest it wisely, then give it back to you when you
need it, minus a small fee, of course.

mobs.Name: equite romemob
mobs.LongDescription: This equite may not be a social leader, but he is quite wealthy.
mobs.Description:
Scorned by more patrician fellow citizens for his business dealings,
this equite has the last laugh as he watches them go into debt as his
wealth builds.  He is very tall and massively built, leading one to
believe there might be some minotaur ancestry in his bloodline.

mobs.Name: woman shopworker romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The woman works in a shop by day, then cares for her family at night.
mobs.Description:
A life of poverty is a life of hard work.  This small, dark woman looks
old for her years.  Her fingers are callused from work, and her back is
bent.  She has great strength in her wiry frame, but it is severely
tested.

mobs.Name: carpenter romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The carpenter works long hours in the summer, but he is well paid.
mobs.Description:
Never out of work in a city where politicians vie for public favor with
their building programs, this carpenter is hoping to move to better
quarters soon.  He is a tall, dark haired man of about 30 with a deep
tan from his life out of doors.

mobs.Name: guest romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The dinner guest reclines lazily on the sofa, gesturing for more food.
mobs.Description:
Elegantly coiffed, elegantly dressed, the guest is seated on an elegant
chaise and served elegant food.  Only rigorous training in the field of
Mars or at the gymnasium has enabled her to keep her well-proportionned
body.

mobs.Name: roman woman romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The woman nods her head in your direction as she steps out of your way.
mobs.Description:
At the bottom of the social heap, this woman shares space at
entertainments with the slaves knowing they may one day earn their
freedom, but she never will.  She longs for the freedom that wealth and
widowhood might bring, but realizes it is not to be her lot.

mobs.Name: farmer romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The farmer brings produce left from the Faire to sell in Rome.
mobs.Description:
He had a most profitable week while the Faire was in progress.  It was a
safe celebration and all the fairegoers seemed hungry, so he was able to
sell lots of his produce, but there is still some left to sell to the
greengrocer in town.

mobs.Name: general romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The Roman general contemplates the celebrations of his victories.
mobs.Description:
Wearing the laurel wreath of the successful Roman general, Fobos
Maximilius follows his successful army back to Rome.  They bring with
them treasures from the mighty civilizations and barbaric tribes they
have conquered.  The general ponders the effect his triumph may have on
his political career.  Perhaps he should stage a coup.

mobs.Name: standard bearer roman soldier standard-bearer romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Glad to be back home, the standard-bearer slowly lowers the standard.
mobs.Description:
A deep tan born of countless summers spent conquering new territory
contrasts sharply with the ice blue eyes and blond hair bleached almost
white by the sun.  The son of a slave turned freedman, this citizen's
Nordic heritage is very clear both in his coloring as well as his
fierceness in battle.

mobs.Name: slave Gaul gallic captive romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The Gallic captive, now a slave to the Romans, glares haughtily at you.
mobs.Description:
He was a great and fierce fighter, but he was captured and now will be
a great and proud slave.  His body still retains the remnants of blue
paint, which evidently was not enough to frighten off the Roman armies.
His amulet of herbs and unmentionables, worn about his neck, were also
not enough to protect him from capture.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 stare; %5 glare

mobs.Name: roman warrior romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The mighty minotaur Roman warrior needs no helmet as his horns suffice.
mobs.Description:
Roman citizens come in all shapes and sizes.  The minotaur's grandsire
was captured during an early raid on Crete.  He did well as a slave,
earning great quantities of gold as a favored charioteer (of the leek,
or green team).  He was freed, and his son and grandson thereby were
able to be citizens.

mobs.Name: warrior elephant roman romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The huge elephant stomps along, grinding the dirt to dust.
mobs.Description:
The pachyderm packs a whallop with her trunk, although she has not been
used for fighting.  Originally brought over from Africa by Hannibal,
who wanted to "surprise" the Romans one winter, these Romans are
delighted to bring them back as a prize to Rome.  They can carry
literally tons of treasure brought back from the wars.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 yawn;%5 emote rears back, preparing to STOMP you.

mobs.Name: ratman roman warrior soldier ratsoldier romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The Ratman Ratsoldier looks fierce despite his long twitching tail.
mobs.Description:
As long as you are a land owning citizen, you may sign up for a 20 year
stretch in the Roman army.  Although it is a hard life (especially for
a rat), the promise of glory and a regular salary are hard to resist.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 pose;%5 twitch

mobs.Name: halfling roman soldier romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The halfling looks small, but his heart is as brave as any Roman's.
mobs.Description:
This halfling is small and far from the land of his grandparent's birth,
but he is a Roman citizen-soldier and very proud of it.  His parents,
captured in a raid, were able to buy their freedom from their small
tobacco shop.

mobs.Name: gnome roman soldier romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The gnomish soldier is on holiday, looking for entertainment.
mobs.Description:
This gnome was something of a washout in terms of carrying around 3 days
worth of equipment on his back, but he is a positive genius when it
comes to building bridges and designing campsites.  He is small and
getting a trifle old for the life of a soldier.

mobs.Name: gnome old cloth merchant romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The old gnome leads a donkey laden with bolts of wool.
mobs.Description:
Bringing heavy bolts of wool woven from Stanneg sheep, the cloth
merchant hopes to trade for some fairy cloth, should he be lucky enough
to discover the fairy home.

mobs.Name: tinker romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The tinker easily carries his huge pack on his massive back.
mobs.Description:
"Wandering from village to village, that's the life for me!"  A man of
enormous strength and cleverness, the tinker carries the tools of his
trade on his back.  Quick to fix, that's the tinker.

mobs.Name: worshiper romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The worshiper prays his sacrifice will not go unheeded.
mobs.Description:
The worshiper has saved all year to purchase the oxen to bring to
sacrifice to his god.  It has meant doing without, but he is used to
that.  If the god answers his prayer, he won't have to do without much
longer.

mobs.Name: worshiper romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Bacchus' worshiper is long lost to the pleasures of wine, song and love.
mobs.Description:
For this young woman, worship of the god Bacchus is like a continual
round of pleasure.  Her head in a drug and wine induced fog, she dances
for the god and the other worshipers, lost to the world around her.

mobs.Name: high priest romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The high priest sacrifices the animal at the altar.
mobs.Description:
The high priest is a patrician, a wealthy and noble Roman who has been
elected to this extremely important office.  If he cannot convince the
god to grant the people's wishes, all of Rome will suffer.

mobs.Name: slave romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The slave hastens about his task.
mobs.Description:
Brought here from Greece, this slave is unlikely to have to work very
hard.  He will most likely soon be employed as a tutor or scribe.  The
Romans have a healthy awe of Roman learning.

mobs.Name: roman soldier romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The Roman soldier fought hard to win new land for Rome.
mobs.Description:
Roman soldiers have earned enough for the republic in their many
campaigns of conquest that Roman citizens no longer must pay heavy
taxes or work as slaves due to their poverty.  This soldier was proud to
carry back part of the bounty of war, although the chest was quite
heavy.

mobs.Name: wolf victim romemob
