mobs.LongDescription: The shaggy gray wolf lifts his massive head as you enter his small den.
mobs.Description:
Brought back from the far north by a minion of the Maximus clan, the
wolf wearies of his long waits in this airless hole.  The only
unfiltered light he has seen is when he has been released to hunt in the
arena.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 howl

mobs.Name: panther victim romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The sleek black panther paces restlessly in his small cage.
mobs.Description:
Brought back from a campaign 3 months ago, the panther has subsisted on
a steady diet of adventurers and gladiators.  He looks at you, bored, as
if to say, "Why couldn't they at least send someone who would be a
challenge?

mobs.Name: bear victim romemob
mobs.ShortDescription: the huge and very furry bear
mobs.LongDescription: Looking like a big teddybear with teeth, the bear is ready to fight.
mobs.Description:
One mighty swipe of his paw could easily knock you flat.  The long sharp
claws would rake the skin right off your body, leaving the meat and
bones there for him to munch on.

mobs.Name: minotaur victim romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The minotaur lowers his head, ready to spear you with long sharp horns.
mobs.Description:
Brought back from Minos, this minotaur is HUGE, sentient, intelligent,
and just plain mean.  He is a favorite of the Roman crowds, because
there is always a lot of blood and gore when the minotaurs are brought
out.

mobs.Name: tiger victim romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The tigers' large black and gold stripes have a dizzying effect.
mobs.Description:
The tiger rests lazily on the dirt floor of his cage.  Don't make the
mistake of thinking he is asleep.  Under the smooth glossy fur you can
see rippling muscles, and you know if he decides to *pounce* on you, you
are history.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 snarl

mobs.Name: prisoner victim romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The prisoner looks sadly around her cell, knowing she is about to die.
mobs.Description:
She will not be much of a challenge for the gladiators, since she is so
weak from hunger and lack of sleep.  She spilled some red wine on the
white toga of a very important guest of the Maximus clan, and has been
sent here as an example to the other servants.

mobs.Name: jeweler romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The jeweler eyes you appraisingly.
mobs.Description:
Marius is a small, hefty freedman, a former slave to Homerus Maximus,
who is now his patrone.  Marius has an excellent eye for jewels and
knows what people will buy.  Naturally, he makes small "gifts" of his
best selections to his patrone.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%4 say How about a little sparkle for the love of your life?
;%3 say YOU've got a friend in the diamond business!
;%3 emote smiles a particularly oily smile.

mobs.Name: Julius Maximus romemob
mobs.LongDescription: An aging senator, the head of the clan Maximus, Julius remains fit.
mobs.Description:
Julius is a man of many years, but he has taken great care to remain fit
and youthful in appearance.  He owes his full head of hair to great
genes, but the deep brown color is from a substance purchased for him
from a small shop in town, a shop that he owns.

mobs.Name: Gluteus Maximus
mobs.LongDescription: Gluteus Maximus frowns as you intrude on his space.
mobs.Description:
Gluteus has a lot wagered on this race, and doesn't take kindly to
intruders.  He is a MASSIVE man of truly colossal proportions.  Even his
tunic and toga can't disguise the beefiness of the form beneath.

mobs.Name: Augustus Maximus romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Augustus cheers loudly for the leeks, as the chariots race past his box.
mobs.Description:
The youngest of the male adults in the Maximus clan, Augustus is
probably the most successful.  He is good natured, friendly, active, and
an astute businessman.  Like the rest of his clans, he makes frequent
trips to the field of Mars and the baths to remain fit and healthy.  He
would be a challenging opponent!
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote smiles benignly at you.

mobs.Name: Gaius hotfood shopkeeper romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Face glowing with sweat, Gaius asks, "What can I get for you?"
mobs.Description:
Since most people can't cook at home, Gaius does a good business
providing hot food.  He has several shops in different parts of Rome,
where he caters to different appetites.  It is always hot in his store,
but Gaius has become used to it.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote wipes down the counter with a fairly clean rag.
;%5 emote accepts delivery of a shipment of elephant tails from the
arena.

mobs.Name: Sulla image shopkeeper romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Sulla sells magic to enhance your image.
mobs.Description:
Sulla purchases powders, potions and other items from alchemists and
priests of many sects and resells them to the wealthy.  His many
assistants will also perform various services for you, such as
hairdressing, hair softening, hair removal, hair coloring, massage, in
short, anything to enhance your beauty.  Sulla has many of his
assistants working at the more exclusive baths in town.

mobs.Name: assistant romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Sulla's assistant will painlessly remove hair from your arms and legs.
mobs.Description:
Using a mixture of bat's blood and hedgehog ashes, Sulla's assistant
will peel the hair from your arms and legs.  Roman men prefer to be
hairless, although generally they prefer this to be done in privacy.
Sulla is also skilled in using hot walnut shells to soften the hair, in
case you do not like arm stubble.

mobs.Name: assistant romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The shopkeeper's assistant sweeps up the shop, trying to look busy.
mobs.Description:
A young slave, learning the business, the assistant has learned it is
best to always at least appear to be busy.  The assistant is about 14,
the son of another of the shop owner's slaves.  He knows he is quite
lucky to have landed such an easy spot in life.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote grumbles under his breath.
;%5 emote mutters, "I always get stuck with the dirty work."

mobs.Name: spectator fan romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A spectator is filthy, half drunk and screaming his head off.
mobs.Description:
The spectator has a small fortune riding on the leeks losing today, but
he's so drunk and rowdy he's all but forgotten.  He's not a very tall
man, but very strong and very hairy, showing some of his undoubted
dwarven ancestry.
mobs.ActionScript: %%4 emote thumps you hard on the back, grinning.

mobs.Name: spectator fan romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A spectator is filthy, half drunk and screaming his head off.
mobs.Description:
The spectator loves all the spectacle of the theater, which has gotten
very amusing now that it has some real competition in the form of the
arena in the north of town.

mobs.Name: Drucilla woman roman romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Drucilla drowsily drifts off into dreamland, dreading dinner.
mobs.Description:
Drucilla would rather be anywhere but entertaining boring dinner guests.
Her mind drifts off as she smiles and nods at them.  Where has she gone?
Drucilla the dreamy-eyed is tall and slender, with dark brown hair
fashionably styled in brown curls around her pale brown-eyed face.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 em looks up at you, startled out of her reverie.

mobs.Name: patrician roman romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The patrician ignores you, his attention focused elsewhere.
mobs.Description:
Unless you are another wealthy citizen or unless you are needed for some
task, or unless you get in his way, you do not exist for this wealthy,
toga-wearing citizen.  You are of less importance than the sandals on
his elegant feet.  Body hardened by hours spent on the Field of Mars,
the patrician will be a difficult opponent.

mobs.Name: equite wealthy romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The equite looks about him with satisfaction, pleased at his success.
mobs.Description:
Gradually moving up the social ladder, the equite has made quite a lot
of money off the Roman's love for the odd and unusual.  This helps him
hang out with the patricians.  Since he spends most of his time social
climbing and making money, he is not quite so fit as his patrician
"friends".
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote pats his paunch and smiles.

mobs.Name: gateguard guard romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A gateguard stands here, tending the gate.
mobs.Description:
Clad in light armor, the gateguard makes sure only the right people are
allowed into Rome.  He also strictly enforces the "no cart" policy.
The streets have become so congested that no carts are allowed within
the city walls until after sunset.

mobs.Name: gateguard guard romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A gateguard stands here, tending the gate.
mobs.Description:
Clad in light armor, the gateguard makes sure only the right people are
allowed into Rome.  He also strictly enforces the "no cart" policy.
The streets have become so congested that no carts are allowed within
the city walls until after sunset.

mobs.Name: gateguard guard romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A gateguard stands here, tending the gate.
mobs.Description:
Clad in light armor, the gateguard makes sure only the right people are
allowed into Rome.  He also strictly enforces the "no cart" policy.
The streets have become so congested that no carts are allowed within
the city walls until after sunset.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 say Halt! Who goes there!;%5 glare

mobs.Name: nymph romemob
mobs.LongDescription: This nymph will tempt you into dishonor with her seductive beauty.
mobs.Description:
Beautiful but deadly.  The nymph smiles seductively at you, inviting you
to follow her into joyful but mindless abandon.  Forever young, forever
beautiful, forever dangerous.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 wiggle

mobs.Name: pan romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The curious looking man with goat horns and goat feet plays his pipes.
mobs.Description:
Pan is looking for woodland nymphs, hoping to lure them to him with his
music.  He is always looking for them, but never accepted because he is
SO ugly.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote looks around for a nymph to chase.

mobs.Name: woman wife romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The young Roman woman sits on the hard wooden benches, watching.
mobs.Description:
Another non-person to the rest of the Romans, the young woman still
enjoys watching the entertainments, even though she must sit high up
against the back wall and on hard, splintery wooden benches.  Hers is a
hard life, and although she possesses a certain wiry strength, she will
not live long enough to give her husband more than a child or two.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote shrinks back, trying NOT to be noticed.

mobs.Name: slave drunk romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The slave found some time off and went out to have a good time.
mobs.Description:
Lucky to be the pampered slave of a very indulgent master, the young man
used to be even closer to his master and his master's friends.  Once he
started growing a beard, however, he was given errands to run and
speeches to scribe.  Much more boring work.
mobs.ActionScript: %5 flutter

mobs.Name: farmer romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The farmer has come into town from Stanneg, full of wonder at Rome.
mobs.Description:
Although he has heard all his life about the marvels of the great city
of Rome, he has always believed them to be myths.  A cyclops raid on his
home burned down his crops and farmhouse, so he has taken his family to
Rome to seek his fortune.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 gasp
;%5 say well I'll be the son of a blue-nosed donkey!  Will you look at
that!

mobs.Name: helper romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The fuller's helper has slipped away from his work to enjoy the day.
mobs.Description:
The fuller is at his country home today, so his helper closed up the
shop early and escaped to enjoy the day with his friends.  Hopefully, he
will not be caught!  He is a youth of 17, tall with dark hair and a long
straight nose that hints of his patrician ancestry.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote looks at your dirty clothes and snickers softly.

mobs.Name: vendor romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The vendor sells hot roast chestnuts to warm your hands and belly.
mobs.Description:
Every morning she buys chestnuts at the grocers and hot charcoal, then,
rain or shine, roasts chestnuts in the Forum.  She will wrap them in a
bit of paper or cloth she finds and give them to you to warm your hands,
your mouth and your belly.  The vendor is ageless, and you feel she may
have some tricks up the long loose sleeves of her tunic.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 yell Hot chestnuts! Get your charcoal-grilled chestnuts right
here!!

mobs.Name: Antonius romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Shoulders stooped with age, the elderly man peers at a scroll.
mobs.Description:
His eyesight going as are the rest of his faculties, still, Antonius the
Younger is a remarkable orator.  His grasp of Roman common law is
remarkable, and his name is well known throughout the courts.  For that
reason, his services are still much sought after and he can well afford
his luxurious office.

mobs.Name: jason romemob
mobs.LongDescription: #GJason is much more than a pretty piece of marble.#N
mobs.Description:
Jason led the original Super Hero band.  One glance at his incredible
physique (and this clear white marble statue hides NOTHING), one peek
into his clever mind, and you can easily understand why so many Greek
Heroes followed him to Colchis.  Of course, stealing the golden fleece
back from the dragon might have had something to do with it as well.

mobs.Name: Maximus romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Maximus Maximus chortles gleefully as another sucker enters his shop.
mobs.Description:
A small, oily man of indeterminate age, you can sense that in another
lifetime Maximus might have sold used camels or snake oil cures.  There
is a wiry strength to his body and a look of confidence and
determination that makes you hesitate to attack him.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 chortle

mobs.Name: young Briton romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A young Briton was brought back from one of Rome's recent campaigns.
mobs.Description:
Trainable!  This young man would be good for running errands.  If he is
brighter than he looks, he might make a good scribe.  Although he comes
just to the elbow of your average full-grown minotaur, he has reached
his full height, and the long walk back from his homeland has
strengthened him.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 peer

mobs.Name: pedagogue greek teacher ped romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The pedagogue might be able to teach you to read.
mobs.Description:
An expensive slave, much valued.  You will be the envy of all of your
friends if you buy this brilliant, cultured Greek pedagogue.  And, due
to some slight infirmities we are willing to sell him cheap!

mobs.Name: druid witch woman romemob
mobs.LongDescription: A witchy woman from Gaul casts some nasty spells on you.
mobs.Description:
Don't let the blue skin put you off!  This wench will cast her evil
spells only on your enemies if you should buy her.  With the loose black
waves of hair floating behind her she may look a bit untidy, but she
will be a blessing in your retinue.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 cast 'control weather'

mobs.Name: warrior fierce Hun romemob
mobs.LongDescription: The battle-scarred blond warrior looks fierce.  Scary!
mobs.Description:
Towering above you, this Hun was brought back from a land far to the
north of here inhabited mainly by Germanic tribes.  Such a deal! Already
trained in the arts of war, this warrior could make a bundle for you in
the arena.  Make an investment in your future with this warrior.

mobs.Name: dresser female hairdresser slave romemob
mobs.LongDescription: An elderly hairdresser would make a nice present for your sister.
mobs.Description:
This woman is well trained in the arts of styling hair in the latest
fashion.  Roman clothing may not change much from year to year, but you
wouldn't want to go to that dinner party in last year's hairstyle!  This
little woman won't eat much, but she will be worth her weight in gold
coins.

mobs.Name: architect builder romemob
mobs.LongDescription: Slave to the joys of building, the roamin architect-builder works ceaselessly.
mobs.Description:
Finally ready to build that little villa outside town?  Perhaps you had
something a bit grander in mind?  A fortress on top of a volcano?  A
small village inhabited by some of Rome's more unusual creatures?  Then
you've come to the right place.  Purchase this builder and ride his
dream!

mobs.Name: Samurai Trainee
mobs.LongDescription: A Samurai Trainee is standing here trying to gather lost Karma.
mobs.Description:
You see before you a young Samurai.  His clothes and weapon indicate that he
is only a trainee.

mobs.Name: Samurai Apprentice
mobs.LongDescription: An apprentice looking Samurai is meditating here.
mobs.Description:
You see a samurai apprentice standing before you.  He looks much like a
trainee, but you can't quite tell.

mobs.Name: Samurai Warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A Samurai Warrior is here trying to look grim.
mobs.Description:
You find yourself before one of the greatest warriors of all time.  And, from
the looks of his weapon, he is ready to fight.

mobs.Name: Shogun of Understanding
mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Understanding is here pondering on something.
mobs.Description:
The Shogun of Understanding glows with goodness and stares straight at you as
if he knows something.

mobs.Name: Shogun of Ethics
mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Ethics is offended by your appearance.
mobs.Description:
The Shogun of Ethics towers over you.  From the sight of his bloodied sword,
you decide not to be 'judged'.

mobs.Name: Shogun of Loyalty
mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Loyalty is here, panting, as if he just fled from something.
mobs.Description:
The Shogun of Loyalty stands tall and proud.  You think that he might be a good
friend to have.

mobs.Name: Shogun of Respect
mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Respect is here, polishing his ancient sword.
mobs.Description:
You see a huge figure grasping a spear-like weapon.  His presence alone is
enough to demand respect.

mobs.Name: Shogun of Authority
mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Authority demands something from you.
mobs.Description:
This man reminds you of everything you ever feared in a parent. You want to
run back to your room.

mobs.Name: Shogun of Knowledge
mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Knowledge exclaims occasionally 'Eureka!'
mobs.Description:
The Shogun of Knowledge merely looks at you, making you wonder what he really
knows.

mobs.Name: Shogun of Truth
mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Truth stands here muttering riddles.
mobs.Description:
This guy is mean, strong, and has a bigger weapon than you.
He scares you ... no lie.

mobs.Name: Shogun of Caring
mobs.LongDescription: The Shogun of Caring is here tucking flowers into his belt.
mobs.Description:
The Shogun of Caring reminds you somewhat of your father.  You just wanna give
him a great big hug!

mobs.Name: Tokugawa Yoshikatsu
mobs.LongDescription: Tokugawa Yoshikatsu is here meditating.
mobs.Description:
Tokugawa Yoshikatsu was one of the greatest Samurai to ever kill a man.  And,
soon, either you or he will die.

mobs.Name: maid
mobs.LongDescription: The Maid is waiting for your order.
mobs.Description:
She is very beautiful with golden hair, and deep blue eyes.  A good reason
for coming here more often, you think to yourself.

mobs.Name: sexton
mobs.LongDescription: A Sexton is sitting here, drinking hot tea.
mobs.Description: The Sexton looks like he is relaxing after another gravedigging job.

mobs.Name: swan
mobs.LongDescription: A swan is swimming around in the pond.
mobs.Description: The white swan is very elegant.

mobs.Name: duckling
mobs.LongDescription: A duckling is swimming around in the pond.
mobs.Description: The duckling is adorable, it looks most of all like a tiny furball.

mobs.Name: sparrow
mobs.LongDescription: A sparrow is flapping around on the ground.
mobs.Description: The sparrow looks like it is enjoying life.

mobs.Name: duck
mobs.LongDescription: A duck is here, quacking happily.
mobs.Description: The duck is quite fat.  It looks like it is enjoying life.

mobs.Name: chief
mobs.LongDescription: The Chief Guard is looking very upset.
mobs.Description: A very angry chief.

mobs.Name: cityguard guard
mobs.LongDescription: A cityguard stands here, looking very upset.
mobs.Description: A big, strong, angry guard.

mobs.Name: secretary
mobs.LongDescription: A secretary is sitting at the desk, typing away on the typewriter.
mobs.Description:
She looks very busy.

>
The Secretary says 'Sorry, but the Mayor is extremely busy today.'
The Secretary says 'Please sit down and have a seat in the meantime.'

mobs.Name: mayor
mobs.LongDescription: The Mayor is sitting in his huge chair, snoring loudly.
mobs.Description: He is a stocky, middle-aged man with thin, grey hair.

mobs.Name: crier
mobs.LongDescription: The Town Crier is here, weeping quietly.
mobs.Description: He is very good at his job - completely dissolved in tears.

mobs.Name: wizard mage
mobs.LongDescription: A Wizard walks around behind the counter, muttering to himself.
mobs.Description:
The wizard looks old and senile, and yet he looks like a very powerful
wizard. He is equipped with fine clothing, and is wearing many fine 
rings and bracelets.

mobs.Name: baker
mobs.LongDescription:
The Baker looks at you calmly, wiping flour from his face with one 
hand.
mobs.Description:
A fat, nice looking baker. But you can see that he has many scars on 
his body.

mobs.Name: grocer
mobs.LongDescription:
A grocer stands at the counter, with a slightly impatient look on his 
face.
mobs.Description:
A tall grocer, who moves two 200 pounds bag of flour around on his 
shoulders.

mobs.Name: weaponsmith
mobs.LongDescription:
A weaponsmith is standing here, eager to sell you his tools for 
carnage and destruction.
mobs.Description:
He's a young weaponsmith, who still has lots to learn.  But it look like 
he can use his weapons as well as sell them.

mobs.Name: armorer
mobs.LongDescription:
An Armorer stands here displaying his shiny new (and previously 
owned) armors.
mobs.Description:
An old but very strong armorer.  He has made more armors in his 
life than you have ever seen.

mobs.Name: receptionist
mobs.LongDescription: A receptionist is standing behind the counter here, smiling at you.
mobs.Description:
You notice a tired look in her face.  She looks like she isn't paid well 
enough to put up with any crap from mud players with attitudes.

mobs.Name: captain
mobs.LongDescription: A retired Captain stands here, selling boats.
mobs.Description: This Captain has eaten more sharks than you have killed peas.

mobs.Name: sailor
mobs.LongDescription: A Sailor stands here, waiting to help you.
mobs.Description: He looks like a strong, fit sailor.

mobs.Name: uncle juan
mobs.LongDescription: Uncle Juan is here ready to take your order.
mobs.Description: He looks like he may or may not have a green card.

mobs.Name: wally watermaster
mobs.LongDescription:
Wally the Watermaster is standing behind the counter, proudly 
displaying his fine collection of contemporary waters.
mobs.Description:
Wally is a bit pudgy but looks very strong.  He has a glass of 
Midgaard Natural Spring Water in his hand.

mobs.Name: postmaster post master
mobs.LongDescription:
The head Postmaster is standing here, waiting to help you with your 
mail.
mobs.Description:
The Postmaster seems like a happy old man, though a bit sluggish.  
He worries about the reputation of the EMS (Elite Mail Service), as many 
people seem to think that it's slow.  Perhaps if he were to brush the 
cobwebs from his uniform it'd help to make a better impression.

mobs.Name: ice drakes icedrakes
mobs.LongDescription: A dozen ice-drakes squabble over tasty diamond treats.
mobs.Description:
Ice drakes are the secret of gnomish cryogenics. Feeding the ice drakes 
with diamonds and sapphires allows them to get up enough chilling power 
to keep people deep frozen, giving them hugely extended lifetimes. The
ice drakes are around two feet in length, and covered in blue, silver 
and white scales. A crest of ice runs down their backs, and they snort 
little icy clouds which seem to cling to the ground.

mobs.Name: priest cleric healer
mobs.LongDescription: The Priest is standing here, offering his services.
mobs.Description: The priest is young and healthy.  His purse looks full and heavy.

mobs.Name: harold undertaker
mobs.LongDescription: Harold the Undertaker is here selling coffins.
mobs.Description:
Harold is tall, skinny and black and has a very shrill voice.  He walks 
around with a long stick, used as both walking stick and to messure 
peoples height.
mobs.ActionScript:
%10 puke;%10 snicker;%20 snore;%90 spit;%40 giggle;%50 addict;%90 
bkiss;%10 wave

mobs.Name: guildmaster master
mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster is standing here.
mobs.Description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly 
see the vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine 
magic clothing, and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue 
shimmering aura.

mobs.Name: guildmaster master
mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster is standing here.

mobs.Name: guildmaster master
mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster is standing here.
mobs.Description:
You realize that whenever your guildmaster moves, you fail to notice 
it - the way of the true thief.  She is to be dressed in poor clothing, 
having the appearance of a beggar.

mobs.Name: guildmaster master
mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster is standing here.
mobs.Description:
This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several 
scars across his body proves that he was using arms before you were 
born. He has a calm look on his face.

mobs.Name: sorcerer guildg
mobs.LongDescription: A sorcerer is guarding the entrance.
mobs.Description:
He is an experienced mage who has specialized in the field of Combat 
Magic.  He is here to guard the Mage's Guild and his superior knowledge 
of offensive as well as defensive spells make him a deadly opponent.

mobs.Name: knight templar guildg
mobs.LongDescription: A knight templar is guarding the entrance.
mobs.Description:
He is a specially trained warrior belonging to the military order of 
the Faith.  His duty is to protect the faithful from persecution and 
infidel attacks and his religious devotion combined with his superior 
skill makes him a deadly opponent.

mobs.Name: assassin guildg
mobs.LongDescription: An assassin is guarding the entrance.
mobs.Description:
He is a thief who has specialized in killing others as effectively as 
possible, using all sorts of weapons.  His superior knowledge of how and 
where to use them combined with his extraordinary stealth makes him a 
deadly opponent.

mobs.Name: knight guildg
mobs.LongDescription: A knight is guarding the entrance.
mobs.Description:
He is an expert warrior who has attained knighthood through 
countless chivalrous deeds.  His duty is to protect the Guild of 
Swordsmen and his extreme skill combined with his experience in warfare 
makes him a deadly opponent.

mobs.Name: tailor
mobs.LongDescription: A Tailor is sitting here, making new garments.
mobs.Description:
Everywhere on his garments, there are needles and thread in every 
color. He seems busy with sewing a new dress, but is looking at you 
suspiciously, muttering, 'Don't touch anything with those filthy hands!'

mobs.Name: jeweler
mobs.LongDescription: A Jeweler is standing behind his counter, displaying his goods.
mobs.Description:
He is wearing rings on each of his fingers, and amulets with 
diamonds and gold hangs around his neck. He looks at you witha wry 
smile, saying, 'Welcome wealthy citizens!'

mobs.Name: rosy
mobs.LongDescription: Rosy is here with her hands in a pot, replanting some flowers.
mobs.Description:
Rosy is a midaged woman with her long hair braided. Dirt patches 
adorn her simple dress, as if she uses it to clean her hands now and 
then. She smiles when she sees you and asks, 'What will it be today?'

mobs.Name: merchant
mobs.LongDescription: The merchant stands here, displaying his fine white paper.
mobs.Description:
The merchant looks stern. He is properly dressed and looks up from 
his writing as you enter. 'How can I help you?' he asks.

mobs.Name: man roulette
mobs.LongDescription: The man stands here behind a roulette table.
mobs.Description:
The merchant looks stern. He is properly dressed and looks up from 
his writing as you enter. 'How can I help you?' he asks.

mobs.Name: waiter
mobs.LongDescription: A waiter is going around from one place to another.
mobs.Description: A tired looking waiter.

mobs.Name: waiter
mobs.LongDescription:
A man who in his young days was a famous sorcerer but now leads a 
quiet, peaceful life as a waiter.

mobs.Name: waiter
mobs.LongDescription: A waiter who seems to have reach contact with God.

mobs.Name: waiter
mobs.LongDescription: A waiter who knows where all his customers have their money.

mobs.Name: waiter
mobs.LongDescription:
A waiter is here who looks like he could easily kill you while still 
carrying quite a few firebreathers.

mobs.Name: filthy
mobs.LongDescription: Filthy is standing here, eager to serve you a special drink.
mobs.Description:
Filthy looks real, ehm, dirty.  He likes to keep his costumers happy,
but do not mess with him or else he'll get upset.

mobs.Name: keeper peacekeeper
mobs.LongDescription:
A Peacekeeper is standing here, ready to jump in at the first sign of 
trouble.
mobs.Description: He looks very strong and wise.  Looks like he doesn't answer to ANYONE.

mobs.Name: cityguard guard
mobs.LongDescription: A cityguard stands here.
mobs.Description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

mobs.Name: janitor
mobs.LongDescription: A janitor is walking around, cleaning up.

mobs.Name: fido dog
mobs.LongDescription: A beastly fido is mucking through the garbage looking for food here.
mobs.Description:
The fido is a small dog that has a foul smell and pieces of rotted meat 
hanging around his teeth.

mobs.Name: mercenary merc
mobs.LongDescription: A mercenary is waiting for a job here.
mobs.Description: He looks pretty mean, and you imagine he'd do anything for money.

mobs.Name: drunk
mobs.LongDescription: A singing, happy Drunk.
mobs.Description: A drunk who seems to be too happy, and to carry too much money.

mobs.Name: beggar
mobs.LongDescription: A beggar is here, asking for a few coins.
mobs.Description: The beggar looks like she is fed up with life.

mobs.Name: odif yltsaeb
mobs.LongDescription: An odif yltsaeb is here, walking backwards.
mobs.Description: The odif is a small god that has been reversed by some dog.

mobs.Name: cityguard guard
mobs.LongDescription: A Cityguard is here, guarding the gate.
mobs.Description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

mobs.Name: green gelatinous blob
mobs.LongDescription: An oozing green gelatinous blob is here, sucking in bits of debris.
mobs.Description: A horrid looking thing; it's huge, greenish, and looks like the blob.

mobs.Name: rufus paper boy
mobs.LongDescription: Rufus the paper boy is here, shouting about the local news.
mobs.Description:
Rufus was recently hired by the Midgaard News service to advertise the
local newspaper.  Since most peasants (that's you) can read, it's a good
way to get the information in your world out and about.  He snaps at you
to type "NEWS" (all capital letters) to find out what's up!
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 say Extra, extra, read all about it!;%1 say Type NEWS for all the news that's fit to print!

mobs.Name: postmaster immpost
mobs.LongDescription: The Immortals own Postmaster, is already licking the stamps.
mobs.Description:
The Immortal Postmaster is here to serve the Immortal breed of Elite.
He can be summoned by the magic words of :
LOAD MOB 3070

Please do not let him loose in the mortal world.

mobs.Name: kitten
mobs.LongDescription: A small loyal kitten is here.
mobs.Description: The kitten looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

mobs.Name: puppy
mobs.LongDescription: A small loyal puppy is here.
mobs.Description: The puppy looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

mobs.Name: beagle
mobs.LongDescription: A small, quick, loyal beagle is here.
mobs.Description: The beagle looks like a fierce fighter.

mobs.Name: rottweiler
mobs.LongDescription: A large, loyal rottweiler is here.
mobs.Description: The rottweiler looks like a strong, fierce fighter.

mobs.Name: wolf
mobs.LongDescription: A large, trained wolf is here.
mobs.Description: The wolf looks like a strong, fearless fighter.

mobs.Name: cryogenicist cryo gnomish gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A gnomish cryogenicist stands here, feeding his ice-drakes.
mobs.Description:
The wizened little gnome is wrapped head to toe in thick yak-skin 
garments. He is constantly slipping the dozen ice-drakes crunchy diamond 
and sapphire treats, and they snort chilly clouds of appreciation which 
crawl along the floor.

mobs.Name: quest harold
mobs.LongDescription: Harold the Undertaker is here selling coffins.
mobs.Description:
Harold is tall, skinny and black and has a very shrill voice.  He walks 
around with a long stick, used as both walking stick and to messure 
peoples height.

mobs.Name: questeq shopkeeper
mobs.LongDescription: A Quest equipment shopkeeper
mobs.Description:
He is an old man, but you should still not take him for granted, after all,
he is the shopkeeper of the quest eq, and he probably knows how to make the
best of the equipment he is selling.

mobs.Name: horse mount
mobs.LongDescription: A horse is standing here.
mobs.Description: This looks like a normal horse.

mobs.Name: white pawn
mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the light realm is here waiting for orders.
mobs.Description:
This white pawn looks quite patriotic. He stands ready to give his life for the
Crown.

mobs.Name: white pawn
mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the light realm is rushing to the opposite side.
mobs.Description:
This white pawn looks quite brave. He wants to reach the other side so that
Malthus can get another rook.

mobs.Name: white pawn
mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the light realm is here, trying not to be noticed.
mobs.Description:
This white pawn looks like a wimp. He is here praying that Malthus doesn't
sacrifice him...pathetic, isn't it?

mobs.Name: white pawn
mobs.ShortDescription: a pawn of the white court
mobs.LongDescription: A pawn is here, cursing Malthus.
mobs.Description: This white pawn looks quite angry. He is upset that Malthus has sacrificed him.

mobs.Name: priest white bishop
mobs.LongDescription: A priest of the light realm stands here.
mobs.Description:
He seems willing to send you to Heaven so he can help you reach a higher
spirituality. He wields a powerful mace for just such a purpose.

mobs.Name: white knight
mobs.LongDescription: A knight of the light realm stands here.
mobs.Description:
Here stands a magnificent knight of the light realm. It seems he wants you to
take a close look at his sharp lance.

mobs.Name: white rook castle
mobs.LongDescription: A large, white stone castle is scouting the area.
mobs.Description:
This white rook is a very large man-made tomb on wheels. Just from the looks of
it, it will probably be YOUR tomb.

mobs.Name: white queen
mobs.LongDescription: The queen of the light realm stands here.
mobs.Description:
The white queen is a stunningly beautiful woman with pale skin and a mass of
light hair that frames her head like the sun.  This is surely love at first
sight for you.

mobs.Name: white king
mobs.LongDescription: The king of the light realm is here, trying to hide from danger.
mobs.Description:
The white king looks like a wimp. He keeps peering around, apparently in
hopes of spoting a rook to hide behind. You wonder why Malthus made him the
king instead of you..

mobs.Name: black pawn
mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the dark realm is here waiting for orders.
mobs.Description:
This black pawn looks quite patriotic. He stands ready to give his life for the
Crown.

mobs.Name: black pawn
mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the dark realm is rushing to the opposite side.
mobs.Description:
The black pawn looks quite brave. He wants to reach the other side so that
Turing can get another rook.

mobs.Name: black pawn
mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the dark realm is here, trying not to be noticed.
mobs.Description:
The black pawn looks like a wimp. He is here praying that Turing doesn't
sacrifice him...pathetic, isn't it?

mobs.Name: black pawn
mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the dark realm is here, cursing Turing.
mobs.Description:
The black pawn looks quite angry. He is upset that Turing has let him get
captured.

mobs.Name: priest black bishop
mobs.LongDescription: A priest of the dark realm stands here.
mobs.Description:
He seems willing to help you straight into your grave so that he can properly
bless you.

mobs.Name: black knight
mobs.LongDescription: A knight of the dark realm stands here.
mobs.Description:
Here stands a magnificent knight of the dark realm. He seems to want you to
take a close look at his powerful lance.

mobs.Name: black rook castle
mobs.LongDescription: A large, black stone castle is here, looking for someone to kill.
mobs.Description:
The black rook is a very large man-made tomb on wheels. Just from the looks of
it, it will probably be YOUR tomb.

mobs.Name: black queen
mobs.LongDescription: The queen of the dark realm stands here.
mobs.Description:
The black queen is a stunningly beautiful woman with dark skin and a mass of
dark hair that crowns her head like a black cloud. If looks could kill, you'd
already be dead!

mobs.Name: black king
mobs.LongDescription: The king of the dark realm is here, trying to avoid capture.
mobs.Description:
The Black King looks like a wimp. He is keeps peering around, apparently in
constant fear of being captured. You wonder why Turing made him the king
instead of you.

mobs.Name: hermes official timekeeper
mobs.LongDescription: Hermes is here, staring at the hourglass.
mobs.Description:
Hermes looks happy. The last grains of sand are about to drop down from the top
portion of the hour glass. Turing's reached his time limit, so in a moment,
Hermes may get to forfeit black's move.

mobs.Name: hopper official
mobs.LongDescription: Hopper is here, examining the rules book.
mobs.Description:
Hopper is here scratching his head. He's not sure if the last move by Malthus
was legal or not..

mobs.Name: chessmaster grand malthus
mobs.LongDescription: Malthus is here, patiently twiddling his thumbs.
mobs.Description:
Malthus is legendary for his masterful skill at playing chess. This Grand
Chessmaster looks smart, but not half as smart as RIGEL. Apparently, he went
last and is now waiting for Turing to respond.

mobs.Name: chessmaster grand turing
mobs.LongDescription: Turing is here, wondering how she can save both queen without losing a pawn.
mobs.Description:
Turing is one of the greatest chessmasters ever. She looks smart, maybe even
smarter than IO! She'll need all of her wits if she's going to escape from the
trap Malthus set without loosing any pieces.

mobs.Name: money distributor money13100
mobs.ShortDescription: Drops money - never to be outside chute
mobs.LongDescription: Drops money - NEVER to be outside chute
mobs.Description:
Drops money to the guards so that they can pick it up.
and so that it will load prperly.
grrrr
mobs.ActionScript: %%30 drop all.pay

mobs.Name: compressed air elemental
mobs.LongDescription: The air elemental is here fighting the decreasing space.
mobs.Description:
The air elemental does not seem to be pleased at all with its situation,
being confined within the narrow walls of a pump in a dwarven iron mill.
If it was not for the supreme power of the summoner that bound it to
this place it would be wreaking havoc on the elemental plane of air by
now.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote huffs.
;%10 emote puffs.
;%10 emote let go of some air.

mobs.Name: king air elemental ruler
mobs.LongDescription: The air elemental is bored but can not find an exit.
mobs.Description:
The entrapped air ruler looks completely enraged over its situation.
Being enclosed in a pump has not made its temper any better. It is
trying to break the seal holding it in in any manner available. You just
might have given it the chance it has been waiting for.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote huffs.
;%10 emote puffs.
;%10 emote tries to break the wall down. It buldges markantly.
;%10 emote blows off some steam.
;%3 berzerk

mobs.Name: pumper sweaty desperate
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven pumper is desperately trying to deflate a pump.
mobs.Description:
Water is flushing down his body as he desperately and in vain tries
to force the large pump down, trying to achieve at least some effect.
There is no physical hindrance, as you can see, for this very able,
body to complete the task but he does just not seem to be able to make
it happen. On the expression on his face you can clearly see that he is
not to pleased about it. He would be even less if the overseer came
by...
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote kicks desperately in the air as he hangs from the pump lever.
;%10 emote kicks the grid and mutters something obscene.
;%10 say Whattaya lookin at?
;%10 emote glares towards you.

mobs.Name: pumper dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven pumper presses air from a pump in next to the blast furnace.
mobs.Description:
Arms like marble blocks and heavy heavy shoes are a must to be able
to run the furnace pumps. He looks content with his chosen profession
even though he only does one thing - Pump. He has the mill emblem on his
shoulderpad as all other responsible workers in the mill do.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote pushes up the pump lever.
;%10 emote pulls down the pump lever.
;%10 emote grins as he is fully aware of what he is doing.

mobs.Name: human food prisoner fodder
mobs.LongDescription: A piece of giant fodder runs around in circles.
mobs.Description:
This pathetic human is trying to escape his most probable future.
What his crime is, is not that important at the moment. He just wants to
stay alive just a little bit longer. He looks very well fed to be an
escaped prisoner. He even has sauce stains on his torn shirt. Guess the
food was not why he ran away.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote squeeks 'elp!'
;%10 emote looks around desperately trying to avoid the guards.
;%40 south
;%40 east
;%40 west
;%40 north
;%10 hide
;%10 sneak
;%10 flee

mobs.Name: guard Giant feeder
mobs.LongDescription: The Prison Guard is looking for one of his escaped prisoners.
mobs.Description:
The prisoner guard has got a problem he really must solve in a hurry.
If he can not find the escaped prisoners he will have to take their
place in the food chain. And as he also is one of the people delivering
the food to the giants he DOES know what they will do to their live
dishes, so being a prisoner in the mill is not something he wants to
become. There really is only one way out and that is through(!) a
giant. Most people do not survive that treatment, which is not so very
strange when you come to think of it.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote searches around for some lost food.
;%10 emote mutters something untranslatable.
;%10 emote sizes you up for a match or perhaps suitability.
;%10 emot ask 'Do you want to come along. I have something to show you.'
;%10 bash fodder
;%40 stand

mobs.Name: weasel gigantic giant fat
mobs.LongDescription: The fat gigantic weasel licks his lips as he sees you.
mobs.Description:
The weasel looks like any other weasel, except that this one
looks even more concerned about what is happening around it. There is
one more difference; it stretches 7 yards in length from nose to tip of
the tail (it has a short tail). But what brought it here in the first
place is unknown to you. Perhaps the constant supply of high quality
food.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote whispers to you 'I should have gotten that life insurance'
;%40 emote licks his fur.
;%10 emote jumps up in panic, peers around and slowly calms down again.

mobs.Name: summoner assistant
mobs.LongDescription: The summoner's assistant is conducting services for his master.
mobs.Description:
This well dressed dwarf carries all the necessary tools for his
master. This could be the reason he looks a bit more hunky than the
average dwarven magician apprentice, that use to be frail, of dwarven
standards of course. You cannot really figure out if he knows any spells
at all, but then again, do you really want to find out?
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote reties a knot on one of his many pouches.
;%10 emote mumbles something. This could be the start of some serious
 incantation better take a step back.
;%10 emote scratches something down in his notepad.
;%10 emo stares at you and states 'You disturb me and my master - Leave!

mobs.Name: caravan giant
mobs.LongDescription: A caravan giant staggers under his load.
mobs.Description:
Giants are known to be gigantic. This one is too, but in all
directions. His shoulders span over 10 feet. The rest of his
configuration fits his shoulders. He has worked out a lot. Could be he
carries metal bars from the foundry to the blacksmiths for a living.
Those thousands of pounds he carries do not seem to bother him the
slightest, but beware so he does not give them all to you, at once.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote puts down a foot right next to you. Phew, that was close.
;%10 emote juggles a metal bar over your head, perhaps you should
 increase your wimp level.
;%10 emote yawns a bit as he walks on.
;%10 give bar receiver
;%40 get bar
;%3 emote gives you a metal bar.
;%10 wield bar

mobs.Name: moron giant twin
mobs.LongDescription: A caravan giant staggers under his load.
mobs.Description:
Did not another one of the giants look exactly the same as this one??
All giants look pretty much the same (especially for a non-giant) but
that extremely thick forehead and the sagging jaw with its drop of drool
does look familiar... (Hmm who have you been hanging out with?) Perhaps
you have risked your life too long among these creatures or it could be
just ordinary paranoia.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote licks up a drop of drool from his lip.
;%10 emote drools slightly leaving a drip on his lip.
;%10 emot looks down on you and smiles. You definitely do not like this.
;%10 wield bar

mobs.Name: receiver bar dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarf counting bars for a living sits here.
mobs.Description:
The dwarf in front of you holds a notepad in his hand and is
currently summing up how many bars each of his giants have carried so
far. He must have nerves of steel to haggle with the giants as they
easily could drop their load on him converting him into a little wet
pool of dwarven moistness.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote gnaws a bit on his pencil.
;%10 emote looks over his shoulder to where his predecessor sat.
;%10 emote wonders where your load is.
;%85 get bar
;%85 give bar giant

mobs.Name: elemental enforcer
mobs.LongDescription: An elemental enforcer has his thoughts somewhere else.
mobs.Description:
The dwarven mage is dressed up in some odd silver dress. Looks like
he uses it in his job, as it is a bit more risky than the other ones'.
As a water elemental enforcer he commands the elementals into the molten
metal to give it a special and extra magical solidification process.
Naturally the water elementals are not overhappy with this as they are
annihilated when they step in to the smelt freezing it. A person with
such powers is surely not to tamper with.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks at you and you can see his eyes glow of extreme power.
;%10 emote mutters something and you feel the very fabric of the world
 shiver.
;%10 say Begone! - Your presence is not wanted.

mobs.Name: dwarf flow changer black
mobs.LongDescription: A blackened dwarf is ready for a new direction.
mobs.Description:
The little dwarf swaps a smelt directing blocker in a very congruent
pattern. Guess he has had this position for a very long time. He has to
be extremely bored or suffer from some kind of rare brain disease to
cope with it. Could also be that simple that he never got a replacement.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emo lifts up the blocker and puts it down again a bit differently.
;%10 emote changes the flow of metal. Oh, that was swift.
;%10 emote asks you if you want to take over the position.
 'It is well paid'

mobs.Name: sorter sorterer dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A small dwarf sits in a pile of trash.
mobs.Description:
Trash, trash, trash, everywhere trash, but in the midst of everything
a little dwarf who tries to sort out all the things the smiths and
everyone else has had a bad day with. Some things can still be used,
some go for remelting while others he equips himself with. What remains
is also Trash.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say You got something for me?
;%10 say Hey, You can leave your stuff over there.
;%30 wea all
;%20 get all
;%10 drop all

mobs.Name: blacksmith dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: The ordinary blacksmith does what is expected from him.
mobs.Description:
The blacksmith is taking a little break while the next specimen is
heating up to a suitable temperature. Sweat is breaking out all over his
well marbled body. Any ordinary dwarven female would twist her head
around and go knee-weak in his presence and tie knots in their beards.
Even you halt a bit to admire the musclegroups playing.

mobs.Name: polisher dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A wicked dwarf stands here with a dirty piece of cloth in his hand.
mobs.Description:
'No Stain - More Gain' is the polisher's motto as he breaks out
another clean cloth and attacks another, in your eyes already clean,
piece of metal. Perhaps the fluids have gone to his head as he never
rests in this his battle against dust. Dust is otherwise very much
present in a blacksmiths workshop. On the other hand no one complains as
it sure is a very boring task to perform, that no one wants to take
over.

%%10 emote scans over the metal surface and detects a invisible spot.

;%10 shudder

mobs.Name: shopkeeper shoppie
mobs.LongDescription: The Blacksmith Shopkeeper offers you a trade.
mobs.Description:
Proud and tall, the shoppie stands behind his desk pointing out wares
on display for you. You do not see any money lying around so either
no one else has been here today (hardly) or he is very quick to stash
it away in a safe place. That task is one of the few he would not trust
even his closest assistant with.
<worn on feet>       a pair of high clogs (hidden)
<worn under feet>    a shopkeeper stool (invisible)

%%10 say 'Are you going to stand there all day or
 are you going to buy something?
;%10 say Can I interest you in todays specials?
;%10 emote gives an order to his assistant.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper assistant
mobs.LongDescription: The Shopkeeper assistant perfects the display.
mobs.Description:
Proud and almost as tall as the shopkeeper (could be that he has to
move around so that he can not stand still on a stool or in some high
clogs hidden behind a desk). The shopkeeper's assistant wanders about
the displays correcting invisible misalignments in the rows of weapons
and armours. Once in a while he orders his assistant to go and fetch an
item from the ready room.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote plocks a bit among the displays.

 go get some.

mobs.Name: assistant immob119 shopkeeper
mobs.LongDescription: The Shopkeeper assistant's assistant is always at your service.
mobs.Description:
The shopkeeper assistant's assistant is the one that really does
everything in the shop, except giving orders of course, but he holds his
dream of one day getting his own assistant so that he too could relax a
bit. Unfortunately his current paycheck does not really approve of this
yet. But one day, one day, he WILL have one.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote makes sure the pricetag is clearly visible in a piece of
 equipment.
;%10 emote mumbles something about the lazy polisher.

mobs.Name: shoveller ore dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A tiny dwarf almost covered in stone dust looks back at you.
mobs.Description:
This tiny dwarf surely adds on to the dwarven taunts as he really is
wider that he is tall. It is not fat that made him this way but a
combination of genetics, ultraheavy labour and of course a suitable bone
structure. Even his head looks flatter that the usual dwarven citizen.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote waves his shovel in front of you.
;%10 say Uhuh?!
;%10 emote shovels some ore towards the mixing station.
;%10 say Where are your working clothes. My shift ended 3 hours ago.

mobs.Name: flinger alloy dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: An alloy flinger stands in he midst of a huge amount of alloying bars.
mobs.Description:
The pace of the alloy flinger is a bit irregular. It is not due to
him coming after but more due to the amount of metal currently in the
melt pool whirls waiting for alloys. It has to be balanced not to get
any unwanted phases in the steel. The alloy dosage job is a very
important one, at least according to his foreman and he is no one to
argue with.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote razes a heap of bars but builds it up again in seconds.
;%10 emote mumbles something about a steel recipe to himself.
;%10 em flings another small bar of unknown origin into the smelt stream.
;%10 say You are not the next shift - Go Away - and you are late too!!!

mobs.Name: carbon black shoveller
mobs.LongDescription: Something black watches you.
mobs.Description:
The little guy shovelling coal in the very essence of blackness. He (?)
is so black in the blackest of rooms that he seems to blur and melt into
the background. If it was not for the continual moaning and grumbling
and the stirring of dust behind him, you would never find him.
Where did he go? - No light can progress in the black puff he left.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote is suddenly detectable as he suddenly moved.

mobs.Name: limestone white shoveller
mobs.LongDescription: Something white watches you.
mobs.Description:
The little guy is shovelling limestone in the very extreme of whiteness.
He (?) is so white in the whitest of rooms that he seems to blur and
melt into the background. If it was not for the continual moaning and
grumbling and the stirring of dust behind him, you would never find him.
Where did he go? - No light help in the white puff as everything goes
white.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote is suddenly detectable as he suddenly moved.
;%10 emote coughs badly.
;%10 emote makes a big cloud of limestone dust blow up towards you.

mobs.Name: skeleton closet
mobs.LongDescription: Someone shoved a skeleton into the closet, so now it bides its time.
mobs.Description:
Just another typical skeleton, all bones and no food, ehh flesh. It
looks like it used to be humanoid before its creation, but one can not
be completely sure. Now it just stands here, waiting for something.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote stares at you.

;%8 open door west

mobs.Name: human slave
mobs.LongDescription: The weapon hardening slave wished for a better ending.
mobs.Description:
A human. You really have not seen that many running around loose in
the dwarven iron mill. On the other hand this one is chained to the
wall so he really does not count either. He looks well fed, strangely
enough, but he does not seem all that happy about it anyway. Guess he is
to much aware of his fate, as a part in the creation of human slaying
weaponry.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote whines softly.
;%10 emote shakes his chains in a vain effort to go free.
;%10 say Save me,  pleaseeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee!!!
;%10 emote shapes up and screams 'Come Ooon, Ill give you a fight for
the money.'

mobs.Name: Jill secretary
mobs.ShortDescription: the Accountant and Assisting Manager Secretary
mobs.LongDescription:
The Accountant and Assisting manager secretary has not had a break all
 day.
mobs.Description:
The work as a servant/secretary to both the accountant and the
assisting manager is heavy work, with a very tight schedule. She must
complete everything in time or she will be hunched and of course taunted
by the manager's secretary sitting further away in the hallway. She
looks a bit skinny, perhaps she has skipped one too many lunch breaks
just to keep up with her work and everyone knows that coffee with extra
caffeine/no sugar is not that nutritious. Btw, she got a name. It is
Jill.

mobs.Name: air filter elemental
mobs.LongDescription: The filtering elemental tries to clean anyone entering the office.
mobs.Description:
This elemental appears almost only as a shimmer in the air,
incorporeal, but it gives you a feeling of refreshment as it whirls
around you tearing slightly in your clothes, but leaving no trace but
fresh air (or at least fresher than out in the mill). Continuously it
stands here purifying the air for everyone in the Finance department.

%%90 HIDE
;%5 emote cleans off all the dirt on your body.

mobs.Name: accountant accountants
mobs.LongDescription: The Mill Accountant is the physical manifestation of all accountants.
mobs.Description:
Small, stubby brown hair, brown beard, small black dots as eyes and
most presumably a bleeding ulcer. The accountant of most larger
companies could be described as this and the iron mill is no exception.
The only difference is only that he is a bit smaller, but that is only a
dwarf thing and not worth mentioning, especially here in dwarven land.
His slender fingers have had many years of practise sorting paper
concerning the corporations financial status. One wonders if the
manager's assistant is his twin, but that must be an illusion.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote scribbles something down on paper.
;%10 emote moves another paper to the Out basket.
;%10 emote smiles as he finds another way to save a few gold coins.
;%1 emote takes a quick look at you and hollers 'GUARDS!!!'

mobs.Name: mimic chest
mobs.LongDescription: A treasure chest stands next to the wall.
mobs.Description:
A wooden treasure chest stands on golden feet in the corner of the
room. It is a rather plain chest but for the odd shaped key hole and the
bone lid sealing.
The chest is closed.

mobs.Name: assistant manager
mobs.LongDescription: The Assistant Manager has no interest in you what so ever.
mobs.Description:
Small, stubby brown hair, brown beard, small black dots as eyes and
most presumably a bleeding ulcer, the assisting manager of most larger
companies could be described as this and the iron mill is no exception.
The only difference is only that he is a bit smaller, but that is only a
dwarf thing and not worth mentioning, especially here in dwarven land.
His slender fingers have had many years of practise sorting paper
concerning the corporations financial and employee status. One wonders
if the accountant is his twin, but that must be an illusion.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote scribbles something down on paper.
;%10 emote moves another paper to the Out basket.
;%5 emot smiles as he finds another way to cut down on something.
;%1 emote takes a quick look at you and hollers 'GUARDS!!!'

mobs.Name: Manager
mobs.LongDescription: The Mill Manager is a very important person.
mobs.Description:
The Mill Manager is a secure and well reputed male member of the
dwarven society. His duties involve such complex matters as making sure
the investors are pleased and that no one complains (at least not to any
outsider). His most tiresome duty has to be, sitting in his office chair
all day without being asleep when someone enters the room.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote offers you a cigar while you all wait for the Guards.
;%10 say Do you have an appointment?
;%90 close door east
;%10 say This is not Sales. Off with you!

mobs.Name: Jane secretary
mobs.LongDescription: The Manager's Secretary is fully relaxed.
mobs.Description:
The mill manager's secretary is a young dwarven woman with both beard
and hair bleached from black to something a bit more white-blue. She
also seems to have a good lung capacity even for a dwarf and even more
strange, not extremely ugly legs. Her dress makes her appearance even
more clear to any spectator or more preferred, the VIP-visitors. The
clothes directive came directly from the mill manager himself, who also
did the recruiting himself. Kind of shows his preferences pretty much.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote polishes her already perfect fingernails.

;%2 emote removes a beard hair with a split end.

mobs.Name: Gretchen hostess
mobs.LongDescription: Gretchen, the VIP Club Hostess, greets you with a smile.
mobs.Description:
This well formed dwarven woman must be from one of the northern
dwarven kingdoms as she looks a bit less tanned than the rest of the
dwarven lot here. Could also be that she spends most of her time down in
the VIP-club of the Iron Mill. Her hair is set up like two gigantic
blond pretzels, one on each side of her head. Not the most common of
hairdos.

%%10 smile

 you within her enormous bossom.

 all, but you still feel the urge to fully comply without any
 restrictions what so ever.

mobs.Name: radiator dancing little fire flame
mobs.LongDescription: A small flame dances around on the floor.
mobs.Description:
A small flame not much larger that a blacksmith's hand dances around
on the floor. It does not ignite anything except for a few cigars, it
just takes care of the room's heating and some small degree of amusement
of the mill manager and his visitors.

mobs.Description:
The little guy shovelling coal in the very essence of blackness. He (?)
is so black in the blackest of rooms that he seems to blur and melt into
the background. If it was not for the continual moaning and grumbling
and the stirring of dust behind him, you would never find him.
Where did he go? - No light can progress in the black puff he left.

mobs.Name: overseer mill
mobs.LongDescription: The Mill Overseer struts about in his official vest.
mobs.Description:
If you thought the workers looked sturdy and well trained, this man
makes that impression wither instantly. Arms, legs, hands, yes even
eyebrows are massive with muscles and nothing to mess with or insult.
There is not a single piece of fat anywhere, only muscles. His weight
is hard to match with anyone else in the whole mill.

%%10 say Hey Slacker!  Back to work with you!

mobs.Name: dog runner
mobs.LongDescription: The runner dog carries a heavy load.
mobs.Description:
The runner/carrier dogs are a combination of a huge Saint Bernard
and an even larger Irish setter. Four feet in height (with load) and
with muscles playing in their so powerful bodies they make up marvellous
creatures. The dog wears a large double cargo basket usually filled with
nutrition for the blast furnace.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote licks you in the face. Yuck!
;%10 emote almost bashes you down as it rushes by.
;%10 emote tries to mark its territory on your leg.

mobs.Name: worm front mixxer guildg
mobs.ShortDescription: The front part of the mixing worm
mobs.LongDescription: A big circle of sharp teeth devours anything in sight.
mobs.Description:
The eternally moving teeth of the unimaginably, enormous, tied up,
mutant sandworm would care less if you would get stuck in it or not.
Always fed with stone and ore it would devour you before even you
noticed it, no matter the thickness of your armour. Luckily for you (and
it) it is slightly less intelligent than a goldfish and just a tiny bit
smarter than its rear end.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 emote devours some ore.
;%20 emote devours some limestone.
;%20 emote devours some coal.
;%5 emote tries to suck you in but you leap away at the very last
 second.

mobs.Name: worm rear mixxer end guildg
mobs.ShortDescription: The rear end of the mixing worm
mobs.LongDescription: The shivering end of a gigantic worm produces a continual flow of goo.
mobs.Description:
The giant mutated sandworm that is kept in the mill's lower region is
so incredibly large that its rear end takes up almost a whole room for
itself. That is good as the rear end has developed an intelligence of
its own (even though it surely is not much). Continuously extruding a
well digested menuer, it is most important that it is fed properly and
at all times. Its 'leavings' usually are taken care of with most caution
and transported away for further use, without any need of processing.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote produces a big cloud of smelly gas. Bleh!
;%10 emote floods you from your waist down in manure.
;%10 emote floods you from your ankle down in manure.
;%10 emote floods you from your neck down in manure.
;%10 emote floods you from your helmtop down in manure. Oops...
;%10 emote fill all your bags with manure. Congratulations.
;%10 emote shivers as to prepare for that extra big load to emerge.

mobs.Name: bonker xBonk
mobs.LongDescription: An enormous humanoid watches you with disdain.
mobs.Description:
As the last of his breed he has withdrawn from his adventures and now
spends his time as a personal bodyguard to the master blacksmith (as if
the master himself needed it) and as his closest assistant in the
smithery. He sure does have the strength and stamina for the job even
though his wits are sometimes to discuss, but then again with that
complexion you really do not want to bug him with smart comments about
his lack of intelligence as you most certainly do not want this short
fused guy as a foe.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote picks up a hot piece of metal with his bare hand.

 attention.

mobs.Name: fire elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A softly glowing fire elemental dries up the surrounding mix.
mobs.Description:
This minor elemental is bonded in the uppermost part of the mill as a
first contact with the incoming mixture of ore preparing it for what to
come by continuously scorching it make it steam off any residual water.
As all elementals it is a bit undefined in its shape but it is grossly
humanoid. Sudden flames protrude from its frame in a rather irregular
pattern.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote dries you up a bit.
;%10 emote makes you warm all over. Not too bad in the winter, you think.
;%10 say No, no, no. Not a chimney. It is a blast furnace!!!
;%10 emote spreads the mix evenly over the furnace cross section.
;%10 emote spanks you real hard for being so ignorant. Aiiii!
;%10 emote burns you lightly as a flame bursts from its body.

mobs.Name: fireball fire elemental major
mobs.LongDescription: A living fireball bounces around roasting you into a crisp.
mobs.Description:
To compare this one with the preheating elemental is like to compare
a mild summer breeze with a volcanic eruption. One can see the stone
itself sweat from a bare look from the elemental and you are very sure
that stone does not have any glands for that. You can see that it is
more or less spherical in shape when it happens to stand still for more
than a fraction of a second. If the increase of elemental power
continues like this one can only but wonder what awaits you further down
the furnace...
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 bounce
;%10 emot makes the stone lining break out in waves of sweat.
;%10 emote tries to ignite you, but you gracefully decline.

mobs.Name: fire elemental essence
mobs.LongDescription: The essence of fire almost makes you go blind.
mobs.Description:
The fire elemental shines brighter than the sun making it totally
impossible to look at but you can from the corner of your eye and
resisting the resulting pain see the flames coming out of its
body like a million blowtorches. Not only that, you sense that it is
coming, closer and closer...
mobs.ActionScript:
%%15 unlock door down
;%40 open door down
;%10 close door down
;%10 emote hisses 'Fire Fire Fire'
;%10 emote hisses 'Burn Burn Burn'

mobs.Name: fire elemental
mobs.ShortDescription: an elemental for reheating of metal
mobs.LongDescription: A joyful fire elemental hangs out in the smelt pool.
mobs.Description:
A fire elemental is bathing in a pool of smelt. It splashes around
and enjoys every second of it greatly. Not every day one find a pleased
elemental on this plane of existence. Better watch out so that is does
not invite you into its bath as it would most certainly scorch you very
badly.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote licks its mouth after a quick sip of smelt.
;%10 emote makes a quick crawl to the other side of the pool.
;%10 emote tries to drag you down for a 'refreshing' swim.

mobs.Name: Charmer dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A soaking wet dwarf looks after the wellbeing of the water elementals.
mobs.Description:
The charmer is keeping the water elementals healthy. That is his duty
in a short sentence. He does not really do anything else. He makes sure
the summoned cooling elementals are in full vigour and that they are
able and available to perform their duties. He also makes sure that the
control of these creatures is total as they most certainly will not like
what they have to do.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote comforts some unseen entity.
;%10 emot starts to glow as he restores himself to full potential.
;%10 emote snores badly as he sucks in air through his flooded nostrils.

mobs.Name: water elemental
mobs.LongDescription: The water elemental awaits further orders without any joy.
mobs.Description:
The Water elemental splashes down upon the molten metal drying it up.
Allowing for the workers to remove the bars so that a new batch of smelt
can be applied into the moulds. Unfortunately the water elementals are
severely hurt in the process as the smelt contains to much heat. Too bad
for them the charmers/summoners have them under total control otherwise
they would most certainly have done something completely different when
receiving that order.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote lack of comfort makes even you feel bad.
;%10 emote starts to bleed or maybe cry, who could ever tell...
;%10 emote leaves a wet trail as it slowly moves around.

mobs.Name: worker remover bar dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven worker removes bars from their moulds.
mobs.Description:
The worker is dressed in dull grey clothing as all workers in the
mill but these carry the insignia of the foundry department on their
chests as well as the mill emblem on the shoulder pads. Their work is to
remove the newly solidified iron bars from their moulds and place them
in the bar storage. A job that would give most people pneumonia as it
varies so much in temperature from free running smelt to the constant
splashes of water elementals and small trips out of the room to the
outside and back again.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote picks up a metal bar.
;%9 em watches new smelt come pouring into a mould, giving him more work.
;%10 emote drops a solidified metal bar.
;%15 cough
;%25 west
;%25 south
;%25 north
;%25 east
;%10 emote coughs badly.

mobs.Name: Master smithy blacksmith
mobs.LongDescription: The Master Smithy is one piece of compact dwarven power.
mobs.Description:
No wonder this dwarf became a blacksmith. His technique is great when
wielding his hammer powerfully and with extreme precision in every blow.
Add to that a great planning skill for the development of tools (rural
as well as war) AND knowledge of the most ancient secrets of magic.
Combined with years and years of practise you get a master blacksmith,
one of the most respectful cunning persons you have ever met. Not
someone you would like as an enemy, if you ever would mess with
him he would most certainly mess you up REALLY bad.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote gives away a small chant as he pounds on a piece of metal.
;%10 emote aligns his substrate perfectly with a perfectly aimed blow.
;%60 close door south
;%10 emot tells you 'Perhaps you should leave and fight me another day'
;%10 emote releases a extremely powerful spell into his work.

mobs.Name: Summoner dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven summoner is surrounded by magical energies.
mobs.Description:
You can actually feel a shift in the air as the summoner approaches.
His build is stocky as most other dwarfs but the arcane forces surge
strongly through this one. He wears no marking on his otherwise plain
clothing, but a simple brownish broosch with the official iron mill
logo. As a summoner he posses the power of summoning or dismissal at
will.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote opens up a rift to the elemental planes by just a flip of his
 finger.
;%10 emote grumbles over getting another air elemental.
;%10 emote muffles a giggle as he notices your puny apparition.

mobs.Name: crusher giant
mobs.LongDescription: WATCH OUT! The Giant crusher is going to whack you unless you move.
mobs.Description:
BONK! SMASCH! KRUSCH! GRUNT! The sounds the giants emit
whilst persuing their ultimate goal to destroy all stones bigger than
very very tiny. The dwarfs made a nice thing fooling them into this or
maybe the bribes were enough. They seem to enjoy it very much and they
would not give a second of thought about it if you came in there
somewhere between their BIG sledge and the ground, they might even like
the nutrial addition.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote shouts 'WHOPPA!!!!!!!!!'
;%10 emote bonks you on the head. Ouch that hurt.
;%10 emote roars 'Die Stone DIE!'
;%10 emote looks at you and drools 'Fresh Canned Food - Yummie!'

mobs.Name: Guard
mobs.LongDescription: A cocky mill guard is looking for intruders and here YOU are...
mobs.Description:
If the ordinary dwarf is stocky compared with human standards he
still would look like a thin thread compared with this hunk of a dwarf.
Worth noticing is that he does not hold any rank implying that his
superiors would be worse. The guards are under strict orders to remove
(in any way possible) any trespassers and nothing will make these highly
trained guards to disobey. Guess the punishment for disobedience is
worse than anything you can muster up.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say Thank YOU for showing up - I have waited all day.

;%10 say Hello and very much Good bye!!!

mobs.Name: worker dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven mill worker fulfils his tasks without delay.
mobs.Description:
Well a dwarf is a dwarf is a dwarf is a dwarf is a .... *sigh*
This one is no different than the rest of them, short and stocky with a
big beard worn clearly visible no matter what happens. He stares at you
angrily for disturbing his so very important work, whatever it might be.
On his shirt he has the iron makers union logo showing his membership
and the mills emblema on his shoulder pads.

mobs.Name: worker dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven mill worker shovels dirt down the grid.
mobs.Description:
Well a dwarf is a dwarf is a dwarf is a dwarf is a .... *sigh*
This one is no different than the rest of them, short and stocky with a
big beard worn clearly visible no matter what happens. He stares at you
angrily for disturbing his so very important work of shovelling dirt
into the ground grid. Oh his shirt he has the iron makers union logo
showing his membership and the mills emblem on his shoulder pads.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote checks his very dirty schedule.
;%10 emote shovels some limestone down the grid.
;%10 emote shovels some ore down the grid.
;%10 emote shovels some coal down the grid.
;%10 emote ignores you as long as you do not stand in the way.
;%3 emote is going to tell his friends you bothered him. Then they are
 going to beat you down and feed you to the mixxer...

mobs.Name: worker dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven mill worker has 'dirt' up to his waist.
mobs.Description:
Well a dwarf is a dwarf is a dwarf is a dwarf is a .... *sigh*
This one is just a bit different to the rest of them. He can not have
any kind of smell sensory system left after being covered in menuer  all
the time. He glares angrily at you for disturbing his so very important
work of shovelling dung onto the runner dogs. Oh his shirt he has the
iron makers union logo showing his membership and the mills emblem on
his shoulder pads.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote has a messy schedule to wade through.
;%10 emote shovels some dung into a wicker basket.
;%5 emote removes some manure from his beard.
;%10 emote tries to find his shovel beneath a big pile.
;%10 emote ignores you as long as you do not slip into his pool.
;%3 emote is going to tell his friends you bothered him. If they do not
 flee first...

mobs.Name: dragon Bxodegra dwarf spectral quester00
mobs.LongDescription: A tiny dwarf with a shimmering beard walks around in search of something.
mobs.Description:
The destiny of this young man is not what one could expect. He is out
on his biggest quest so far, and one of the hardest ever. He is looking
for himself or rather his true self. Exchanged in the cruelest of ways
as a child he now roams the lands in his constant search.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks very troubled.
;%10 emote ask 'You got the directions to the Yak farm?'
;%10 say Can you show me to Stanneg?
;%10 say There is an evil wizard hiding on the Northern Continent.
;%10 emote smiles as his beard suddenly shimmer in all colours and none.
;%10 ponder
;%10 smile

mobs.Name: killer dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A small dwarf 'takes care' of the slaves.
mobs.Description:
Wicked, wicked. This small dwarf seems to be in charge of the last step
of the manufacturing of extra good weaponry. He makes sure the weapons
are correctly aligned, lies perfect in your hand and even more important
that they really do work as they should. He also does some hardening of
weaponry, by the most classic way. By shoving them deep into a live
victim.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 grin
;%10 emo accidentally steps into a pool of blood, but he does not care.
;%10 emote smiles towards you. You do not like that.
;%10 snicker

mobs.Name: Guard chain
mobs.LongDescription: The swift Chain Guard makes sure noone misuses the chain.
mobs.Description:
If the ordinary dwarf is stocky compared with human standards he
still would look like a thin thread compared with this hunk of a dwarf.
Still this specimen seems very dexterious. Could be that his job is to
make sure that the large chain to the furnace top is in order and that
nobody that should not be there is there.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say Thank YOU for showing up - I have waited all day.
;%10 say What are you doing here?!
;%10 say Unauthorised use is punishable by DEATH!
;%10 snicker

mobs.Name: immob155spc guard elite
mobs.LongDescription: A powerful Mill Elite Guard charges you without hesitation.
mobs.Description:
If you have meet the other mill guards, you clearly see a difference.
This one seems in even better shape and look even more powerful. Could
be his rigorous training in all traits, both warrior and mage and
depending on faith either clerical or dexteriosity. The complete set of
skills makes him a very dengerous enemy. And enemy he is, to all
trespassers and outpointed undoers in the vicinity. If you have the
chance to leave, do so or he will make you stay, permanently.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 say There YOU are - Partytime.
;%20 get pay
;%5 say Rest now and be forever dead.
;%5 emote says 'Hello' and smiles wickedly.

mobs.Name: immob155spc guard elite
mobs.LongDescription: A powerful Mill Elite Guard is out on a search and destroy mission.
mobs.Description:
If you have meet the other mill guards, you clearly see a difference.
This one seems in even better shape and look even more powerful. Could
be his rigorous training in all traits, both warrior and mage and
