mobs.Name: Cyclops crusher
mobs.LongDescription: BEWARE! The Cyclops crusher has no depth perception.
mobs.Description:
KASCHMASKEDONK - BANG! Fragments of stone fly like crazy around the
totally wicked cyclops. Well bigger than the crusher giants it can
totally demolish a stone block with a single blow. Even the giants are
afraid of him as his visual field and other ablilities are rather
limited. That may also be your only chance to come through this.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote glares at you in the way only a one eyed cyclops can.
;%10 emote bonks you on the head. A little to deep it seems. OUCH!!!
;%10 emote roars 'Die Stone DIE!' and look at you.
;%10 emote drools at you 'Food - Comsie comsieeeee...'

mobs.Name: ice elemental
mobs.LongDescription: The ice elemental was too cold and was sat aside.
mobs.Description:
Summoning elementals is not the most exact of sciences even if some
want you to think so. Sometimes the elementals ripped from their home
plane are stronger or weaker than usual. Sometimes one just get hold of
the wrong kind. This was meant to be a water elemental but the summoner
was not aware of that this little fellow was on a quick visit to its
neighbouring plane and got a little surprice when it appeared. Now it
just sits here waiting to be dismissed home.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote shivers a bit in the heat.
;%10 emote glares icily towards you.
;%10 emote makes you miss that wollen cap your mother gave you as a
 child.
;%10 emote giggles as some snow appears in the air around it.

mobs.Name: ice white caravan giant
mobs.LongDescription: A caravan ice giant staggers under the heat.
mobs.Description:
The ordinary caravan giants are Huge. This rather sweaty ice giant
makes them look puny, unfortunately for him the temperature here is a
quite a bit higher than in his home country somewhere far north. The
heat puts him in constant agony but he do not leave anyway. Apperantly
he have made a deal with someone to stay otherwise he would surely be
long gone as he surely misses his ice widths and ice giant pals. He
would even consider saying 'Hi' to a Frost giant if he saw one just for
that brief moment of meeting someone from back home.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emot puts down a foot right next to you. Phew, that was close.
;%10 emote sweats out huge amounts of sweat.
;%10 emote staggers under his load as he walks on.
;%70 give bar receiver
;%40 get bar
;%3 emote gives you a bar.

mobs.Name: Guard
mobs.LongDescription: A cocky mill guard is looking for intruders and here YOU are...
mobs.Description:
If the ordinary dwarf is stocky compared with human standards he
still would look like a thin thread compared with this hunk of a dwarf.
Worth noticing is that he does not hold any rank implying that his
superiors would be worse. The guards are under strict orders to remove
(in any way possible) any trespassers and nothing will make these highly
trained guards to disobey. Guess the punishment for disobedience is
worse than anything you can muster up.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say Thank YOU for showing up - I have waited all day.
;%10 say I am going to remove you from this place - Bit by bit.
;%10 say Hello and very much Good bye!!!

mobs.Name: FIRE big dancing elemental flame
mobs.LongDescription: A BIG flame dances around in the furnace.
mobs.Description:
The flame lives in the burning coal of the furnace and spread his
graces in form of extreme heat to the pieces of metal inserted into the
furnace. It is very obvious to you that he do not like to be disturbed.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote shakes the coal ground as he watches you.
;%10 emote offers to light your whole body.
;%10 emote crackles as is consumes some object you just lost.
;%10 emote tries to engulf you in flames.

mobs.Name: converter air elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A air elemental dives through the smelt pool, avoiding the doctors blade.
mobs.Description:
The air elemental is forced through the pool of smelt. On its way
through it gathers small particles that is not supposed to be there and
bring it to the surface. This is not the most fun thing to do for a air
elemental but sometimes someone else like a powerful summoner can
convince even the most stubborn elemental to do his handywork.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote dives into the pool again.
;%20 emote quickly jumps over the scanning doctors blade.
;%10 emote spits out some dirt he swallowed.

mobs.Name: tester weapon
mobs.LongDescription: The weapon-tester has just found a new specimen to test a new weapon on.
mobs.Description:
The weapon tester performs the tests necessary to make sure that the
weapons made, really are as good as they should be. He is a little
wicked dwarf that have managed to acquire a pretty good skill with
almost any weapon available and he really does know how to make you feel
great pain.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote checks his test specimen.
;%10 emote looks at his X-Rigs to make sure they work properly.
;%10 emote checks his test subject.

mobs.Name: test subject
mobs.LongDescription: A human has been selected as a subject in a weapons test.
mobs.Description:
First thing you see when you look closer is that the, soon to be very
dead, human is blind. That is pretty obvious as someone has scorched
away the eyes. A pretty nifty way to keep prisoners calm. They really
can not do anything but stand around waiting...
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote just stands there chained to a X-rig.
;%10 emote is completely silent, no way he is going to distinguish himself.
;%10 emote tries to cry, but has no tearchannels left.

mobs.Name: Mom giant moron mother
mobs.LongDescription: The anxious mother of two giants wonders if you have seen her kids.
mobs.Description:
As a giant mother with two intellectually challenged sons, she is
constantly nervous that her offspring would get into trouble. She has
taken the opportunity to search them up at their new job to see how
things are progressing. Just as any caring parent would.

%%10 emote licks up a drop of drool from her lip.

;%10 emote seems worried.
;%10 emote looks down on you and smiles. You are not sure you like this.

mobs.Name: halfling soldier
mobs.LongDescription: The halfling soldier is wandering round off duty.
mobs.Description:
The halfling soldier look battle scarred and, despite being off duty, he 
still carries his sword.  He looks like he knows how to use it too.

mobs.Name: halfling guard palace
mobs.LongDescription: The palace guard stands to attention.
mobs.Description:
The guard stands ready to defend the kingdom of Delray.  His heavily 
polished armor shines, and there are decorative tassels and braids on 
his halberd, but despite the formality of this dress-uniform his weapon
is razor sharp, and his eyes move from place to place, seeking out the 
next threat.

mobs.Name: halfling palace servant
mobs.LongDescription: The palace servant is tidying up.
mobs.Description:
Like all good servants, he has mastered the art of doing his job without
intruding on other people in the room.  He is dressed in the dark blue 
livery of the palace of Delray.

mobs.Name: congar eel
mobs.LongDescription: A congar eel writhes in the corner.
mobs.Description:
He's a real slippery character, six feet of pure muscle with razor sharp 
teeth.  His black eyes regard you suspiciously as you enter the room. He 
seems in a particularly bad mood - you'd better watch out!

mobs.Name: dogfish
mobs.LongDescription: The dogfish glides dangerously round the room.
mobs.Description:
This fellow looks like a natural killer, sleek like a shark, fast and 
agile with rows of teeth.

mobs.Name: lobster
mobs.LongDescription: You almost don't see the lobster nestling behind a statue.
mobs.Description:
The lobster looks like a tough customer, powerful claws to crush his 
enemies and shiny black armor plating to protect him.  He's just going 
about his business and doesn't want any trouble.

mobs.Name: Malaig halfling magician
mobs.LongDescription: Malaig, the kings first advisor, is working on a new spell.
mobs.Description:
This is the most powerful mage in the kingdom, you can almost feel his 
power.  Energy crackles  between his fingers as he works on his latest 
spell.  His eyes stare intensely at a miniature dragon held in his hands,
as he works you think you see the dragon twitch. Suddenly a flame about 
the size of your finger flares from the its mouth and the tiny dragon 
leaps from the magicians  hand.  Malaig snaps his  fingers, the dragon 
disappearing in a puff of smoke, and proceeds to scrawl notes in a large 
book on his desk.  He looks up, noticing you for the first time - you 
feel like you shouldn't be here.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote mutters and scribbles some notes in a book.;
%10 emote snaps his fingers.

mobs.Name: halfling prince heir baby
mobs.LongDescription: The heir to the throne is gurgling and sucking his thumb.
mobs.Description:
The young prince is doing what all babies do - trying to eat his hand.  
Of course, since he is a Prince he does this with a certain nobility.  
Apparently this baby is over four hundred years old, which makes him the 
oldest baby you've ever seen.

mobs.Name: halfling king delray
mobs.LongDescription: The King of Delray sits impassively on his throne.
mobs.Description:
The King is clearly a warrior, not a courtier.  His arms bulge with 
muscle and the sword he carries looks more functional than decorative. 
His eyes are tired, worn down by the pressure of ruling for four hundred 
years.

mobs.Name: halfling queen delray
mobs.LongDescription: The Queen of Delray glides smoothly around the room.
mobs.Description:
The Queen is a dainty and dignified halfling.  She looks at you calmly 
as if she meets scruffy adventurers every day.

mobs.Name: gaoler licky kicky creature
mobs.LongDescription: The gaoler runs over to you and licks your hand.
mobs.Description:
This is one of Malaigs conjurations, a gaoler.  He appears to be 
constructed of pieces of scrap all cobbled together in the shape of a 
dog.  He bounds around the room, licking your hand in a friendly manner. 
But don't be fooled, the hind quarters are sharpened steel and made for 
killing. Licky-Kicky has only two functions - lick and kick.  At the 
moment he's feeling licky - you'd better hope it stays that way.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote licks your hand.;
%10 emote bounds around the room excitedly.

mobs.Name: wyrm serpent
mobs.LongDescription: The Wyrm hisses and draws back, ready to strike.
mobs.Description:
He's a monster, there's no doubt.  The Wyrm towers above you ready to 
lunge down and bite you in half.  This is the only survivor from the 
beasts conjured by Malaig to face the invaders.  You wonder how the 
others could possibly have been killed, you won't have to wonder forever 
though - either you'll find out very soon, or you'll be dead!

mobs.Name: halfling general mad
mobs.LongDescription: The mad general stares at you with wild eyes.
mobs.Description:
No wonder he's lost the plot, the rockfall to the south must have 
blocked the way out centuries ago, leaving him trapped here ever since.  
Once he was a proud general, a mighty warrior, slicing orcs and kobolds 
in defense of his kingdom.  Now he's a raving loon, with drool on his 
chin and a homicidal glint in his eye.

mobs.Name: orc prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: The Orc is slumped sadly in the corner of the room.
mobs.Description:
The orc looks tired, which hardly seems surprising - the beds here don't
look very comfortable.  You suspect that the room service isn't exactly 
five-star either.  He carries many scars, the results of Malaig's 
experimentation to make better killers.

mobs.Name: kobold prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: The Kobold paces up and down the cell.
mobs.Description:
You'd think he would be bored after four hundred years pacing up and 
down this cell, but he's a kobold and not very bright.  He doesn't look 
in very good shape either - clearly the larger prisoners take his share 
of the food.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote paces up and down.;
%10 emote mumbles.

mobs.Name: shoal fish
mobs.LongDescription: There is a shoal if tiny coloured fish flitting about the room.
mobs.Description:
Individually they wouldn't be a match for a mighty adventurer like you, 
but there are literally thousands of them, all with brightly glinting 
scales, and sharp teeth.

mobs.Name: citizen halfling delray
mobs.LongDescription: A citizen of Delray ambles aimlessly through the city.
mobs.Description:
He has a happy expression on his face, pleased to be able to walk 
the streets of his beloved city in safety. He has a chubby face, 
and a little pot belly - obviously living the good life.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote whistles a happy tune.;
%5 emote sneezes, sending up a small stream of bubbles.

mobs.Name: soldier offduty halfling
mobs.LongDescription: A halfling soldier is wandering around off-duty.
mobs.Description:
Taking advantage of his time off, this soldier is enjoying
the sights of the City of Delray. He does not seem at all
surprised to see seaweed and fish sharing the streets.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote flexes his fingers.;
%5 emote whistles softly to himself.

mobs.Name: child halfling
mobs.LongDescription: A spritely halfling child hops and skips down the street.
mobs.Description:
At over four hundred years old, she has had a longer 
childhood than most. Still, she still seems to be enjoying 
herself, skipping about with a jolly expression on her 
little halfling face.

mobs.Name: halfling mage apprentice
mobs.LongDescription: An apprentice mage practices hard to become a master magician.
mobs.Description:
The apprentice mage yearns to one day become as powerful as her 
master, Malaig. Her attention is elsewhere, and her lips and 
fingers move as if practicing spells,

mobs.Name: halfling junkmaster shopkeeper jakat
mobs.LongDescription: The head and shoulders of Jakat poke out above the piles of junk.
mobs.Description:
At first glace he appears to be buried, and you prepare to offer
him assistance. You soon realise however that this is the 
proprietor, Jakat.

mobs.Name: halfling innkeeper
mobs.LongDescription: A portly innkeeper leans casually against the bar.
mobs.Description:
He has a round belly from drinking too much ale, and the biggest 
forearms you have ever seen. He has spent the best part of four 
hundred years lugging barrels of ale about, and serving his 
regulars.

mobs.Name: ghost gorkan halfling
mobs.LongDescription: A semi-transparent halfling glides across the room.
mobs.Description:
When he was alive, Gorkan was a magician almost as powerful as 
Malaig himself - in fact he was Malaig's brother. Jealous of his 
brothers power and popularity, he tried to betray the City of 
Delray until he was banished by his brother to live the rest of 
his life outside the city walls. After many decades, his magic 
began to fail and he drowned but even death could not free him 
from Malaig's justice, and he haunts this place still.

mobs.Name: giant octopus
mobs.LongDescription: The tentacles of a huge octopus lunge at you out of a cloud of ink.
mobs.Description:
You can barely make out the shape of the giant octopus's head 
through the inky murk around you. Eight long tentacles flail about 
you, trying to draw you in to the vicious beak in the centre.

mobs.Name: terrapin
mobs.LongDescription: A little terrapin is paddling furiously towards the altar.
mobs.Description:
He is only the size of your hand, but he could still give you a nasty 
nip! Aw, just look at his little legs go.

mobs.Name: turtle giant
mobs.LongDescription: A huge turtle bats at you angrily with his flipper.
mobs.Description:
His craggy face glares at you irritably, annoyed at being disturbed. 
Those flippers could give you a nasty whack, and his jaws look about 
the right size to snap off your head.

mobs.Name: prawn
mobs.LongDescription: A little prawn flips across the sandy ground.
mobs.Description:
Your eyes can barely make out the little prawn as she flips her body 
along the seabed, between the coral pillars.

mobs.Name: king prawn
mobs.LongDescription: The King Prawn gazes down on you from his perch in the coral towers.
mobs.Description:
The King Prawn is the ruler of all prawns, he sits upon his coral 
throne, master of all he surveys. Some might dismiss him as a wimpy 
shrimp, but you don't get to be king prawn around these parts without 
knowing a thing or two about dirty fighting.

mobs.Name: anenome
mobs.LongDescription: A bloated red anenome squats protectively over her coral patch.
mobs.Description: Nobody wants an anenome as an enemy.

mobs.Name: seahorse sea horse
mobs.LongDescription: A seahorse rears up in front of you!
mobs.Description:
She stares at you with boggling eyes, down her long nose as if to
say "..and what do you want?". Probably not best pleased to see
you.

mobs.Name: starfish
mobs.LongDescription: A red and orange starfish scuttles along in front of you.
mobs.Description:
Hmm..as you stare and the starfish you gradually realise that 
those five arms of his would wrap perfectly around your head - 
might even squash it.

mobs.Name: eel wriggly
mobs.LongDescription: A long thin eel wriggles out of your way.
mobs.Description:
He's a slippery customer, just going about his business and 
not looking for any trouble. He probably squeeze you flat if 
you mess him about.

mobs.Name: weed weeds seaweed clinging fronds
mobs.LongDescription: Long fronds of seaweed grab you as you try to pass.
mobs.Description:
You could think they were trying to strangle you! The long 
strands grapple with your arms, and wrap around your head, 
making it difficult to see.

mobs.Name: barracuda vicious
mobs.LongDescription: A long thin barracuda snaps at you viciously.
mobs.Description:
Say "ba" (ba), "ra" (ra), "cu" (cu), "da" (da), put it all together 
and what have you got? Babararacucudada - what does it say? I dunno, 
but i think we got a hit record. *faint*

mobs.Name: halfling citizen delray
mobs.LongDescription: A halfling skips merrily along the city streets.
mobs.Description:
She just seems happy to be alive, beaming from ear to ear, and gliding
along with a skip and a spring in her step.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote skips gaily along.;
%5 emote giggles merrily.

mobs.Name: cloud coal dust
mobs.LongDescription: A mucky cloud of coal dust envelopes you.
mobs.Description:
The cloud swirls around, carried by the random currents of the ocean. The
thick black particles stick to your clothes, and choke you. The coal dust
seems to have a life of its own!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote swirls towards you on a current of water, choking you!.;
%5 emote wraps itself around you.

mobs.Name: crab little
mobs.LongDescription: A tiny crab scuttles nonchalantly in front of you.
mobs.Description:
The little crab happily scuttles about in the silty sand. Just look at her
little legs go! Hehehe. She seems to be going round in circles - one of the
problems with walking everywhere sideways.

mobs.Name: clownfish clown fish
mobs.LongDescription: A colourful clownfish is here, goofing about.
mobs.Description:
The clownfish is a startling yellow colour, with brilliant blue markings.
He looks fairly timid though, be careful not to scare him off.

mobs.Name: monkfish
mobs.LongDescription: A monkfish swims about here, praying.
mobs.Description:
The monkfish is a wide squat fish, with a powerful tail and black-tipped 
brownish fins.

mobs.Name: citizen halfling delray
mobs.LongDescription: A citizen of Delray dances merrily through the city.
mobs.Description:
She seems cheerful and full of the joys of life, she almost seems to
dance through the city, smiling at the other inhabitants around her.

mobs.Name: deep one creature
mobs.LongDescription: The evil Deep One chants in a very odd, very wicked language.
mobs.Description:
The Deep One has found the fabled sunken continent of R'liagh, and joined
with its fellow deep ones in continual prayers to invoke the most 
evil of evil.  Resembling a human covered with fish scales and enhanced
with gills, the sheer evil presence of this monster is enough to knock
down your armor class by several points.

mobs.Name: deep one creature
mobs.LongDescription: The evil Deep One swims in an endless search for the sunken island R'liagh.
mobs.Description:
Fish scales cover the once-human body of the evil Deep One, faithful 
subject of the evil god Cthulu.  Once this poor soul wandered solid
ground. Increasingly evil, increasingly drawn to water, one day he murdered
an entire town, then walked into the sea.

mobs.Name: Thraxx
mobs.LongDescription: A Thraxx is trying to drag you down into the water with its four arms!
mobs.Description:
This thing is an amphibious creature with six eyes on its salamander-like head.
It raises its four muscular arms and and claws you with suprising ferocity.

mobs.Name: piranha pirana
mobs.LongDescription: Some Piranhas are searching for blood.
mobs.Description:
This fish has red scales with a dark pattern. Although the fish is 
quite small the mouth is huge and has thousands of small teeth.
Piranhas go through toothbrushes rather quickly.

mobs.Name: Argundian Tiger
mobs.LongDescription: A big bad tiger is devouring you with his hungry eyes.

mobs.Name: parrot ara
mobs.LongDescription: A parrot is sitting on the lower branches of a tree.
mobs.Description:
The parrot is talking constantly meaningless words that it has picked up from
people travelling on the trail.

mobs.Name: cannibal native
mobs.LongDescription: A Cannibal rushes out from the bushes and attacks you!
mobs.Description:
The Cannibal stares back at you with crazed eyes. He is wearing only a
loincloth of deerskin and has a feather from a horn-bird behind his left
ear.

mobs.Name: captain silver
mobs.LongDescription: Captain Silver stands behind a desk and eyes you with his only eye.
mobs.Description:
He looks exactly as a pirate taken from an old pirate movie. He is wearing a
dark blue coat and has a black pirate-hat on his head.

mobs.Name: cannibal shaman
mobs.LongDescription: A shaman chants strange words.
mobs.Description: He has some feathers in his hair, and he looks completely insane.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote chants, "redro taht htiw seirf ekil uoy dluow".

mobs.Name: shopkeeper grim edgar shamhna
mobs.LongDescription: #rGrim #MEdgar #rthe one-eyed tavernkeeper#N is standing behind the bar.
mobs.Description:
It is the good old Edgar, our tavernkeeper. His tall body is dressed 
in a long, black robe. He's got only one eye left, and a long scar across 
his cheek symbolizes his killer experience, and you get the impression 
that though he is a friendly clannie, you'd better not insult him when 
you get drunk. Tired from numeruous wars this mighty warrior retired from 
the battlefields and opened the clan's bar. Friendly he greets all 
Shamhna members as they approach the tavern. He knows each member's 
favorite drink so there is no need to order anything, simply give him a 
sign and he will serve it. Besides food and drinks Edgar also has some 
other useful items to sell.

mobs.Name: morella shamhna vamp
mobs.LongDescription: #MMorella #rthe curvy vamp#N, watches you expectingly.
mobs.Description:
Morella is a redheaded, sexy vamp with green, serpentine eyes. Her
perfect body is dressed in tight, semi-transparent clothes which show 
more then they actually cover. Black fishnet stockings perfectly fit on 
her long legs that stand on red, 4 inch high heels. Morella is the 
prettiest of all girls from the mansion and knows all the means by which 
to make the warriors of Shamhna feel comfortable when they return from 
the battles.

mobs.Name: quartermaster dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven quartermaster stands by the gangplank selling tickets.
mobs.Description:
The quartermaster has the rough appearance of a fellow who spends all
his hours at sea. His clothes are grubby and mended with patches of
sailcloth, and his beard is ragged and unkempt. His hands, covered
with thick calluses, hold a handful of wooden tickets.

mobs.Name: quartermaster dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven quartermaster stands by the gangplank selling tickets.
mobs.Description:
The quartermaster has the rough appearance of a fellow who spends all
his hours at sea. His clothes are grubby and mended with patches of
sailcloth, and his beard is ragged and unkempt. His hands, covered
with thick calluses, hold a handful of wooden tickets.

mobs.Name: werewolf wolf were
mobs.LongDescription: A powerful werewolf strides purposefully down the street.
mobs.Description:
Humanoid in shape, but with facial features resembling those of a 
wolf, the werewolf is obviously very strong and quick. He walks around 
with an air of superiority, master of all he surveys.

mobs.Name: wereboar boar were
mobs.LongDescription: A wereboar struts about self-importantly.
mobs.Description:
The wereboar is very heavily built, with wide shoulders and arms roped 
with thick muscle. He doesnt look particularly intelligent, but then its 
likely he prefers violence to chess.

mobs.Name: werecat cat were
mobs.LongDescription: A werecat picks his way nimbly across the street.
mobs.Description:
At a first glance he looks like a human, but a closer look shows that 
the short hair on his head is really fur, and his eyes are slitted. He 
moves very gracefully, almost gliding across the street. Occasionally he 
clicks his claws together - a kind of nervous twitch.

mobs.Name: wererat rat were
mobs.LongDescription: A devious wererat skulks around here.
mobs.Description:
With his beady eyes and twitchy nose, this humanoid creature resembles a
rat. Glancing suspiciously around he dry-washes his hands nervously. He 
certainly looks an untrustworthy individual - I'd check my pockets if I 
were you.

mobs.Name: weretiger tiger were
mobs.LongDescription: A mighty weretiger stalks confidently down the street.
mobs.Description:
He looks born to rule, with a calm penetrating gaze, and a powerful
build. He is well dressed, and moves confidently, his eyes scanning the
whole street. His eyes are slitted, and a very pale yellow, his hair is
a light reddish colour, with darker stripes.

mobs.Name: werewolf wolf were
mobs.LongDescription: A powerful werewolf snarls at you.
mobs.Description:
Can you believe it? You travel all this way to take a look round his 
home and he's not pleased to see you? Some people have no manners. It'd 
probably be best to go now, before he starts some trouble.

mobs.Name: wereboar boar were
mobs.LongDescription: A wereboar mumbles unitelligibly at you.
mobs.Description:
He's certainly well built, but you can tell that he's not exactly the 
sharpest tool in the box. He looks at you suspicously, and looking into 
his eyes you can tell that he's trying to figure out why you don't look 
like the other wereboars. You better leave before he figures it out.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks blankly at you.;
%10 mumbles to himself.

mobs.Name: werecat cat were
mobs.LongDescription: A werecat blinks as he looks at you.
mobs.Description:
He blinks at you, and rubs his eyes as if he has just awakened. You 
better not have disturbed him! Like a domestic cat he likes to sleep, 
but unlike a his domesticated cousins, he is likely to rip your arms 
off if you've upset him.

mobs.Name: wererat rat were
mobs.LongDescription: A sneaky wererat regards you suspiciously from across the street.
mobs.Description:
He's a devious fellow, theres no doubt, I'd keep an eye on my gold if I 
were you. His beady little eyes size you up, weighing and measuring, I 
bet he could tell you your entire inventory.

mobs.Name: weretiger tiger were
mobs.LongDescription: A proud weretiger surveys the room.
mobs.Description:
He stands head and shoulders above everone else, gazing 
impassively around him. His calm face gives away his 
confidence at being able to handle anything life throws 
at him.

mobs.Name: weretiger priest high were tiger
mobs.ShortDescription: the High Priest of the weretigers
mobs.LongDescription: The High Priest of the weretigers is here, mumbling canticles.
mobs.Description:
He's dressed in long white flowing robes, with a purple trim. He's 
obviously deeply religious, he murmurs his prayers to his totem, the 
tiger, almost constantly.

mobs.Name: werewolf shaman were wolf
mobs.LongDescription: The Shaman of the Werewolves is chanting here.
mobs.Description:
Unlike his kinsfolk, who are a bizarre mixture of wolf and man, the 
Shaman has a wolf's head and a mans body. His shapeshifting skills have 
been honed by his meditations to such a degree that he can metamorphose 
different parts of himself, almost at will. He wears a ragged collection 
of robes and amulets, and carries a small rod with a golden wolfshead.

mobs.Name: wererat priest rat were
mobs.LongDescription: The Priest of the Wererats is checking the collection plate.
mobs.Description:
He doesn't look very reputable, but then neither do the rest of the 
wererats. He keeps looking in the collection plate, and you cant help 
noticing that he occasionally removes some of the coins and places 
them in his own pocket.

mobs.Name: werecat priest cat were
mobs.LongDescription: The Priest of the Werecats is watching over his people.
mobs.Description:
With his slightly pointed ears, and short hair, he looks very handsome. 
His slitted yellow eyes glance at you as you enter, and watch you as you 
move around. Clearly he doesnt trust you around his flock.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote watches you suspiciously.;
%10 emote glances around the room.

mobs.Name: wereboar priest boar were
mobs.ShortDescription: the High Priest of the wereboars
mobs.LongDescription: The High Priest of the wereboars is trying to count his congregation.
mobs.Description:
Dressed in long flowing robes, he looks fairly respectable, but as he 
surveys his temple, you get the impression that he's trying (in vain) to 
count the people there.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks puzzled.;
%10 emote grunts something at you.

mobs.Name: korgan huntsmaster wolf were werewolf
mobs.LongDescription: The Huntsmaster of the werefolk suddenly appears from behind you.
mobs.Description:
Korgan is the hero that all the werefolk (not just the wolves) wish to 
emulate. He truly is a magnificent sight as he towers over you. His arms 
are banded with thick muscle, and his fur is tinged silver-grey. His 
teeth are as large as your fingers, and his eyes glow with power.

mobs.Name: werewolf hunting were wolf
mobs.LongDescription: A werewolf is hunting here.
mobs.Description:
Metamorphosed into lupine form, the werewolf looks like a powerful 
timber wolf. Standing as high as your waist, his hackles rise as he 
looks at you. He bares his teeth in warning, and a low growl begins 
in his throat, I think he just found his lunch - You!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote growls at you.;
%95 hide

mobs.Name: weretiger hunting were tiger
mobs.LongDescription: A weretiger is here, looking for a snack.
mobs.Description:
It's a bit late for eating out - but the hunting garden is always open, 
and thanks to the hard work of Huntsmaster Korgan, well stocked.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote growls at you.;
%95 hide

mobs.Name: wererat hunting were rat
mobs.LongDescription: A wererat tries to sneak up on you.
mobs.Description:
His sharp little teeth glint in the dim light of the hunting garden, and 
he stares at you with piercing black eyes. He's too small to eat you 
whole, but that doesn't mean he won't try to eat bits of you!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks at you and licks his lips.;
%95 hide

mobs.Name: werecat hunting were cat
mobs.LongDescription: A werecat stalks carefully through the bushes.
mobs.Description:
He's incredibly graceful, as he moves towards you through the 
undergrowth. Hmm...wait a second, while you admiring his style - he's 
got his eye on your leg, and he looks very hungry.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote growls.;
%95 hide

mobs.Name: wereboar hunting were boar
mobs.LongDescription: A wereboar munches happily on a severed limb.
mobs.Description:
He's very heavily built, this wereboar, and so clearly needs alot of 
food to keep him going. He may be a bit 'thinking impaired' but he seems 
to have dismembered his lunch very efficiently.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote burps.;
%95 hide

mobs.Name: weretiger were tiger high seat
mobs.LongDescription: The High Seat leads the werefolk.
mobs.Description:
Each of the weretigers take it in turns to take up the office of High 
Seat. Each lasts for a single month, after which another takes his 
place. Being the leader of all the werefolk is a heavy burden, and the 
strain shows in his dulled eyes, and slumping shoulders. Still, he seems 
proud to serve.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks very tired.;
%10 emote peers wearily around the House.

mobs.Name: weretiger were tiger seat assent
mobs.LongDescription: The Seat of Assent is counting votes.
mobs.Description:
The Seat of Assent is an official post, which is rotated through the 
were tigers on a monthly basis. His job is to count the votes in favour 
of any motion put before the Werehome House of Lords.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote peers around the House.;
%10 emote carefully re-checks his counting.

mobs.Name: weretiger were tiger seat rejection
mobs.LongDescription: The Seat of Rejection is counting votes.
mobs.Description:
Every month a different weretiger holds the post of Seat of Rejection. 
When a motion is put before the House of Lords, he counts to number of 
votes against, and relays this information to the High Seat.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote stands on the tips of his toes, to get a better view.;
%10 emote carefully counts the votes.

mobs.Name: birt wererat lord were rat
mobs.LongDescription: The Lord of the wererats is gloating over his collection of junk.
mobs.Description:
Lord Birt is the sneakiest, most lightfingered, and most devious of all 
the wererats. No wonder then, that he is also their leader and most 
admired hero. While you look at him he stares back, he's already made 
a note of everything in your inventory, and is probably about to help 
himself to it.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote tries to slip his hand into your pocket.;
%10 emote rubs his hands together with glee.

mobs.Name: dorlan wereboar lord were boar
mobs.LongDescription: Lord Dorlan is struggling with some paperwork.
mobs.Description:
He's not the sharpest tool in the box (if you know what I mean) but 
sadly for the wereboars, he's the sharpest tool in their box. However, 
you would be wise not to underestimate him. He's very heavily built, 
with a jutting pugnacious jaw, and fists like cured hams.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote growls.;
%10 emote glares at you.

mobs.Name: kralian werecat lord were cat
mobs.LongDescription: Lord Kralian looks after all his people.
mobs.Description:
The werecats were the last of the werefolk to arrive at werehome, and 
though is was a long time ago by human standards, the long-lived 
werecats remember Lord Kralian's role in bringing them to their home. 
Old he might be, but he moves with the agility of a cat, and his 
reactions are like lightning.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote yawns.;
%10 emote flexes his muscles.

mobs.Name: xamon werewolf lord were wolf
mobs.LongDescription: The mightiest of all the werefolk towers over you.
mobs.Description:
Lord Xamon is the largest werewolf you have ever seen, you barely stand 
as high as his chest. His deeds outstrip even those of Huntsmaster 
Korgan - it's said he once killed a huge golden dragon with his bare 
hands. The same hands that are poised to rip out your throat.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote ROARS!

mobs.Name: loremaster weretiger were tiger
mobs.LongDescription: An ancient weretiger waits to pass on his wisdom.
mobs.Description:
Once a proud weretiger, the loremaster has done it all, seen the outside 
and fought dragons and demons, and spent years studying the ancient lore 
of the werefolk. You can feel his wisdom as you look into his eyes, 
and a sense of calm descends upon you.

mobs.Name: aaron shopkeeper expedition werewolf were wolf
mobs.LongDescription:
A burly werewolf will sell you everything you could need for an 
expedition.
mobs.Description:
He's pretty well built, and has quite a few scars, showing that he knows 
what he's talking about when he tries to sell you adventuring equipment.

mobs.Name: prisoner filthy human
mobs.LongDescription: A ragged and filthy prisoner cowers before you.
mobs.Description:
He's not been well looked after, his eyes are wide with terror and lack 
of food has turned him into a shadow of a human being. He's covered in 
his own filth as he cringes on the ground in front of you, begging for 
his life.

mobs.Name: prisoner bloody elven elf
mobs.LongDescription: A ragged elf looks beaten and bruised.
mobs.Description:
He looks like he's been put through a mill, his arms are covered with 
weeping sores and his clothes are dirty and torn.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote cowers before you.;
%10 emote weeps piteously.

mobs.Name: prisoner dwarven dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarf tries in vain to hide under a bush.
mobs.Description:
His eyes are dull, and is beard is patchy and matted with blood and 
filth. He has a hunted look, and constantly scans the area, as he 
scrabbles at the ground, trying to hide.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote scrabbles at the ground, making his fingers bleed.;
%10 emote cringes in fear.

mobs.Name: insects swarm bugs
mobs.LongDescription: You hear buzzing, and see a swarm of insects flying at you.
mobs.Description:
These insects are more of an annoyance than a threat.
It is made up of hundreds of annoying insects.

mobs.Name: bat
mobs.LongDescription: A black furry bat flies into your face.
mobs.Description:
You hear a high pitch screech. It is a black furry bat. This
annoying creature usually travel in flocks, so WATCH OUT.

mobs.Name: shepherd man
mobs.LongDescription: A humble shepherd is here looking after his sheep.
mobs.Description:
The shepherd is a a patient old man, who has spent all his days looking after
his sheep, and all his nights studying the virtue of Humility. Through the his
wrinkled face though you can see his proud dignity and begin to sense that he
was once a warrior.

mobs.Name: girl child
mobs.LongDescription: A smiling young girl is here.
mobs.Description:
The girl looks shyly at you. Even at this
young age, she has learned enough of her
culture to be humble. She jumps rope and
look up at you expectantly.

mobs.Name: sheep
mobs.LongDescription: A sheep peacefully eats grass.
mobs.Description:
Even the sheep in New Magincia seem to exude
humbleness. The sheep has pure white fleece.

mobs.Name: katrina woman shepherd
mobs.LongDescription: Katrina the Shepherd is her looking over the village.
mobs.Description:
Katrina was one of the Warriors of Destiny. She epitomizes the virtue of
humility. After her great Enlightenment, she traveled back to her home and
helped rebuild Magincia. She still is a great warrior and an able guardian
of New Magincia.

mobs.Name: rat
mobs.LongDescription: A rat is gnawing on a book.
mobs.Description:
This giant rat is smelly and fleas jump up from fur. The rats
have been a great problem in the library because they eat and
shred the books. This rat seems to be rabid, so beware of his
teeth.

mobs.Name: spider
mobs.LongDescription: The giant spider sits on its web.
mobs.Description:
This scavenger has seemed to collected many things,
including books, scrolls, and other scraps. His
glistening teeth drip with poison.

mobs.Name: mage
mobs.LongDescription: A mage stands here reading a book.
mobs.Description:
The mage in his ever-increasing search for Honesty
and Truth, has come to library to peruse the ancient
tomes of knowledge. He glances at you, and returns
to his study.

mobs.Name: nystul librarian mage
mobs.LongDescription: Nystul the Librarian sits at his desk, writing some scrolls.
mobs.Description:
Nystul is the mentor, teacher, mage of the Lyceum.
He is a shining example of Truth. His head is bowed
over a book, but power radiates from him.

mobs.Name: mariah mage
mobs.LongDescription: Mariah walks around the stacks, busily looking for a book.
mobs.Description:
Mariah is another Warrior of Destiny. She joined
the Avatar to add some magical punch during his
Enlightenment. She seems serene in her total
devotion to the virtue of Honesty.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 say Where is that damn book!

mobs.Name: slime puddle mass
mobs.LongDescription: An ugly green mass sits on the ground in a puddle.
mobs.Description:
The slime is an amorphous goo. It seems pretty
wimpy, but it has alot of friends. As you look
at it you wonder who these things reproduce.

mobs.Name: snake
mobs.LongDescription: The snake strikes.
mobs.Description:
The green snake tongue darts in and out tasting the air.
It sense spilled beer, and the distinctive taste of human.

mobs.Name: horse smithy
mobs.LongDescription: Mr. Smithy, the talking horse, is chewing hay.
mobs.Description:
This useless horse is a novelty, he can talk. Though
his talk is often meaningless and he gives out irrelevant
clues, his sleek body and his much practiced jaw muscles
can be very dangerous.
mobs.ActionScript: %20 gibber; %10 snicker

mobs.Name: bard musician
mobs.LongDescription: A bard sits here strumming his mandolin.
mobs.Description:
The bard seems happy and content to play his
mandolin. He is a seeker of compassion, but
in the his spare time he sings and dances.

mobs.Name: beggar
mobs.LongDescription: A beggar is here with his hand out.
mobs.Description:
He is more accustomed to receiving Compassion,
than giving it. But help him out gov, give him
a few coins.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 emote begs you for a dime or two -- or twenty!

mobs.Name: iolo bard musician
mobs.LongDescription: Iolo sits here with a bottle in his hand, and a smile on his face.
mobs.Description:
Iolo is one of the first Warrior of Destiny. He seems to be a little
bit tipsy from the party and you wonder why he has wandered down to
the cellar. Anyway, in the spirit of the virtue Compassion that he
embodies, he holds out a bottle for you.
mobs.ActionScript: %20 dizzy;%10 say hmm you twins or something?

mobs.Name: jester chuckles
mobs.LongDescription: Chuckles the Jester is juggling and entertaining here.
mobs.Description:
Chuckles the Jester is here mumbling, 'Spam Spam.' This annoying
characteristic is Lord British's major entertainment. He is
laughing and telling corny jokes. He seems to hold his dinner
in his hands, and when he dance the bells on his hat jingle merrily.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 chuckle;%10 cackle;%10 laugh;%10 emote yells, 'Spam Spam'

mobs.Name: townsman man
mobs.LongDescription: A townsman is here downing drinks.
mobs.Description:
This townsman is here partying and having many drinks. Though
he is also an ardent believer in Compassion, and a responsible
citizen, he knows the value of a good party.

mobs.Name: gwenno bard
mobs.LongDescription: Gwenno the Bard, Iolo's happy wife, wanders around with bow in hand.
mobs.Description:
You see a pretty woman, with finely sculptured musculature. She's seems
to guard the party with her Infinity Bow, the best bow in the Ultima world.
Her kindly eyes seem to emit pure Compassion, and as she wanders she helps
the drunks up and leads them out the door.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 sing;%10 say Hi folks, you seen the avatar?

mobs.Name: orc ape
mobs.LongDescription: A mutated ape carries a spear.
mobs.Description:
This orc is a disgusting animal, this ape-like monster
scratches it armpits. It travels in herds and is a coward.

mobs.Name: troll
mobs.LongDescription: A stony troll swings his club.
mobs.Description:
This huge monster is immense and powerful. Over a chest and a
head taller then you, his meaty arms swings a club at you.

mobs.Name: wisp ball
mobs.LongDescription: A blue ball of light soars over to you and winks.
mobs.Description:
The wisp is constantly blinking. It wishes information
exchange. It looks peaceful, but will defend itself.

mobs.Name: druid
mobs.LongDescription: A chanting druid walks the woods.
mobs.Description:
Dressed in long robes that obscure his face, the druid is softly chanting
words and traveling through the woods. He is one that is secure in his
sense of Justice, and enlightened in the ways of judging others. Through
his communion with nature, he has gained power.

mobs.Name: druid
mobs.LongDescription: A druid walks around a flame.
mobs.Description:
This druid seems to be entranced by the fire. She chants
softly as she waves her hand and stares into the flame.
She is one with the flame. When she looks at you her hard
eyes, only judge, seeking Justice.

mobs.Name: judge
mobs.LongDescription: The judge sits here.
mobs.Description:
You cannot help but shiver as you see the Judge sit here silently.
His eyes pierce into your soul, and he knows. He knows your faults.
He knows your virtues. He knows if you've been bad or good....so be
good. This ultimate purveyor of Justice, sends criminals to jail
everyday, sometimes with his bare hands.

mobs.Name: jaana druid
mobs.LongDescription: Jaana the Druid is in deep meditation.
mobs.Description:
You meet the another Warrior of Destiny. She helped to lead the
magical force to the Avatar. The Avatar's mentor in Justice, she
has gone to the woods to drive life into a corner.

mobs.Name: prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: The Prisoner grips the bars with his dirty hands.
mobs.Description:
The Prisoner seems to a be slimy character. He was a thief,
and Justice was done to him. You glimpse light shining off
of something black in his hands.

mobs.Name: prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: The Prisoner is big and grins evilly at you.
mobs.Description:
This Prisoner was convicted of one of the most
heinous crimes, MURDER. It took many guards and
druids to restrain this beast.

mobs.Name: citizen yewsman
mobs.LongDescription: A citizen of Yew walks around.
mobs.Description:
Being the second largest city in Britannia, second
only to Britain itself, this city employs and houses
many people. This citizen of the city of Justice
strolls the street, sure of his Virtue.

mobs.Name: bartender
mobs.LongDescription: A bartender stands here in middle of a throng of people.
mobs.Description:
A smiling face asks you want you would like to drink.
Well versed in compassion, he has heard and sympathized
with many people how have gone to him for advice. His
advice to you, is to kick back and enjoy a drink.

mobs.Name: owner bartender
mobs.LongDescription: The owner of the pub walks around to her customers.
mobs.Description:
The pub owner waves and smiles to you. She
asks what you want to drink and eat.

mobs.Name: ettin
mobs.LongDescription: The ettin scratches its heads, and attacks.
mobs.Description:
With its two heads, it should make sense that this monster should
have double the intelligence. But in fact it has half.

mobs.Name: gremlin
mobs.LongDescription: This little creature sneaks around and steals your food.
mobs.Description:
He seems to be just a head with little hands and feet sticking
out of it. It does not seem like these things could hurt you,
but your money pouch seems much lighter.

mobs.Name: headless
mobs.LongDescription: The headless creature seems to be heading right for you!
mobs.Description:
No one really understands how these things can sense,
but as it unerringly reaches for you, you know it does.
In any case these creatures are strong and endurable.

mobs.Name: fighter
mobs.LongDescription: A muscular fighter searches here.
mobs.Description:
This fighter is cleaning out the dungeons. In the
peaceful time following the Avatar's success, there
are few ways to show Valour.

mobs.Name: geoffrey fighter
mobs.LongDescription: Geoffrey the Fighter leads this campaign.
mobs.Description:
The muscle power of the Warriors of Destiny, Geoffrey is
immense. His board shoulders make you look like a mouse.
He epitomizes Valour.

mobs.Name: lord serpent simon
mobs.LongDescription: Lord Simon of the Serpent Hold stares at your form.
mobs.Description:
His movements are liquid and art. As he makes a few practice
swings, you HOPE that you are never on the receiving end of his
immense sword. This is The Lord of Serpent Hold, courage itself
solidified into a human form.

mobs.Name: mimic
mobs.LongDescription: A treasure chest is here, overflowing with gold.
mobs.Description:
The treasure chest reforms, and spits out a
glob of poison. Beware adventurer of the Mimic.

mobs.Name: gazer eyeball
mobs.LongDescription: A floating eyeball glares at you.
mobs.Description:
This creature is comprised of one main eyeball and several
auxiliary eyeballs coming of the main. The eyeballs draw
you in, making you forget who you are...

mobs.Name: tinker
mobs.LongDescription: A tinker is fiddling with one device or another.
mobs.Description:
The tinker has huge rippling muscles and a scarred skin.
You realize that his great Sacrifice to his craft has led
to his incredible strength and weaponskill. This is not
one you wish to fight.

mobs.Name: julia
mobs.LongDescription: Julia the Tinker is here forging a sword.
mobs.Description:
Julia the Tinker provided some of the muscle power to the Avatar,
during his Great Quest for enlightenment. She was a Warrior of
Destiny and you see that not much has changed since those days.
She represents Sacrifice in everything she does. She is the Keeper
of Oral History, as well as a prominent weaponsmith.

mobs.Name: lady
mobs.LongDescription: The Lady of Empath Abbey stands here.
mobs.Description:
When you see her your heart almost stops, as you feel the intense
waves of pure Love come from here body. Her love for you almost
knocks you down. You cannot hurt this one.

mobs.Name: sandtrap tentacle
mobs.LongDescription: A tentacle reaches out of the sand, and latches onto your leg.
mobs.Description:
The sandtrap burrows around under the stand, and comes
onto travellers hidden. No one is really sure what the
Sandtrap looks like, but it is a dangerous foe.

mobs.Name: dragon
mobs.LongDescription: A dragon is here lying on his heap of treasure.
mobs.Description:
The dragon looks like every other dragon you've seen, wings,
tail, fire. Only this one doesn't have a dorky color attached
to it. And doesn't talk about annoying C++ terms.

mobs.Name: paladin
mobs.LongDescription: A paladin practices his sword strokes here.
mobs.Description:
This paladin works hard to keep his Honor and the Honor of
his people. Honor does not lead his life, Honor is his life.
His shiny armour and equally shiny sword serves to remind you
that he is among Brittannia's most powerful battalion.

mobs.Name: dupre paladin
mobs.LongDescription: Sitting here, Dupre the Paladin consults his maps.
mobs.Description:
Dupre the Paladin was constant companion of the Avatar and a
Warrior of Destiny. He is a symbol of Honor. He is currently
trying devise a plan of attack to get the dragon.

mobs.Name: reaper
mobs.LongDescription: The reaper strikes out with his tentacles.
mobs.Description:
The reaper is immobilized and attached to the ground.
Even with this disadvantage his tentacles and magical
powers more then make up for disadvantage.

mobs.Name: gargoyle king draxthanum
mobs.LongDescription: The King of Gargoyles is here.
mobs.Description:
Draxthanum the Winged Gargoyle is here to observe the odd habits
of humans and there combat tactics. He is red with wings, and is
strong and his aura is overpowering.

mobs.Name: ghost spirit
mobs.LongDescription: The spirit of peaceful man floats around here.
mobs.Description:
This ghost seems peaceful, even though he is chained
to the earth through some responsibility.

mobs.Name: ghost spirit
mobs.LongDescription: This ghost was an evil man in a past life.
mobs.Description:
In through its transparent face, you can see a
grimace of evilness and swoops over to you.

mobs.Name: skeleton
mobs.LongDescription: The skeleton walks around in tattered clothing.
mobs.Description:
The skeleton has rotting bits of flesh attached to its bones.
It carries a rusty shield and sword. In fact the only thing
completely clean on it is its white teeth, perhaps from its
nightly meals of flesh and bone.

mobs.Name: demon demon
mobs.LongDescription: A demon unfurls his wings and swoops into you.
mobs.Description:
The most dangerous undead, and among the most dangerous of all
monsters, this beast can use all magics, is strong and hardy.
Right now he seems to be busy...killing you.

mobs.Name: mourner
mobs.LongDescription: A mourner bows his head over the grave.
mobs.Description:
A mourner is in tears. She is crying over the grave of a loved
one. She is expressing poignant Spirituality. This gives her
strength to persevere.

mobs.Name: shamino ranger
mobs.LongDescription: Shamino the Ranger sits here, meditating.
mobs.Description:
The last Warrior of Destiny, Shamino sits here in a yoga
position. The Enlightened smile on his face confirms that he
indeed is one with the spirit of Spirituality.

mobs.Name: timelord
mobs.LongDescription: The Timelord is here in an aura of power.
mobs.Description:
The Hourglass that he holds in his hand actually controls the
fickle powers of time. This being is so awe-inspiring that you
fell an urge to prostrate yourself to him. But as all godly
powers must be, he is truly and totally neutral.

mobs.Name: guardian
mobs.LongDescription: The Guardian as far as you can tell is just a big red face.
mobs.Description:
First you hear a booming voice. 'You WILL join the Fellowship.'
He is the latest, and some people say greatest of the Avatar's
enemies. And now you have the joy of meeting him.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 say You WILL join the Fellowship!

mobs.Name: blackthorn
mobs.LongDescription: Blackthorn wonders how he lost the throne.
mobs.Description:
Blackthorn was more misguided rather then evil. Though he was
still a foe of Avatar that eventually was destroyed, during this
era he still is corrupt and VERY, VERY dangerous.

mobs.Name: exodus
mobs.LongDescription: Exodus is here, reveling in his island fortress.
mobs.Description:
Exodus, the horrible progeny of Minax and Mondain is here. More
powerful then his parents, he is also more dangerous. He was the
last of the Triad that the Avatar destroyed.

mobs.Name: minax
mobs.LongDescription: Minax is here conjuring up the evil spirits.
mobs.Description:
More powerful then her master and lover, Minax is as beautiful as
she is dangerous. Bold enough to take on the forces of evil without
the gem, she eventually proved to be their mistress. Without the
Avatar the world would still be under her complete power.

mobs.Name: mondain
mobs.LongDescription: Mondain grips his evil gem and conjures magic to destroy you.
mobs.Description:
Mondain. the first of the Triad of Evil, was the first foe that
the man, later to be known as the Avatar, was to face. Mondain
had killed his father to gain the power of the dark gem that he
wielded.

mobs.Name: sentri
mobs.LongDescription: Sentri stoically stands here, protecting his Lord and castle from harm.
mobs.Description:
Sentri is a powerful man, whose only job is to protect the life
of Lord British. In seeing this done he is completely armoured
and wields a heavy blade.

mobs.Name: batlin
mobs.LongDescription: Batlin says, 'Join the Fellowship.'
mobs.Description:
Batlin is an evil man that goes around and corrupts the young. 
He is though protected by the power of his god.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 emote yells, 'Join the Fellowship!'

mobs.Name: avatar
mobs.LongDescription: The Avatar is here chatting to Lord British.
mobs.Description:
The Avatar is the symbol of courage and truth and love, and all
that descends from it. He has mastered Compassion, Humility,
Justice, Spirituality, Honesty, Sacrifice, Valor, and Honor. He
truly is an inspiration to those who know him.

mobs.Name: lord british
mobs.LongDescription: Lord British is healing the Avatar's wounds.
mobs.Description:
Lord British sits in his throne. When you see him, you know the
meaning of true leadership. His charisma is almost tangible. On
him you see the three crown jewels. These hold power both
figuratively and truly.

mobs.Name: shark
mobs.LongDescription: The shark smells blood.
mobs.Description: This fish can sense blood in the water and comes to kill you.

mobs.Name: seahorse seahorse
mobs.LongDescription: The peaceful seahorse swims here.
mobs.Description:
The seahorse is an amazingly beautiful creature. Its swimming
and diving please you.

mobs.Name: squid
mobs.LongDescription: The squid's tentacles reach for you.
mobs.Description:
The squid easily is double the boat in size. Its tentacles
are huge and you fear as it grabs for you.

mobs.Name: armourer
mobs.LongDescription: The armourer stands here.
mobs.Description: The armourer sells...armour.

mobs.Name: weaponseller
mobs.LongDescription: The Weaponseller stands here.
mobs.Description: The weaponseller sells... weapons.

mobs.Name: boatseller
mobs.LongDescription: The boatseller stands here.
mobs.Description: The boatseller sells...boats.

mobs.Name: ghost wizard figure pale
mobs.LongDescription: The pale figure of a wizard looks forlornly at the remains of the shop.
mobs.Description:
He is dressed in long flowing robes, which look to be fairly badly 
singed. His beard is scorched too, and he glances nervously around the 
room without seeing you. You can almost see right through his pale form.

mobs.Name: baker ghost
mobs.LongDescription: The ghost of a baker, flinches at every sound.
mobs.Description:
He was a rather corpulent individual while he was alive, with a jolly 
smile. His ghost is recognisable, but he flinches at every sound and his 
apron is full of burn holes. In fact, its not just his apron - you can 
see right through him!

mobs.Name: grocer ghost
mobs.LongDescription:
The ghost of a grocer is standing around, with a slightly bewildered 
look on his face.
mobs.Description:
The grocer looks surprised to be dead, blinking uncertainly as he surveys
the wreckage around him. He appears to be missing an arm!

mobs.Name: ghost weaponsmith ghostly
mobs.LongDescription: A ghostly weaponsmith peers uncertainly at you.
mobs.Description:
He was only a young man when the wrath of the gods was unleashed. He holds
a stout cugel in one hand, and glares around him, looking for his enemy. 
He obviously hasn't realised yet that he is dead.

mobs.Name: ghost armorer ghostly faded
mobs.LongDescription: A faded ghostly armorer stands here in a battered breastplate.
mobs.Description:
He was an old and seasoned campaigner even before he open his armory, 
selling protective items to fresh faced, and naive adventurers. He has 
found a battered but still wearable breast plate in the wreckage, and 
wears it now to protect himself.

mobs.Name: ghost receptionist
mobs.LongDescription: A pale ghostly receptionist looks out of place here.
mobs.Description:
You notice a confused look on her face.  She has realised something 
is wrong, but not yet figured out what!

mobs.Name: ghost captain seafarer
mobs.LongDescription: A pale ghostly seafarer gazes into the fog.
mobs.Description:
The rags draped around his scarred body were once fine seamans clothes, 
sturdy and warm for stormy seas, but now burnt and full of holes.

mobs.Name: sailor ghost thin whispy
mobs.LongDescription: A thin and whispy sailor haunts this area.
mobs.Description:
He looks he was a strong sailor while he was alive, he's now missing 
his bottom half, and he moans as he floats towards you.

mobs.Name: ghost uncle juan
mobs.LongDescription: Uncle Juan's ghost loiters about, looking for his tacos.
mobs.Description:
He looks very surprised to be dead, and obviously not used to roaming 
away from his taco stand. He peers around looking for his tacos, and 
sniffs the air for a hint of chilli sauce.

mobs.Name: wally watermaster ghost shade
mobs.ShortDescription: the ghost of Wally the Watermaster
mobs.LongDescription: The shade of the watermaster is here, looking for something to drink.
mobs.Description:
One of Midgaards model citizens, Wally once ran the watershop near 
the east gate. The air in this place is dry, and Wally's ghost wanders 
the streets looking for even a drop of water to wet his throat.

mobs.Name: postmaster post master ghost
mobs.LongDescription: The ghost of the postmaster mechanically goes about his work.
mobs.Description:
He spent all his life in service to the inhabitants of EliteMUD. Now 
thats he's passed on (and very badly scorched by the rain of fire) he 
knows nothing else but his work, and mechanically continues sorting 
mail, not even noticing that it's never collected.

mobs.Name: priest cleric healer ghost
mobs.LongDescription: A ghostly priest weeps silently at the fall of Midgaard.
mobs.Description:
Ah! The poor soul, to have died so young, and in the prime of health. 
His peity and service to the Gods could not save him from their rage. 
Half of his face has been burnt right off, exposing bone underneath and 
his left arm has also been stripped of flesh by the scourging fire.

mobs.Name: harold undertaker ghost
mobs.ShortDescription: the ghost of Harold the Undertaker
mobs.LongDescription: Harold the Undertaker has sold his last coffin.
mobs.Description:
Harold was once a tall skinny man, plying his trade about the town of 
Midgaard, much to the annoyance of many mortals. He must have annoyed 
the gods as well, with his irreverant blowing of kisses because his 
ghost walks in a peculiar fashion - as if someone had taken one of those 
coffins and shoved it up his a**!

mobs.Name: guildmaster master ghost
mobs.LongDescription: A ghost appears in the shape of a guildmaster.
mobs.Description:
He looks very tired, and very dead. His clothes are torn and he moans 
occasionally as he stares at the destruction all around him.

mobs.Name: guildmaster master ghost
mobs.LongDescription: You see a ghost in the shape of a guildmaster.
mobs.Description:
He once believed he was close to the gods, but has been harshly 
disabused of that misconception. He stares in disbelief at the 
destruction - he seems to have lost all faith in the gods.

mobs.Name: guildmaster master ghost
mobs.LongDescription: The guildmaster's ghost haunts this area.
mobs.Description:
Even missing an arm, and so thin and whispy that she is almost 
transparent, you can appreciate the stealth in her movement 
as she glides around.

mobs.Name: guildmaster master ghost
mobs.LongDescription: A ghostly guildmaster searches for his arms.
mobs.Description:
No, his weapons are with him, still sheathed at his side - but he 
is sadly lacking the limbs to draw them.

mobs.Name: sorcerer ghost
mobs.LongDescription: A ghostly sorcerer attempts to bar your way.
mobs.Description:
While alive he was dedicated to protecting the guild premeses of the 
Mages. The onslaught of the gods has obviously taken him by such 
surprise that he hasnt even realised that he is a ghost - doomed to 
endlessly haunt the ruined city.

mobs.Name: knight templar ghost
mobs.LongDescription: A holy templar's ghost stands before you.
mobs.Description:
Perhaps that should be 'holey' templar - the the rain of fire which 
swept across the city has shredded him. No doubt he died protecting 
innocents, or maybe clerics.

mobs.Name: assassin ghost
mobs.LongDescription: A faint impression of an assassin glides towards you.
mobs.Description:
For a man in his line of work being dead has to be an advantage - no 
sound, can walk through walls, can disappear just by turning sideways. 
Of course theres a downside, you can't get drunk!

mobs.Name: tailor ghost
mobs.LongDescription: A pale ghostly tailor, sadly fingers his ruined clothes.
mobs.Description:
He sighs forlornly as he looks at his own clothes, which are shredded 
and charred. He peers around, searching to needle and thread, and 
perhaps a miracle to sort out his garments.

mobs.Name: jeweler ghost
mobs.LongDescription: The shade of the jeweler scrabbles through the ash for precious stones.
mobs.Description:
He's on his kness, search desperately through the wreckage for any of 
the old stock from his shattered jewellery shop. He doesn't appear to 
have found much of value yet, just ash.

mobs.Name: waiter ghost shade
mobs.LongDescription: The pale shade of a waiter offers you a drink.
mobs.Description:
Unlucky, the glass he offers you is empty, and chipped around the 
edges. Its most likely therefore that he offers you the glass out of 
habit, and has no comprehension of what has happened.

mobs.Name: filthy ghost
mobs.LongDescription: An especially filthy ghost is searching through the rubble.
mobs.Description:
Just looking at him you can tell that the dirt with which he is coated 
is not fresh. In fact it seems likely that he was filthy while he was 
alive. He searches frantically through the dirty ash, but gives no 
indication of what he is searching for - anything he can sell.

mobs.Name: keeper peacekeeper skeleton skeletal
mobs.LongDescription: The charred remains of a peacekeeper patrols this area.
mobs.Description:
Bits of burnt flesh hang from the charred bones of a once tall warrior. 
His eyes glare from his skull, and for some reason he seems to be 
angry. He keeps muttering about unruly mortals, and the wrath of the gods.

mobs.Name: cityguard guard skeletal skeleton
mobs.LongDescription: A badly burnt cityguard snaps to attention.
mobs.Description:
He tries to appear helpful and friendly, and smiles at you as you 
approach. However its hard to feel comfortable when confronted by 
a large blackened skeleton grinning at you with only half a face.

mobs.Name: janitor ghoul ghoulish
mobs.LongDescription: A ghoulish janitor hovers around here, scooping up trash.
mobs.Description:
He has no choice but to hover, he is missing the bottom half of his 
body. The upper torso and arms float a few feet off the ground, and 
every so often, stoop to pick up some piece of trash from the mucky 
ash on the ground.

mobs.Name: fido dog ghastly
mobs.LongDescription: A horrible ghastly fido is grubbing through the trash.
mobs.Description:
The charred ghost of this small dog looks ghastly, with globs of 
charred flesh hanging from his bones.

mobs.Name: mercenary merc skeletal
mobs.LongDescription: The bones of a mercenary dance around you.
mobs.Description:
You think he's trying to tell you something, but are unable to to work 
out what. A few rags still cling to the skeleton, but he lacks any 
weapons, perhaps thats what he wants?

mobs.Name: drunk skeleton
mobs.LongDescription: A clumsy skeleton staggers around here.
mobs.Description:
It takes you a moment to realise that he has his feet on backwards, 
which is why he's having so much trouble walking. Once a drunk 
always a drunk eh?

mobs.Name: beggar half
mobs.LongDescription: Half a beggar lies crumpled on the floor.
mobs.Description:
He has been sliced in half vertically, which must have made his eyes 
water. He lies slumped against a shattered wall. Perhaps you should 
look around and find the other half.

mobs.Name: odif yltsahg ghost
mobs.LongDescription: An odif yltsahg has been turned inside out!
mobs.Description: The odif has been completely turned inside out by those vindictive gods.

mobs.Name: cityguard guard skeletal skeleton
mobs.LongDescription: A badly burnt cityguard snaps to attention.
mobs.Description:
He tries to appear helpful and friendly, and smiles at you as you 
approach. However its hard to feel comfortable when confronted by 
a large blackened skeleton grinning at you with only half a face.

mobs.Name: grey gelatinous blob
mobs.LongDescription: An oozing grey blob gloops its way around the ruined city.
mobs.Description:
Its just a horrible big grey blob. A closer look reveals that it was 
once green in colour, but has been turned grey by the rain of fire, 
and the sucking up of lots of that horrible ash.

mobs.Name: rufus paper boy ghost
mobs.LongDescription: The pale ghost of Rufus sits sobbing in the centre of the square.
mobs.Description:
Rufus was hired in the heyday of the Midgaard News Service to advertise 
the local newspaper. He used to spend all day shouting at people to 
read the NEWS, but his incessent babble was a constant annoyance to 
anyone who came accross him. He isn't talking now however, and a closer 
look reveals that his mouth has been stuffed with burnt newspaper, and 
his hands carefully removed.

mobs.Name: kitten little lovely
mobs.LongDescription: A cute little kitten is cleaning the ash off herself.
mobs.Description:
Well, it seems the gods do have a soft spot for animals after all. The 
little kitten is safe and well, and doesn't appear to have been harmed 
in the slightest. She looks at you and blinks her large eyes, you are 
overcome by an urge to pet her.

mobs.Name: puppy loyal
mobs.LongDescription: A loyal puppy bounds around your ankles, yapping exitedly.
mobs.Description:
The puppy seems overjoyed to see you. He obviously hasn't had any 
living people to play with for quite some time.

mobs.Name: horse mount skeletal
mobs.LongDescription: A gleaming skeletal horse stamps impatiently.
mobs.Description:
It looks nothing like a normal horse, it gleams brightly, and its eyes 
are like red glowing coals. You think that rather than destroying the 
horse, the gods have improved it.

mobs.Name: dagga avatar rage
mobs.LongDescription: A towering figure of fiery rage furiously attacks you!
mobs.Description:
His entire body consists of living flame, and you suddenly understand 
that the desecretion of the city is the result of Dagga passing through. 
His head, which makes up just over half his height, bears an expression 
of utter fury, his brows drawn down like buttresses against any attack. 
He launches himself at you without thought, just a wordless roar of 
anger.

mobs.Name: dervish rage flame
mobs.LongDescription: A tiny ball of concentrated rage flails about you furiously.
mobs.Description:
The anger of the gods has become concentrated to form at tiny ball of 
fiery rage. The ground beneath him is heavily scorched, and he is so 
hot that it hurts to look at him.

mobs.Name: jade golem guardian
mobs.LongDescription: An animated figure made of jade guards this cave.
mobs.Description:
This solid jade golem has been carved in the shape of a man, but much 
bigger, towering over you. He appears not to notice you as he goes about 
his work, using a peculiar artefact, and continually making subtle 
adjustments to the gateway carved upon the cave wall.

mobs.Name: enraged angry mob dwarf male
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarf looks angrily at YOU!
mobs.Description:
You seem to have done something you should not do. A fair guess is that
you bought an entry at hourly rates from Slick (a scumbag by profession) 
to his location. Prostitution is not popular amongst the harbour town 
citizen and against the law as well. Now he is here to more handily punish 
you for your wicked behaviour.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote roars 'You Bastard!' spraying you with froth.
;%5 emote glares at you with great contempt.

mobs.Name: enraged angry mob dwarf male
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarf looks at YOU with great disgust!
mobs.Description:
You seem to have done something you should not do. A fair guess is that
you bought an entry at hourly rates from Slick (a scumbag by profession) 
to his location. Prostitution is not popular amongst the harbour town 
citizens and against the law as well. Now he is here to more handily 
punish you for your wicked behaviour.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote faces you with a wicked grin.
;%5 emote smiles wickedly towards you.

mobs.Name: enraged angry mob dwarfess female
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarf woman glares at YOU angrily.
mobs.Description:
You seem to have done something you should not do. A fair guess is that
you bought an entry at hourly rates from Slick (a real naughty scumbag) 
to her location. Prostitution is not popular amongst the harbour town 
citizen and against the law as well. Now she is here to make you feel how 
wrongly you acted.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote hollers 'THERE YOU ARE!'
;%5 emote glares at you with great contempt.

mobs.Name: enraged angry mob dwarfess female
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarf woman stares enraged at YOU!.
mobs.Description:
You seem to have done something you should not do. A fair guess is that
you bought an entry at hourly rates from Slick (a real naughty scumbag) 
to her location. Prostitution is not popular amongst the harbour town 
citizen and against the law as well. Now she is here to more handily 
punish you for your wicked behaviour.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote screams 'You PIG!'
;%5 emote practice swings her big axe a few times.

mobs.Name: lady lust
mobs.LongDescription: A Dying Lady of Lust lies before you.
mobs.Description:
The dwarfen woman has not spent much time at her new profession. Her
life has been a continous struggle to keep above the surface but she
finally fell through, tempted by the grandiose visions she was served by
her employer, Slick. Now she regrets it, but she is bound by a more or
less slavelike contract.

mobs.Name: Jenny Haniver
mobs.LongDescription: Jenny Haniver is acting out her anger over something.
mobs.Description:
A natural leader, this aggravating woman. She leaves no cause
unattended, no struggle unfought and no mischief unmessed with. People
say she causes trouble, but she merely accentuates them in favour of
close and physical argumentation. Nevertheless she is shunned by most,
except those whose arguments she is dabbling with at the moment.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote sharpens her claws.
;%5 say Welcome

mobs.Name: minotaur
mobs.LongDescription: The battle scenting minotaur has found someone to start a battle with.
mobs.Description:
Anything approaching battle evaporates pheromones from their glands, if
they have any. And when they do, these pheromones are easily picked up
over huge distances by a war-smelling and fight-scenting minotaur nose.
Especially if it is as large as this one's. This otherwise typical sample
of his breed sniffed up a possible battle and forced his way there. Now
he
is about to start one by himself at any moment unless you beat him(to
it).
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote aims his horns towards YOU!
;%5 emote snorts at you.

mobs.Name: bony fish
mobs.LongDescription: A big but bony fish just noticed its first food in ages.
mobs.Description:
The food supply for fish in this place is not plenty, very meager in
fact and the fish just have to widen their usual food selection. This
particular fish has not had a decent meal in ages, which is pretty
clear as it is mostly skin, bones and a few occasional pointy teeth.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote does its best to look unintelligent.
;%5 west
;%5 east
;%5 north
;%5 south

mobs.Name: ghoti silent
mobs.LongDescription: A little fish sounds just like the other fishes.
mobs.Description:
This small, soundalike fish swims around trying to melt in with the
rest of the population in these waters. Just one more fish in the sea at
the end of the day. It just sounds a little different.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote causes your mind to wander of, finding the word 'tough'.
;%5 emote causes your mind to wander of, finding the word 'women'.
;%5 emote causes your mind to wander of, finding the word 'action'.
;%5 west
;%5 east
;%5 north
;%5 south

mobs.Name: skinny guppy
mobs.LongDescription: A really wild minimal fish swims around screaming the fish way.
mobs.Description:
The skinny guppy is a real hard-core fish. The sea is to calm and need
to be stirred up a bit and this angry little pale, skinny guppy does its
best. It is not much, but it is the principle that counts.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 say BLUPP!!!
;%5 emote wiggles it skinny tail.
;%5 west
;%5 east
;%5 north
;%5 south

mobs.Name: red eye ninja deep gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A deep gnome with red eyes looks at you strangely.
mobs.Description:
Small and almost invisible this little deep gnome conducts duties with
utmost care and precision. What his duties are you will never know, at
least not until it is much too late. A slight gleam of mockery can be
seen in his eyes as he watches you.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote makes a straining body movement and goes 'iiiiaaaahhh'.
;%5 emote peers at you.
;%5 emote mocks you.
;%5 emote points at you and laugh.
;%5 emote dodges your view and appears behind you.

mobs.Name: female red eye ninja deep gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A deep gnome with red eyes looks at you strangely.
mobs.Description:
Small and almost invisible this little deep gnome conducts duties with
