mobs.Description:
Everything should go to the right place. Stuffing the cargo bay of a
ship is a responsible task. The danger of everything in the load
tumbling over to one side in the middle of a storm is always present and
would surely be very hazardous. A very appreciated man when he does his
job properly, and nobody has ever come back to complain, so he is.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote points towards a still empty slot.
;%5 emote makes sure everything is where it should be.
;%5 say Do NOT touch that!

mobs.Name: Troll longshoretroll
mobs.LongDescription: A longshoretroll carries some bars up to the boat.
mobs.Description:
He is really too big for this job but nobody has had the guts to
complain, at least not to him. But on the other hand he loads up pretty
much when he takes his strolls up and down the planks from ship to
shore, so they let him be. Perhaps you should too.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote grunts some.
;%5 emote flips a bar in the air as he passes you.
;%5 emote muffles a little trollish laugh as he looks at you.

mobs.Name: Minotaur Longshoreminotaur
mobs.LongDescription: The bighorned longshoreman does his way through the other longshoremen.
mobs.Description:
The minotaur longshoreman is a really dangerous creature. How he got this
job from the start is a really good question. His big horns should get in
the way in the narrow passageways of any boat. And he is even bigger than
an ordinary troll. But then again that could be exactly why nobody cares,
at least as long as he does his job as good as he, after all, does.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote froths heavily.
;%5 emote walks very close to you.
;%5 emote just tried to peek at your stuff.

mobs.Name: Dwarven longshoreman
mobs.LongDescription: The Dwarven longshoreman carries metal bars on board.
mobs.Description:
In the small stuffs of the boats it can be very useful to be small, so
that one can reach in fully (or even walk in). For some of the
longshoremen that has been a real problem as their muscles have grown
considerably since they were hired. But their storing skill usually
makes up for that nowadays.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote glares at you as you are not helping with the load.
;%5 flex
;%5 emote wipes off some sweat.

mobs.Name: winged Fairy longshoreman
mobs.LongDescription: A fairy longshoreman does the final matching of the load.
mobs.Description:
Some think it is strange that such a weak creature has been hired as a
longshoreman, but the fact that he can fly really makes up for that he
only takes one piece at the time.  The storage rate increases
considerably if he is allowed to aid in the storing. On the other hand
this little fairy does look a bit more powerful than an ordinary one.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote flutters past you.
;%5 emote manage to move one metal bar.
;%35 north
;%35 south
;%20 fly
;%5 emote pokes you in order to make you move out of his way.

mobs.Name: drow evil Longshoreman whipper
mobs.LongDescription: An elf stands looking over the premises, hand on his whip.
mobs.Description:
Long and tall this drow stands overlooking the longshoremen, following
their every move. Held in his hand is a long whip that sparkles of
energy. A strange thing is he never seems to use it on anybody. Wonder
what or who he is waiting for...
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote whacks his whip in the air.
;%5 emote straightens up the back of all that is present.
;%5 emote caresses his whiphandle.
;%20 grin

mobs.Name: Lagoon monster
mobs.LongDescription: The Lagoon monster has hidden itself.
mobs.Description:
Usually hidden but now aroused by your presence the lagoon monster has
now come out to amuse itself on your behalf. Its size is immense and as
a relative to Kraken it sure has long tentacles that work almost
separately from the monster. This could become very dangerous.

mobs.Name: Lagoon monster tentacle
mobs.LongDescription: The rattling arm of some lagoon monster tries to surround you.
mobs.Description:
Long, powerful, muddy (that is the worst) and covered with suction pods,
the tentacle rattles in the water in search of ... of ... YOU!!!

%%5 emote schlurps softly.;

mobs.Name: dwarf guard
mobs.LongDescription: The Harbour Boat Guard is out looking for smugglers.
mobs.Description:
A dwarven sailor without a sailing ship to enlist on and with a powerful
constitution can, if opportunity arises, take up the job as harbour
guard. Equipped with long spetums they travel the harbour water basin
making sure noone takes a swim or tries to bring contraband into the town
or even worse try to evade taxation...
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote watches the water surface really carefully.
;%5 emote watches your every move.
;%5 scout

mobs.Name: Rowman
mobs.LongDescription: A rowman sits by his oar.
mobs.Description:
If you have strong arms and nothing else to do, why not do what this
fellow does? Be a rowman. Travel known waters, see places you have seen
many many times before, go home in the evening. Everything you ever
dreamed of right? He does seem jolly even though he keeps one eye
constantly on the water as if he was looking for something.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote row row rows a boat gently cross the bay.
;%5 emote glances towards the water surface.
;%5 emote wonders what you are doing out here.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper Fritz official
mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the customs official is here as a part of his duties.
mobs.Description:
He is a gentle and kind man that only does his duties. Unfortunately
so many evil men hate him for this as his task is not that popular
amongst them. If he were to catch you trying to sneak out of the harbour
without the necessary papers the fee you would have to pay would be quite
a bit larger and his associates would surely enforce this upon you.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote peers at you.
;%5 say You have the correct papers?
;%5 say You can not leave until you have been taxed properly.

mobs.Name: Guard Heavy Custom
mobs.LongDescription: The Heavy Customs Guard obediently awaits new instructions.
mobs.Description:
Fully obedient and ready to react on the slightest sign of any criminal
intent or action, this dwarf is not to be tampered with. That is unless
you are Fritz the Tollman and head of Custom Guard operations. The guard
looks a bit evil, but that is just his appearance. He sure does treat
everyone the same way.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote stands silent watching you.
;%5 emot awaits orders from the Head of Customs what to do about you.

mobs.Name: Critter ICE Troll
mobs.LongDescription: A rather warm Ice Troll is in sightseeing.
mobs.Description:
He looks a bit sweaty even though it is a rather pleasant temperature.
Could be he is used to places to very much below zero. Apart from that
it looks like he is in good condition, big and strong as most trolls.
Being a really skilled scout he keeps his eyes open to check for any
changes around him, such as you showing up.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote sweats a bit.
;%5 emote grunts.
;%5 emote looks at you and wonder why you survived the evolution.

mobs.Name: ice block Critter white
mobs.LongDescription: A big white ice block. These northern continent critters do look strange.
mobs.Description:
A large block of ice walks (!!!) around here doing whatever large
walking blocks of ice do. You have never seen anything like this and you
will not probably see anything like it again. Where did it come from?
Who did it? How? And WHY? The questions gather but the ice block is so
very silent, but what did you expect? Or do you know iceblockish?
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 emote does not do anything.

mobs.Name: PSB boy UMHTmob13270
mobs.LongDescription: A Pet Shop Boy does not really do his job.
mobs.Description:
This long and loose limbed boy hangs around all day doing nothing. 'I
am an artist', 'I am creating' are typical sentences that pour out of him
all day, constantly. What he really does is unknown but one could guess
that he is getting inspiration for new songs. Right now he is aiding the
Petshop shopkeeper in his daily duties.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote peers around.
;%5 snicker
;%5 emote looks at the pets.
;%5 look UMHTmob13271

This long and loose limbed boy hangs around all day doing nothing. 'I

mobs.Name: Stranger Tall dark UMHTmob13272
mobs.LongDescription: A really handsome stranger is looking for some long term company.
mobs.Description:
The tall dark stranger is about to embark on a long trip and is now
looking for someone that was supposed to meet him here and join him on
the trip. He looks really nice and is most surely rich and famous too. It
almost sounds too good to be true.
mobs.ActionScript:

mobs.Name: imak bard troll 00_Kami
mobs.LongDescription: Imak, the troll bard, sings better than Hulio.
mobs.Description:
Imak, the little trollish bard usually sits in a corner singing small
and self composed songs that would make the great and very famous Hulio
completely speechless. He is so cute you just can not take your eyes
from him for a long time.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote sings a lovely tune.
;%5 emote wonders why Hulio has such a big Fanclub.
;%5 emote sings a song for you.
;%5 smile

mobs.Name: Cat
mobs.LongDescription: An alley cat.
mobs.Description:
The cat is greyish brown with streaks over its fur. It is a pure racial
cat. Its genes contain all cat genes there are. The best and the worst
in a complete mixture. Lucky you, if you find a cuddlier animal.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%40 purr
;%5 emote licks your leg.
;%30 emote licks its own face.

mobs.Name: Dog Skeletal skeleton
mobs.LongDescription: The skeleton dog.
mobs.Description:
It is a dog. Or at least was. And maybe it is again. Someone took the
work of peeling the bones of the dog when it died and then poured some
magic into it bringing it back to a undead life. It now becomes the
loyal follower of whomever it is given to.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote walks on very unbalanced legs.
;%5 emote tries to bark, but no lungs give no sound.
;%5 emote tries to identify some unnoticeable smell.

mobs.Name: Orc Tamed
mobs.LongDescription: The 'tamed' orc smiles towards you.
mobs.Description:
Hi! The orc does not look nearly as wild as its usual brethren. He
even has polished teeth, watercombed hair and a at least somewhat
standable breath. There has to be some real power involved to take the
naughtiness out of such a naturally mean breed.

%%2 say Anyone have a comb?

mobs.Name: Falcon
mobs.LongDescription: A falcon.
mobs.Description:
A little bird. But what a set of fangs and bill! It would easily have
a go at any mouse around without too much trouble. Just keep it away
from eyes and ears and everything will be ok for you.

%%5 emote tries to pick your eyes out.

mobs.Description:
#Y What a BIG bird. It has got bright yellow feathers that almost shine
as it positions itself next to you. It is so big it could kill a cow
singlehandedly, eh, singleclawedly. Make sure it is well fed and far
off.
#N

mobs.Name: Dead Cow
mobs.LongDescription: The cow is almost dead.
mobs.Description:
OH NO!!! Someone tried to off the poor cow! There are distinct claw
marks all over its big body and there are pieces of flesh missing, thorne
out through the thick skin. Even one of the eyes is gone. How disgusting.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper Fritz Cleric
mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Cleric.
mobs.Description:
Fritz stands single in a world of turmoil. As being one of the few of
his order he has taken the opportunity to stay here at the local shrine
producing small things to ease the problems of the local population or
his community as he refers to them. A little cure here and a bigger heal
there, everything for his god of Neutrality and Tolerance.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper Fritz Tooldwarf
mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Tooldwarf.
mobs.Description:
A stocky little dwarf with stocky little limbs and stocky little
fingers.  Even his hair and beard look stocky. Hmm, dreadlocks... it
might be called. His plain but robust clothing suits not only his body
but his working conditions with sharp and heavy things lying around
everywhere.

mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Cat-salesman.
mobs.Description:
Fritz got to be one of the sleaziest characters you have ever
encountered and you sure have seen a few. Slim clothing, in a green-
blue- pinkish coloring, accessorized with a similarly coloured wide-
brimmed hat with a small feather in its band. And not to forget,
extremely well polished black shoes. If you want a deal with him you have
to bundle up quite a few gold pieces under his table.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper Fritz Beer Hoister
mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Beer Hoister.
mobs.Description:
A stained white (or at least used to be white) linen is the first
impression you get of this dwarf and as first impressions last, so does
that linen. If you get over it, you find a rather friendly little
bartender awaiting your orders with a smile from behind this, for human
standards, low bar.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper Fritz Harbour Official
mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Harbour Official.
mobs.Description:
Tall, for a dwarf, and pompous Fritz is located behind his desk doing
paperwork. There seems to be a lot of that awaiting him too. The local
mayor does seem to let over quite a lot of responsibility for him,
wonder why, but he seems to cope even though he works a lot of overtime.

mobs.LongDescription: Fritz your very personal salesguy.
mobs.Description:
As you look at Fritz you see a little glow in his eyes and he starts to
talk about the closest thing around showing you how incredibly good and
high quality it is and that you really really have to buy at least one.
He even helps you to put one on you as he pushes you to the next shelf
in his well assorted high quality sales boutique.

mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Doppelganger.
mobs.Description:
He looks familiar, could be because there are two of him. The immense
ringing and the continual double vision of his customers took its tribute
one day when a group of travelling psionics came in for a drink at what
they thought to be a local cultural happening. Alcohol and psis do not
make a healthy combination at least not for the surroundings.

mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Receptionist.
mobs.Description:
Usually the reception is crowded and Fritz has so much to do he hardly
has time to breathe. Today, au contraire, it is completely dead. He has
taken this opportunity to relax a bit behind his desk. A little instant
sun and a pair of shorts can sometimes really make somebody's day.

mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Tollman.
mobs.Description:
He is a gentle and kind man who only does his duties. Unfortunately so
many hate him for this as his tasks are not that popular and he is but
the tool. On the other hand you were lucky to find him in his office. If
he were to catch you sneaking out of the harbour without the necessary
papers the fee would be a bit larger and his associates would surely
enforce this on you, with a smile and lots of possible pain.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper Fritz Fishtrader
mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Fishtrader.
mobs.Description:
Slightly cold and wet, Fritz stands in the middle of his large newly
bought barrels of iced fish, but he sure seems to enjoy it. Fish is his
life and secretly one can guess that he dreams of one day becoming one.
And he would surely know where to go to avoid the fishers and where to
stay cold and comfortable.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper Fritz old Baker
mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the old Baker.
mobs.Description:
It is hard for a baker to work ahead, but Fritz here has. His bread is
so heavy and of course of such high quality it would have been ruined a
long time ago if not. But it has not. So now he rests upon his products
and lives solely on a healthy diet of meat and fish with a bit of
vegetables. And a beer or three once in a while.

mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Pumpman.
mobs.Description:
From well even further down the mountain base Fritz brings up his clear
and mineral rich waters. And, of course, trades them off with good
profits. He wears an old Iron Mill vest with its logo on the back, no
doubt where he got his pumping training.

mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Mage.
mobs.Description:
The world seems to shimmer around this character as he walks around in
his cave shop constantly picking and fixing with his potions and papers
until they are so perfectly aligned it suits his well structured mind.
His two favorite things in his shop are the potion for seasickness and
the one against.

mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Tailor.
mobs.Description:
Long and thin bodily composition makes Fritz no ordinary dwarf, even
though he lives in a rather typical Dwarven Undermoutain Harbour Town.
But his skilled eyes can still without a moment of hesitation pick out
your size and even more interesting what you could be interested in in
the way of clothing.

mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Slaughterer.
mobs.Description:
Fritz has a rather unique style of cutting up animals. He goes in to
something that looks like close melee with such a frenzy that one hardly
thinks that he would survive... It looks VERY brutal but it is clearly
efficient in both time and losses, but it has also earned his the title
slaughterer instead of butcher.

mobs.LongDescription: Fritz the Cartographer.
mobs.Description:
Mapmaking is an art, too bad the artist has so little material to work
with as he is stuck here and not out in the field. This also shows in
his output. They seem rather limited in viewable range and areas but
there are a lot of copies. A never-ending supply is at your disposal.

mobs.LongDescription: Sigourney was left behind by her sister.
mobs.Description:
A small but long lived female deep gnome weaves ropes for her living as
her twin took the part of wrestling monsters. Someone had to stay at
home and that fell on poor Sigourney. She looks pretty cute but her hands
are going gnarled from all the rope strings that pass through them. If
you ask nicely, perhaps she will sell you some.

mobs.Name: Fortuneteller
mobs.LongDescription: The Fortuneteller sits in a corner serving truths about the world.
mobs.Description:
The fortune teller sits in the corner revealing the future to anyone
that asks for it or comes close enough. The future is not to be tampered
with easily so treat this man with duly respect.

mobs.Name: miner Japanese
mobs.LongDescription: A slightly blueish Japanese miner is far away from home.
mobs.Description:
A blueish japanese tries to get something warming into his body. The
blue does not seem to be his natural colour but caused by too long
exposure to the ice mines in the northern, very cold, continent.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote whispers to his friend 'Did you say they found ancient eyes

;%5 shiver

mobs.Name: mad prophet
mobs.LongDescription: The prophet swings his staff wildly at you, muttering arcane phrases.
mobs.Description:
His robes are neat, though threadbare, and his hair and beard are both
long and ragged, showing both the order of his mind, and the chaos of
his thoughts.  He rambles what seems nonsense, and yet at times speaks
with both a strong voice and clarity of thought that frightens.  Perhaps
he will impart some ancient wisdom upon you... or tell you of his pet
dragon when he was a boy.  Who can say?

mobs.Name: cook
mobs.LongDescription: The guild cook snarls at you as he prepares your meal.
mobs.Description:
Small and hairy, this man wishes he were anywhere but here.  Working over 
a hot stove all day does not appeal to him.

mobs.Name: Meagan barmaid
mobs.LongDescription: The barmaid, Meagan, greets you with an inviting smile.
mobs.Description:
As you look over, the bar maid comes walking up to you, her hips
swaying nicely.  She smiles and presses up against you, asking if 
there is anything, anything at all, that you need.  You'd feel a 
little more special if she didn't keep looking at your money pouch.
mobs.ActionScript: %%05 say Hey there, sexy.  What can I do ye for?

mobs.Name: attendant immortal shopkeeper SDclan
mobs.LongDescription: The Immortal Attendant lives only to serve you.
mobs.Description:
The Attendant is humanoid in shape, with sallow grey skin, and
large black eyes. He looks at you with a mixture of awe and 
fear. He has been brought across space and time by the rulers 
of the #RStorm Dragons#N to serve their clan for eternity.

mobs.Name: tornado
mobs.LongDescription: THE tornado is here, and crushes you!

mobs.Name: squid giant
mobs.LongDescription: A giant squid is here entangling you with hundreds of tentacles!
mobs.Description:
It has hundreds of tentacles that end in cruel suckers and vicius barbs. As
you look at it you see that it has no other thoughts than just to kill you 
an eat you raw.

mobs.Name: moby dick whale
mobs.LongDescription: Moby Dick, the famous white whale bubbles around here.
mobs.ActionScript: %15 emote blows a cascade of water into the air.

mobs.Name: francis drake sea dragon sir
mobs.LongDescription: Sir Francis Drake, the Sea Dragon swims around in the water here.
mobs.Description:
The drake looks as elegant and beautiful as any other dragon you have seen.
It whitish blue scales glitter in the sun, and its big yellow eyes looks at you
with an undying hunger.
mobs.ActionScript: %15 growl

mobs.Name: megaladon
mobs.LongDescription: A Megaladon, a giant shark from the deeps is hunting prey here.
mobs.Description:
The megaladon must be a distant relative to the white shark, but four or five
times as big! As you look into its wide open mouth you see countless rows of
nine inch teeth, ready to be stained by your blood.

mobs.Name: zookeeper chrissy christine
mobs.LongDescription: Christine the Zookeeper is standing here feeding the animals.
mobs.Description:
Christine the Zookeeper loves her job!  She gets to work with all of the
interesting animals of the New Mavernal Zoo every day.  Her hair is a
mess, and she doesn't smell too great, but that is OK for the job she has
to do.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote reeks like the animals she works with.;%10 smile

mobs.Name: danno zookeeper dan
mobs.LongDescription: Danno the Zookeeper is standing here cleaning out cages.
mobs.Description:
Danno the Zookeeper has a very diffucult job ahead of him.  He gets to
 clean up after all of the animals in the zoo!  The zookeeper does't smell
 too sweet, but he doesn't seem to mind.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote points to the mess you are leaving.;%10 sigh;%10 say I wish
 people would learn to clean up after themselves!  The animals are bad
 enough as it is.

mobs.Name: gorilla male katu
mobs.LongDescription: A large male gorilla sits here pondering his existence.
mobs.Description:
The large silverback meets your gaze with an eerily intelligent one of his
own.  Katu is the solitary gorilla in the zoo's collection since his mate
Nalaga died a year ago.  Now poor Katu sits alone waiting for someone to
visit him.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote beats his barrel chest proudly.;%10 emote closes his eyes and
 smiles as he remembers his mate.;%10 emote likes bananas, but only the
 ones from Africa!

mobs.Name: siamang gibbon female mother
mobs.LongDescription: A female siamang gibbon swings through the trees.
mobs.Description:
The female siamang gibbon swings through the trees with her long sinewy
arms.  She has a powerful grip, and even when she is barely balanced, she
manages not to fall from her arboreal perch.  The siamang has a large
black pouch on her throat which she uses to create the eerie call distinct
to her species.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote emits an eerie call to her mate.;%10 emote swings through the
 trees with the greatest of ease.

mobs.Name: male siamang gibbon
mobs.LongDescription: A male siamang gibbon sits in a tree calling to his mate.
mobs.Description:
The male siamang is only slightly larger than his female mate.  He has the
characteristic large throat sac by which he creates his eerie whooping
call.  He flies easily through the tree-tops of his enclosure.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote grabs a branch and takes off swinging.;%10 emote throws his
head back and starts to whooop whoooop whooooop whoooooop!

mobs.Name: baby siamang gibbon
mobs.LongDescription: A baby siamang gibbon is standing here sucking his thumb.
mobs.Description:
The baby siamang is very cute indeed.  He has a tiny little face, and you
can't help but laugh when you watch him try to walk.  His arms are too
long for his body, so he holds them in the air above his head.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote gives up trying to walk and just sits down to pout.

mobs.Name: young siamang gibbon
mobs.LongDescription: A young siamang chases his brother around.
mobs.Description:
The young siamang is quite a sight as he zips through the trees chasing
his younger brother around.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 tickle baby;%10 taunt baby

mobs.Name: komodo dragon
mobs.LongDescription: A large komodo dragon lumbers toward you in search of a meal.
mobs.Description:
You think you are lucky that this dragon only eats carrion??  Maybe not! 
His bite is so deadly that he will kill you within minutes.  Then once you
are dead, he will eat you at his leisure!

mobs.Name: gila monster
mobs.LongDescription: A colorful gila monster basks in the sunlight.
mobs.Description:
The colorful gila monster appears to be sluggish, but don't turn your back
on him as he will attack you and kill you with his poisonous bite!

mobs.Name: mata turtle matamata
mobs.LongDescription: A large mata mata floats stealthily beneath the surface of the water.
mobs.Description:
At first glance, the mata mata appears to be a large pile of leaves below
the surface of the water, but as you peer closer a small head shoots out
from beneath the strange turtle's shell.  The mata mata uses camoflauge
and lightning reflexes to capture his aquatic prey.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote snaps his head out from under his shell and grabs a fish.

mobs.Name: peacock bird colorful
mobs.LongDescription: A colorful peacock shows off his beautiful tail.
mobs.Description:
The peacock uses his lovely tail to attract his less colorful mate, the
peahen.  His glorious tail has been used as decoration for centuries. 
Maybe one of his feathers will look nice in your cap!
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 strut

mobs.Name: kiwi bird
mobs.LongDescription: A fuzzy brown bird walks around here because he has no wings!
mobs.Description:
The fuzzy brown kiwi is one of the few wingless birds.  He prefers the
darkness of night, and can seldom be seen anywhere else.

mobs.Name: pygmy marmoset young
mobs.LongDescription: A young pygmy marmoset swings from a branch here.
mobs.Description:
The pygmy marmoset peers down at you from his perch.  He is rather shy, so
you might have to lure him down here with a piece of candy.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote peeks out shyly from his perch.

mobs.Name: female pygmy marmoset
mobs.LongDescription: A young female marmoset peers at you with cautious eyes.
mobs.Description:
The shy marmoset cowers as you try to get a closer look.  She doesn't
trust you very much, and she shakes with fear as you approach.

mobs.Name: marmoset male pygmy
mobs.LongDescription: A male marmoset cautiously approaches you.
mobs.Description:
This bold male marmoset is actually very afraid right now.  He is only
approaching you because he must defend his territory, which you appear to
be in right now.

mobs.Name: golden lion male tamarin
mobs.LongDescription: A male golden lion tamarin screeches fiercely at you as you enter his territory.
mobs.Description:
The male tamarin is generally a shy creature, but if you threaten his
territory, he will attempt to chase you away.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote screeches fiercely!

mobs.Name: golden lion female tamarin
mobs.LongDescription: A female golden lion tamarin hides in her tree-top nest.
mobs.Description:
The tamarin female is more cautious than her male mate.  She gazes at you
cautiously from the relative safety of her tree-top nest.

mobs.Name: lion
mobs.LongDescription: A fierce lion roars as he attacks you!
mobs.Description:
The mighty lion is rather stupendous with his glorious mane and proud
stature.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 roars loudly!;%10 purr

mobs.Name: tiger
mobs.LongDescription: A vicious tiger surprises you as he attacks from behind.
mobs.Description:
The magnificent tiger is covered with the characteristic black and orange
strips.  His large claws are indeed as fearsome as his long sharp teeth.

mobs.Name: zoo director
mobs.LongDescription: The Zoo Director stands here waiting to tell you all about the zoo.
mobs.Description:
The Zoo Director is so full of information!  If you stand around long
enough, he will tell you all about the New Mavernal Zoo and the
surrounding areas.  You can even ask him how to get to any of the exhibits
in the zoo!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 'I like bananas, but only the ones from Africa!;%5 'If you'd like to 
find your way to any of the exhibits, check out the map in the map room or 
get your own from one of our Information Aides!;%5 'Be sure to visit Katu, 
he gets so lonely sometimes.;%5 smile;%5 'Welcome to the Newbie Zoo!

mobs.Name: groundskeeper gardener
mobs.LongDescription: A groundskeeper is planting some flowers to brighten up the zoo.
mobs.Description:
The groundskeeper's hands are covered with dirt, and he smells of
fertilizer.  He does his best to keep the zoo looking great!

mobs.Name: groundskeeper
mobs.LongDescription: A groundskeeper is here trying to keep the zoo clean.
mobs.Description:
The groundskeeper is always walking around picking up after people.  He
does his best to keep the zoo looking nice.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 grumble;%10 glare

mobs.Name: sisaly information aide
mobs.LongDescription: Sisaly the Information aide is here to help you.
mobs.Description:
Sisaly the Information Aide is a helpful young lady.  She will provide you
with maps, brochures, and various other bits of information!

mobs.Name: salesman souveneir
mobs.LongDescription: A young man stands here waiting to assist you with your purchases.
mobs.Description:
This helpful young man is here to help you with your souveneir purchases. 
Simply <list> then <buy item> to get him to help!

mobs.Name: snack shop employee lady
mobs.LongDescription: A helpful young lady stands here watching over the Snack Shop.
mobs.Description:
This helpful young lady keeps the counter of the snack shop stocked so you
can find something to eat and drink in the New Mavernal Zoo.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote tries to look busy in case her boss walks in.

mobs.Name: boy
mobs.LongDescription: A little boy is wandering around looking at the animals.
mobs.Description:
This young man has his eyes filled with awe as he looks at the many
animals found in the New Mavernal Zoo.

mobs.Name: girl
mobs.LongDescription: A little girl looks at you with wonder.
mobs.Description:
The little girl doesn't seem sure if you are a part of the exhibit or a
visitor like her...
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote stares in awe.

mobs.Name: mom mother woman
mobs.LongDescription: A lovely woman wanders around the zoo.
mobs.Description:
This lovely young woman seems to have lost her son.  She is wandering
around calling his name...
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 'Bart!  Where are you?;%10 'Have you seen my son?

mobs.Name: dad father man
mobs.LongDescription: A young man is wandering around calling for his wife.
mobs.Description: This young man seems to have misplaced his whole family!
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 grumble;%10 'Where could they have gone?;%10 sigh

mobs.Name: titi monkey
mobs.LongDescription: A titi monkey sits in the tree.
mobs.Description:
The titi monkey has golden fur and a long fuzzy tail.  He sits high up in
the tree-tops gazing down at you.

mobs.Name: tucker orang orangutan
mobs.LongDescription: A silly young orangutan is doing flips across the room.
mobs.Description:
Tucker is a young orangutan, still small and silly.  He is playful, and he
tries to entice you into a game of fetch.  You soon realize it is YOU who
is doing the fetching!
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 wiggle;%10 grin;%10 giggle;%10 stare

mobs.Name: darwin information aide info
mobs.LongDescription: Darwin the Information Aide is here to help you.
mobs.Description:
Darwin knows all kinds of facts about the many animals in the zoo.  He can
help you find your way around and provide you with various maps.

mobs.Name: trainer instructor newbie guildmaster
mobs.LongDescription: A wise man stands here to train all newbies.
mobs.Description:
This wise man will train you with your skills.  He is learned in all of
the classes of skills.  This wise instructor is brought to you by a grant
from the Save the Newbies Foundation.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 'Tell me "practice" and let me teach you something!"

mobs.Name: medic newbie healer
mobs.LongDescription: The Newbie Zoo Medic is here to help you when you need it.
mobs.Description:
This lady is a skilled professional.  She is learned in the ways of magic
and healing.  She will gladly clean your wounds if you let her.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 'I can't wait til I get licensed so I can actually help you!

mobs.Name: salesman souvenir man young
mobs.LongDescription: A young man stands here waiting to assist you with your purchases.
mobs.Description:
This helpful young man is here to help you with your souveneir purchases. 
Simply <list> then <buy item> to get him to help!

mobs.Name: penguin escapee bird escaped
mobs.LongDescription: A penguin tries to look inconspicuous as she tries to escape the zoo.
mobs.Description:
This little penguin managed to somehow escape from the bird house!  She's
on the run now and doesn't want to go back!

mobs.Name: troll
mobs.LongDescription: A swamp troll charges towards you.
mobs.Description:
This huge behemoth towers to a height of 15 feet.  He sneers at you 
as he approaches and raises two black taloned claws to strike you.

mobs.Name: troll
mobs.LongDescription: A green troll attempts to get a hold on you.
mobs.Description:
This big troll towers several feet over you.  He has a large spear
which he seems to ply with utmost prowess.  He jabs his spear at you
and cackles with glee.

mobs.Name: ogre
mobs.LongDescription: An ogre stands here getting ready to beat in your face.
mobs.Description: This mean bastard looks like he could tear you limb from limb.

mobs.Name: thing
mobs.LongDescription: the Swamp Thing shambles about here.  It seems hungry.
mobs.Description: The Swamp Thing has huge fists, which look like they could pound you flat.

mobs.Name: gnoll
mobs.LongDescription: There is a mean looking gnoll here.
mobs.Description: The Gnoll seems annoyed at your presence.

mobs.Name: beast
mobs.LongDescription: A huge hairy beast shambles towards you with death in his eyes.
mobs.Description:
This huge beast stands about 20 feet in height and has huge green clawed
appendages.

mobs.Name: beast
mobs.LongDescription: A rather small beast cringes in terror as it notices you.
mobs.Description:
This rather small beast looks like you could take it out with a single
sword blow.

mobs.Name: will will-o-wisp
mobs.LongDescription: A Will-O-Wisp darts here and there, making fun of you.
mobs.Description:
This strange little creature seems very hard to keep your eyes on.
You stare as hard as you can at the glowing ball of floating light and
are just able to notice a small pair of glowing eyes.

mobs.Name: snake anaconda
mobs.LongDescription: A monstrous snake slithers towards you, thinking 'breakfast'.
mobs.Description: This 10 meter anaconda looks rather hungry.

mobs.Name: snake python
mobs.LongDescription: A rather large python rests in a coil here.
mobs.Description: It's the largest Amazon python you have ever seen.

mobs.Name: hag
mobs.LongDescription: A Marsh Hag is here.
mobs.Description:
Yech!  She manages to make even Smurfette look attractive.  That's ok,
because she thinks you stink too, and she's about to do something about it.

mobs.Name: slaad
mobs.LongDescription: A Death Slaad is standing here distraught.  He seems lost.
mobs.Description:
This dark apparition stands a meager 13 feet in height.  Even in the dim
swamp light, the blade of his scythe gleams.

mobs.Name: wolf
mobs.LongDescription: A marsh wolf sniffs the ground has followed your scent.
mobs.Description:
This wolf looks plump.  She probably ate a friend or two of yours who came
into the marsh.

mobs.Name: mound shambling
mobs.LongDescription: A heap of garbage shambles towards you.
mobs.Description: This grotesque pile of plant matter fills you with utmost horror.

mobs.Name: shaman orc
mobs.LongDescription: An orc shaman stands before you holding a staff and wearing robes.
mobs.Description:
This old orc has an array of bones stuck in his hair and strange symbols
painted on his face and hands.

mobs.Name: giant
mobs.LongDescription: A marsh giant stomps towards you.
mobs.Description: This huge monster of a man has green gnarly teeth and a BIG stick.

mobs.Name: gargoyle
mobs.LongDescription: A large gargoyle lands next to you, baring his fangs at you.
mobs.Description: This creepy fellow looks like he could use you as a meal.

mobs.Name: mummy
mobs.LongDescription: The mummy awakens and walks against you.
mobs.Description:
This tall, withered husk of a former nobleman is dressed in remenants of once
resplendant white cloth.

mobs.Name: skeletal warrior
mobs.LongDescription: The skeletal warrior cackles and attacks!
mobs.Description:
This tall, withered husk of a former king is dressed in remenants of once
resplendant white cloth.

mobs.Name: dark knight
mobs.LongDescription: A knight in glinting black armor guards here.
mobs.Description:
The paladin wears a shiny plate. He watches every step you take.
He rest his arms on a large broadsword.
mobs.ActionScript: %15 emote looks you over with a suspicous look.

mobs.Name: dark priest
mobs.LongDescription: A priest is walking around here muttering.
mobs.Description:
The priest is dressed in black robes. The priest look
very wicked..
mobs.ActionScript: %20 emote prays to the powers that be.; %20 say I am not worthy.

mobs.Name: evil cleric
mobs.LongDescription: A cleric is praying to his god here.
mobs.Description:
The priest is dressed in brown robes. The priest look
very wicked.
mobs.ActionScript: %25 emote prays to the powers that be.

mobs.Name: orcus death demon evil
mobs.LongDescription: Prince Orcus, the wicked lord of the demons, rests on his throne.
mobs.Description: Orcus looks extremely horrid, with his leathery wings and strong physique.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 snort;%20 say Give me your soul.;
%15 emote feeds off your hate and your cuts.

mobs.Name: death knight
mobs.LongDescription: A skeletal knight in glinting black plate is walking around here.
mobs.Description:
The knight is dead but still walks.  Tattered garb hangs on his feeble
frame, but he exudes power.

mobs.Name: paladin crusader knight
mobs.LongDescription: A paladin is crusading to retake the holy temple.
mobs.Description:
This knight wears the tabbard of Welmar with the avatar's symbol
emblazoned upon it.  He is a brave warrior and tries valiantly to retake
the holy temple.
mobs.ActionScript: %%25 say Fight on!  We must prevail!;%15 say Fear not!  Good is on our side!

mobs.Name: captured paladin knight
mobs.LongDescription: A knight in shiny plate is fighting to escape the crypt.
mobs.Description:
This knight has been captured and is now a prisoner of the undead lords.
Still, he is very strong, and constantly fights to escape and save his
temple.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 say We must not give up hope....;%10 emote prays for freedom.

mobs.Name: snake
mobs.LongDescription: A large dreadful snake is at your feet, hissing at you.
mobs.Description: It looks hungry.

mobs.Name: snake
mobs.LongDescription: A small green snake is here, and it doesn't look too friendly...
mobs.Description: It looks harmless.

mobs.Name: centipede
mobs.LongDescription: A small centipede is here, making its way across the floor.
mobs.Description: It looks completely harmless.

mobs.Name: kobold
mobs.LongDescription: An ugly kobold is here, searching for dinner.
mobs.Description: It looks ugly.

mobs.Name: orc
mobs.LongDescription: The orc walks around, looking for someone to kill.
mobs.Description: You notice an evil look in his eyes...

mobs.Name: orc
mobs.LongDescription: A large orc is here, looking really mean.
mobs.Description: He looks dreadful.

mobs.Name: warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A tall warrior is here.  He has more scars than anyone you have ever seen.
mobs.Description: He seems to be a strong, brainless fighter.

mobs.Name: warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A tall warrior is here.
mobs.Description: He seems to know his way with weapons.

mobs.Name: hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A small hobgoblin stands here.
mobs.Description: The hobgoblin looks quite lost.

mobs.Name: snake
mobs.LongDescription: A brown snake watches you.
mobs.Description: The snake looks quite mean.

mobs.Name: centipede
mobs.LongDescription: A white centipede is here.
mobs.Description: The centipede doesn't really seem to notice you.

mobs.Name: hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A large hobgoblin is here.
mobs.Description: The hobgoblin looks quite dangerous.

mobs.Name: orc
mobs.LongDescription: An orc is here, looking for something (or perhaps someone?) to eat.
mobs.Description: Well, he doesn't seem to be friendly.

mobs.Name: lion mountain
mobs.LongDescription: A mountain lion is here, growling at you viciously.
mobs.Description: The lion looks very nasty with huge claws and big teeth.

mobs.Name: giant hill
mobs.LongDescription: A hill giant is here, tossing some rocks around.
mobs.Description:
The hill giant looks like he's about 9 feet tall.  By his actions you 
come to the conclusion that he's not very intelligent.

mobs.Name: mage
mobs.LongDescription: A small intelligent looking mage is standing here.
mobs.Description: His IQ makes almost any elitemud player look stupid..

mobs.Name: troll
mobs.LongDescription: A large mean-looking troll is here.
mobs.Description: Well, it looks dangerous!

mobs.Name: snake
mobs.LongDescription: A large green snake is here, looks like a guardian for an evil force.
mobs.Description: You see a evil creature.

mobs.Name: thief
mobs.LongDescription: A thief is here, all dressed in black.
mobs.Description:
He seems to be counting a handful of coins.  Maybe you ought to count YOUR
gold too...

mobs.Name: orc
mobs.LongDescription: An ugly orc is standing here.
mobs.Description: It's quite disgusting to look at.

mobs.Name: centipede
mobs.LongDescription: A small harmless centipede is here.
mobs.Description: Well it doesn't seem to pay any attention to you.

mobs.Name: warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A human warrior is here.  He has a evil grin in his face.
mobs.Description: He doesn't look friendly at all...

mobs.Name: kobold
mobs.LongDescription: A green kobold is here.
mobs.Description: It looks slimy..

mobs.Name: adventurer sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Adventurer is here seeking his fortune.
mobs.Description:
The Adventurer is a hardy soul, toughened by years of rough and tumble.
He is clothed in the simple leggings and tunic of a humble man, sensible
wear for an outdoor life.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote pauses in his quest for glory, whips out a grubby flannel and wipes his face.

mobs.Name: squire sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Squire stands patiently waiting for his Master to call.
mobs.Description:
The Knight's Squire, resplendent in his red and green uniform, stands 
ready to assist his master. A young human he is in the bloom of good
health and as a special sign of recognition has been allowed to carry
his own sword on this dangerous mission.

mobs.Name: wyvern sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Wyvern lunges at you with vicious claws extended.
mobs.Description:
The Wyvern is a distant relative of the mighty Dragon. Smaller and 
without great intelligence it has nevertheless survived since the 
wyverns were driven from their home near the mountains of Moria by 
Divine Will. The journey has hardened it beyond all recognition and 
numerous scars across its scales are testament to its survival 
abilities. You wonder if it may have been mistaken for a dragon!

mobs.Name: knight sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Knight stands here, shining in his armour.
mobs.Description:
The Knight is a powerful human aged about thirty years old. His eyes 
shine with the glazed expression of a man pursuing a holy war. His 
task, to rid the land of dragons! His armour and sword are new and 
shiny and you suspect that he has yet to meet his first dragon.

mobs.Name: lion sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Mountain Lion eyes you hungrily.
mobs.Description:
The Mountain Lion is more of a great cat rather than a true lion. It 
is thin and hungry and covered in short brown fur. Yellow eyes blaze 
at you from its short flat face and powerful legs are tipped with razor
sharp claws poised to rip you to shreds.

mobs.Name: snake giant sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Giant Snake slithers towards you across the ground.
mobs.Description:
The huge brown snake is thicker than a man's thigh and very long. It 
is slowly and smoothly gliding towards you over the ground.

mobs.Name: champion knight sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The King's Champion stands here praying for guidence.
mobs.Description:
A veritable powerhouse of a man, the King's Champion is dressed in 
expensive and well maintained armour. His robes and finery are offset 
by his hardened, battle-scarred face. His gaze is steely and merciless 
and he has you at its focus.

mobs.Name: salamander giant sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Salamander rears up and pours forth fire!
mobs.Description:
The Salamander is a creature of heat and fire with a human torso and a 
reptilian lower half. Its gold eyes are sunk deep into its head which 
is topped with wild black hair. Its skin is red and the scales on its 
tail fade from red to orange at its tip.

mobs.Name: egg dragon sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: An Egg sits here waiting to hatch.
mobs.Description:
The size of a small boulder the egg's surface is smooth but mottled with 
many colours. It rocks slightly from time to time and you surmise that 
a dragon is about to hatch from it.

mobs.Name: hatchling sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Hatchling flaps about practising with its wings.
mobs.Description:
The Hatchling is a rather large but nonetheless, baby, dragon. It is 
flapping its wings experimentally and hopping about on its already 
sturdy and powerful legs. Its scales have hardened in the hours after
its hatching and it is already well protected. As it peers at you it 
seems more curious about you than afraid or aggressive.

mobs.Name: YoungWyrm young wyrm sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Young Wyrm eyes you thoughtfully.
mobs.Description:
The Young Wyrm has the fully developed body of a dragon and has mastered
the art of flight and dextrous use of its limbs. Although only half grown
it is large and its otherwise grey colouration is beginning to lighten as
its adult hue starts to show through.

mobs.Name: wyrm sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Wyrm is resting here.
mobs.Description:
The Wyrm is a fully grown dragon. It really is very large indeed. It
has a long neck and tail, which give it excellent reach, and very sharp
claws. Its wings occasionally fan the air producing powerful blasts 
which threaten to knock you off your feet. This one has turned out a 
rather impressive gold colour and seems to shine with a gentle light.

mobs.Name: ElderWyrm elder wyrm sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Elder Wyrm, conscious of his duty, stands here protecting his clan.
mobs.Description:
The Elder Wyrm is a seasoned campaigner. Years of study and exercise in
the formative atmosphere of the Storm Dragon clan have produced a being
destined for greatness. Next in line for the ruling class he is happy
to serve his clan in the knowledge that elevation will come when he is
ready.

mobs.Name: drake dragon sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Drake, master of all he sees stands here.
mobs.Description:
The Drake, newly appointed to his position in the ruling classes,
stands tall and proud. As a dragon of particular worth and dedication,
he has reached enlightenment and is now one with the forefather,
Glaurung.

mobs.Name: drake golden sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: A Huge Golden, Storm Dragon Drake, stands here.
mobs.Description:
The Drake is a burnished gold colour, like that of a glorious sunset. He
is slimmer than the average dragon with a longer neck and tail than
usual. His teeth and claws however look perfectly normal for a dragon!

mobs.Name: drake powerful sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: A Powerful Storm Dragon Drake, stands here.
mobs.Description:
Quite short and squat for a dragon, the Drake still dwarfs most other
sentient beings he comes across. His scales are a steely grey series
of overlapping plates that are very hard to penetrate. His eyes are
bright green and occasionally the transparent inner eyelid blinks
enabling him to study you without ever taking his eyes from you.

mobs.Name: GreatDrake great drake sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Great Drake of the Storm Dragons stands here.
mobs.Description:
The Great Drake is a huge specimen of a dragon. Dark brown from its
serious looking mouth down to the tip of its long flexible tail the
only concession to colour are its yellow eyes. It scales look very
tough, its teeth and claws razor sharp. A very formidable killing
machine should it choose to turn on you.

mobs.Name: greatdrake ancient great drake sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: An Ancient Great Drake and mighty warrior, stands here.
mobs.Description:
Despite his enormous size the Great Drake hovers just above the ground. 
Famed for his fighting prowess he still has a few chipped and cracked 
scales from teaching enemies the power of the Storm Dragons. Armoured
like a tank and possessed of both physical and mental weapons of 
destruction he weaves an intricate pattern of light between his front
claws.

mobs.Name: greatdrake mighty great drake sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Mighty Great Drake stands here.
mobs.Description:
Huge and battle scarred, the scaly bulk of a Mighty Great Drake fills 
your view. His powerful body is covered in scales larger than a dinner 
plate and his equally well-armoured limbs are well placed to rend you 
limb from limb.

mobs.Name: GrandDrake grand drake sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: A Storm Dragon Grand Drake stands here.
mobs.Description:
The Grand Drake has almost reached the pinnacle of the Storm Dragon
clan. It is easy to see why. Wise but kindly eyes peer down at you
from the head of this enormous dragon. A beautiful silvery-gray sheen
ripples across the well muscled body as it moves.

mobs.Name: avatar dragonlord granddrake grand drake sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: A Mighty Avatar Dragonlord stands here.
mobs.Description:
You stand before a mighty avatar dragonlord. His eyes burn with fire as 
he looks impassively at you. He is dressed in shiny golden armour that 
blazes like the sun and in his had he holds a huge sword.

mobs.Name: grand drake genial dragonlord GrandDrake sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Genial Avatar Dragonlord stands here.
mobs.Description:
He has chosen to appear in avatar form today. A large glowing 
golden humanoid stands before you, tastefully attired in a plain white
robe and a large golden belt. Perched jauntily on his head sits the 
traditional pointed wizards hat! A neat fringe protrudes under the rim
neatly framing the grinning face below. Friendly, genial and extremely
deadly are impressions that his casual countenance convey!
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 cast 43 genial

mobs.Name: HighDrake high drake dragonlord sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: A High Drake and Dragonlord stands here.
mobs.Description:
As a leader of the Storm Dragons the High Drake is respected and feared 
in all the lands. Wise and powerful, both physically and mentally, 
he takes a particularly strong role within the clan itself. Whereas 
some clan members further the clan mainly in the world outside,
this one also takes time to nurture the young and pass on his wisdom.

mobs.Name: statue immortal god sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: A Statue of a Storm Dragon Immortal stands resolute here.
mobs.Description:
A feeble replica of the might and glory of a Storm Dragon God has
been placed here to allow its namesake's spirit to permeate this
place.

mobs.Name: attendant sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: An Attendant awaits the pleasure of a Storm Dragon.
mobs.Description:
These attendants all look the same to you! Humanoid but strangely
silent they show no emotion as they move among the Storm Dragons.
Their grey sallow skin gleams oddly in the light and their eyes are
sunken, dark pools.

mobs.Name: soul vanquished sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: A Vanquished Soul suffers here.
mobs.Description:
A vanquished soul writhes in agony. An ephemeral, ghost like, outline
of a man it waxes and wanes with a slow pulsing rhythm. Barely audible
moans and cries of anguish seem to appear from nowhere around you.

mobs.Name: bone beast sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: A Bone Beast rattles and clacks as it moves towards you!
mobs.Description:
An strange assortment of bones, animated by hatred and suffering, are
lurching about unable to find eternal peace. It doesn't seem very 
interested in you. It's probably more concerned with it's own problems.

mobs.Name: elf tortured sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: A Tortured Elf writhes in agony on the floor here.
mobs.Description:
He seems to be in very bad condition and it doesn't look like he 
will last much longer. However, you notice that some of the cuts 
have been partially healed, as if Zharradan is keeping him alive 
and in pain for as long as possible...

mobs.Name: elf tortured sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: A Tortured Elf writhes in agony on the floor here.
mobs.Description:
She seems to be in very bad condition and it doesn't look like she 
will last much longer. However, you notice that some of the cuts 
have been partially healed, as if Zharradan is keeping her alive 
and in pain for as long as possible...

mobs.Name: ElderWyrm elder wyrm sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Elder Wyrm, conscious of his duty, stands here protecting his clan.
mobs.Description:
The Elder Wyrm is a seasoned campaigner. Years of study and exercise in
the formative atmosphere of the Storm Dragon clan have produced a being
destined for greatness. Next in line for the ruling class he is happy
to serve his clan in the knowledge that elevation will come when he is
ready.

mobs.Name: drake dragonlady sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: A Dragonlady, one of the Storm Dragon Drakes, stands here.
mobs.Description:
She is slightly larger than an average dragon and you realise that
female dragons have a slight size advantage over the males. She regards
you with a not unkindly air whilst retaining the ability to reduce you
to a bloody pulp, should she choose to do so.

mobs.Name: hatchling messy sdzone
mobs.LongDescription: The Hatchling flaps about practising with its wings.
mobs.Description:
The Hatchling is a rather large but nonetheless, baby, dragon. It is 
flapping its wings experimentally and hoping about on its already 
sturdy and powerful legs. Its scales have hardened in the hours after
its hatching and it is already well protected. As it peers at you it 
seems more curious about you than afraid or aggressive.

mobs.Name: isha elf
mobs.LongDescription: Isha the Dark Elf is here, observing you silently.
mobs.Description:
She is no less than beautiful, skin as dark as the night and hair shining like
silver in the moonlight.  Her slender body is adorned with a sleeveless shirt
and a short skirt made from black scales joined with silver threads.  Her back
is covered by a large, hooded cloak as black as her skin and in her broad
silver belt hangs a long, slender sword in a silver scabbard.

mobs.Name: death reaper
mobs.LongDescription: Death the Grim Reaper is observing you silently from empty eye sockets.
mobs.Description: The dark-robed skeletal figure radiates an unendurable coldness.

mobs.Name: drow sentry
mobs.LongDescription: A drow sentry is standing here, ready to slay any intruders.
mobs.Description:
The dark elf has shocking white hair and pitch black skin.  His eyes glow
bright red, and are very fierce.

mobs.Name: spider small
mobs.LongDescription: A small spider scampers around here.
mobs.Description: This small spider is probably very poisonous.

mobs.Name: drider
mobs.LongDescription: A bloated, evil looking drider is looking for food.
mobs.Description:
The drider is a drow from the waist up, but the rest is a massive, horrid
spider.

mobs.Name: spider widow large
mobs.LongDescription: A large black widow is crawling on the wall.
mobs.Description: The black widow is easily identified by the red hourglass on its back.

mobs.Name: captive woman
mobs.LongDescription: A woman stands here, sobbing.
mobs.Description:
This woman is weak and feeble from her stay in the pen.  You think you can
make out what appears to be an Elite clan symbol on her clothes.

mobs.Name: captive elf girl
mobs.LongDescription: A young elven girl stands here, looking for a way to escape.
mobs.Description:
This girl is bold and defiant.  You think you can see the Elysium symbol
embroidered on her dress.

mobs.Name: squire human prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A squire stands here, looking for a way to escape.
mobs.Description:
This young man is hurt from an escape attempt.  You think you can make out
a blazing phoenix on his tabard.

mobs.Name: ratman prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A ratman prisoner is trying to rebel against his drow masters.
mobs.Description:
This young ratman, proudly wearing a Guerilla headband, is trying to break
his shackles.

mobs.Name: troll prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A troll prisoner is nursing his burn wounds.
mobs.Description:
This troll was captured in a raid into Midgaard.  You think he is wearing
the colors of the Malina clan.

mobs.Name: vampire prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A vampire prisoner has been exposed to sunlight.
mobs.Description:
This vampire is wearing a noble's seal of the Night Tribe.  He looks quite
hurt from his burns.

mobs.Name: dwarf shackled warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven warrior pulls mightily against his chains.
mobs.Description:
This dwarf has been beaten across the head.  You can see the torn tabard
of the Divine Powers clan.

mobs.Name: dwarf chained warrior prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven prisoner seems half-crazed.
mobs.Description:
This dwarf has scars all over his back.  You can see the feared symbol of
the Army of Darkness tattooed on his back, with the word "Geefunk" written
beneath it.

mobs.Name: fairy prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A fairy prisoner is standing here, crying.
mobs.Description:
This fairy is bloodied and hurt.  She is wearing a dress typically worn by
Artemisians.  Her wings have been plucked.

mobs.Name: shogun samurai prisoner captured
mobs.LongDescription: A samurai prisoner is chained to the wall.
mobs.Description:
The samurai is saddened and wants to regain his honor.  He is wearing the
distinctive symbol of the Shogun clan.

mobs.Name: dwarf prisoner insane moc derro
mobs.LongDescription: An insane derro prisoner is here, cackling madly.
mobs.Description:
This dwarf has gone quite insane.  He has the words "Minions of Chaos"
written across his chest in blood.  His own blood, probably.

mobs.Name: woman elf prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: An elven prisoner is here, sighing about her fate.
mobs.Description:
This woman has the symbol of the sun on her shirt, quite stained from her
tribulations.

mobs.Name: half elf prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A half-elven prisoner scowls, wanting to break free.
mobs.Description:
This half elf has the triangular symbol of the TRI clan on his shirt.  It
is covered in blood, probably his own.

mobs.Name: vampire shadowblade sb prisoner captured
mobs.LongDescription: A captured vampire is chained to the wall.
mobs.Description:
This vampire wishes to break free.  She is always looking around for a way
to escape her chains.  She has the symbol of the Shadowblades tattooed on
her neck.

mobs.Name: lizardman prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A lizardman prisoner is here, hitting the wall in frustration.
mobs.Description:
The lizardman has several scales torn from his scalp, and is bleeding
rather badly.  He bears the symbol of the Storm Dragons on his sash.

mobs.Name: prisoner dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarf is chained here, grinning madly.
mobs.Description:
This dwarf seems quite insane.  He is standing on some bones of some
creature he smashed.  He's also naked, and you can see the letters "TKK"
tattooed on his arse.

mobs.Name: werewolf pack prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A werewolf is here, raging against his shackles.
mobs.Description:
This werewolf seems very old and grey.  He is trying to break his shackles
and be free so that he can run with his pack once again.

mobs.Name: drow noble
mobs.LongDescription: A drow noble is walking around.
mobs.Description:
The drow has pitch black skin and pure white hair, and a light colored
goatee.  He wears all black, and looks very evil.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 emote looks right at you.

mobs.Name: drow master swordmaster
mobs.LongDescription: A drow swordmaster is here, instructing the youth.
mobs.Description: The drow swordmaster does not look it, but he is very old and wise.
mobs.ActionScript: %%25 emote gives a few tips on how to fight.

mobs.Name: drow student
mobs.LongDescription: A drow student is here, sparring.
mobs.Description: He must be very swift and deadly, or he will just end up a corpse.
mobs.ActionScript: %1 test;%25 emote lunges in a practice swing.

mobs.Name: slartiin wizard old man
mobs.LongDescription: Slartiin the Stupendous, the great wizard, is exploring.
mobs.Description: Slartiin is very old and wise.  His beard touches the ground.

mobs.Name: nude drow woman
mobs.LongDescription: A mostly nude drow woman is standing here, shouting at you.
mobs.Description:
This drow woman is incredibly beautiful, but you don't have the time to
admire her assets.  She seems quite angry with you.

mobs.Name: bathing drow woman
mobs.LongDescription: A drow woman is here, taking a relaxing bath.
mobs.Description:
This woman is incredibly beautiful.  You guess correctly that the dark
elves kill the women who do not look beautiful.

mobs.Name: drow torturer
mobs.LongDescription: A drow is here, delighting in torture.
mobs.Description:
This dark elf is particularly sadistic.  He is in charge of torturing
anyone the Matron Mother does not like.

mobs.Name: drow servant
mobs.LongDescription: A drow is serving his superiors.
mobs.Description:
This drow wears very little, and is careful not to upset his superiors,
lest he become dinner.

mobs.Name: drow guard
mobs.LongDescription: A drow guard is standing here, ready to slay any intruders.
mobs.Description:
The dark elf has shocking white hair and pitch black skin.  His eyes glow
bright red, and are very fierce.

mobs.Name: drow weaponsmith
mobs.LongDescription: A drow weaponsmith is here, labouring on a sword.
mobs.Description:
This drow is very old and venerable.  Drow look very young until they are
about 600 or 700 years old, so he must be incredibly old.  His hair is
almost yellow, and his skin is starting to grey, but he still looks very
dangerous.

mobs.Name: drow armourer
mobs.LongDescription: A drow armourer is here, working on a mithril shirt.
mobs.Description:
The drow armourer seems to be very old, and is probably a deadly opponent.
He knows how to make armour so he is not attacked by his superiors.  His
inferiors just die.

mobs.Name: drow merchant
mobs.LongDescription: A drow merchant is here, offering to sell his goods.
mobs.Description:
This drow seems to be quite old and wise.  He wears a seal that is the
symbol of an ancient drow house, but only Azzinoden lives in this city.
He must be either very talented or very powerful to be left alive.  He is
the merchant for the city.

mobs.Name: drow retelzin wizard magician
mobs.LongDescription: Retelzin Azzinoden, the drow magician, works in his laboratory.
mobs.Description:
Retelzin is a much respected magician amongst the drow.  Many people come
to buy his rare and powerful magic.

mobs.Name: drow commoner
mobs.LongDescription: A drow commoner is here, walking around the streets.
mobs.Description:
This drow appears very young and nimble.  He is probably a deadly
opponent.

mobs.Name: drow prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A drow prisoner is here, wanting to escape torture.
mobs.Description:
This drow has burn marks all over his skin and back.  He probably upset
Kazlyn.

mobs.Name: drow masseuse
mobs.LongDescription: A drow is here, giving massages to the women.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the many unimportant dark elves.  He has been forced to
give massages to the other drow, but it's a cushy task, so who cares?

mobs.Name: drow woman
mobs.LongDescription: A drow woman is naked from the waist up, and is getting a massage.
mobs.Description:
This dark elf is very lovely.  She is quite beautiful, with very long
white flowing hair streaming across her shoulders.  She seems to enjoy the
massages that are her right.

mobs.Name: akkadian paladin
mobs.LongDescription: Akkadian, a young paladin, explores the tunnels.
mobs.Description:
Akkadian is a young knight that has been exploring the tunnels with his
friends.  He wears the symbol of the Dimaron Lords.  His brown hair is cut
short, but he is very well groomed.

mobs.Name: fredrick friar
mobs.LongDescription: Friar Fredrick is here, bringing aid to the prisoners.
mobs.Description:
The friar is a priest of Chronias, the god of all that is good in the
world.  He is rather large himself, and probably drinks too much of his
sacremental wines.  His beard is very, very, very fuzzy.
mobs.ActionScript: %1 test;%20 emote waves his mace.;%15 burp;%20 say Repent!

mobs.Name: pem
mobs.LongDescription: Pem stands here, ready with his spear.
mobs.Description:
Pem is a healthy young man.  He adventures with Friar Fredrick and wants
to buy a farm one day.

mobs.Name: spider massive poison
mobs.LongDescription: A massive poisonous spider is eating a dead drow.
mobs.Description: This spider is just absolutely huge.

mobs.Name: noble woman drow
mobs.LongDescription: A drow noblewoman looks at you haughtily.
mobs.Description:
This dark elf is quite attractive and domineering.  She has her white hair
braided so that she can fight with it.  Her skin is pitch black, and is
flawless.

mobs.Name: drow woman
mobs.LongDescription: A drow woman is here, walking around the streets.
mobs.Description:
This drow appears very young and nimble.  She is probably a deadly
opponent.

mobs.Name: kazlyn drow matron mother
mobs.LongDescription: Kazlyn, the Matron Mother, looks around arrogantly.
mobs.Description:
Kazlyn is extremely powerful.  She is quite deadly, and knows almost
everything there is to know about magic.  In her life she has attacked
many wizards, and killed them all, just to prove that she is the best.
Her billowy white hair catches a breeze lightly, and her fierce green eyes
miss nothing.

mobs.Name: tashken drow
mobs.LongDescription: Lord Tashken stands here, eyeing you calmly.
mobs.Description:
Tashken is an old and noble drow.  He is a quick fighter, and has only
ever been defeated once, by his wayward son, Corbaine.  He serves the
Matron Mother and is her current favorite.  He keeps his hair trimmed
short, and his goatee groomed.
mobs.ActionScript: %%90 circle

mobs.Name: drow assassin
mobs.LongDescription: A drow assassin leaps to kill you!
mobs.Description: This dark elf is an extremely deadly enemy.  He is trained to kill.

mobs.Name: arziana drow
mobs.LongDescription: Arziana is standing here, smiling slyly.
mobs.Description:
Arziana is the daughter of Kazlyn, and as such, is the first in line to
become the Matron Mother.  She is, herself, very attractive, and quite
deadly when she needs to be.

mobs.Name: mercurien drow
mobs.LongDescription: Mercurien would like to know why you are in her chambers.
mobs.Description:
Mercurien is Tashken's first wife, and the sister to Kazlyn.  She is
rather distressed lately, and her appearance shows this.  Her skin has
taken on a grey hue.

mobs.Name: denzar drow
mobs.LongDescription: A drow is here, nursing his wounds.
mobs.Description:
This dark elf is young and haughty.  His skin is rock black, and his hair
is snow white.  He keeps his hair cut short, and has grown a soft, white
goatee.  His eyes are a fierce green.  For some reason, he has fled into
the Gauntlet.

mobs.Name: studying drow
mobs.LongDescription: A drow is here, studying.
mobs.Description: This dark elf is busy studying.  You don't think he even sees you.

mobs.Name: large drider
mobs.LongDescription: A very large drider is here, looking for someone to slaughter.
mobs.Description:
This is quite possibly the largest drider you have ever seen.  It is very
large, and looks very hungry.

mobs.Name: piranha snake huge
mobs.LongDescription: An absolutely huge piranha snake swims around, looking for food.
mobs.Description:
This animal is long, white, and has lots of teeth, but if you grab it
behind the ears, it's harmless!

mobs.Name: umber hulk
mobs.LongDescription: A huge umber hulk rips the cliff apart.
mobs.Description:
The umber hulk has 4 eyes, and huge mandibles.  It can tear through sheer
rock without a scratch on its hard plated skin.

mobs.Name: drow hunter
mobs.LongDescription: A drow hunter is chasing down his foe.
mobs.Description:
Drow hunters are very deadly opponents, and are dedicated to the complete
annihilation of their enemies.  This one is employed by Kazlyn herself.

mobs.Name: gargoyle
mobs.LongDescription: A gargoyle swoops to attack!
mobs.Description:
This is a very large and dangerous looking gargoyle.  He is made of almost
solid rock, and looks very heavy.  His claws are extraordinairily sharp.

mobs.Name: cave troll green
mobs.LongDescription: A putrid green cave troll hisses madly.
mobs.Description:
You've seen the trolls in the Troll caves, but this guy looks REAL mean.
He is huge, spindly and green, and oozes puss.  His muscles ripple when he
burps.

mobs.Name: drow elite guard
mobs.LongDescription: A drow elite guard refuses to let you pass.
mobs.Description:
This dark elf is in the service of Kazlyn.  It is his job to stop people
from entering the palace without permission.

mobs.Name: balazar drow
mobs.LongDescription: Lord Balazar stands here, eyeing you skeptically.
mobs.Description:
Balazar is the son of Kazlyn, and is very important in the structure of
House Azzinoden.  He keeps his white hair groomed and long, and is clean
shaven.  His eyes are a horrid orange color.

mobs.Name: drow noble sparring
mobs.LongDescription: A drow is here, sparring with the air.
mobs.Description: This noble is fighting the air, practicing his skills.

mobs.Name: duck malard montgomery
mobs.LongDescription: A duck is here, quacking happily.
mobs.Description: This duck is very smart and talented.

mobs.Name: michael garn megaron
mobs.LongDescription: Michael Garn is standing here, grinning demomically.
mobs.Description:
Michael is a vile and wretched man.  He has many powers that come from
supernatural sources, and is an extremly deadly foe.  He is the sworn
enemy of Denzar, and wishes to kill that dark elf.

mobs.Name: bandar nazet half drow
mobs.LongDescription: Bandar Nazet, the deadly half-drow, keeps his bow aimed at you.
mobs.Description:
Bandar is one of the most feared heroes of the drow, period.  He died
many, many years ago, in a famous struggle against the elven priest-kings, 
but dark and dangerous magic has resurrected him.  He was most well know
for his archery, and is reputed to have never, ever missed a shot.  He
keeps his white hair trimmed short, and wears a thin mustache and goatee.
The brand of House Nazet is clear on his exposed shoulder.

mobs.Name: death demon
mobs.LongDescription: A death demon is here looking for prey.
mobs.Description: The demon seems to be ready to jump on the first sight of living flesh he sees.

mobs.Name: crazed man worshipper
mobs.LongDescription: A crazed worshipper is standing here screaming.
mobs.Description:
The worshipper has eyes of red and look as though Satan has stolen his soul for
keeps.

mobs.Name: minor demon
mobs.LongDescription: A minor demon is searching for a soul to torture.
mobs.Description:
The demon has a cruel gleam in his eyes, and starts looking at your soul. He is
clothed in fire and carries a wicked looking scythe.

mobs.Name: walking satanic
mobs.LongDescription: The walking satanic is searching for worthy souls.

mobs.Name: blind follower
mobs.LongDescription: A blind follower is practicing a spell.

mobs.Name: satanic
mobs.LongDescription: A satanic is searching for a good soul.
mobs.Description: The satanic wants you to follow him.

mobs.Name: jack ripper
mobs.LongDescription: Jack the Ripper is looking for live bait.
mobs.Description: Jack is cleaning the blood off his knife.

mobs.Name: hell hound
mobs.LongDescription: A hell hound is here mucking on the souls of the dead.
mobs.Description: This undead creature is a horrible abomination of a beastly fido.

mobs.Name: worshipper
mobs.LongDescription: A worshipper prostrates himself in the name of Satan.
mobs.Description: What a pitiful excuse for a worshipper.

mobs.Name: warlock
mobs.LongDescription: A warlock will pray for you in the name of Satan.
mobs.Description: The warlock has an aura of the deepest shade of blood.

mobs.Name: counsellor
mobs.LongDescription: A counsellor tries to lure you deeper into hell.
mobs.Description: The counsellor radiates an aura of evil.

mobs.Name: concubine
mobs.LongDescription: A concubine is here trying to make your life a living hell.
mobs.Description: Nag Nag Nag...

mobs.Name: mud addict soul
mobs.LongDescription: One of numerous souls of a mud addict wails here.
mobs.Description: The soul stares at you mournfully, shaking it's head.

mobs.Name: guardian
mobs.LongDescription: The Guardian of the Night will not let you live.
mobs.Description: Looks like the biggest, baddest, and ugliest thing you have ever seen.

mobs.Name: satan
mobs.LongDescription: Satan is coming to collect your soul.
mobs.Description: Satan is the Master of Evil.

mobs.Name: major demon
mobs.LongDescription: A major demon is painting the walls with your blood.
mobs.Description: The major demon has got to be the second ugliest thing you have ever seen.

mobs.Name: bael baelzubel
mobs.LongDescription: Baelzubel is spreading lies and deception.
mobs.Description: Baelzubel is the Lord of the Lies.

mobs.Name: sufferer
mobs.LongDescription: A sufferer looks at you for sympathy.
mobs.Description: A sufferer is here wailing in pain and agony.

mobs.Name: greater demon huge
mobs.LongDescription: A greater demon claws at you angrily.
mobs.Description:
A huge demon looks evil and angry at your presence. Its teeth dripping 
with blood from its last victim.

mobs.Name: fury
mobs.LongDescription: A Fury flies towards you in attempt to consume you.
mobs.Description:
The Fury flutters around you looking for spots to feed upon. It's body is
covered in the blood of past warriors.

mobs.Name: hades
mobs.LongDescription: Hades laughs at your mortality and lunges towards you.
mobs.Description: Hades appears as a reincarnation of death as known to you.

mobs.Name: hell spawn
mobs.LongDescription: A hell spawn attempts to kill you!
mobs.Description:
Their eyes are bright red with blood as its true meaning. It looks hungry
for the blood of any prey it can get.

mobs.Name: ferrix queen
mobs.LongDescription: Queen Ferrix is waiting here in search for mortal men.
mobs.Description:
Here lies a beutiful woman whom at first glance, appears peaceful and loving.
But as you peer close, you can see the death claws of her nails and the
vicous armor worn by her.

mobs.Name: liz borden
mobs.LongDescription: Liz Borden is looking for live bait.
mobs.Description: Liz is cleaning the blood off her knife.

mobs.Name: spellcaster spellcastera special
mobs.LongDescription: A spellcaster type A wants a room description.
mobs.Description: Its a helper, hihi

mobs.Name: spellcaster spellcasterb special
mobs.LongDescription: A spellcaster type B wants a room descption.
mobs.Description: Its a helper, hihi

mobs.Name: spellcaster spellcasterc special

mobs.Description: Its a helper, hihi

mobs.Name: spellcaster spellcastere special
mobs.LongDescription: A spellcaster type E wants a room descption.
mobs.Description: Ouch this dragon, can do some nite dragon stuff

mobs.Name: spellcaster spellcasterf special
mobs.LongDescription: A spellcaster type F wants a room descption.
mobs.Description: Ouch this dragon, can do some nite dragon stuff

mobs.Name: spellcaster spellcasterg special
mobs.LongDescription: A spellcaster type G wants a room description.
mobs.Description: This one is evil!

mobs.Name: spellcaster spellcasterh special
mobs.LongDescription: A spellcaster type H wants a room description.
mobs.Description: This one is evil!

mobs.Name: spellcaster spellcasteri special
mobs.LongDescription: A spellcaster type I wants a room description.
mobs.Description: This one is evil!

mobs.Name: hardhitter hardhittera special
mobs.LongDescription: A hardhitter type A wants a room description.
mobs.Description: Hit em hard.

mobs.Name: hardhitter hardhitterb special
mobs.LongDescription: A hardhitter type B wants a room description.
mobs.Description: Hit em hard.

mobs.Name: hardhitter hardhitterc special
mobs.LongDescription: A hardhitter type C wants a room description.
mobs.Description: Hit em hard.

mobs.Name: hardhitter hardhitterd special
mobs.LongDescription: A hardhitter type D wants a room description.
mobs.Description: Hit em hard.

mobs.Name: hardhitter hardhittere special
mobs.LongDescription: A hardhitter type E wants a room description.
mobs.Description: Hit em hard.

mobs.Name: tank tanka special
mobs.LongDescription: A tank type A is here but needs a room description.
mobs.Description: Wizard from hell?.

mobs.Name: tank tankb special
mobs.LongDescription: A tank type B is here but needs a room description.
mobs.Description: Wizard from hell?.

mobs.Name: tank tankc special
mobs.LongDescription: A tank type C is here but needs a room description.
mobs.Description: Wizard from hell?.

mobs.Name: tank tankd special
mobs.LongDescription: A tank type D is here but needs a room description.
mobs.Description: Wizard from hell?.

mobs.Name: tank tanke special
mobs.LongDescription: A tank type E is here but needs a room description.
mobs.Description: Wizard from hell?.

mobs.Name: spellcaster spellcasterj special
mobs.LongDescription: A spellcaster type J wants a room descption.
mobs.Description: Ouch this dragon, can do some nite dragon stuff

mobs.Name: Troll King
mobs.LongDescription: A large imposing troll stands before you.
mobs.Description:
Before you stands a very large; a very ugly; troll.  He gives off an 
odor that is typical of these ugly brutes.

mobs.Name: Troll Captain
mobs.LongDescription: The Captain of the Troll Guard looks menacingly about him.
mobs.Description:
A competant, but ugly, troll stands before you decked out in 
an odd assortment of armor pillaged from his different victims.

mobs.Name: Troll Queen
mobs.LongDescription: A regal looking female troll stands before you.
mobs.Description:
A regal looking female troll stands here looking regal in her "beauty".
It takes a  troll to understand it.

mobs.Name: Troll Guard
mobs.LongDescription: A troll stands here guarding something.
mobs.Description:
You see an average everyday troll guard standing here ready to pound
you into the ground with his sledgehammer fists.

mobs.Name: Male Troll
mobs.LongDescription: An ordinary, under-the-bridge type troll looks suspiciously at you.
mobs.Description:
This looks like a common, average, everday, find under the bridge, troll
