you see almost under every bridge being crossed by billy goats.

mobs.Name: Female Troll
mobs.LongDescription: A female troll overwhelms you with her bad breath.
mobs.Description:
This is a comon troll that you see almost any where.  She looks like
she can be a tad dangerous.

mobs.Name: Ogre Chief
mobs.LongDescription: A large ogre stands before you cracking his knuckles.
mobs.Description:
A rather large (and rather dumb) ogre stands before you.  The way he
besides nuts, in those rather large hands of his.

mobs.Name: Male Ogre
mobs.LongDescription: A huge ogre stands before you.

mobs.Name: Female Ogre
mobs.LongDescription: An ogre stands before you.

mobs.Name: Snotling Child Ogre
mobs.LongDescription: A snotling childish ogre wipes his nose on you.  Ewww!
mobs.Description:
The little snotling is remarkably dirty, even for an ogre!  He
seems to be playing some childish game using bones.

mobs.Name: Snotling Child Troll
mobs.LongDescription: A snotling childish troll plays here.
mobs.Description:
Snotling trolls look a lot like adult trolls ... big, meaty, mean,
with low foreheads and a "Make my day" kind of aggressive stance.

mobs.Name: master psionicist psi creston Creston
mobs.LongDescription: Creston is here working on advanced Psionics.
mobs.Description:
Creston is the most powerful psionicist that has ever been.  He is 
able to do things with psionics that past masters never thought
possible.  
This is a man who has spent his entire life pushing the limits of 
psionicism.  He is immensely powerful in the arts and probably could
rend your body into two with just a mere thought.

mobs.Name: painting
mobs.LongDescription: A large painting is hanging on a wall.
mobs.Description:
A painting glorifying the greatest of the Psionicists ever the 
mighty Creston.  The painting itself depicts Creston single handedly
battling a horde of demon spawn.

mobs.Name: paintbrush brush
mobs.LongDescription: An artists paintbrush is lying here on the table.
mobs.Description:
The bristles on the brush are permanently stained with many different
colors from being used.

mobs.Name: paint can paintcan
mobs.LongDescription: A paintcan sits here on a shelf.
mobs.Description:
The paintcan is made of some kind of metal with a wooden lid sealed 
by wax to keep the paint from drying out.

mobs.Name: Easel
mobs.LongDescription: A painters easel leans against the wall.
mobs.Description:
The easel stands here waiting to hold paintings.  It is covered
with gooey paint.

mobs.Name: guard
mobs.LongDescription: A psionicist school guard is standing here.
mobs.Description:
The guard probably has very little training in the arts of war and 
would not last in a fight against a trained warrior.

mobs.Name: novice psi psionicist
mobs.LongDescription: A novice of the psionicist school is wandering about.
mobs.Description:
The novice is wearing a white robe which has a  red triskelion 
embroidered on the breast.  He is one of the students of this 
school who are here learning about the secret powers of the mind.
Physically he is weak but who knows what interesting tricks this 
young novice has learned in his little time studying at the school.

mobs.Name: novice psi psionicist
mobs.LongDescription: A novice of the school is here practicing psionics.
mobs.Description:
Like the other novices in the school she is wearing a white robe with
a red triskelion embroidered on the breast.  She is one of the students
of this school who are here learning about the secret powers of the
mind.  This novice is not ready for any type of confrontation, but 
once her innate powers of the mind are fully developed she will be
powerful.

mobs.Name: apprentice psi psionicist
mobs.LongDescription: An apprentice is here demonstrating for the novices.
mobs.Description:
After years of study the novices of the school take grueling tests 
to become apprentices.  This apprentice has made achievements 
within the school and is considered an advanced student of the mind.
The apprentices in this school are of a level of mastery within 
their skill that they can be a formidable opponent in battle.

mobs.Name: apprentice psi psionicist
mobs.LongDescription: The apprentice is here learning from the masters.
mobs.Description:
This apprentice has made achievements within the school and is 
considered an advanced student of the mind.  The apprentices in 
this school are of a level of mastery within their skill that they 
can be a formidable opponent in battle.

mobs.Name: master psi psionicist
mobs.LongDescription: A master in the arts of psionics is teaching class.
mobs.Description:
The master psionicist is here lecturing to a class of novices. The
masters have been studying psionics for many years and are truly 
powerful in the ways of psionics. Only a handful of the best 
psionicists ever achieve the rank of master.

mobs.Name: master psi psionicist
mobs.LongDescription: The master psionicist is here studying the latest writings of Creston.
mobs.Description:
The masters have been studying psionics for many years and are truly 
powerful in the ways of psionics. Only a handful of the best 
psionicists ever achieve the rank of master.

mobs.Name: lhurgoif
mobs.LongDescription: A large 3 legged 5 armed deformed beast is chained to the wall.
mobs.Description:
The twisted hulk before you is one of Creston's experiments that 
went totally wrong.  This beast is covered with a slimy green skin,
and has 5 hulking arms and 3 powerful legs, all with razor sharp claws.

mobs.Name: phantasm phantasmal force forces
mobs.LongDescription: Phantasmal forces are roaming the practice hall.
mobs.Description:
Phantasmal forces are psionic projections made by a psionicist.  They
are used in the school to teach students the discipline of projecting
psionic energy at a distance.  The forces appear to be made of mist.

mobs.Name: entity psionic energy
mobs.LongDescription: A conscious mass of psionic energy looks for its maker.
mobs.Description:
The psionic entity is similar to the forces in that it is a psionic
projection.  The mist that composes most other psionically projected
beings also composes the entity. This particular projection has a
particularly nasty habit of seriously hurting unknowing students.

mobs.Name: warrior psionic
mobs.LongDescription: A warrior made of psionic energy is hanging around.
mobs.Description:
One of the more powerful projected entities that inhabit the practice 
hall of the school, the psionic warrior is one that is never practiced
by the students.  Such is the power of the warrior that usually masters
are the only psionicists with enough power and control to project these
fierce warriors.

mobs.Name: angel projection
mobs.LongDescription: You see what appears to be a psychic projection in the form of an angel.
mobs.Description:
The projected angel is the most powerful of the psionic projections.  
To date, only 3 of the attending psionic masters, Creston being one of
them have been able to project this truly powerful force.

mobs.Name: janitor Malki malki
mobs.LongDescription: A janitor is here sweeping the halls.
mobs.Description:
Malki the janitor has worked cleaning the halls of the school for many 
years.  Malki appears to be well into his 50's, he docent look like much
trouble to anyone.  He is wearing his trusty coveralls and is carrying 
a mop.

mobs.Name: servant
mobs.LongDescription: A servant of the school is hurrying about working.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the many servants who work at the school.  Whether their
duties are cleaning or running errands for the masters, the servants are
here to perform the chores that are too mundane for either the students
or the teachers to do.

mobs.Name: psionicist psi
mobs.LongDescription: A psionicist is here at the school for advanced studies.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the graduates of the psionicist school.  After much 
studying he was able to pass the test and become a full member of
the brotherhood of psionicists.  While more powerful than the students
studying at this school, he would not be able to stand up to the more
advanced skills of the Masters that teach here.

mobs.Name: servant
mobs.LongDescription: A servant of the school is completing her work.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the many servants who work at the school.  Whether their
duties are cleaning or cooking, the servants are here to perform the
chores that are too mundane for either the students or the teachers to
do.

mobs.Name: mage visit visiting dill Dill Dilligaf dilligaf
mobs.LongDescription: A mage is here to visit with his old friend Creston.
mobs.Description:
Dilligaf the mage is here to visit with his old friend Creston with 
whom he had grown up.  Where Creston chose to study psionics
Dilligaf chose to study the arcane ways of the wizards.  While his
knowledge and skills are totally different from that of the masters,
Dilligaf could still stand his own in fights against anyone in the 
school except Creston.

mobs.Name: poor mudder
mobs.LongDescription: A poor mudder, lost in this place.
mobs.Description: You will become her if you are not careful.

mobs.Name: star
mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful white star smiles at you.
mobs.Description: You can't tell what the star looks like, it is too bright!

mobs.Name: nebula young
mobs.LongDescription: A young nebula, waiting to become a star.
mobs.Description: It hasn't got a definite shape, it is just a cloud of mist.

mobs.Name: comet speedy
mobs.LongDescription: A speedy comet is waiting to crush your head in.
mobs.Description: You see the offspring of Halley's comet, here just to wipe everything out.

mobs.Name: red supergiant
mobs.LongDescription: An enormous, red supergiant is forced to protect the galaxy.
mobs.Description:
You notice the giant is not as tough as his name sounds ...
Still he can be very powerful.

mobs.Name: white dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A tiny white dwarf is trying to sneak away from duty.
mobs.Description:
Like the red giant, he is also appointed to stand guard for the galaxy.
But somehow he manages to escape.  Though tiny, it can take a lot of hits!

mobs.Name: horsehead nebula
mobs.LongDescription: A huge nebula is here, resembling a horsehead.
mobs.Description:
You can only make out its shape from the darkness.  He was cursed to stay in
here and his face may never be seen by anyone again.

mobs.Name: andromeda
mobs.LongDescription: The poor Andromeda is chained to the wall, suffering ...
mobs.Description:
She was once a princess of beauty.  However, her beauty has led to a Goddess's
jealousy and she has to suffer here endlessly until Perseus comes.

mobs.Name: hercules
mobs.LongDescription: The Mighty Hercules is working hard on his extra Labours for the Gods.
mobs.Description:
He has been put to do the Ten Labours -- ten impossible tasks, by Hera, the
queen goddess, who disliked him.  But he finished them all and at the end was
granted immortality. He is a very brave and strong fighter.

mobs.Name: pegasus
mobs.LongDescription: The wild pegasus is grazing peacefully.
mobs.Description: It is the legendary horse with wings on its back.

mobs.Name: orion
mobs.LongDescription: Orion is still hunting for Scorpio.
mobs.Description:
He is the legendary hunter who almost defeated Taurus the bull, but got killed
by Scorpio.  The gods put them both up as constellations but one appears on one
side of the sky and the other the other side so they will never meet.

mobs.Name: pleiades
mobs.LongDescription: The Pleiades are here, weeping for the loss of their sisters.
mobs.Description:
These are the seven sisters of the Myths, and as for why they are here, no
one knows; even the Gods themselves have forgotten.

mobs.Name: draco head
mobs.LongDescription: The gigantic Head of Draco lurks out from beneath and prepares to roast you.
mobs.Description:
This evil-looking head is even larger than a giant.  He is the last guardian 
before entering the inner galaxy.  His neck is flexing in a random fashion so 
hitting the head is certainly not easy.

mobs.Name: draco baby
mobs.LongDescription: A baby draco is crawling on the Draco's body.
mobs.Description:
You see a tiny creature which looks like a dragon except that its body
resembles a snake.  Gosh, is this a draco, you wonder, is this the thing
we are on now?

mobs.Name: aries
mobs.LongDescription: Aries is sitting here, welcoming you.
mobs.Description:
You see a white goat here, the first guardian of the Zodiac, also the ruler of
Spring. He looks as if he is expecting you.

mobs.Name: taurus
mobs.LongDescription: Taurus wants to leave, but has been forced to stay as a guardian here.
mobs.Description:
You see a wild-looking bull with a bad temper.  He is well-built and looks like
he can fight well ... indeed he has fought with Orion before and survived.

mobs.Name: gemini
mobs.LongDescription: Gemini is looking for his brother; have you seen him?
mobs.Description:
As soon as you see him you know that he is the most perfect man you have seen.
You can't find any imperfections on him.

mobs.Name: gemini
mobs.LongDescription: Gemini is hiding from his brother, grinning evilly at you.
mobs.Description:
As soon as you see him you see the most imperfect man you have ever seen.
How can there be such a contrast?  You wonder ...

mobs.Name: cancer
mobs.LongDescription: Cancer the crab is here, hoarding the treasure away from you.
mobs.Description:
You see a gigantic crab (YES, it is bigger than you!) with a crushed shell.
Legend is that he was crushed by Hercules when he was sent by Hera to kill him.
So Hera made Cancer a constellation for his work.

mobs.Name: leo
mobs.LongDescription: Leo the lion is roaring at you, ready for a strike!
mobs.Description:
His metallic skin means that he could be the one which was killed by Hercules
during his first Labour.  His skin is so weapon-proof that Hercules had to use
his bare hands to tear the lion into two from its mouth!

mobs.Name: virgo
mobs.LongDescription: Virgo is sitting here, winking at you suggestively ... you are alarmed!
mobs.Description:
From what you have seen, you now realize that legends are legends, and Virgo
may not be the maid of chastity and purity at all!  But still she looks
gorgeous and is waiting for your first move, whatever it is ...

mobs.Name: libra
mobs.LongDescription: Libra, the fair and just, is staring at you, weighing up the sins of your past.
mobs.Description:
He is a wise old man and can see people's thoughts through their eyes....
Now all he can see from you is greed and bloodshed.

mobs.Name: scorpio
mobs.LongDescription: Scorpio is moving his tail towards you, waiting to put an end to some mortals.
mobs.Description:
Ever since he killed Orion in the myths, he has been punished by having 
Sagittarius' arrow aimed at his heart forever.

mobs.Name: sagittarius centaur
mobs.LongDescription: Sagittarius the centaur is waiting to let go of his well aimed arrow ...
mobs.Description: He is a centaur and a well trained archer. No one can escape his arrows.

mobs.Name: capricorn
mobs.LongDescription: Capricorn is here, feeling bored ... he wants a fight!
mobs.Description:
You see a mean-looking ram here.  He used to be a fierce fighter in the ancient
war but now the gods have decided to put him here, to live out the rest of his 
days in peace.

mobs.Name: aquarius
mobs.LongDescription: The beautiful Aquarius is standing here, holding THE vessel.
mobs.Description:
The pretty Water Bearer is smiling at you, you think you'd better give her a 
hand with holding the vessel.

mobs.Name: pisces mermaid
mobs.LongDescription: Pisces the mermaid is sitting here, waiting for your help.
mobs.Description:
She has been forced to serve her husband, who had been cursed to turn into a
fish and she deserves your pity.

mobs.Name: pisces fish
mobs.LongDescription: Pisces the fish, is jealous of your approach...
mobs.Description:
He was once a very handsome man but now has turned into an ugly big fish.
So he becomes jealous of any living thing which is more handsome than him.

mobs.Name: bear ursa major
mobs.LongDescription: Ursa Major the bear is the last defense against any intruders.
mobs.Description:
The Huge Bear which resides in the northern skies is here. 
You think you'd better turn back.  At least you have got a chance of survival.

mobs.Name: cassiopeia queen
mobs.LongDescription: Cassiopeia, the queen of the Universe, is sitting on her throne.
mobs.Description: She is the Queen of Dignity; facing her you feel all your dignity has gone.

mobs.Name: cepheus king
mobs.LongDescription: Cepheus, the king of the Universe, is sitting on his throne.
mobs.Description:
He is the King of Might as well as of the Universe. You suddenly feel very
weak and useless in front of him.

mobs.Name: polaris polar star
mobs.LongDescription: Polaris, the polar star, who commands the whole Universe, stands before you!
mobs.Description:
He is the Master of the Universe, (NOT He-Man!), the most powerful!  
Even the King and the Queen obey him.  As you look at him you notice he is 
actually a STAR, with dazzling bright light ... maybe you shouldn't have come
here at all?

mobs.Name: fairy female
mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful female Fairy frolics in the flowers here.
mobs.Description:
The fairy is about 32 centimeters tall and as she notices you she
greets you with a smile.

mobs.Name: fairy male
mobs.LongDescription: A male fairy stands here looking for a mate.
mobs.Description:
He looks strong to you now since you are the same size as him. Probably quite
the adversary too.

mobs.Name: monk fairy
mobs.LongDescription: The Monk of Faerise is standing here, chanting a psalm.
mobs.Description: The Monk looks really wise and omnipotent. He doesn't seem to notice you.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 emote mumbles to himself.;%10 emote prays to the powers that be.

mobs.Name: puck sprite
mobs.LongDescription: Puck, the mischeivious sprite stands here looking for trouble.
mobs.Description:
Puck is Oberon's loyal servant. He notices you and smirks. Looks like he has
something in store for you!

mobs.Name: fairy evil
mobs.LongDescription: A hideous looking fairy glares at you and attacks.
mobs.Description:
She is the ugliest fairy you have ever seen. She definitely doesn't seem
to fit in well with the other fairies. Maybe she's an outcast.

mobs.Name: unicorn female
mobs.LongDescription: A female unicorn is here, comforting her mate.
mobs.Description: She is a beautiful creature, but there is a sadness about her.

mobs.Name: unicorn male
mobs.LongDescription: A male unicorn with his horn slashed off stands here weeping in pain.
mobs.Description:
Since his horn has been detached from his body, he looks like a magnificent
white stallion.

mobs.Name: bee bumble
mobs.LongDescription: A bumble bee is here gathering pollen.
mobs.Description: The Bumble Bee looks very angry that you have entered its territory.
mobs.ActionScript: %%25 emote buzzs loudly making your ears ring.

mobs.Name: girl gigantic young
mobs.LongDescription: A gigantic young girl is here, running around trying to catch fairies.
mobs.Description:
She towers above you. She suddenly looks your way, giggles and starts
swinging her net at you. Maybe you shouldn't have bothered her.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote hums happily, swinging her net.;%10 emote exclaims, 'My, you're an ugly fairy!'

mobs.Name: servant fairy woman
mobs.LongDescription: A servant of the king and queen fairies dusts happily here.
mobs.Description:
She looks like a very pleasant woman. She hums quietly as she works, seems
to like her job.

mobs.Name: titania queen fairy
mobs.LongDescription: Titania the beautiful queen of fairies sits here on her throne.
mobs.Description:
Titania is the most beautiful fairy you've ever laid eyes on. She smiles
sweetly at you.

mobs.Name: oberon king fairy
mobs.LongDescription: Oberon the handsome king of the fairies sits here admiring his queen.
mobs.Description:
Oberon looks very charming, his smile is broad and his body is built.
He seems very fond of the lovely lady sitting beside him.

mobs.Name: mage guildmaster
mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster stands here.
mobs.Description: An old man peering through ancient tomes rests here.

mobs.Name: cleric guildmaster
mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster stands here.
mobs.Description: An old man wrapped in purple, long-flowing robes meditates here.

mobs.Name: warrior guildmaster
mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster stands here.
mobs.Description: A small man dressed in black robes stands here, waiting to train you.

mobs.Name: thief guildmaster
mobs.LongDescription: Your guildmaster stands here.
mobs.Description:
A small human dressed in black rests in the corner. As you enter he grabs
a knife and throws it at you. It lands in the wall next to your left ear.
'We will now begin', is all he says.

mobs.Name: receptionist woman
mobs.LongDescription: A dark skinned, veiled woman greets you from behind the desk.
mobs.Description:
This arabian beauty is obviously the daughter of some high ranking official.
As you attempt to sneak a peek under her veil you notice a small moon-shaped
birth mark on her left cheek.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 twiddle; %10 daydream; %10 yawn

mobs.Name: bartender man mage old
mobs.LongDescription: An old withered man leans against the bar.
mobs.Description: He looks distracted as he pours five drinks at once without error.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 fart; %10 grumble

mobs.Name: john brother singer lead
mobs.LongDescription: Brother John, lead singer for the Lokettes stands on stage.
mobs.Description: You see the lead singer of the Lokettes lip synching to an old Zochan tune.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 hum; %10 wiggle; %10 sing

mobs.Name: panhandler
mobs.LongDescription: A panhandler rests here.
mobs.Description: A small skinny man rests here, hoping to find a warm heart.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 sigh

mobs.Name: panhandler
mobs.LongDescription: A panhandler rests here.
mobs.Description: A small skinny man rests here, staring at your clothes.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 sniff

mobs.Name: beggar
mobs.LongDescription: A grubby beggar sits here in the filth.
mobs.Description: This poor soul seems down on his luck, perhaps you might spare a dime?
mobs.ActionScript: %15 beg; %10 grovel

mobs.Name: baker
mobs.LongDescription: The baker stands here playing solitaire.
mobs.Description: You see a large man in a white apron covered in flour from head to toe.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper
mobs.LongDescription: The shopkeeper sits here.
mobs.Description: You see a half-elf sitting on a stool behind his counter.

mobs.Name: banker
mobs.LongDescription: A banker stands here waiting to help you.
mobs.Description: This small halfling seems adept at counting money.

mobs.Name: ahkeem tailor
mobs.LongDescription: Ahkeem the tailor welcomes you to his store.
mobs.Description:
This middle-aged man looks you over with disdain and quickly suggests a new
wardrobe.

mobs.Name: vera lady
mobs.LongDescription: Vera the veggie lady beems as you look over her stand.
mobs.Description: A tall slender woman stands before you, smiling broadly.

mobs.Name: butch
mobs.LongDescription: Butch the meatcutter stands here in his bloodied apron.
mobs.Description:
This stocky dwarf has a mad glint in hes eye, as he twirls his cleaver
carelessly into the air.

mobs.Name: abdul armorer
mobs.LongDescription: Abdul stands here, waiting to help you.
mobs.Description:
Abdul returns your gaze with a steady eye. You quickly glance away under his
cold stare and place your order.

mobs.Name: igor weaponsmith
mobs.LongDescription: Igor stands here doing... something.
mobs.Description: You see a small dwarf with a large hump on his left shoulder.

mobs.Name: cassandra
mobs.LongDescription: Cassandra stands proudly over her selection.
mobs.Description:
You see a happy weather-worn face whose lines suggests many years on the open
sea. It is only through years of fishing that she is able to withstand the 
smell that permeates the air.

mobs.Name: foreman man
mobs.LongDescription: The foreman stands here screaming at the workers.
mobs.Description:
A worried looking dwarf stands here, constantly making notes in his book and
looking at his watch.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 scratch; %15 pace

mobs.Name: construction worker
mobs.LongDescription: A construction worker steadily works here.
mobs.Description: A large sweaty looking man doesn't even return your glance.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 emote wipes off his sweaty brow with a handkerchief.; %10 grumble

mobs.Name: statue brahman
mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Brahman stands here.
mobs.Description:
The statue made of solid marble depicts the mighty god defeating Siva in
magical combat.

mobs.Name: statue siva
mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Siva stands here.
mobs.Description:
The statue of the High Lord of Destruction stands here, being attacked by
Brahman in magical combat.

mobs.Name: statue indra
mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Indra stands here.
mobs.Description: This statue looks like an enormous elephant.

mobs.Name: statue yama
mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Yama stands here.
mobs.Description: This is a statue of the God of Death. It is covered with odd runes.

mobs.Name: statue surya
mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Surya stands here.
mobs.Description:
The statue of Surya, the God in charge of the Sun, almost glows with a
fiery aura.

mobs.Name: statue kali
mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Kali stands here.
mobs.Description:
The statue of the Black Mother Kali is made of black marble and is covered
with silver runes.

mobs.Name: statue brihaspati
mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Brihaspati stands here.
mobs.Description:
The statue of Brihaspati, the God of Scholars and Knowledge is made of a
weathered marble.

mobs.Name: statue puchan
mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Puchan stands here.
mobs.Description:
The statue of Puchan, God of Travellers, is covered with dust and worn as if
it had been dragged a long way down a dusty road.

mobs.Name: aziz human canon
mobs.LongDescription: Aziz the Human Canon stands here.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 pose; %10 gaze

mobs.Name: mustafah human robber
mobs.LongDescription: Mustafah the Human Robber stands here.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 snicker; %10 emote greedily counts some money.

mobs.Name: fatima elf invoker
mobs.LongDescription: Fatima the Elven Invoker stands here.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 blink ; %10 twiddle ; %10 pose

mobs.Name: kareem dwarf mercenary
mobs.LongDescription: Kareem the Dwarven Mercenary stands here.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 flex; %10 grin

mobs.Name: nomad merchant
mobs.LongDescription: A nomad merchant looks you over.
mobs.Description:
This robust fellow returns your gaze with a smile, but something inside you
tells you not to trust him very far.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 smirk; %15 say You wanna buy? Spezzial prize for you, mizzter!

mobs.Name: bodyguard guard
mobs.LongDescription: A bodyguard sizes you up.
mobs.Description: This large half-orc quickly glances you over and returns to his duties.
mobs.ActionScript: %5 growl

mobs.Name: kid thief
mobs.LongDescription: A skinny kid wanders around.
mobs.Description: This small child sees you looking at him and quickly looks away.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 apologize

mobs.Name: dockworker
mobs.LongDescription: A strong dockworker walks by moving crates.
mobs.Description:
Although seemingly dull witted, this hulking mass carries the huge crates
from the boats like it was a box of lilies.
mobs.ActionScript: %5 spit; %5 burp; %5 fart; %5 swear

mobs.Name: man taxcollector
mobs.LongDescription: A small man walks around scribbling in a notebook.
mobs.Description:
The city's taxcollector walks from store to store, collecting the Sultan's
fee for living in his grand city.
mobs.ActionScript:
%10 snicker; 
%15 emote looks you over with a penetrating and somewhat greedy look.

mobs.Name: gord
mobs.LongDescription: Gord the Rogue stands here.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 chuckle

mobs.Name: chulainn knight
mobs.LongDescription: Chulainn the Knight stands here.
mobs.Description:
This large man does not seem to be surprised at your approach and looks at you
quizzically.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 ponder

mobs.Name: daghdha
mobs.LongDescription: Daghdha the Arch-Magi stands here.
mobs.Description: This man is dressed in long brown robes and has a penetrating gaze.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 emote pulls a burning cigarette out of his ear with a grin.; %10 pose

mobs.Name: curley greenleaf
mobs.LongDescription: Curley GreenLeaf stands here.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 think

mobs.Name: man wandering prophet
mobs.LongDescription: A small grey-haired man walks around spouting gospel.
mobs.Description:
This sad case may have been an evangelist in another lifetime. He is known to
stand in corners and accost passers-by with his doomsday preaching.

mobs.Name: alley cat
mobs.LongDescription: A small harmless feline searches for food.
mobs.Description: You see a small starved cat.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 purr; %10 lick; %10 stretch

mobs.Name: vulture
mobs.LongDescription: A vulture circles above you.
mobs.Description: As you look up at this bird, you see that the only thing it wants is a corpse.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 gibber; %5 fps

mobs.Name: old man
mobs.LongDescription: An old man sits here playing chess.
mobs.Description: He seems intent on winning.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 ponder; %10 scratch; %5 stare

mobs.Name: lugh librarian
mobs.LongDescription: Lugh the Librarian sits behind a desk.
mobs.Description: This huge hulking mass rises, as someone asks him a question.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 peer

mobs.Name: dust devil
mobs.LongDescription: The wind kicks up some dust.
mobs.Description: What you see before you is really a baby air elemental.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 growl

mobs.Name: lamia beast
mobs.LongDescription: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
mobs.Description:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beatiful woman, but the lower
body of a four-legged beast. She licks her lips as she looks at you greedily.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 lick

mobs.Name: dervish
mobs.LongDescription: A raggety dervish stands here.
mobs.Description: This man looks like he could use a lot of rest.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 dizzy

mobs.Name: sultan
mobs.LongDescription: The Sultan rests here on his throne.
mobs.Description: You see a large wealthy man in red robes smiling at you.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 smile; %10 yawn

mobs.Name: harem girl
mobs.LongDescription: A lovely, veiled harem girl stands here.
mobs.Description:
You see a dark skinned beauty, wearing almost transparent silks and a light
blue veil. Her loyalty to the Sultan is unwavering.
mobs.ActionScript: %7 giggle

mobs.Name: jailer
mobs.LongDescription: The Jailer is resting here.
mobs.Description:
You see a pathetic soul resting here. Probably some ex-nobleman that has
fallen out of grace with the Sultan.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 hiccup; %10 snort

mobs.Name: eunuch
mobs.LongDescription: A eunuch stands here watching over the girls.
mobs.Description:
You see a large man whose only duty is to protect the harem. He has been
castrated for the ladies' safety.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 glare

mobs.Name: sultans favorite girl nichole
mobs.LongDescription: Nichole, the Sultan's favorite girl rests on a mound of pillows.
mobs.Description:
You see the most beautiful Arabian girl that has ever met your eyes. Too bad
she is about to kill you.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 smirk

mobs.Name: krishna statue
mobs.LongDescription: The statue of Krishna is standing here.
mobs.Description:
This is a statue of the God Vishnu's most radiant incarnation,
the heroic Krishna.

mobs.Name: mage guildguard
mobs.LongDescription: The Guard for the Guild of Mages stand here.
mobs.Description: This man looks like a mage/warrior. I wouldn't mess with him.

mobs.Name: cleric guildguard
mobs.LongDescription: The Guard for the Guild of Clerics stands here.
mobs.Description: This man looks like a cleric/warrior. I wouldn't mess with him.

mobs.Name: warrior guildguard
mobs.LongDescription: The Guard for the Guild of Warriors stands here.
mobs.Description: This man looks like Conan's cousin. I wouldn't mess with him.

mobs.Name: thief guildguard
mobs.LongDescription: The Guard for the Guild of theives stands here.
mobs.Description:
You see a thief dressed all in black. He quickly stands as you enter and
steps to bar your way. You notice his hands resting on two sheathes.

mobs.Name: servant boy
mobs.LongDescription: A servant boy is here running errands.
mobs.Description: You see a small boy running around in the halls of the palace.

mobs.Name: sultans guard
mobs.LongDescription: A guard stands here, protecting the innocent.
mobs.Description: You see a trained fighter, ready to help those in need.
mobs.ActionScript: %5 say Move on, people!

mobs.Name: sultans guard
mobs.LongDescription: A guard stands here, watching the gate.
mobs.Description: You see a trained fighter, ready to defend the city.

mobs.Name: sultans guard chief
mobs.LongDescription: The Chief of the Sultan's Guard stands here.
mobs.Description: You see a large man skilled in hunting and killing.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 pose; %10 bully

mobs.Name: mercenary
mobs.LongDescription: A mercenary stands here waiting for a job.
mobs.Description: You see an assassin down on his luck, looking to be freelanced out.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 peer; %10 fps

mobs.Name: shipwright captain
mobs.LongDescription: An old captain rests here carving on a stick.
mobs.Description:
You see the shipwright of New Thalos, waiting to sell someone a boat. He beams
a smile at you through his beard, as you walk in.

mobs.Name: blacksmith
mobs.LongDescription: The blacksmith stands here pumping air into his fire.
mobs.Description:
You see a large human,  dripping in sweat, standing before you. He takes
a break from his swealtering work to bid you welcome.

mobs.Name: horse
mobs.LongDescription: A horse stands here.
mobs.Description: You see one of the fine Arabian beasts known about the land.
mobs.ActionScript: %5 raspberry

mobs.Name: tourist
mobs.LongDescription: A tourist stands here looking lost.
mobs.Description:
You see a small rotund man with a strange object around his neck and a nose
guard. He is looking at a small map that he seems to be holding upside down.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 point; %10 gibber

mobs.Name: ixitxachitl ray
mobs.LongDescription: A very large ray with a wicked looking tail swims here.
mobs.Description: You see a large ray with sharp fangs and a barbed tail.

mobs.Name: cryohydra
mobs.LongDescription: The cryohydra stands here.
mobs.Description: A grey-brown reptilian creature with amber eyes stands before you.

mobs.Name: minotaur lizard
mobs.LongDescription: The minotaur lizard stands here.
mobs.Description: A huge lizard-like reptile with horns like a minotaur.

mobs.Name: dog death
mobs.LongDescription: The death dog stands here.
mobs.Description: A large two-headed hound barks at you vicously.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 bark

mobs.Name: lion spotted
mobs.LongDescription: The spotted lion stands here.
mobs.Description: A large fierce dapple-skinned lion glares at you.
mobs.ActionScript: %15 growl

mobs.Name: behir
mobs.LongDescription: A behir slithers on the ground.
mobs.Description: You see a large snake-like reptile with more than a dozen legs.

mobs.Name: chimera creature lion goat dragon
mobs.LongDescription: A creature with three heads: lion, goat, and dragon stands here.
mobs.Description:
The chimera is still a mystery, better left unexplored. This creature has
the hindquarters of a goat, the forepaws of a lion and the body of a red
dragon.

mobs.Name: couatl
mobs.LongDescription: A couatl hovers here.
mobs.Description:
A beautiful creature with the body of a serpent and feathered wings, the
colour of the rainbow.

mobs.Name: giant hornet
mobs.LongDescription: The giant hornet hovers here.
mobs.Description: It is a hornet, what else can be said?
mobs.ActionScript: %15 emote hops around, buzzing hysterically.

mobs.Name: pegasus
mobs.LongDescription: The pegasus stands here, flexing its wings.
mobs.Description:
A magnificent winged steed, this horse looks much like the arabian thorough-
breds you have seen in stables.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 blink

mobs.Name: elvira
mobs.LongDescription: Elvira stands here mixing a love potion.
mobs.Description:
You see a very healthy female dressed in black, with long flowing hair to
match her outfit.

mobs.Name: braheem
mobs.LongDescription: Braheem stands here talking to the walls.
mobs.Description: You see a powerful but slightly insane mage.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 gibber

mobs.Name: high priest
mobs.LongDescription: The high priest rests here meditating, well he WAS meditating.
mobs.Description: He does NOT look real happy about you disturbing him.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 pose

mobs.Name: royal guard elite
mobs.LongDescription: An Elite Royal Guard stands here smiling happily.
mobs.Description:
You see one of the Royal Guards of New Thalos who seems to have undergone
some heavy training.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 flex

mobs.Name: patch bartender
mobs.LongDescription: A large half-orc with a patch over one eye pours beer behind the counter.
mobs.Description:
You see a really big guy here, who seems to have lost an eye in one manner
or another.

mobs.Name: stitch
mobs.LongDescription: Stitch, the leather dude reclines in his chair.
mobs.Description:
You see a small hobbit with his feet kicked up on his desk, waiting for some
sucker, uhm customer to walk into his store.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 snore

mobs.Name: gardener elf
mobs.LongDescription: A small elf stands here tending the garden.
mobs.Description:
A young elf stands here in dirt-covered overalls. He seems to be weeding his
garden.

mobs.Name: nightmare demon horse
mobs.LongDescription: A large horse, black as night, stands here.
mobs.Description:
You see the largest horse you have ever seen before. Standing 10 feet at the
shoulders, it breathes flames from his nostrils and leaps to attack you.

mobs.Name: wolverine wolf
mobs.LongDescription: A large wolf-like creature leaps out from the darkness.
mobs.Description: You see a powerful-looking beast with sharp fangs and huge claws.

mobs.Name: mimic painting
mobs.LongDescription: You see an incredibly life-like painting of the Sultan's mother.
mobs.Description: Boy is she ugly.

mobs.Name: mayor rabbit
mobs.LongDescription: The Mayor of New Thalos stands here.
mobs.Description: You see a chubby rabbit dressed in his best suit.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 chuckle; %10 chortle; %10 say What a beautiful day!

mobs.Name: chef
mobs.LongDescription: The chef stands here making dinner.
mobs.Description: You see a very large human who seems to taste everything he makes.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 burp; %10 gloat

mobs.Name: evil beggar
mobs.LongDescription: A beggar stands here, asking for gold.
mobs.Description:
The beggar looks oddly familiar... you note that he is wearing the
faded colors of a master assassin.
mobs.ActionScript: 10% chuckle; 10% cackle; 10% sigh; 10% say I am Evil!

mobs.Name: bouncy ferret male m500
mobs.LongDescription: The bouncy male ferret races through the grasses.
mobs.Description:
This small bundle of fur loves racing through the high grasses.
Although small, he is fierce and can easily kill animals several times
his size.  He is sly and quick, and not an animal you want to harass!
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 sneeze

mobs.Name: general Roman procession leader m501
mobs.LongDescription: The Roman general follows his triumphal procession into Rome.
mobs.Description:
Wearing the laurel wreath of the successful Roman general, Fobos
Maximilius follows his successful army back to Rome.  They bring with
them treasures from the mighty civilizations and barbaric tribes they
have conquered.  The general ponders the effect his triumph may have on
his political career.  Perhaps he should stage a coup.
mobs.ActionScript: %%3 hop

mobs.Name: albino female ferret snow white m503
mobs.LongDescription: The pure white ferret is too busy playing ferret games to notice you.
mobs.Description:
Often just a streak of white, racing up a tree or across the road in
front of you (startling the horses), this ferret spends her days
frolicking in the grass.  She is so beautiful, so soft and sleek, that
she is frequently fed by passersby.  She is an animal worthy of being a
pet to an emperor.

mobs.Name: centurion Roman soldier leader m504
mobs.LongDescription: The Roman centurion commands his 100 soldiers with a will of iron.
mobs.Description:
Wearing a bronze helmet topped with bright red feathers, the Roman
centurion struts at the head of his 100 man command.  The Roman army
was, as always, successful, and the centurion is mentally spending the
bonus he will receive.  He is a tall man, well favored, with a long
straight nose.  His skin is well-tanned and firm, though it bears many
scars.

mobs.Name: warrior Roman returning m506
mobs.LongDescription: The young Roman warrior struts along proudly with his comrades in arms.
mobs.Description:
Finished with his first campaign, the young warrior feels he has
acquitted himself with honor.  He has carefully guarded his salarium,
his ration of salt, and he will bring that back to his family.

mobs.Name: slave captive gallic Gaul m508
mobs.LongDescription: The Gallic captive, now a slave to the Romans, glares haughtily at you.
mobs.Description:
He was a great and fierce fighter, but he was captured and now will be
a great and proud slave.  His body still retains the remnants of blue
paint, which evidently was not enough to frighten off the Roman armies.
His amulet of herbs and unmentionables, worn about his neck, were also
not enough to protect him from capture.

mobs.Name: fairy floating m509
mobs.LongDescription: Lightly floating on a breeze, the fairy flies north to see Titania.
mobs.Description:
The delicate fairy, dressed in gossamer thin fabric, is enjoying the
feel of the light breeze on his skin.  His delicate pale features and
light boned body make him appear frail, but his magic makes him
fearsomely strong.

mobs.Name: orc black huge captive prisoner m510
mobs.LongDescription: The huge Black Orc shuffles along, a captive of war in chains.
mobs.Description:
During a trip through the Morian caves, in search of the fabled
treasures of the ancient elven city of Illir, the Roman army decimated
the population of Orcs, deeming them too stupid to bother to bring
back.  They did spare a few, just for the curiosity sake.

mobs.Name: elf woodelf wood m512
mobs.LongDescription: The little wood elf is heading off for a lark in Tynstri to the east.
mobs.Description:
The merry little elf has skin the color of oak bark on a warm summer
afternoon.  He is off to visit some distant cousins, who live in the
woods northeast of Tynstri.  With his dark green tunic he easily blends
into the woods surrounding the road.  He slips into the woods, hiding
when the path becomes busy.

mobs.Name: rabbit longears mr jackrabbit m513
mobs.LongDescription: Mr. Longears is off to visit his jackrabbit friends in the forest.
mobs.Description:
Mr. Longears is a very large rabbit, with long, strong hind legs and
feet and ears that stretch high above his head.  As he hops along, his
legs pound the earth with a heavy thud, and he practically flies
through the grass.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 hop;%5 em wiggles his rabbit nose, sniffing the air

mobs.Name: burnt umber ghost dragon m514
mobs.LongDescription: The huge burnt umber ghost was once a graceful dragon.
mobs.Description:
Why should ghosts always be a foggy white?  That's what this (former)
dragon thought.  She loved beautiful jewels while still alive, and this
is about the best she can do now that she is a dragon ghost.  Robbed of
her strength by death, she can still be a formidable opponent.

mobs.Name: barbarian evil slave m515
mobs.LongDescription: The evil barbarian is led in chains past you, a prize of war.
mobs.Description:
A tall human ... perhaps all of 6.5' (about 2m.) ... with heavy bone
structure and well defined musculature, the captive will undoubtedly
sell for a high price at the slave market.  His unshaven chin juts out
with pride, and his shoulders remain square, his back straight.  He is
aware of his worth and uncowed by his status.

mobs.Name: warrior elephant roman m516
mobs.LongDescription: Huge elephants brought back from a foreign campaign pound along.
mobs.Description:
The pachyderm packs a whallop with his trunk, although he has not been
used for fighting.  Originally brought over from Africa by Hannibal,
who wanted to "surprise" the Romans one winter, these Romans are
delighted to bring them back as a prize to Rome.  They can carry
literally tons of treasure brought back from the wars.

mobs.Name: hedgehog little m517
mobs.LongDescription: The little hedgehog has rolled up into a spiny ball.
mobs.Description:
The little hedgehog wishes to be left alone to sleep (if the sun is
shining) or roam around and rid the earth of worms, beetles and slugs,
surely a noble occupation!  This one is aware of your interest, and has
rolled himself into a little ball of sharp spines that say, "Don't
touch!"

mobs.Name: sleepy bat hanging m518
mobs.LongDescription: The sleepy bat is hanging from the tree branch, hoping he's invisible.
mobs.Description:
This bat tends to think of the Romans as a race of vampires.  He and
his brethren, a small band of fruit bats, are killed by the romans and
the bodies drained of blood.  The blood is sold to the Roman shops
which help keep the citizens beautiful.

mobs.Name: gnome gnomish scientist psci psi pscientist m519
mobs.LongDescription: The #ggnomish#Y pscientist checks you carefully for signs of dragoness.
mobs.Description:
He has heard rumors that sometimes dragons masquerade as other life
forms, and he is hot on the trail of some field research on the
subject.
Obviously, he has ignored the effect the dragons' hot breath might have
on his slightly hairy pointed ears.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 pose

mobs.Name: ratman roman warrior soldier ratsoldier m520
mobs.LongDescription: The Ratman Ratsoldier looks fierce despite his long twitching tail.
mobs.Description:
As long as you are a land owning citizen, you may sign up for a 20 year
stretch in the Roman army.  Although it is a hard life (especially for
a rat), the promise of glory and a regular salary are hard to resist.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 pose

mobs.Name: elf ranger m521
mobs.LongDescription: The elf ranger watches you warily.
mobs.Description:
The elf is new to his ranger job, and he takes it quite seriously.  He
is worried about the tramping of the Roman soldiers through this woods,
although as yet they have not discovered the path to the deep forest.
He fears he will soon have to do battle with them.

mobs.Name: elf scout m522
mobs.LongDescription: The elf scout looks for signs of danger approaching Tynstri.
mobs.Description:
This small woodland elf is training hard, hoping one day to become a
mighty ranger.  Her hair is a deep green and quite short.  She is tiny,
but wiry, and her dusky brown skin helps her blend in.  She is ever
watchful for danger, although she is unsure what form it will take.
Could those enormous footprints, for example, be from some large
elf-predator?
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 peer;%5 scout

mobs.Name: Peter Rabbit m523
mobs.LongDescription: Peter looks about curiously, wondering where the elves grow cabbages.
mobs.Description:
A bit away from his original home, nevertheless Peter Rabbit still
loves carrots and cabbages, and the elves have a hard time keeping him
away
from their greens.  He is often to be seen hopping through the woods in
his blue waistcoat.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 hop

mobs.Name: Benjamin Bunny m524
mobs.LongDescription: Benjamin is a handsome little rabbit with white fur and pink ears.
mobs.Description:
Benjamin often accompanies Peter on adventures in the forest.  Today
they are finding many little tricks to play on the elves.  Together
they can pound their hind feet into deep depressions in the earth, so
watchful elves believe there are LARGE MONSTERS in their forest!
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 hop

mobs.Name: cat striped skunk m525
mobs.LongDescription: The black cat has a strange white stripe down his back.
mobs.Description:
Pepe LePew would love this little stinker.  The skunk is busy digging
through forest debris looking for good things to eat.  She is solid
black with a bright white stripe starting at her head and extending
through her tail.  She may be small, but she has a secret weapon that
forces even very large predators to back away.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 sniff

mobs.Name: Pepe LePew skunk m526
mobs.LongDescription: This skunk ain't no stinker.  He's a lover!
mobs.Description:
Pepe is so busy looking for the skunk of his dreams that he may not
notice you.  Be sure not to frighten him, because the results would be
... alarming!

mobs.Name: Mrs T Tiggywinkle Hedgehog m527
mobs.LongDescription: Mrs Tiggywinkle is full of grandmotherly advice for you.
mobs.Description:
Mrs T has tiny pink feet and a soft black nose.  Her back is covered
with long sharp spikes, and she is apt to roll up into a ball of spikes
when she is frightened.  Her belly is covered with soft white fur.
Mrs. T is very small, but very well armored.

mobs.Name: duck jemima puddle puddle-duck m528
mobs.LongDescription: Jemima Puddle-Duck waddles happily through forest streams and ponds.
mobs.Description:
That's what ducks do best, after all!  Swimming in the little lakes and
ponds is something Jemima learned to do very early in life, and she is
quite good at it.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 kvack

mobs.Name: fairy apprentice mage m529
mobs.LongDescription: A young fairy holds tightly to a short stick that seems to glow.
mobs.Description:
The fairy is out exploring the woods for the first time, experimenting
with a wand he discovered in a workshop.  A very tiny mage with
gossamer wings that beat rapidly, his magic makes him more powerful than
a human
many times his size.

mobs.Name: gnome old cloth merchant m530
mobs.LongDescription: The old gnome leads a donkey laden with bolts of wool.
mobs.Description:
Bringing heavy bolts of wool woven from Stanneg sheep, the cloth
merchant hopes to trade for some fairy cloth, should he be lucky enough
to discover the fairy home.

mobs.Name: tinker m531
mobs.LongDescription: The tinker easily carries his huge pack on his massive back.
mobs.Description:
"Wandering from village to village, that's the life for me!"  A man of
enormous strength and cleverness, the tinker carries the tools of his
trade on his back.  Quick to fix, that's the tinker.

mobs.Name: druid captive m532
mobs.LongDescription: In his earth colored robes, the druid walks in harmony with the forest.
mobs.Description:
Captured in Gaul, the Romans noted the druid's remarkable healing
abilities.  He will undoubtedly become the physician for some patrician
unable to afford a Greek slave.  He is tall, lean and pale, with long
brown hair tied neatly at his neck with a leather thong.

mobs.Name: mouse m533
mobs.LongDescription: The frightened mouse scurries off to hide from you.
mobs.Description:
Long black whiskers twitching as he glares at you from his beady little
mouse eyes, the mouse is panicking, attempting to flee ... from YOU!
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 em twitches nervously.;%2 twitch;%2em 's whiskers tremble violently.

mobs.Name: fox sly red m534
mobs.LongDescription: The sly red fox curls up in the shade, tail tucked neatly around him.
mobs.Description:
The fox may be the picture of innocence and foxy beauty where he lies
beneath the tree, but he is a very clever fellow.  Hiding his razor
sharp teeth in an appearance of sleep is just one of his many tricks.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 snore

mobs.Name: gnome picnic boy m535
mobs.LongDescription: The boy gnome carries the heavy basket, looking for a good picnic spot.
mobs.Description:
The boy gnome wonders what his Midgaardian girl friend could possibly
have packed in the basket, it is so heavy.  It feels like rocks!  The
little gnome hopes they will find a nice place for a picnic very soon!
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile girl

mobs.Name: girl picnic m536
mobs.LongDescription: The Midgaard girl warily fingers her dagger as she looks about her.
mobs.Description:
She has never seen so many trees in her life.  They have a presence of
their own - a "beingness", and she is unsure whether it is benign or
evil.  She leans a bit closer to her gnome and wonders if she should
help with the heavy basket.  She has packed some rocks to hold down the
blanket.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 flirt boy

mobs.Name: changeling baby m537
mobs.LongDescription: Apparently someone has abandoned a sweet little baby.
mobs.Description:
But Beware!  This softly crying babe is a changeling.  He will become a
small demon with a raging temper when disturbed.
mobs.ActionScript: %%3 cry

mobs.Name: girl red riding hood ridinghood m538
mobs.LongDescription: The little girl in a bright red hooded cape carries a heavy basket.
mobs.Description:
Two long dark pigtails trail out from under the cherry red hood that
keeps the child's head warm.  Bright blue eyes and an eager smile give
her a very elfin charm, although she is undoubtedly human.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 say do you know the way to Grandmother's house?;%1 say Have you seen
my pet wolf?

mobs.Name: owl m539
mobs.LongDescription: The horny owl eyes the mice hungrily.
mobs.Description:
You are glad it's the mice and not you that those big golden eyes are
staring at!  The sharp beak and long talons look like they could do a
lot of damage.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 yell C'mere little mousey!  I have a nice surprise for you!

mobs.Name: sparrow m540
mobs.LongDescription: The gray-brown sparrow is looking for yummy worms and seeds.
mobs.Description:
The tiny bird hops along in the short grass looking for good things to
eat.  It has a small, sharp beak and short, delicate claws, and doesn't
look like it could hurt anything bigger than a worm.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em chirps cheerfully.;%2 emote pecks away at the dirt, trying to
unearth a worm.

mobs.Name: worm red m541
mobs.LongDescription: The long, glistening red worm looks like bird food.
mobs.Description:
He took a wrong turn in one of the many tunnels underground and now,
alas, he is destined to be breakfast for some sparrow or bait for some
fish.  He is your garden variety long red worm, not too bright.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 emote heads down into the dirt and knocks himself out on a rock.

mobs.Name: slug m542
mobs.LongDescription: The slug slimes his way along the underside of a leaf.
mobs.Description:
Carrying a little house around with him is a lot of work.  The slug
munches the tender leaves of young plants and wonders how long til he
has to build something a little larger.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 emote slimes along happily.

mobs.Name: sly pinworm m543
mobs.LongDescription: #r"DESTRUCTION FROM WITHIN!!" shouts the lowly pinworm.#N
mobs.Description:
The sly pinworm is waiting for his chance to work his way into your
body and cause massive destruction! ... or at least some itching,
discomfort, and massive barfiness.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 say C'mon, baby! Let me worm my way into your heart!

mobs.Name: halfling roman soldier m544
mobs.LongDescription: The halfling looks small, but his heart is as brave as any Roman's.
mobs.Description:
This halfling is small and far from the land of his grandparent's birth,
but he is a Roman citizen-soldier and very proud of it.  His parents,
captured in a raid, were able to buy their freedom from their small
tobacco shop.

mobs.Name: gnome roman soldier m544
mobs.LongDescription: The gnomish soldier is in charge of building roads across ravines.
mobs.Description:
This gnome was something of a washout in terms of carrying around 3 days
worth of equipment on his back, but he is a positive genius when it
comes to building bridges and designing campsites.  He is small and
getting a trifle old for the life of a soldier.

mobs.Name: fanatic religious ranger E
mobs.LongDescription: #RThe religious ranger yells, "Repent or be swallowed by the whale!"#N
mobs.Description:
Disheveled and wild-eyed, this ranger looks a bit like he's come out
the worse from an encounter with one of the wild pigs that roam the
forests.  He is quite clear in speech, however, and very strong in his
beliefs.  Normally, he will waste no time assisting you to see the
Right Path, however today his focus appears to be a certain demon and
his freak show.  There is a slight streak of dirt through his blue
#bElysium#N Emblem of Heroism.

mobs.Name: elf Elfking mighty E
mobs.LongDescription: The Mighty Elfking dispenses justice with a shining hammer.
mobs.Description:
Cape billowing behind him, the mighty avatar Elfking strides through
the faire, swinging his hammer threateningly at those who would
misbehave.  He dispenses a rigid justice where it is needed.  Easily
spotted by his well polished shiny gold armor, his beautifully made
elven white gold crown, his mighty Hammer of Justice and the huge
superhero cape floating behind him, the Elfking is revered by all,
elves and non-elves alike.
mobs.ActionScript: %%80 ass E;%3 smile elfwench;%3 cuddle elfwench

mobs.Name: curly elven ranger E
mobs.LongDescription: The curly headed elven ranger looks sternly at her pet purple dragon.
mobs.Description:
"Did you start that fire?", she asks Anastasia.  Anastasia averts her
eyes, her color changing from deep purple to bright fuschia.  The
ranger priestess has the huge job of overseeing the reforestation of 
#bElysium#N after the recent wars.  There are many rangers hard at work, 
but some (like her pet dragon) often seem to be more often a problem 
than they are a help.

mobs.Name: black wolf noble knightly werewolf E
mobs.LongDescription: The noble midnight black wolf appears almost knightly.
mobs.Description:
There is a certain nobility to this black wolf who appears and
disappears without warning, silenty on soft padded feet.  If you look
closely, you will see the #bElysium#N insignia on his chest.

mobs.Name: royal bodyguard
mobs.LongDescription: The royal bodyguard searches anxiously for the princess.
mobs.Description:
Angry that she has once again managed to slip away from his protection,
the princess's bodyguard is also terrified to face the wrath of the
Elfking.  Don't be surprised if he stops you to ask about her.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%2say Hey! Have you seen Her Royal Highness, Princess Buttercup?;
%2say Tsk! Tsk! That naughty princess!

mobs.Name: princess elf E
mobs.LongDescription: Disguised as a peasant, the princess clutches her buttercups.
mobs.Description:
An elven princess finds it's wise sometimes to "disappear" from her
bodyguards.  She wanders the faire in a peasant dress, embroidered with
buttercups, looking a little too clean to be a real peasant.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E

mobs.Name: knight bowing honor E
mobs.LongDescription: A man of honor who follows THE code, the knight bows as he passes.
mobs.Description:
Tall and powerful as he is, the first thing that strikes you about this
knight is his sense of honor.  You sense that for this knight, his
heart knows only virtue, his blade defends the helpless, his might
upholds the weak, his word speaks only truth and his #rwrath#N undoes
the wicked ... he is a Knight sworn to valour!  (an #bElysium#N Knight,
of course!)
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E

mobs.Name: magician deft E
mobs.LongDescription: The deft magician amazes you with feats of prestidigitation!
mobs.Description:
Strikingly handsome blue eyes set off by pale blond hair hint at the
immortal ancestry of this magician, although the slight points of his
ears indicate some elven blood as well.  Truly god-like in appearance,
he is also amazingly talented at his craft.  His long, strong, flexible
fingers are no doubt part of the reason for this.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E

mobs.Name: elfwench wife
mobs.LongDescription: Laughing, the elfwench looks around for her Elfking.
mobs.Description:
She laughs entirely too often to be pure elf, and is not at all likely
to take life seriously.  In love with color, she has streaked her pale
blond hair with a rainbow, and plaited it into bands around her head.
When she turns her head, you catch a glimpse of a row of brightly 
colored jewels along the rim of one ear.  She is devoted to her Elfking 
and can usually be found in his company.
mobs.ActionScript: %%95 ass E;%5 flirt Elfking;%5 wiggle elfking

mobs.Name: red cheeked red-cheeked rosy troll ranger
mobs.LongDescription: The leader of the trollish rangers is a rosy cheeked lass.
mobs.Description:
Eager to protect and cherish her forest as she has been (painstakingly)
taught, the ranger is busy digging new caves for homeless bears.  To
instantly replace the trees that are gone, she's directing some of the
other trolls to stand with arms outstretched and pretend they are
trees.  So far, none of the birds have been fooled into landing on an
arm or a head.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%95 ass E;
%3em worries about all the little critters burned out of their homes.

mobs.Name: bigbird bird big enormous bright yellow
mobs.LongDescription: The bright yellow bird towers over you, looking worried.
mobs.Description:
This bird must be at least 7' (over 2 metres) tall.  His long fluffy
yellow wings end in hand-like appendages, each with an opposable thumb.
His long thick round legs are bright orange with horizontal red
stripes.  As you crane your head to look up you see he looks out at you
from soft, sad, deep blue eyes, and you long to set him free.  You are
a bit worried by his large orange beak, however.  He could probably do
quite a bit of damage with that should he become angered.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 pace;%2 frown

mobs.Name: peasant girl pretty
mobs.LongDescription: The pretty peasant girl came from a nearby farm to see the faire.
mobs.Description:
Much more exciting than market day!  The girl lost many of her family
and village to the dreadful forces of evil.  She was saved by the great
warriors of #bElysium#N, and has come to celebrate the victory and to
see the treasures brought here from lands far away.

mobs.Name: troll ranger powerful
mobs.LongDescription: The powerful troll ranger accidentally uproots a mighty oak.
mobs.Description:
Sometimes the troll rangers are more of a problem than they are a help.
Asked to cull the sick and dying trees, they are as likely to pull the
large healthy trees as the ones that are frail.  They are very very
strong, however, and eager to defend the forest against its many
predators.  They just aren't too sure what to do!
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 say C'mere little birdie!

mobs.Name: elf ranger elven
mobs.LongDescription: The elven ranger studies the damaged tree thoughtfully.
mobs.Description:
The elves feel a special kinship with this forest.  It is their natural
home, and they are closely attuned to its special vibrations.  Many
choose to live their lives in close harmony with a special grove.
Others become rangers, roaming the forest ceaselessly.
mobs.ActionScript: %%3 em sings a soft enchantment, encouraging the flowers to bloom.

mobs.Name: cleaner dwarf trash collector janitor
mobs.LongDescription: The #Rdwarven#Y cleaner follows behind the faire goers, cleaning up.
mobs.Description:
Small, powerful, with long hairy arms and a rather dense expression,
the dwarf is cleaning up trash and looking for treasures as he does so.
Sometimes people toss things that he can use.  He is quite poor.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5em stumbles into you, mumbling, 'scuse me'.;%5 says Make way!

mobs.Name: tall lad peasant ribbon seller vendor shopkeeper
mobs.LongDescription: A tall peasant lad walks about shouting, "Ribbons! Get your ribbons!"
mobs.Description:
The tall peasant lad is carrying a large display of pretty ribbons and
other small "fairings".  Ribbons are a lovely small luxury for the
every day person, and the lad has them in many colors.  The ribbons are
attached to several large horizontal slats which are in turn attached
to a long pole.  As the lad wanders around the faire, his display goes
before him, high up in the air like a flag.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 yell Pretty ribbons! #cR#mi#gb#yb#bo#rn#ws#R for your lady!

mobs.Name: juggler jugglers
mobs.LongDescription: Flaming torches fly high into the air as the juggler performs.
mobs.Description:
A tall, lean human throws torches high into the air, deftly catching
them as they fall.  There are so many flying so swiftly that it looks
like a column of flame rises over the juggler's head.

mobs.Name: demon disguised E
mobs.LongDescription: Tall and menacing, the demon slyly invites you into his tent.
mobs.Description:
Come my fine friends!  Come and see the most fascinating of nature's
perversions!  Gathered for you from lands far and near!  Come into my
tent and see the creatures safely locked away!
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E;%8 em smiles slyly at you.;%6 em beckons you closer.

mobs.Name: chess player ranger E
mobs.LongDescription: Sitting in deep shade, the #rFairy#Y ranger concentrates on chess.
mobs.Description:
This ranger has semi retired to a life fighting battles on the
chessboard.  When the call to protect #bElysium#N is heard, however, he
is in the front of the battle, fearlessly fighting evil.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E;%5em studies the chessboard thoughtfully.

mobs.Name: monk leonine E
mobs.LongDescription: The monk with the thick mane of golden hair R-O-A-Rs at you.
mobs.Description:
You can tell from his shining armor that this is no ordinary monk.  His
gloriously thick mane of hair barely fits beneath that helmet.  Perhaps
the tight fit of the helmet is why he R-O-A-Rs so often.  Or maybe not.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E

mobs.Name: minotaur thief E
mobs.LongDescription: A powerful minotaur rests his shoulders against a tree, sizing you up.
mobs.Description:
Although a thief, his talents were well used by the forces of good
during the recent battles.  The clan thief was easily able to slip
behind enemy lines and steal battle plans as well as the wealth of the
evil tribes attempting to plunder Elysium.
mobs.ActionScript: %%95 circle;%85 ass E

mobs.Name: Madame K gypsy fortune teller E
mobs.LongDescription: Madame K knows all, sees all.  Let her tell you the future in your hand.
mobs.Description:
Long dark hair flows freely down her back.  Madame K looks at you from
eyes dark with mystery and you are certain she knows all the secrets of
your soul.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%85 ass E;%5 say Cross my palm with silver!;
%5 say I only read #wCLEAN #ypalms.  Go wash your hands.

mobs.Name: troll ranger lover E
mobs.LongDescription: The troll ranger jealously guards the entrance to Madame's.
mobs.Description:
Towering powerfully over most of Madame K's clients, this ranger eyes
each one as he enters her wagon.  He glares at those he doesn't like,
and many of her would-be customers are scared off.  He, in turn, is
watched by some of the gypsy men who don't want him chasing off good
customers!
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E;%5 glare troll;%5 glare minotaur;%5 glare half-elf;%5 glare

mobs.Name: immortal lord dragon
mobs.LongDescription: The captive's terror fills the dragonlord with fierce delight.
mobs.Description:
Having lived in the Elysium Mountains longer than anyone can remember,
the assumption is that this particular dragon is immortal.  Only fools
still attempt to kill him.  It is said that once he was so enraged that
his fire literally blew the top off of this mountain, and that his
breath still warms the many hidden pools in the valley.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 kill captive;%5 eat blackhearted;%5snarl captive

mobs.Name: troll trollish ale wench 18024
mobs.LongDescription: #RThe #ytrollish #Rale wench asks you, "So what'll you 'ave, lovey?"#N
mobs.Description:
The wench eager to sell you ale also looks powerful enough to keep the
entire crowd in line.  After much (forced) scrubbing, she no longer
SMELLS trollish, but she has kept the size, power, and sheer stupendous
ugliness of that race.  Oh! and you had better count your change.  I
don't *think* she's very good at making change yet.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5say 'ave a glass o' me best! Only 10 gold coins!;%5 pinch elf

mobs.Name: dragon feeder warrior
mobs.LongDescription: "Here's a tasty morsel for you" says the warrior, prodding a captive.
mobs.Description:
It's a tough job but somebody's gotta do it.  Elysium stands firmly on
the side of #wgood#N, and evil must be firmly rooted out.  When the
battles were raging and the supply of evil captives seemed endless,
only the evil hearts were fed to the dragon, who obligingly purified
them with his white hot flame.  Now, though, the forces of evil are on
the run and the entire captive becomes the sacrifice.

mobs.Name: purple dragon small Anastasia
mobs.LongDescription: The small purple dragon hovers, gleefully awaiting the order to "Burn!"
mobs.Description:
Reluctantly employed by the guild of rangers, solely on the very strong
recommendation of one of its members, Anastasia has the very important
role of clearing away underbrush in preventive maintenance fires.
Raised by elves in an experiment, she has retained all of the mischief
of the dragons and the disdain for lower life forms common to both
races.  She dearly loves her job and frequently practices starting
fires when her elf would rather she did not!

mobs.Name: TRI warrior three-headed beast head
mobs.LongDescription: The massive warrior head stares moodily out through the bars.
mobs.Description:
One of three heads attached to the same massive body, this head in
particular chooses to fight first and think later.  Quarrels between
the other two heads are usually resolved by this one taking charge.
mobs.ActionScript: %%80 ass head;%5 bonk 2.head;%5 bonk 3.head

mobs.Name: TRI thief three-headed beast head
mobs.LongDescription: The thief looks at you slyly, wondering what you are worth.
mobs.Description:
This head is stuck in the middle, between the warrior and the mage.
His instincts urge him to do a sly stab in your back (so don't turn
your back on him!) but the mage keeps insisting that spells are the
answer!
mobs.ActionScript: %%80 ass head

mobs.Name: TRI mage three-headed beast head
mobs.LongDescription: The mage head of the amazing three-headed monster spits in your face.
mobs.Description:
The mage has a thinly veiled contempt of the other two heads (and the
rest of the world), but nevertheless will listen to the warrior  - at
least some of the time.  He is a malcontent in part because he is
always last to achieve a new level.
mobs.ActionScript: %%80 ass head

mobs.Name: maypole dancer red
mobs.LongDescription: The dancing girl weaves her #rred#Y ribbon in with the white ones.
mobs.Description:
The maypole dance is a celebration of rebirth.  As the dancers wind in
and out of each other in a complex spiral of steps, the ribbons are
wound around the tall tree growing within the circle of stones.

mobs.Name: maypole dancer white
mobs.LongDescription:
#wWhitei#Y ribbons form a spiral pattern on the maypole as the boy
dances.
mobs.Description:
At the end of the dance, the white and red ribbons will form a spiral
on the maypole symbolizing the circle of life.  For a land badly hurt
by long years of war, the rebirth is especially significant.

mobs.Name: captive feline dl dark legion
mobs.LongDescription: The feline #bc#ga#bp#gt#bi#gv#be#Y mews pitifully over her fate!
mobs.Description:
Captured in the final wave of fighting and sent here to feed the
dragon, the feline raises her voice in a loud lament.  She wonders,
miserably, if she *pounces* on the dragon in a last ditch effort to
avoid being his dinner, if she has a chance to escape.  If she fails,
surely they will do something horrible to her ... like feed her to
mice, instead ...  On a tag on her collar you can see the emblem for
#bD#ga#br#gk #bL#ge#bg#gi#bo#gn#N clan.

mobs.Name: captive terrorist tkk
mobs.LongDescription: The captive #Cter#crorist whimpers at the lick of dragonfire.
mobs.Description:
This particular captive used to delight in terrorizing sweet little old
lady gnomes.  Alas, he looks forlorn and pitiful, awaiting his turn to
be dragon hors d'oeuvres.  A somewhat tattered #CT#cKK#N insignia is
loosely attached to his outer cloak.

mobs.Name: raspberry scented peasant malina
mobs.LongDescription: Phew! one of the peasants has had too much raspberry brandy!
mobs.Description:
Perhaps, if you must be a peasant, it's better to be a bit drunk.  This
particular peasant has been indulging deeply in a bottle of raspberry
brandy and is a bit worse for wear as a result.  Actually, he reeks!
On his dirty burlap tunic you see a faded emblem of the clan
#MMalina#N.
mobs.ActionScript: %%8 flirt wench;%5 em guzzles his ale.;%5pinch wench;%5 nudge wench

mobs.Name: dragoon goon Phos
mobs.LongDescription: The little dragoon sits by the side of the road, worshipping his sun.
mobs.Description:
Seated by the side of the path, the soldier dressed in #cblue#N and
#mpurple#N watches his Phos set in the far distance, then waits for it
to happen again.  Occasionally he eats the scraps of food kind souls
leave for him, but mostly he is content to sit and wait for the sun to
make an appearance.  He was a valiant warrior, but his mind has, sadly,
gone.

mobs.Name: squire troll
mobs.LongDescription: The #ytroll#Y squire easily carries the heavy armor to his knight.
mobs.Description:
Pitifully, he will never quite make it to knighthood.  His tiny troll
brain just can't seem to hold all the rules and the few spells they are
allowed to learn.  He is strong, however, and healthy, and the knight
will have an excellent squire for many many years.

mobs.Name: child rainbow newbie
mobs.LongDescription:
The #rr#ya#gi#cn#mb#bo#rw#Y child looks about her in wonder.  "What's
this?" she asks.
mobs.Description:
Dressed in all the colors of the rainbow (but mostly bronze), the child
wanders the faire.  Her eyes are wide with wonder, and she asks about
everything she sees.  Occasionally one of the older fairegoers will
stop by and offer to help her.

mobs.Name: hunter warrior woman Arts
mobs.LongDescription: The woman #bhunter#Y stands aloof from the games of knights.
mobs.Description:
Although invited to participate in the Knight's games - the jousting,
wrestling and other forms of hand to hand combat, the woman scoffed at
them as "boys' games".  She chose instead to continue her work
protecting the children and her own society of women.  She is secure in
her knowledge of her own strength and feels no need to constantly prove
herself.  On her tunic you see the emblem of the clan #bArtemisian#N.

mobs.Name: dragon storm stormy SD
mobs.LongDescription: No matter where he goes, the red dragon cannot escape his cloud.
mobs.Description:
A bright, vividly red dragon looks at you from stormy gray eyes.
Everywhere he goes, he is followed by a storm cloud towering inches
from his 5' high head.  If you look closely, you will see a #RStorm
Dragon #Ninsignia tattooed on one wing.

mobs.Name: hat seller hatseller vendor
mobs.LongDescription:
#y"Fine 'ats for gents! Luvly 'ats for th'ladies" says the hat
seller.#N
mobs.Description:
Nobody goes bareheaded in Elysium.  Whether it's protection from the
elements, a little extra oomph! when attacking the (very very few)
remaining bad guys, or just wanting to be really spiffy, everyone wants
something on their head.

mobs.Name: tinker
mobs.LongDescription: The tinker offers to turn your helmet into a cooking pot.
mobs.Description:
After all, you'll not be needing armor in this land of peace!  This
tinker has travelled the length and breadth of the kingdom and seen the
changes wrought first by war then the coming of peace.  He can fix
almost anything metallic for you.

mobs.Name: voodoo child E
mobs.LongDescription: The #Mvo#wo#Mdoo child#Y watches you from mysterious gray eyes.
mobs.Description:
Born and raised under the powerful aura of voodoo magic, the voodoo
child is a child no longer.  He is an expert with the natural magic
latent in forest, stream, animals.  Although it is a brutal magic, it
has til now been aligned with the honor of Elysium.  Still, late on a
moonless night you will hear the heartbeat of his drums and resolve to
remain indoors.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E

mobs.Name: innocent warrior baby-faced baby E
mobs.LongDescription:
Despite his baby-faced innocence, you #rfear#Y this #bElysium#Y
warrior.
mobs.Description:
He has the innocent face of an unborn child, but his dagger strikes
#rfear#N into the bravest of evil hearts.  He is an aged and
well-experienced avatar warrior, having lived many lives and been
gloriously victorious over evil in all of them.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E

mobs.Name: man jack-in-the-box jack
mobs.LongDescription: An enormous man springs out at you.
mobs.Description:
Small wonder Jack chooses to hide in that box!  He is hideously ugly.
Uglier than a troll!  He has a huge round white head, two blue dots for
eyes and a long, pointy orange nose.  On his head he wears a tall,
pointed yellow helmet that looks like it could hurt you if he chose to
head-butt you.  Better steer clear of it!

mobs.Name: human singer Marilyn Manson
mobs.LongDescription: The strange human sings songs of deepest evil in a tuneless voice.
mobs.Description:
Long dirty brown hair hangs over a scrawny bare human male chest.  The
lips sneering, leering at you are smeared with red well beyond their
natural boundaries.  It is not until you look into the man's wildly
painted eyes that you begin to be afraid for there is nothing, nothing
inside them.

mobs.Name: Sir Norbert Naughty knight
mobs.LongDescription: Sir Norbert the Naughty cheats at wrestling as at everything else.
mobs.Description:
To be fair, he really can't help himself, being three quarters drow.
It's a way of life.  With his deep blue skin and close cropped white
hair, he is able to pass in this festive crowd as an unusual elf kin.

mobs.Name: Methar knight
mobs.LongDescription: Methar and his steed Valiant have won most of the games today.
mobs.Description:
Methar is a tall, well-muscled minotaur, a veteran of the recent wars
and well practiced at both hand to hand combat and the intricate moves
required of a knight on horseback.  Methar's brown hair is well-mixed
with gray and kept tied neatly.  His long drooping mustache is
well-waxed.
mobs.ActionScript: %%15 mount valiant;%80 ass valiant

mobs.Name: Valiant horse
mobs.LongDescription: Valiant tosses his long white mane with pride.
mobs.Description:
Tall, nimble, powerful and intelligent - what more could one ask of a
horse?  Valiant's coat is as pure a white as his heart, and more than
once his quick thinking and actions have saved his owner from harm.
mobs.ActionScript: %%80 ass methar

mobs.Name: purple people eater monster
mobs.LongDescription: The furry three-toed flying purple people eater looks sadly out at you.
mobs.Description:
Clueless as to why he's been forced to live behind bars, the lonely
purple people eater silently begs for release. At 9' (not quite 3m),
his head rubs against the ceiling of the tent, mussing his fur.  This
makes him quite upset.  All day long people walk by laughing and
pointing at him.  He hasn't had a decent meal in ever so long!  Perhaps
you would volunteer to be a snack?

mobs.Name: peasant man
mobs.LongDescription: The peasant looks in awe at the jugglers and all the performers here.
mobs.Description:
A rough peasant from a farm badly ravaged by the long wars, he hasn't
seen the luxuries offered at the faire for many years.  Luxuries
including soap  ... The peasant is weary, but well muscled and long on
endurance from all of the labor involved in farming.

mobs.Name: elysium warrior E
mobs.LongDescription: The warrior wanders the faire, never entirely at ease with the peace.
mobs.Description:
The battles have gone on for so long and so viciously, that there is an
