expectation of imminent danger in the hearts of all of #bElysium#N's
brave warriors.  Whether they fight with dirk or with hammer or with
incantation, they are instantly ready to subdue evil.
mobs.ActionScript: %%50 ass E

mobs.Name: gypsy dancer
mobs.LongDescription: Flying skirts and stomping feet fire the gypsy's dance.
mobs.Description:
The gypsy turns rapidly around and around, her skirts flying with her
movement.  Her feet stomp in time to the wild rhythm of the violin and
her fingers *click* *click* in a counter rhythm.  Her vivid red skirt,
loose, low cut white blouse, wide leather belt and shiny black boots
ensure she earns a few extra coins for her dancing.

mobs.Name: gypsy violinist
mobs.LongDescription: Magic fills the air when the gypsy plays upon his violin.
mobs.Description:
His hair is a wild dark cloud around his head as he brings music forth
from the delicate violin tucked under his chin.  Somehow, the gypsy's
whole body is involved when he plays and the music he brings to life is
filled with an awesome power.

mobs.Name: dwarf dwarven silversmith
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven silversmith urges his oxen up the road.
mobs.Description:
On his way to sell his well-crafted silver at the faire, the dwarf
knows he is already late.  He is unconcerned, however.  He knows there
will be an unquenchable demand in this new era of prosperity.

mobs.Name: human pilgrim
mobs.LongDescription: Black-garbed and solemn-faced, the #whuman#Y pilgrim trudges along.
mobs.Description:
Headed for the fabled home of peace, harmony and well being, the
pilgrim is torn between hopes of a true reconciliation between the
factions and philosophies that have torn this world apart and the fear
that nothing real has changed, that one faction has simply grabbed the
ascendancy, however momentary.

mobs.Name: snake dominant head
mobs.LongDescription: #yThe dominant snake head points at you and screams, "MINE!"#N
mobs.Description:
A two-headed snake!  Each head has a tiny snake collar.  The one on
this head says, "Squeezers".  Despite the name, you are more likely to
be poisoned than squeezed to death.  Assuming the snake(s) can make up
their mind(s) what to do with you at all!
mobs.ActionScript: %%05 kill rat;%05 eat rat;%90 ass snake

mobs.Name: snake non-dominant head
mobs.LongDescription: #yThe non-dominant snake says, "No! MINE!", and slithers towards you.#N
mobs.Description:
Ever seen a snake pout?  Not a pretty sight.  But when you are always
the loser ... Each of the two snake heads forms a small triangle, and
there are alternating teal and light turquoise bands down the length of
the snake.
mobs.ActionScript: %%03 kill rat;%90 ass snake

mobs.Name: rat snake food snakefood
mobs.LongDescription: The rat scurries arout the cage, whiskers and tail twitching.
mobs.Description:
Placed here to keep the snake(s) well fed and content (so they don't
ogle the paying customers) the rats run in circles around the cage.
They know they are doomed.  They would need a ratman superhero to
rescue them.  These rats are just your standard rats ... gray, white,
and pink with a green striped tail.

mobs.Name: vampire gnome gnomish cod
mobs.LongDescription: Child-sized himself, the vampire gnome lusts for children's blood.
mobs.Description:
It is unusual for the gnomish to be seduced into the dark side, but
this is the exception.  When he smiles broadly, two long fangs reveal
themselves.  During the recent wars this gnome left behind a trail of
undead children.  Aside from the fangs and the #YChildren of Darkness#N
tattoo, this gnome could easily pass for normal.

mobs.Name: bard
mobs.LongDescription: The bard will sing epic songs in your honor - for a price.
mobs.Description:
Although he does indeed carry news from one castle fortress to the
next, news which he records in song and in rhyme, the bard is a very
practical man.  For a small fee he will cheerfully invent some heroic
deds for you and sing of them to your friends and foe.  Instant
immortality!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em sings, "Alas, my love, you do me wrong to cast me out so
discourteously.  For I have loved you so long, delighting in your company."
;%5 sings,
"What ho! The Elfking he did go, a-hunting evil drow ..."

mobs.Name: General ham hammerin H Bone E
mobs.LongDescription: General H ("Hammerin'") Bone wields sword and magic with equal prowess.
mobs.Description:
A tall and straight #rAvatar#N with slightly large head and feet,
General H Bone was in charge of the Elven Armies during the recent War
Against the Evil Hordes.  He is still revered by those elves with a
military bent to their nature, as you will see from the many pictures
of him hung in Elven dwellings.  General Bone has long straight blond
hair tied neatly with a leather thong.  He doesn't put up with any
nonsense!
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E

mobs.Name: bard joyous joy
mobs.LongDescription: Songs of joy and wicked rhymes keep the bard (and you) smiling.
mobs.Description:
It is a long trek to the faire.  The bard is not a rich man, but he has
discovered that people like to laugh and think of pleasant things.
When they are happy, he prospers.

mobs.Name: elite warrior
mobs.LongDescription: The #:R#bE#yL#bI#yT#bE#Y warrior #Wis lying there, stunned.
mobs.Description:
The warrior was hoping to win medals and gold for his clan, but he's
not having a good day.  Hammered into his chest plate you see the
insignia of the Elite clan.

mobs.Name: fairy warrior wizard E
mobs.LongDescription: The #rFairy#Y warrior wizard wreaks #bElysium#Y vengeance upon evil.
mobs.Description:
For all his undoubted power, the wizard has yet a sort of sad, puppy
dog look about him.  Perhaps he is remembering all of his fellow
wizards who were lost during the war.  With soft gray eyes under the
tall pointed wizard hat, it is no wonder he has many hopeful wizards
following his footsteps.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E

mobs.Name: apprentice wizard E
mobs.LongDescription: The eager apprentice follows his idol in hopeful imitation.
mobs.Description:
He has "borrowed" the wizard's hat, robe, boots and wand which are
all, unfortunately, a trifle large on him.  "One day", he assures you
(and himself), "I shall be a powerfully mighty extremely incredible
wizard of wizards!"
mobs.ActionScript: %%85ass E;%8 em stumbles and almost falls, but quickly rights himself.

mobs.Name: jouster eccentric crazy E
mobs.LongDescription: Despite his eccentric style, the #RDwarven#Y jouster is undefeated!
mobs.Description:
Taking on battles he should have no hope of winning, yet this crazy
#RDwarven#N jouster manages to win again and again.  After watching him
for some hours you become convinced it is his sheer determination and
belief in himself that is bringing him victory after victory.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E

mobs.Name: Sir Enzen knight
mobs.LongDescription: Sir Enzen of the black heart prepares to lance the quintain.
mobs.Description:
Sir Enzen and his horse are both dressed entirely in black, and you
wonder just how hot it gets in there on a summer's day.  not that
spring or summer were overly present during the past year of terror.
Despite his name, nobody has ever proven anything against Sir Enzen.
He is a strong and fearless knight, as well as a wealthy one.

mobs.Name: squire Timothy
mobs.LongDescription: Sir Enzen's squire looks about nervously.
mobs.Description:
Unlike his master, Sir Enzen's squire Timothy is a nervous, weak lad, a
disappointment to his sire and master alike.  Sir Enzen forces him to
train constantly in hopes that he will thereby build muscles and
courage.  He remains as you see him, however, weak and timid.

mobs.Name: knight practicing
mobs.LongDescription: The knight makes a few practice swings with his heavy mithril sword.
mobs.Description:
Some of the knights are disappointed that the wars are over and they
have lost their chance to pillage, rape, collect large amounts of war 
booty and win fame and fortune for their name.  They look to these 
meetings with other mighty warriors to keep their edge between wars.

mobs.Name: philosophical thief elf E
mobs.LongDescription: Pushed out of the church into a life of crime, the thief has prospered.
mobs.Description:
The elf has taken nimbly to his life of crime.  It was not his first
choice, but the Wiccan monks in Tynstri, where he was trained, shoved
him out the door some years ago.  Not only was he guzzling the
sacramental wine late at night, but he was selling it to some underage
dragons who'd developed a taste for it.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E;%90 circle

mobs.Name: troll ranger ferret E
mobs.LongDescription: The #ytrollish#Y ranger has a ferret like cast to his features.
mobs.Description:
He also seems to be fading in and out of view.  Very strange.  Now you
see him, now you don't.  Where does he fade off to?
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E

mobs.Name: stablelass stable lass groom
mobs.LongDescription: The stablelass carefully braids the horse's mane and tail.
mobs.Description:
The knights' horses are pampered more than their wives or children, who
are fostered out to other families.  This stablelass will carefully
comb the horses' coats free of burrs and then carefully braid mane and
tail into elaborate designs.  On a day of celebration, she may braid in
flowers or ribbons as well.

mobs.Name: servant ratman
mobs.LongDescription: The ratman servant collects wood for a fire.
mobs.Description:
Fortunately, the large numbers of people have not been here over long,
or there would be a true shortage of wood.  Although this servant has
managed to find a few spare pieces of wood lying around ... small
pieces of other clans' wagons that surely won't be missed!

mobs.Name: black knight wicked Sir Eldar
mobs.LongDescription: Sir Eldar the Wicked Black Knight swings his heavy battle axe.
mobs.Description:
Sir Eldar is here, like the other knights both good and bad, to win
some of the large cash prizes awarded in the knights games.  He will
also sow a little dissent, make alliances with other families and size
up those weak enough to be wiped out.

mobs.Name: squire bigglesworths
mobs.LongDescription: Sir Bigglesworth's squire grumpily polishes armor.  "Wax on. Wax off."
mobs.Description:
Noble boys are sent to live in other households to learn to be
knights, and this young #bKai#N squire lives in the Bigglesworth
household.  It is a rather loose knit place, and the squire finds he is
expected to do a bit more than he would like. He has been set to polish
the big knight's heavy armor, and it must be done precisely as required
or he will have to do it all over again.

mobs.Name: stablelad lad stable
mobs.LongDescription: The stablelad is a "keeper of horses" but would rather roll in the hay.
mobs.Description:
This tall young minotaur is very excited to be able to help take care
of the all important warhorses.  Many a joust is won or lost based on
the knight's horse and many a copper coin finds its way into the stable
lad who helps to care for a winning rider's mount.

mobs.Name: blacksmith john
mobs.LongDescription: John the Blacksmith attaches a horseshoe to the great warhorse.
mobs.Description:
Being blacksmith to the mighty knights and nobles is an important and
somewhat dangerous job.  If a shoe should come loose during a joust and
cause one of the horses to go lame or simply cause the jouster to lose,
it will not go well for the blacksmith!  On the other hand, John has no
competition at the moment, and smithery is one of the necessities of
this life.

mobs.Name: blacksmith apprentice lad
mobs.LongDescription: The apprentice lad sorts the horseshoes and nails into buckets.
mobs.Description:
Apprenticed to the blacksmith at the age of 7, at 17 the lad is well on
his way to being a fully fledged blacksmith in his own right.  His
shoulders and biceps are large, and even his hands are well muscled.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 mutter

mobs.Name: wild boar beast
mobs.LongDescription: The enormous boar comes charging at you from the underbrush.
mobs.Description:
Even the wild pigs suffered during the conflict, when their habitat was
destroyed.  This boar is larger than most.  She sports two long sharp
tusks, one on each side of a grin which features a full set of long,
sharp teeth.  The boars charge first and think later.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1roar

mobs.Name: dragon soaring
mobs.LongDescription: Soaring high overhead, the dragon smirks at the knights jousting.
mobs.Description:
Puny humans!  For that matter, puny elves! puny minotaurs! yes, even
puny demons, wolves, trolls ... Only dragons can soar with the strength
that he does.  And the silly fools down below are knocking each other
down, slicing each other up.  They will soon be ready to fill a hungry
dragon's
pantry.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smirk

mobs.Name: minotaur peasant
mobs.LongDescription: The minotaur peasant looks for someone on whom to sharpen his horn.
mobs.Description:
Nothing like a very large, combative minotaur who is feeling a might
peckish to liven up a crowd already bent on having a good time.  Give
him a couple of horns of ale, and WATCH OUT!

mobs.Name: gypsy violinist
mobs.LongDescription: The gypsy wields his violin like a weapon.
mobs.Description:
Which, of course, it is.  With his music, the gypsy can make you laugh
or cry or *need* to dance yourself weary.  A thread of silver through
his black hair and a few fine lines are all that show his age, and his
dark eyes sparkle at you as he plays.

mobs.Name: knight jouster Sir Bigglesworth Big
mobs.LongDescription: Sir Bigglesworth runs at the quintain, but is unseated by the dummy.
mobs.Description:
Poor Sir Bigglesworth!  He needs to win this joust to pay his armourer
bills.  That nasty troll will *kill* him if he doesn't get paid.  Sir
B. needed extra armor to cover a slight extra paunch he developped
from a bit too much celebratory beer.

mobs.Name: dark juan E 18084
mobs.LongDescription: Dark Juan eyes you from his hiding place in the shadows.
mobs.Description:
Dark as the night and nasty as they come, you don't want to tangle with
this dude.  He's 220 lbs (100 kilos) of lean mean fighting machine.
More than a little crazed, you see the wicked gleam in his eye just
before you feel his stiletto sink between your shoulder blades.
mobs.ActionScript: %%95 circle

mobs.Name: jack green
mobs.LongDescription: All dressed in spring green, Jack o' the Green is chasing thunder away.
mobs.Description:
Jack o' the Green is the spirit of spring fertility, and in the
mummers' play he will soundly pounce on Rounce-Robble-Hobble, the
thunder, making sure the summer harvest is bountiful.

mobs.Name: hag harvest
mobs.LongDescription: The Wicked Hag o' the Harvest must be defeated or it will fail!
mobs.Description:
Cheered on by ale-drinking crowds, the patron of the harvest will
defeat and slay the wicked Hag o' the Harvest, else the harvest will be
plagued.  The mummer playing the Hag is booed and jeered.  She is a
scrawny old thing, wearing straw and rags and a sheaf of wheat,
symbolizing her role.

mobs.Name: rounce robble hobble thunder
mobs.LongDescription: Rounce-Robble-Hobble makes loud and scary thunder noises.
mobs.Description:
Rounce-Robble-Hobble is the big, dark, frightening personnification of
thunder, acted by a travelling mummer all dressed in dark gray clothing
and face paint, with a streak of white lightning across his chest.  He
must be defeated by Jack o' the Green for spring fertility to be safe!

mobs.Name: court mage elfcourt elf E
mobs.LongDescription: A student of the occult, the elven mage is a member of the elfcourt.
mobs.Description:
The Cult of the Occult ... mysterious elven mages who form part of the
magic of the Court of the Elfking.  This group specializes in arcane
rites and lost spells.  It is rumored that they perform ritualistic
sacrifices at the new moon, although this practice would be condemned
by the Elfking.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E

mobs.Name: gnome gnomish rabble rouser
mobs.LongDescription: The #ggnomish#Y rabble rouser looks about for some #ggnomish#Y rabble.
mobs.Description:
Gnomes (pronounced guh - noamz) are not prone to think of themselves as
rabble, so the heated oratory of the rabble rousers generally fall on
other ears.  The gnomes are tired of being thought of as "those ugly
little fellows who are always underfoot".  Their great intellect should
be prized in such an economical package!

mobs.Name: Rocky steed warhorse stallion
mobs.LongDescription: The great #bElysium#Y warhorse, Rocky, has a fondness for spaghetti.
mobs.Description:
And for other simple pleasures, like fresh water, fresh grass, pretty
stablelasses to braid his beautiful dark brown mane... the good things
in life.  He has earned them, having fought hard in the War Against the
Evil Horde.  Adorned for battle, Rocky wears heavy armor himself and
carries a hefty knight in full armor as well.  He is extremely strong,
and crafty as well.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5em neighs loudly.;%5 em nudges you, searching your pockets for 
apples.

mobs.Name: steed warhorse stallion
mobs.LongDescription: The mighty stallion flicks back his ears and stares you in the eye.
mobs.Description:
This enormous, well-muscled steed, has become a trifle temperamental.
Perhaps the horrors of the war were too much for him.  At one point, he
was transformed into a frog by an evil sorcerer with bad aim.  The
mighty knight upon whose shoulders the spell was supposed to land fell
to the ground, denting his armor and almost *splat*ting the horse/frog.
So the stallion is a bit cranky.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 bite elf;%5 bite troll;%5 bite E;%5 bite half-elf

mobs.Name: chess player dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarf calculates his next move on the chessboard.  Is he trapped?
mobs.Description:
The dwarf has been playing chess here in the shade with his old friend
for a long time.  Of average size for a dwarf, his long dark hair is
streaked with the gray of age and many battles.  A deep jagged scar
runs from the outer corner of his left eye down to the middle of his
jawline, marring the deep straight lines of age on his face.

mobs.Name: captive evil blackhearted
mobs.LongDescription: A blackhearted captive faces the dragon with arrogant bravado.
mobs.Description:
One of the many captives who made up the Evil Horde, this one is
waiting his turn to be dragon food.  He is truly an evil minotaur, so
evil that you can feel it in the air around him.  He is tall, with a
broad frame covered with heavy muscles, and he snarls at you as you
pass, revealing long, sharp white teeth.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5snarl dragon;%2 snarl

mobs.Name: lady knights
mobs.LongDescription: The knight's lady looks around for her servants.
mobs.Description:
A tall, slender human woman, this lady decided to come with her knight
on his venture to the games.  She wished to see the faire in all its
marvels, and she wished to cheer her knight on in the games.  She is
also well aware of the other pleasures available to him away from home,
and is determined that he shall not sample them!
mobs.ActionScript: %%5fashion;%5 comb

mobs.Name: MoC minion chaos captive evil gnome gnomish mage
mobs.LongDescription: The evil gnome feeds off the chaos of fights between captives.
mobs.Description:
This evil little gnome pits captive against captive, amazed that they
are ever gullible to his machinations.  This was his role in the past
wars - instigator, inciter, builder of flames between groups.  The
chaos this created in his world fed him as blood feeds a vampire.
Tattooed across the little gnome's left buttock is the red and white
insignia of the #RM#ri#Rn#ri#Ro#rn#Rs#W of #RC#rh#wa#ro#Rs#N.

mobs.Name: ribbon seller vendor chubby lad shopkeeper
mobs.LongDescription: A chubby lad walks about shouting, "Ribbons! Get your ribbons!"
mobs.Description:
The chubby peasant lad is carrying a large display of pretty ribbons
and other small "fairings".  Ribbons are a lovely small luxury for the
every day person, and the lad has them in many colors.  The ribbons are
attached to several large horizontal slats which are in turn attached
to a long pole.  As the lad wanders around the faire, his display goes
before him, high up in the air like a flag.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 yell Pretty ribbons! #CR#Mi#Gb#Yb#Bo#Rn#Ws#R for your lady!;
%1 yell Pretty ribbons! #CR#Mi#Gb#Yb#Bo#Rn#Ws#R for your horse!

mobs.Name: radioactive assassin glow glowing
mobs.LongDescription: The #bElysium#Y assassin glows with a dangerous light.
mobs.Description:
This assassin has a faint glow to him.  The glow is native to a certain
group of explorers who have spent too long in a part of the caves known
as Sellafield.  They were long ago ensorcelled by a wicked wizard known
as A Tom (named after his cat, they say), and those who spend too long
there often glow.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E;%5 airguitar

mobs.Name: gypsy queen
mobs.LongDescription: The fiercely independent gypsy moves majestically through the faire.
mobs.Description:
Named for the last tsarina of Russia, Alekxandra, the Queen of the
Gypsies descends from an ancient line of gypsies.  Her long nearly black
hair, pale as pale skin, and bright green eyes display a certain air of
mysticism, sensuality, and the knowledge of ancient and dark secrets of
ancestors past.
mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E;%1emote stares at you imperiously

mobs.Name: razputin
mobs.LongDescription:
The evil Razputin whispers wickedly into the ears of all who will
listen.
mobs.Description:
Razputin is one source of evil not yet eradicated by the brave Elysium 
warriors.  His is the quiet, sly evil of the whispering powermonger, the
quick, sly stab to the heart from a monk with an innocent face.
mobs.ActionScript: %%8 em smiles slyly at you.;%6 em beckons you closer.

mobs.Name: large black orc
mobs.LongDescription: A large Black Orc screams some strange words and charges you.
mobs.Description:
The Black Orc looks rather mean and agressive.
He waves his scimitar in a very threatening manner.

mobs.Name: huge black orc leader
mobs.LongDescription: A huge Black Orc screams some commands to his followers and charges you.
mobs.Description:
This Black Orc looks very very mean and muscular.
He is dressed in an ill-fitting black plate and thrusts his
spear at you.

mobs.Name: enormous black orc chief
mobs.LongDescription: A Enormous Black Orc screams some commands to his followers and charges you.
mobs.Description:
This Black Orc looks very very mean and  muscular.
He is dressed in an well-fitting huge evil black plate
and tries to pierce you with his spear.

mobs.Name: balrog humanoid enormous fire
mobs.LongDescription: An enormous humanoid form of fire snickers cruelly at your weak efforts.
mobs.Description:
It is surrounded by sparkling and lethal fire.  It is holding a mighty 
whip in its left hand and a flaming sword in its right hand.  Around its
neck you see the infamous Glob Medallion, and you know its soul is owned
by an evil force.

mobs.Name: Gollum
mobs.LongDescription: Gollum sniffs loud and looks at you with his big fish eyes.
mobs.Description:
This guy really looks like he need something to eat.
He is small and tiny and his skin is almost transparent.
mobs.ActionScript: %15 cry;%15 say Someone have stolen my ring.

mobs.Name: Octopussy blind
mobs.LongDescription: The Octopussy attacks you with its slimy tentacles.
mobs.Description: This is a creature from the deepest part of the pool.

mobs.Name: angel
mobs.LongDescription: An angel walks around, having a happy existence.
mobs.Description:
This is a normal angel. He smiles at you as he notices that you are
watching him. He is very beautiful, and very very good. How could you
even think of harming such a good-willed being?
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile

mobs.Name: angel
mobs.LongDescription: An angel walks around, having a happy existence.
mobs.Description:
This is a normal angel. She smiles at you as she notices that you are
watching her. She is very beautiful, and very very good. How could you
even think of harming such a good-willed being?
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile

mobs.Name: angel guard
mobs.LongDescription: No evil passes the watching eye of the angel guard!
mobs.Description:
This angel has been given the honor of guarding Heaven, or places
inside Heaven, against evilness. Don't mess with him, he knows how to
handle the weapon in his hand.

mobs.Name: angel soldier
mobs.LongDescription: The angel soldier is part of God's army.
mobs.Description:
This angel has signed into the army. He's now part of the glorious army
overseen by Michael, the arch angel. It's a great honor to have achieved
this position, and maybe someday the army will attack Hell. The soldiers
can't wait until that day!

mobs.Name: angel guard death
mobs.LongDescription: The angel guarding the black door of Death is watching you.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the four guards that are to ensure that the riders of
the Apocalypse don't get free before the time is right. The guard is
dressed in black, and he is standing at the north, black door to Death's
chamber. This angel won't budge for anything.

mobs.Name: angel guard war
mobs.LongDescription: The angel guarding the blood red door of War is watching you.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the four guards that are to ensure that the riders of the
Apocalypse doesn't get free before the time is right. The guard is
dressed in bloody red, and he is standing at the south, red door to
War's chamber. This angel won't budge for anything.

mobs.Name: angel guard pestilence
mobs.LongDescription: The angel guarding the green door of Pestilence is watching you.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the four guards that are to ensure that the riders of the
Apocalypse doesn't get free before the time is right. The guard is
dressed in green, and he is standing at the west, green door to
Pestilence's chamber. This angel won't budge for anything.

mobs.Name: angel guard famine
mobs.LongDescription: The angel guarding the grey door of Famine is watching you.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the four guards that are to ensure that the riders of the
Apocalypse doesn't get free before the time is right. The guard is
dressed in grey, and he is standing at the east, grey door to Famine's
chamber. This angel won't budge for anything.

mobs.Name: soul till lindemann
mobs.LongDescription: The soul of Till Lindemann is still singing the text to 'Engel'.
mobs.Description:
This is what is left of Till Lindemann after his death. He died on a
concert with Rammstein, while singing 'Engel'. God knows, he does not
want to be an angel, and so he will most likely not get access to Heaven
- not until he stops singing.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 sing;%10 emote sings 'Gott weiss ich will kein Engel sein!'

mobs.Name: soul elvis
mobs.LongDescription: The soul of Elvis is still trying to get access to Heaven.
mobs.Description:
When Elvis died, he thought he'd get into Heaven right away, but that
wasn't the case. Saint Petrus couldn't make up his mind about Elvis,
and so he decided to think it over. As a result, Elvis have been arguing
with the informant about this ever since he got here, and he will most
likely continue doing that until a final decision is made.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 sing

mobs.Name: soul
mobs.LongDescription: A soul is waiting for his final judgement.
mobs.Description:
This is what all sentient lifeforms become at first when they die:
transparent, non-material manifestations of their former bodies. They
will stay that way, until their actions as live ones have been judged
and their final fate will be decided. Until then, they are unable to
feel emotions, since the presence of this phenomenon could affect saint
Petrus' final decision. In effect, most souls are wandering,
empty-headed ghosts without any goal that they know of themselves.

mobs.Name: informant old man
mobs.LongDescription: The old informant is trying to create some order in his paperwork.
mobs.Description:
This old man is obviously having a bad day. Somehow, all his papers were
mixed up and he accidentally sent a pope to Hell, while Attila was sent
to Heaven. Now he is desperatly trying to get everything right, so
please don't bother him, he doesn't have time for you at the moment. Oh,
and by the way - don't try to attack him. He is way too hard for you.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 swear;%10 sigh;%10 say Oh dangit! I'll never get these papers in order! Why can't they get me a computer or something?

mobs.Name: shopkeeper dresser old man
mobs.LongDescription: An old man is here to dress you up.
mobs.Description:
This old man is very similar to the one at the informations desk, except
that he is much less busy. He is having his little shop here and he is
quite pleased with his current existence. His long white beard goes well
with his white wings and dress, and he has a kind of fatherly look about
him. Oh, and by the way - don't try to attack him. He is way too hard
for you.

mobs.Name: saint petrus
mobs.LongDescription: Saint Petrus is judging your soul - and he doesn't like what he sees.
mobs.Description:
Saint Petrus is the guardian of the gates to Heaven, and he is to make
sure that only the souls of those who lived a worthy life may enter
Heaven itself. As you look into his eyes, you realize that he sees every
little secret that you are hiding within you. He obviously doesn't like
what he sees, because he won't open the gates for you. You guess Hell is
the place where you belong.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 say Begone, you heathen!;%5 say Ack, you miserable wreck of a living creature! I pity you!;%5 sigh

mobs.Name: saint george
mobs.LongDescription: Saint George ended up here in Heaven after his crusade.
mobs.Description:
George was once a noble and very powerful knight - and he still is,
although he has left his physical body. Still wearing (non-physical)
armor, he is now a proud officer in God's army. Hell will have much
trouble withstanding this fighter, who once slew a dragon with his
mighty lance.

mobs.Name: saint nicholas nicholaus
mobs.LongDescription: Saint Nicholas is walking around with a big sack full of loot.
mobs.Description:
Incredibly enough, saint Nicholas the thief got into Heaven after all.
But then again, being the patron saint of thieves includes more than
just stealing - this man helped many in his life, and good deeds are
worth more than evil ones. Especially his many gifts to the children of
the world made saint Petrus make up his mind.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile;%10 emote laughs a merry laugh.;%10 say Ho ho ho!

mobs.Name: saint sebastian
mobs.LongDescription: Saint Sebastian still has the scars from the arrows on his body.
mobs.Description:
Saint Sebastian was a christian who got himself into the roman army.
There he fed the christian prisoners and gave them water and hope. He
was discovered and executed - only he did not die. He later returned to
get his revenge. That was when he finally died, and he was made the
patron saint of archers, as a symbol of his execution, which he survived.

mobs.Name: arch angel gabriel
mobs.LongDescription: Gabriel the arch angel is waiting to recieve further orders from God.
mobs.Description:
Gabriel is the mightiest of the four arch angels. He is the right hand
of God and is generally working as a messanger to the people of Elite.
Gabriel will announce when the judgement day is here, and he also holds
the key to the  chamber of Death, the mightiest rider of the apocalypse.
You really shouldn't mess with this person.

mobs.Name: arch angel michael
mobs.LongDescription: Michael the arch angel is preparing God's army for an assault on Hell.
mobs.Description:
Michael is the second strongest of the arch angels, and the leader of
God's army. He is very mighty, and third in rank below only God and
Gabriel. He has been training how to fight and lead an army all his
existence, and he is very good at it. He holds the key to War, the
second of the horsemen of the Apocalypse and his own nemesis.

mobs.Name: arch angel raphael
mobs.LongDescription: Raphael the arch angel is teaching his priests the holy art of healing.
mobs.Description:
Raphael is the third of the arch angels, and the least violent one. He
has dedicated his existence to teaching and developing the arts of
healing, and he is the most skillful person in this area in existence.
He also holds the key to Pestilence, the third horseman of the
Apocalypse and his own sworn enemy. It will take a lot to make Raphael
use the key to unleash the nameless diseases Pestilence can create upon
Elite.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote utters the words 'pzar'.

mobs.Name: arch angel uriel
mobs.LongDescription: Uriel the arch angel is doing some heavy thinking.
mobs.Description:
Uriel the arch angel is a great scientist, and he is trying to reveal
the innermost secrets of the existence, the secrets that even God know
nothing about. In fact, God told him to try to reveal what happened at
God's creation. To complete this task, Uriel has gathered the most
brilliant dead minds to work for him. Uriel also holds the key to
Famine, the weakest horseman of the Apocalypse. He does this only
because he is the last arch angel, and Famine is the last horseman.
mobs.ActionScript: %%8 frown;%8 mumble;%8 scratch;%8 ponder

mobs.Name: moses
mobs.LongDescription: Moses is God's administrator nowadays.
mobs.Description:
Moses once led his people to triumph over Egypt's armies, away from
slavery. Now he is the general administrator of Heaven, taking care of
prayers, worships etc. A hard work, but Moses is very competent. He is
still carrying his staff and the stone tablets as a memory of the good
old times, when he still had the will to fight. Today, he is mostly
tired and just wishes to have a calm and trouble free existence.

mobs.Name: angel priest healer
mobs.LongDescription: An angel priest is learning the holy art of healing.
mobs.Description:
This angel chose to be a healer in Heaven. His duty is to heal the
wounded and cure the sick. His teacher is the best in existence, and the
priest hopes that he will be at least almost as good himself one day.
When it comes to fighting, however, he hates it and will only harm
another being in self-defense.

mobs.Name: angel priestess healer
mobs.LongDescription: An angel priestess is learning the holy art of healing.
mobs.Description:
This angel chose to be a healer in Heaven. Her duty is to heal the
wounded and cure the sick. Her teacher is the best in existence, she
hopes that she will be at least almost as good herself one day. When it
comes to fighting, however, she hates it and will only harm another
being in self-defense.

mobs.Name: lucifer fallen angel
mobs.LongDescription: Lucifer the fallen stares at you, with the rage of Hell in his eyes.
mobs.Description:
Lucifer was once God's most trusted associate and his most powerful arch
angel, but he wanted God's position for himself and wished to overthrow
his master. Because of this treason he is now banished for all eternity
from Heaven. His entire being is filled with bitterness and hate, and
these feelings affect his appearance; his skin is black, symbolizing his
heart, and his clothing is red, to remind of his rage.

mobs.Name: soul lost damned
mobs.LongDescription: A damned soul is trying to hang on to the edge of the Hole to Hell.
mobs.Description:
This poor soul has no future. He will be forced to enter the portal to
Hell, and after that, he will be reduced to nothing. Pain is the only
feeling he will experience, and his existence will be eternal. Forever
will his agony last, overseen and maintained by demons. Don't ever turn
out like this guy. If you want to be evil, then be careful not to die!
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 scream;%10 cry;%5 sob

mobs.Name: soul lost damned
mobs.LongDescription: A damned soul is walking the Path of Peril towards eternal damnation.
mobs.Description:
This poor soul has no future. He will be forced to enter the portal to
Hell, and after that, he will be reduced to nothing. Pain is the only
feeling he will experience, and his existence will be eternal. Forever
will his agony last, overseen and maintained by demons. Don't ever turn
out like this guy. If you want to be evil, then be careful not to die!
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 sob; %5 sniff;%5 cry

mobs.Name: angel old man fisher
mobs.LongDescription: An old man, or angel actually, is sitting here, fishing.
mobs.Description:
This old man flew his way up to this pond about five hundred years ago,
and he has been sitting here since. He likes fishing, and even though he
uses no bait or hook, the fish occasionally bites a hold onto the line,
so he gets a catch every ten years or so. Of course he throws them back
in the water as soon as he catches them. After all, he ain't going to
eat them.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile

mobs.Name: chemist angel
mobs.LongDescription: An angel with burnt hair and clothing is mixing something together.
mobs.Description:
The angel chemist has specialized himself on chemistry, mainly because
he happens to be a genius within that specific area. He is responsible
for most of the explosions in Heaven, but he also makes a lot of useful
discoveries. At the moment, he is trying to find out what makes hydrogen
so explosive when mixed with air.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 frown;%5 mumble;%5 scratch;%5 ponder;%5 emote does a mistake and his chemicals blow up in his face with a deafening boom!

mobs.Name: physicist angel
mobs.LongDescription: An old angel with a funny haircut is writing something down.
mobs.Description:
This angel seems to be a bit insane. His white hair looks like a
shrubbery, and he is constantly humming to himself. He is sitting down,
writing something on a piece of paper. He is obviously very smart, but,
as mentioned before, somewhat mad.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 laugh;%5 stand;%5 sit;%5 giggle;%5 emote suddenly stands up and yells 'Eureka!'

mobs.Name: magician angel
mobs.LongDescription: An angel is making some funny gestures with his hands.
mobs.Description:
This is the spell researcher in Heaven. He was a great arch mage in real
life, but one of his experiments failed and he blew himself up. Now he
continues his work by researching the nature of magic in the afterlife.
At the moment he is trying to find a way to resurrect dead people.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 frown;%5 mumble;%5 scratch;%5 ponder

mobs.Name: astrophysicist angel
mobs.LongDescription: Uriel's angel associate is trying to figure something astronomical out.
mobs.Description:
This is one of Uriel's personal assistants. He is working with the
universe and the nature of it, how it was created, by whom, when, what
it contains, how big it is etc etc. Not even God knows the answer to
these questions, but with the help of these brilliant minds, he soon
will, especially since he connected them all with his own.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 frown;%5 mumble;%5 scratch;%5 ponder

mobs.Name: angel scientist
mobs.LongDescription: An angel scientist is thinking about some scientific problem.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the really smart people in Heaven. He is a genius in some
area, and his mind is connected to God and all the other scientists. At
the moment he is trying to figure out a way to solve a problem which has
been nagging his mind for some time. This is really not a fighter, but
he can be a formidable opponent nevertheless.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 frown;%5 mumble;%5 scratch;%5 ponder

mobs.Name: old man librarian
mobs.LongDescription: The librarian, an old friendly man, is organizing the library.
mobs.Description:
This old man was the best librarian in the world when he was alive, so
God thought it would be nice to put him on this duty. The old man
approved, and so he was the librarian of Heaven. He keeps the library
nice and tidy, and he likes it. Otherwise, he is just a normal angel.

mobs.Name: death horseman rider apocalypse
mobs.LongDescription: #rDeath#N will reap your soul and crush your body!
mobs.Description:
#rDeath#N is the first and strongest of the riders of the Apocalypse. He
wears a dark cape that covers his whole body, except the hands and the
face, and he rides a black horse, hovering above the ground. His hands
are just bones, and  his face is just a skull with two glowing red
spheres where a normal human  would have eyes. With his scythe in his
hand, he will slaughter all souls on  earth when the judgement day
arrives!
mobs.ActionScript: %%40 emote laughs a wicked laugh.

mobs.Name: war rider horseman apocalypse
mobs.LongDescription: #RWar#N swings his axe. He thirsts for blood!
mobs.Description:
#RWar#N is the second strongest rider of the Apocalypse. His methods
kill fast and effectively. He is actually just an empty steel armor,
being magic enough to have its own counsiousness. He rides a large,
heavily armoured horse with fierce, red eyes, and his axe seems to be
powerful enough to cut a man in half.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 growl;%5 moan;%10 emote swings his axe in a wide circle above his head.

mobs.Name: pestilence rider horseman apocalypse
mobs.LongDescription: #GPestilence#N, the third horseman of the Apocalypse, reaches for you.
mobs.Description:
#GPestilence#N is the third strongest rider of the Apocalypse. His way
of killing might not be the fastest, but it sure is effective! Noone
knows how many poor creatures that have fallen under his painful way of
killing by infecting. As you look at him, you realize that he is nothing
but a big swarm of insects, forming an only vaguely humanoid, but very
solid, shape.

mobs.Name: famine rider horseman apocalypse
mobs.LongDescription: #wFamine#N tries to grab you with a bony hand!
mobs.Description:
Famine is the weakest of the riders of the Apocalypse. He might have
killed many, but his methods are, compared to his brothers', slow and
ineffective. He is also not as good a fighter as his brothers, since he
is but a skeleton, with no flesh or muscles. But still, this bony being
and his starving horse are formidable opponents to most.
mobs.ActionScript: %%30 emote laughs a wicked laugh.

mobs.Name: god
mobs.LongDescription: God the almighty is sitting on his throne in all his divinity.
mobs.Description:
God the almighty, all knowing and all judging has created this whole
world we live in. He is sitting here, in all his might and beauty,
giving those who are good a rich and happy life, and those who have sold
their soul to greed, hatred and other evil feelings a really lousy
existence. Of course, he knows what you are thinking, and he is waiting
for you to do your move.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile;%7 emote pats you on the head.;%5 sigh;%5 say Thou shalt not kill!;%5 say Thou shalt not steal!;%5 say Thou shalt honor thy father and thy mother!;%5 say Thou shalt not worship any god beside me!

mobs.Name: worker
mobs.LongDescription: A confused worker can't understand what his friends are saying.
mobs.Description:
This worker has a confused look on his face. He doesn't seem to
understand what is going on. For some reason, he has stopped building,
ust as everyone else. He tries to say something, but noone seems to
understand him. Just what has happened here?
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say Vad har h#<ae>nt? Varf#<oe>r #<ae>r det ingen som f#<oe>rst#<aa>r mig?;%10 scratch;%5 shrug;%5 frown

mobs.Name: worker
mobs.LongDescription: A confused worker can't understand what his friends are saying.
mobs.Description:
This worker has a confused look on his face. He doesn't seem to
understand what is going on. For some reason, he has stopped building,
just as everyone else. He tries to say something, but noone seems to
understand him. Just what has happened here?
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say Was ist passiert? Warum kann niemand mich verstehen?;%10 scratch;%5 shrug;%5 frown

mobs.Name: worker
mobs.LongDescription: A confused worker can't understand what his friends are saying.
mobs.Description:
This worker has a confused look on his face. He doesn't seem to
understand what is going on. For some reason, he has stopped building,
just as everyone else. He tries to say something, but noone seems to
understand him. Just what has happened here?
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say What is going on? Why doesn't anybody understand what I'm saying?;%10 scratch;%5 shrug;%5 frown

mobs.Name: worker
mobs.LongDescription: A confused worker can't understand what his friends are saying.
mobs.Description:
This worker has a confused look on his face. He doesn't seem to
understand what is going on. For some reason, he has stopped building,
just as everyone else. He tries to say something, but noone seems to
understand him. Just what has happened here?
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say Qu'est-ce que se passe? Pourquoi es-ce que je ne comprends rien?;%10 scratch;%5 shrug;%5 frown

mobs.Name: worker
mobs.LongDescription: A confused worker can't understand what his friends are saying.
mobs.Description:
This worker has a confused look on his face. He doesn't seem to
understand what is going on. For some reason, he has stopped building,
just as everyone else. He tries to say something, but noone seems to
understand him. Just what has happened here?
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say Blaczego nikt mnie nierozumie? Co sie dzieje?;%10 scratch;%5 shrug;%5 frown

mobs.Name: sainte lucia
mobs.LongDescription: Sainte Lucia walks around, enjoying the good weather.
mobs.Description:
Sainte Lucia is truly beautiful, in her white dress and the candles in
her hair. While alive, she brought food to christian prisoners. She held
the food in her hands, and because of that there was no way for her to
hold the candles so she made a small crown to give her light enough to
see. She took this crown with her to Heaven. Too bad she was executed.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile;%5 sigh;%5 stare

mobs.Name: worker
mobs.LongDescription: A confused worker can't understand what his friends are saying.
mobs.Description:
This worker has a confused look on his face. He doesn't seem to
understand what is going on. For some reason, he has stopped building,
just as everyone else. He tries to say something, but noone seems to
understand him. Just what has happened here?
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say Sta je zasto me nitko ne razumije? Pricaj bre srpsi da te ceo svet razume!;%10 scratch;%5 shrug;%5 frown

mobs.Name: Practice Dummy
mobs.LongDescription: a practice dummy stands here waiting to be hit.
mobs.Description:
You see a giant human sort of human shaped object with a picture of a
it comes back and bops you.  Ouch!  That smarted!

mobs.Name: Caretaker
mobs.LongDescription: a Caretaker putters around.
mobs.Description:
An old man seems to be puttering around cleaning this and polishing that.
He is dressed quite simply in a plain robe.

mobs.Name: Queuer bored
mobs.LongDescription: The Queuer is doing what he is best at, queueing!
mobs.Description:
The more than slightly bored queuer has not gone away yet, because he
knows that there is something inside worth waiting for. Could be a cold
beer, a hot meal or just another opportunity.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 sigh
;%10 say IS this queue ever going to start moving ?

mobs.Name: guard
mobs.LongDescription: The guard is blocking the door while he tries to look macho.
mobs.Description:
The door guard really seems to like his job, at least with the few
brain cells he seems to have stored away in his head for use on a very
special occasion somewhere else. But you better not mess with this one
cause he seems to like bullying you around all too much.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say YOU have got a VIP card ?
;%10 say ... and where are YOU going ???
;%10 say You just wait a bit here now.

mobs.Name: guard
mobs.LongDescription: A guard is here watching over the guests' clothing.
mobs.Description:
The guard in charge of clothes protection does not look that fit. He
is the only guard you have seen sitting on guard duty. But under the
surface gleams a mind skilled in the art of war.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say You forgot your ticket, oh no!
;%10 say No ticket - No Clothes
;%10 emote pokes around a bit in the wardrobe

mobs.Name: captain
mobs.LongDescription: The Captain of the Guards is here doing some paperwork.
mobs.Description:
The Captain of Guards is a most well renowned man. He has spent his
time in the army but after becoming bored with the continuous slaying of
monsters up in the mountain he was offered this position by Ma herself.
He could have won all awards on the walls around him if he just wanted.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say Asch now where did that paper go?
;%10 say What are you doing here. Get out !
;%10 emote flexes his big chunks of muscles a bit, impressive!
;%10 emote scrabbles something down on paper.

mobs.Name: Strolling Guard
mobs.LongDescription: The strolling guard is walking around to see if everthing is all right.
mobs.Description:
This guard is just trying to make you enjoy your presence to the
maximum. If there are any problems, he will be taking care of you.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 smile
;%10 say Hello, everything all right here ?
;%10 say Hello! Can I be of any service ?

mobs.Name: janitor
mobs.LongDescription: The Janitor is trying his best to be ignored.
mobs.Description:
The janitor is trying to be out of the way and not to be noticed. His
task is not the most fun but someone got to do it. It looks like he is
really good because you hardly notice how all junk around you disappear.
mobs.ActionScript: %%1 say Excuse me, Sir.

mobs.Name: lady ticket elf
mobs.LongDescription: The ticket selling woman has been here a while, a long while.
mobs.Description:
An old elven face, tainted by boredom meets you. She has been sitting
here for ages waiting for someone to buy a ticket. Her appearance seems
fragile but she looks well fed and in a rather good mood.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote shines a smile at you.
;%10 say Hello, Dancing or Free entrance ticket?
;%10 say Please, do not touch anything.

mobs.Name: monkey white
mobs.LongDescription: A small white faced monkey sits on the bardisk holding a sign
mobs.Description:
The monkey is most probably the pet of one of the bartenders. It is
not a very large monkey but just a bit more than a foot in length. The
fur is short and greyish-brownish all over except for the face where its
clear white. Give it a cookie and he wont eat your ears off.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 smile
;%10 snicker
;%20 emote tries to bonk you in the head with a tin cup.

mobs.Name: man bar hanger
mobs.LongDescription: A man, hanging at the bar, is desperately trying to get a beer for free.
mobs.Description:
If the bartenders all look alike, a typical bar person be twins of
triples or whatever number they are... Sunken eyes, fumbling for a
cigarette, desperately looking at anything in a skirt (even pics) and of
course with the standard 'a large beer' in front of themselves.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks at you.
;%10 say Hi Pal! Sit down and buy me a beer!
;%10 emote places a foot on the bar rail but misses awfully.
;%10 say Ho ! Bartender! I want a new beer. This old one is broken.
;%10 emote looks at the draft dreamily.

mobs.Name: drunk guest
mobs.LongDescription: A happy drunk male is trying to sit properly.
mobs.Description:
This one has been at it for a while. He looks red in his face and has
an even redder nose. You cannot be sure if he is looking at you or not
because his eyes are neither focused or directed in the same heading.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks at you or someone next to you.
;%10 say Hshello Pal! Wher chave you been ?
;%10 hic
;%3 drink firebreather
;%10 say You schtool my beer. *hick* Gimme a new one !
;%10 emote blinks in a desperate attempt to focus on anything.

mobs.Name: Lost desperate Joel
mobs.LongDescription: A desperate man is trying to get to the dinner without passing the bar.
mobs.Description:
Joel is expected. He is in a hurry. He has not the slightest idea
where he is. Well he knows he is inside the Ma Globs Dancing Parlor, but
there is ends. He is not giving up yet. He will come through. Someday...
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks very lost.
;%10 say Ehh, excuse me. Do you know where the restaurant is ?
;%10 sniff

mobs.Name: grand master waiter head
mobs.LongDescription: The head waiter tells you the restaurant is fully booked.
mobs.Description:
The Grand Master Waiter is a handsome man. Perhaps a bit old but
still stunning in his appearance. He moves around with grace and dignity
as if he were royal. He sure is treated like one, anything to get a good
table. He seems to have the power to make you execute his commands.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say What can I do for You ?
;%10 say Welcome! Games north, dance west and the bar east. Bye !
;%10 emote goes through his big book of reservations.
;%10 emote looks at you meaningly and says '...and...'

mobs.Name: croupier
mobs.LongDescription: The croupier is taking care of the game on the table in front of her.
mobs.Description:
Skilled, delicate, nimble fingered and making you lose again and
again, this girl is really good at what she do. But then Ma did not
hire her to lose. The eyes of the croupier reveal that she is very
concentrated on the game.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say place your bets !
;%10 say No glasses on the table.
;%10 emote snickers softly as she wins again.

mobs.Name: gambler
mobs.LongDescription: The gambler is not doing as well as he hoped.
mobs.Description:
The average gambler is slightly drunk, wants to winwinwin and usually
loses. Unfortunately for him, this one is not an exception. The lust
for gambling has become a slight mania and his obsession has screened
him off pretty much from the rest of the world (not beer or umbrella
drinks)
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say Double or Nothing!
;%10 say Here, give me some more tokens, I'll walk home.
;%10 emote searches though his pockets for his last golden coin.

mobs.Name: noble gambler
mobs.LongDescription: A Chemin de Fer gambler cares for just one thing, a stylish game.
mobs.Description:
The average gambler is slightly drunk, wants to winwinwin and usually
loses. This one is an exception. He has style. He got class. He will have
his martinis with the right length of toothpick penetrating the olive or
not at all.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say 'Card'
;%10 say 'Hold'
;%10 emote places a huge bunch of tokens as tip for the croupier.

mobs.Name: gambler

mobs.Name: ninja warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A Ninja Warrior is on a quest to slay the Emperor.
mobs.Description:
The person in front of you is a ninja. He has been trained from birth as
 an assassin and has no equal in this area. He is clad all in black and 
 only his dark eyes are visible through the small slit in his mask. He 
 whispers the word "Akukugara" and looks straight at you. A shiver runs 
 down your spine as a voice that seems to come from nowhere echos 
 "Prepare to die!".

mobs.Name: monk
mobs.LongDescription: A monk of the White Lotus has fled the temple
mobs.Description:
The man before you has a shaved head and wears loose fitting robes.
 He is a peaceful and religious man, a monk who is a member of the
 White Lotus. On his forearms he bares a tatoo of a Lotus Flower.
 His life has been spent practising martial arts to improve his
 self-control. You would be a fool to attack him as his temple has
 been destroyed by the minions of the Evil Daimyo and he is not happy!

mobs.Name: sumo wrestler
mobs.LongDescription: A Sumo wrestles to amuse the Emperor
mobs.Description:
This man is huge. He must weigh over 600 pounds! He is a sumo wrestler
 and one of the Emperor's champions. He is here to provide the Emperor
 with some amusement in these troubled times. You would not fare well
 in a fight against him, if he sat on you it would probably kill you!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 emote wrestles the sumo wrestler to the floor.;
%35 emote charges towards the sumo wrestler attempting to grab him.

mobs.Name: emperor nazaki
mobs.LongDescription: Emperor Nazaki sits here on his throne.
mobs.Description:
He is the Emperor of this peaceful land but of late there has been
 much trouble. The man who acts directly under him- the Daimyo, has
 rebelled and now controls evil forces which are bringing the Emperor's
 land to it's knees. A powerful man and a great ruler- it is a shame
 that this has happened.
mobs.ActionScript: %%30 cheer sumo;%50 say Why don't you join the fun?;%60 pat sumo

mobs.Name: rokoru kubi head
mobs.LongDescription: A disembodied head snaps its teeth at you.
mobs.Description:
Arrgghh, this is digusting. A human head has actually flown away from
 its corpse and is flying towards you! It is a Rokoru-Kubi an undead
 being, no doubt a direct result from it's slaughter by the Daimyo's
 legion of death. It snaps its teeth at you and attacks. It hasn't
 eaten for a while!

mobs.Name: bakemono goblin
mobs.LongDescription: A strange looking goblin eyes you curiously.

mobs.Name: o-bakemono o bakemono goblin
mobs.LongDescription: A huge goblin towers over you.
mobs.Description:
This is a huge goblin, larger that even an ogre or troll and much more
 dangerous. His green, scaly skin looks like it would act as good armour
 and his huge fists look dangerous.

mobs.Name: totate kumo spider trapdoor
mobs.LongDescription: A giant trapdoor spider leaps at you.

mobs.Name: ronin samurai
mobs.LongDescription: A samurai with no master wanders around here.

mobs.Name: samurai
mobs.LongDescription: The Emporer's Samurai searches for the source of evil.
mobs.Description:
The Emperor has sent the last of his troops on a desperate mission to
 destroy the Evil Daimyo. His power is growing and there have been tales
 of horrific beings living in the mountain regions. He has only one thought
 on his mind, and that is to destroy the Daimyo.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say We need your help to destroy the Daimyo!;%30 peer

mobs.Name: shura
mobs.LongDescription: The ghost of a former warrior drifts by.
mobs.Description:
The apparition before you is the ghost of a former warrior, maybe even one
 of the Emperor's own samurai. He has been raised from the dead by evil
 magic to fight on the side of the Daimyo and the Dai-Oni.

mobs.Name: nushi woman beautiful
mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful woman arouses you.
mobs.Description:
The gorgeous woman before you is actually a demon in human form. It has
 taken this form in order to seduce and then kill it's victims, so don't
 get any ideas about asking her for a date!
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 say Well, hello there. Have you got any plans for this evening?

mobs.Name: mukade worm
mobs.LongDescription: A huge glowing worm attempts to devour you.

mobs.Name: shadow demon
mobs.LongDescription: The Shadow Demon is eating your face.

mobs.Name: mantis preying demon
mobs.LongDescription: An enormous preying mantis is preying on you.
mobs.ActionScript: %%40 emote prays to the gods.

mobs.Name: ninja red
mobs.LongDescription: A Ninja with a red costume sneaks around.

mobs.Name: piper man
mobs.LongDescription: A small man plays melodies on a set of pipes.
mobs.Description:
The beautiful music you heard must have been played by this man. 
 He is a very skilled musician and has been asked to play to help 
 raise the morals of the Emperor's followers.
mobs.ActionScript: %%25 emote plays wonderful melodies on his pipes.

mobs.Name: gardener man
mobs.LongDescription: A small and wizened man tends the Emperor's garden.
mobs.Description:
This old man must have a very special skill. It appears as though an
 army of giants would be needed to tend this garden. Maybe he has magical
 skills.
mobs.ActionScript: %%25 emote trims the hedge.;%10 emote say Stay off the grass!

mobs.Name: kappa huge green being
mobs.LongDescription: A huge green being with a flat head bursts out of the water.
mobs.Description:
The being before you looks like a huge troll of some. Its flat head holds
 water which it needs to breath. The only way you will defeat it is by
 hitting it so much that the water spills from it's head.

mobs.Name: tiger white ornamental
mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful ornamental tiger sits here peacefully.

mobs.Name: daimyo evil
mobs.LongDescription: The evil Daimyo awaits news of the Emperor's destruction.
mobs.Description:
This is the man who has caused all the trouble here. The Emperor's
 lands are becoming infested with evil and all because of him! When 
 you look closely though, he dooen't appear to be anything other
 than a human, maybe a good fighter, but he would not have the 
 ability to control all these creatures...
mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 say So you have found me! Now prepare to die.
;%40 emote orders his Ninja to attack.

mobs.Name: dai-oni dai oni creature
mobs.LongDescription: The creature before you is the source of the Daimyo's power.
mobs.Description:
Ah, this would explain it. The Dai-Oni is a great demon from the spiritual
 planes of existence who has felt that the Emperor's benevolent rule
 was causing too much of a threat to all of the dark-minded creatures
 of the lands. He has come to put that right!

mobs.Name: shikome ape hairy
mobs.LongDescription: A weird, hairy ape-like creature runs at you.
mobs.ActionScript: %%30 growl

mobs.Name: kracken
mobs.LongDescription: The tentacles of a Kracken lunge at you.

mobs.Name: lion mountain
mobs.LongDescription: A large mountain lion paces about here.

mobs.Name: bruce lee shopkeeper
mobs.LongDescription: Bruce Lee is here cooking delights for you to sample.
mobs.Description:
They were right, Bruce Lee was not dead! All that happened was that by
 some temporal anomaly he was transported back in time and to these lands.
 Bored with acting, and with not much call for it in these parts, he 
 decided to turn his hand to the art of cookery and food preperation.
 In his spare time he teaches the troops the chinese art of Wing Chun
 and his own martial art- Jeet Kune Do.
mobs.ActionScript: %%50 emote shows his devastating martial arts skills.;%40 pose

mobs.Name: elf elven child m4601
mobs.LongDescription: An elven child is here playing around.
mobs.Description: The elven child looks very friendly.

mobs.Name: elf elven man m4602
mobs.LongDescription: An elf is here busy with his work.
mobs.Description:
The elven man seems to have lived for many thousands of years. He has long
dark hair and his ears are pointy.

mobs.Name: elf elven woman m4603
mobs.LongDescription: An elven woman is strolling around here.
mobs.Description:
The elven woman is very beautiful. She carries a basket with mushrooms and
she seems to be looking for someone.

mobs.Name: elf guard elven m4604
mobs.LongDescription: An elven guard is standing here patrolling the area.
mobs.Description:
The elven guard is armed with a long sword and a bow. He is very tall and
seems to know everybody passing by.

mobs.Name: orc scout m4605
mobs.LongDescription: An orcish scout is here searching for footprints.
mobs.Description:
The orcish scout is quite small. His skin is dark green and he is armoured
with a black mail shirt and a horned helmet.

mobs.Name: elven smith m4606
mobs.LongDescription: An elven smith is here working with a sword.
mobs.Description:
The elven smith is a very tall elf that has a scar cross his face. He looks
very determined with his work and he is covered with dust and sweat.

mobs.Name: innkeeper keeper m4607
mobs.LongDescription: The Innkeeper is standing here serving a meal to some elves.
mobs.Description:
The Innkeeper is a quite young elf with dark hair and silvery eyes. He is
carrying some jugs of beer and is clad with a leather vest and some
marvelous green pants.

mobs.Name: cook elven m4608
mobs.LongDescription: The elven cook is preparing some meals here.
mobs.Description:
The elven cook is young and seems quite inexperienced. He is about six
feet tall and is dressed in white.

mobs.Name: waitress elven m4609
mobs.LongDescription: A waitress is hurrying her way through the halls.
mobs.Description:
The waitress is VERY beautiful as she is clad in a silver shining dress.
She seems to have here mind somewhere else as she carries a meal to the
elven court.

mobs.Name: royal guard elven m4610
mobs.LongDescription: A royal elven guard is standing on his post watching for perils.
mobs.Description:
The royal elven guard looks very proud where he stands. He is clad in
shining armour and wields a silver longsword.

mobs.Name: ancient old one m4611
mobs.LongDescription: An ancient old elf is here telling stories of the past.
mobs.Description: He looks like a very old elf.

mobs.Name: monster prisoner creature m4612
mobs.LongDescription: A monster of hideous proportions is chained to the wall.
mobs.Description:
The monster is about four feet tall and is covered in old rags. He seems to
observe you as you look at him.

mobs.Name: beast monster horned m4613
mobs.LongDescription: A two-horned beast screams as he jumps up behind you.
mobs.Description:
The two-horned beast is 20 feet tall and is doesn't smell as anything you
have met before. He has no clothes but his skin seems very tough.

mobs.Name: queen galadriel woman m4614
mobs.LongDescription: The most beautiful woman you have ever seen is sitting here.
mobs.Description:
As you look on the elven queen Galadriel you feel that your nerves become
less tense. everything else in the world disappears for a moment as your
thoughts flicker away. She is clad in linen and she wears a golden crown
on her head.

mobs.Name: king elf celeborn m4615
mobs.ShortDescription: Celeborn, the King of the Elves
mobs.LongDescription: The king of the elves is resting here.
mobs.Description:
The king of the elves, Celeborn, is very handsome but yet his
face looks grim. He is clad in a shining mail and a long sword 
is placed beside him.

mobs.Name: elf listener
mobs.LongDescription: A young elf is sitting here enchanted by the stories of the elder.
mobs.Description:
The young elf seems to be far away over the shores in his minds. He is
clad in a leather jerkin.

mobs.Name: elf steward m4617
mobs.LongDescription: An elf is here looking over the boats.
mobs.Description:
The elven steward is tall, dark-haired and is clad in a grey cloak. He
looks quite busy mending a golden rudder from a ship.

mobs.Name: elf guard elven m4618
mobs.LongDescription: An elven guard is standing here patrolling the area.
mobs.Description:
The elven guard is armed with a long sword and a bow. He is very tall and
seems to know everybody passing by.

mobs.Name: royal guard elven m4619
mobs.LongDescription: A royal elven guard is standing on his post watching for perils.
mobs.Description:
The royal elven guard looks very proud where he stands. He is clad in
shining armour and wields a silver longsword.

mobs.Name: noname monster
mobs.LongDescription: The Noname Monster is waiting here for nothing.
mobs.Description: You see a dummy Monster.

mobs.Name: noname monster
mobs.LongDescription: The Noname Monster is waiting here for nothing.
mobs.Description: You see a dummy Monster.

mobs.Name: noname monster
mobs.LongDescription: The Noname Monster is waiting here for nothing.
mobs.Description: You see a dummy Monster.

mobs.Name: beholder
mobs.LongDescription: You meet a beholder's deadly gaze!
mobs.Description:
It has a large central eye that projects an anti-magic ray and ten
eyestalks atop the round body which can do anything from charm you
to disintegrate you.  Beholders are not known for their personality.

mobs.Name: lamia beast
mobs.LongDescription: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
mobs.Description:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the 
lower body of a four-legged beast.  She licks her lips as she looks 
at you greedily.

mobs.Name: mimic chest
mobs.LongDescription: A strong chest lies in one corner of the room.
mobs.Description:
A strong, wooden chest bound with iron straps and a heavy pad-lock on 
the front.

mobs.Name: mimic boulder
mobs.LongDescription: Two skeletons lie crushed under a large boulder.

mobs.Name: mimic floor
mobs.LongDescription: The stone floor of this house has been ripped apart.

mobs.Name: mimic pottery
mobs.LongDescription: Some broken shards of pottery lie strewn about the floor.

mobs.Name: mimic planks
mobs.LongDescription: A few wooden planks lie stacked on a low shelf.

mobs.Name: lizard horned
mobs.LongDescription: A small horned lizard flicks his tongue and slithers away.
mobs.Description: A cute little lizard -- that is, if you like reptiles!

mobs.Name: golem stone
mobs.LongDescription: In the corner you see a large, stone golem faithfully standing watch.
mobs.Description:
It is a big chunk of rock that has been magically formed into a giant 
stone creature.  He stands here still guarding the city.

mobs.Name: lamia beast
mobs.LongDescription: A strange lamia stares at you hungrily.
mobs.Description:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the 
lower body of a four-legged beast.  She licks her lips as she looks 
at you greedily.

mobs.Name: guard guardian
mobs.LongDescription: A Giant stone-like guardian in standing here.
mobs.Description:
This unmoving creature looks like a statue.  It is covered with dust.  Maybe it
is a statue?  Only one way to find out.

mobs.Name: guard guardian
mobs.LongDescription: A giant Guardian in the colors of the rainbow is here.
mobs.Description: It's mean, it's from blue to green, it's a fighting machine.

mobs.Name: guard guardian
mobs.LongDescription: The giant statue of the Guardian of Karma is standing here.
mobs.Description:
It's big and covered with moss and other small plants.  Seems to be very
ancient.

mobs.Name: joker gandalf
mobs.LongDescription: Gandalf is standing here, peering around and looking bewildered.
mobs.Description:
Yes!  It's Gandalf, that crazy IMM.  It seems that he is looking for 
Rasure, the love of his life.

mobs.Name: asp snake
mobs.LongDescription: A small, poisonous asp slithers over your feet.
mobs.Description:
The asp is a small, smooth-scaled snake the color of worn pottery.
The poison bite of this snake has felled many a mighty pharoah.

mobs.Name: cobra snake
mobs.LongDescription: A cobra snake rears up and opens its fearsome hood.
mobs.Description:
The cobra snake waves back and forth before you, its hood displaying brilliant
colors designed to serve notice to its prey that it is about to strike.

mobs.Name: mongoose
mobs.LongDescription: A small mongoose slinks along the ground, hunting snakes.
mobs.Description:
The mongoose is a wily rodent, a quick hunter of nasty poisonous snakes.
She sniffs you and appears to be looking for food in your hand.

mobs.Name: pyramid watcher
mobs.LongDescription: The pyramid watcher protects the tombs from intruders.
mobs.Description:
The pyramid watcher has made a pledge to destroy any would-be looters of
the tombs of the pharoahs.  He is clad from head to foot in utilitarian
sand-colored clothing.

mobs.Name: thief tomb
mobs.LongDescription: A sneaky tomb thief moves about in search of treasure.
mobs.Description: The thief brushes against you briefly, then slinks back into the shadows.

mobs.Name: ali baba thief
mobs.LongDescription: Ali Baba is here, hunting for the pharoah's tomb.
mobs.Description:
You see a tall, full-bearded man with a mischevious glint in his eye.  Ali Baba
has made his life from stealing things from others, including many items stolen
recently from under the nose of the hapless guardians of this pyramid.  Someday
he might get caught, but not today...

mobs.Name: magic carpet
mobs.LongDescription: A small woven carpet lies under your feet.
mobs.Description:
The carpet is simply beautiful, made from intricately woven silken material.  
It seems to rise up at the touch of your feet.  Wait, it is rising, a few feet
above the ground!  In fact, it seems to be ALIVE!

mobs.Name: mummy corpse
mobs.LongDescription: A mummy reaches for you, disturbed by your presence.
mobs.Description:
You only see the disfigured, rotting features of decaying human flesh,
animated by the distempered spirit of a long-deceased person.

mobs.Name: sand man sandman
mobs.LongDescription: A sandman rises up from the desert floor.
mobs.Description:
The sandman is exactly that -- some sort of strange being formed from the sands
of the desert floor.  It seems quite large and strong and at home in the heat
and sandy winds.

mobs.Name: efreeti efreet
mobs.LongDescription: The efreeti stands here, sheathed in a column of fire.
mobs.Description:
The efreeti is a mighty being formed from living fire.  He gazes down at you 
with disdain and scorn, arms folded across his mighty chest.

mobs.Name: caryatid column
mobs.LongDescription: A sandstone column stands here, carved into a feminine figure.
mobs.Description:
The column has been carved into a set of four shapely women, each facing
outward into the room.  The sandstone of the caryatid is smooth with age,
but you can still make out a deadly stone sword in the hands of each figure.

mobs.Name: djinn genie
mobs.LongDescription: The djinn issues forth from the confines of a small lamp.
mobs.Description:
The djinn is a mighty being formed from the air itself and frequently
imprisoned in a small lamp, used to do the bidding of those who find him.
He smiles down at you congenially, arms folded across his blue-tinged 
skin, and strokes his goatee.

mobs.Name: hieracosphinx sphinx
mobs.LongDescription: A hieracosphinx looks at you cunningly.
mobs.Description:
The hieracosphinx are cunning, small, but nasty creatures, having the heads
of birds, mighty wingspans, and a full set of four paws to rend their victims
to pieces.  They tend to be quite jealous of the sharper wits of their older
cousins.

mobs.Name: gynosphinx sphinx
mobs.LongDescription: A gynosphinx sits here, befuddled by a riddle.
mobs.Description:
The gynosphinx is a crafty but gentle creature, having the body of a
beautiful dark-skinned woman from the waist up, a feathery set of wings
and the hind legs of a mighty cat.  Right now she is confused, having 
just heard a puzzling riddle from a cousin criosphinx.

mobs.Name: criosphinx sphinx
mobs.LongDescription: A criosphinx calmly watches you.
mobs.Description:
The criosphinx is a calm and friendly creature, having the head of a ram atop
the body of a well-furred feline with eagle-like wings.  He delights in riddles
and in poking occasional fun at his easily confused lesser cousins.

mobs.Name: androsphinx sphinx
mobs.LongDescription: A mighty androsphinx tosses its lion-like mane.
mobs.Description:
The mighty androsphinx is a huge creature, with the body of a lion whose
face is quite man-like, perhaps even handsome, and a massive pair of feathered
wings. Tales are told of pharoahs that were rendered permanently deaf by the 
mighty roar of this sphinx.

mobs.Name: great sphinx
mobs.LongDescription: A mighty sphinx rests here in the sand, dormant now for centuries.
mobs.Description:
The great sphinx appears to be indestructible!
The great sphinx towers tens of feet above you, resting here in a state of 
dormancy.  It has become almost indistinguishable from the sand that surrounds
it, although you can still make out the features of the handsome face that once
advised many rulers.

mobs.Name: ramses mummy
mobs.LongDescription: You have awakened the mighty servant to the pharoahs, Ramses.
mobs.Description:
As your light spills over his face and body, you can see his features begin
to fill out, swell, and harden, until an apparently healthy man stands before
you, clad only in the raiments he was left in when he last slept.  His hair is
a soft black, his skin a deep chocolate, and his tall frame is totally still, 
his chest not even moving to breathe.

mobs.Name: elf archer
mobs.LongDescription: A Elven archer is hiding in the trees.
mobs.Description:
The elven archer is wearing green clothes making him disappear in
the vegetation. He points a bow with a nocked arrow at you.

mobs.Name: cow
mobs.LongDescription: A cow is standing here eating.
mobs.Description: The cow looks very well feed.

mobs.Name: horse
mobs.LongDescription: A horse is standing here.
mobs.Description: The horse look very well feed.

mobs.Name: deer
mobs.LongDescription: A deer is here eating from some bushes.
mobs.Description: The deer looks very peaceful.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 emote looks up and eyes you with suspicion.

mobs.Name: rabbit
mobs.LongDescription: A rabbit is jumping around here.
mobs.Description: The rabbit looks happy.

mobs.Name: wasp
mobs.LongDescription: A wasp is flying here.
mobs.Description: The wasp looks angry.

mobs.Name: badger
mobs.LongDescription: A badger is digging a hole here.
mobs.Description: The badger looks busy.

mobs.Name: snake
mobs.LongDescription: A green snake is slithering over the path here.
mobs.Description: The snake looks dangerous.

mobs.Name: black bear
mobs.LongDescription: A Black bear is resting here better leave it alone.
mobs.Description: The bear looks huge and very dangerous.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 snore

mobs.Name: huge spider
mobs.LongDescription: A huge spider drops down from above.
mobs.Description: The spider looks dangerous.

mobs.Name: highwayman man
mobs.LongDescription: A Highway man charges you from nowhere.
mobs.Description: The highway man grins wickedly.

mobs.Name: king welmar
mobs.LongDescription: The wise King Welmar sits here in his throne.
mobs.Description:
In his later middle-age, with his beard starting to grey, King Welmar is
still very powerfully built, and wouldn't take kindly to an attack.
Despite that, you know he is well-loved throughout the land, and has a
reputation as a wise and just ruler.

mobs.Name: ghost horrible
mobs.LongDescription: You hear a frightening wail, and see a horrible Ghost approaching.
mobs.Description: The Ghost is almost translucent, and looks really SCARY!

mobs.Name: jim guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Jim the Royal guard is here on duty.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Jim wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. He seems very well trained, and moves like an
experienced fighter.

mobs.Name: brian guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Brian the Royal guard is here, training with the Master.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Brian wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. He seems very well trained, and moves like an
experienced fighter.

mobs.Name: mick guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Mick the Royal guard is here, training with the Master.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Mick wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. He seems very well trained, and moves like an
experienced fighter.

mobs.Name: matt guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Matt the Royal guard is here on duty.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Matt wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. He seems very well trained, and moves like an
experienced fighter.

mobs.Name: jochem guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Jochem the Royal guard sits here, off duty.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Jochem wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. He seems very well trained, and moves like a fighter
who has seen more than one battle, and longs to see the next!

mobs.Name: anne guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Anne the Royal guard is here on duty.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Anne wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. She seems very well trained, and moves like a fighter
who has seen more than one battle, and longs to see the next!

mobs.Name: andrew guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Andrew the Royal guard is here on duty.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Andrew wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. He seems very well trained, and moves like a fighter
who has seen more than one battle, and longs to see the next!

mobs.Name: bertram bert guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Bertram the Royal guard is here on duty.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Bertram wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. He seems very well trained, and carries his scars
with pride. This guy seems tough...

mobs.Name: jeanette guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Jeanette the Royal guard is here on duty.
mobs.Description:
