As all members of the Guard, Jeanette wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. She seems very well trained, and carries her scars
with pride. This girl could be nasty if she wanted to...

mobs.Name: peter captain guard royal
mobs.ShortDescription: Peter, the Captain of the Royal guard
mobs.LongDescription: Peter, the Captain of the Royal guard, walks around inspecting.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Peter wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. Even though all the other guards seem well trained,
you realise none of them would stand a chance against this man in a
fight. He stands at least two metres tall, but still moves with an
almost feline grace. He actually radiates strength and confidence,
and you have to fight a sudden urge to come to attention as you see
him.

mobs.Name: master trainingmaster
mobs.LongDescription: The Training Master is here, supervising.
mobs.Description:
Aged, but experienced, the Training Master is skilled in the use
of virtually every weapon type invented by Man.

mobs.Name: herald royal
mobs.LongDescription: The Royal Herald is standing here.
mobs.Description:
This is a young, powerfully built man, whose primary function
is to make Royal Announcements.

mobs.Name: ergan murderer
mobs.LongDescription: Slumped in a corner you see Ergan, aka the Murderer of Townsbridge.
mobs.Description:
You remember a time almost a decade ago, when the news of the day
was how this man had slaughtered the entire population of the little
village of Townsbridge. He was imprisoned, and here he is: a shadow
of the undoubtedly great warrior he once was, but still to be reckoned
with.

mobs.Name: butler james
mobs.LongDescription: James the Butler is standing here, looking pompous.
mobs.Description:
The typical perfect butler: upper middle age, a bit bald and with 
an impressive belly.

mobs.Name: woman cleaning
mobs.LongDescription: There is a cleaning woman here, trying not be noticed.
mobs.Description: Although she has a menial job, she seems to like it.

mobs.Name: cockroach roach
mobs.LongDescription: A large Cockroach is crawling by the wall.
mobs.Description: Very large indeed, and they say cockroaches are hard to kill...

mobs.Name: astrologer
mobs.LongDescription: The Astrologer is sitting here, studying a book.
mobs.Description:
He is old and white-haired, with a long beard. As you see him, you
can almost believe the rumours about stars deciding Fate, and
that astrology is capable of seeing the future.

mobs.Name: tim guard lifeguard
mobs.LongDescription: Tim, the King's Lifeguard, is standing here.
mobs.Description:
This guy looks just like his twin, Tom. There seems to be no
doubt that he is completely prepared to give his life
for the King, if necessary.

mobs.Name: tom guard lifeguard
mobs.LongDescription: Tom, the King's Lifeguard, is standing here.
mobs.Description:
This guy looks just like his twin, Tim. There seems to be no
doubt that he is completely prepared to give his life
for the King, if necessary.

mobs.Name: chef cook
mobs.LongDescription: The Chef is here, shouting orders to the other cooks.
mobs.Description:
It seems he has been tasting his own food a bit too enthusiastically.
He is, in other words, a bit fat.

mobs.Name: cook
mobs.LongDescription: A junior cook makes himself busy stirring a pot.
mobs.Description: A junior cook, eager to do the Chef's bidding.

mobs.Name: david guard
mobs.LongDescription: David, a big, mean-looking man, stands here, guarding the door.
mobs.Description:
He really is big, and you get the feeling he wouldn't take kindly
to an attempt to get past him.

mobs.Name: dick guard
mobs.LongDescription: Dick, a big, mean-looking man, stands here, guarding the door.
mobs.Description:
He really is big, and you get the feeling he wouldn't take kindly
to an attempt to get past him.

mobs.Name: jerry guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Jerry the Royal guard is here off duty, playing dice.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Jerry wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. He seems very well trained, and moves like an
experienced fighter.

mobs.Name: michael guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Michael the Royal guard is here off duty, playing dice.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Michael wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. He seems very well trained, and moves like an
experienced fighter.

mobs.Name: hans guard royal
mobs.LongDescription: Hans the Royal guard is here on duty.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Hans wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. He seems very well trained, and moves like a fighter
who has seen more than one battle, and longs to see the next!

mobs.Name: boris guard royal m15029
mobs.LongDescription: Boris the Royal guard is here on duty.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Guard, Boris wears the chain mail required of
them as uniform. He seems very well trained, and carries his scars
with pride. This guy seems tough...

mobs.Name: Morianne queen m15030
mobs.LongDescription: Lovely Queen Morianne moves gracefully about the room.
mobs.Description:
The daughter of the Grand Mistress, the frightening witch who lives in a
Tower of Sorcery, Morianne has managed to avoid her mother's evil
habits.  She is as pure and lovely as her husband is good and wise.

mobs.Name: Petunia attendant lady lady-in-waiting m15031
mobs.LongDescription: Petunia the Queen's lady-in-waiting is helping her majesty.
mobs.Description:
As all members of the Queen's personal staff, Petunia is the quite
lovely daughter of one of the local nobles.  The Queen hopes to marry
her off soon, as her personality is quite grating.

mobs.Name: Pansy lady lady-in-waiting m15032
mobs.LongDescription: Pansy looks at you from eyes the color of crushed violets.
mobs.Description:
Pansy has a way of getting what she wants from the queen or, indeed, any
member of the court.  She is extremely beautiful, and appears quite
vulnerable.  In fact, of course, she is extremely strong.

mobs.Name: Tulip lady m15033
mobs.LongDescription: Tulip struts arrogantly about the room, stopping only at mirrors.
mobs.Description:
With long blond hair braided in the latest fashion to hit the court,
wearing only the latest and most costly of gowns, Tulip feels she is not
arrogant, just very aware of her place as the most eligible of the
ladies in waiting.

mobs.Name: m15034 sergei guard dungeon
mobs.LongDescription:
Sergei the dungeon guard stands here, seemingly watching everything
at once.
mobs.Description:
Although he never seems to move and inch he appears to be seeing
everything around him simultaneously.  For that matter, you can't
imagine anything could possibly move Sergei; he is easily one of
the largest men you have ever seen.  His armor is worn and dirty,
casting him as a huge black figure.  It's no wonder no one ever
escapes from this dungeon.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote watches you intently.

mobs.Name: m15035 nikolas guard dungeon
mobs.LongDescription:
Nikolas the dungeon guard stands here, seemingly watching everything
at once.
mobs.Description:
Although he never seems to move and inch he appears to be seeing
everything around him simultaneously.  For that matter, you can't
imagine anything could possibly move Nikolas; he is easily one of
the largest men you have ever seen.  His armor is worn and dirty,
casting him as a huge black figure.  It's no wonder no one ever
escapes from this dungeon.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote watches you intently.

mobs.Name: m15036 prisoner heretic reb'malim rebmalim
mobs.LongDescription: The moronic heretic named Reb'Malim stands here, stupidly.
mobs.Description:
This prisoner is guilty of heresy against the Gods, by using unethical
alchemy to reproduce gold and magical items.  At first you fear his
cunning, but when you look into his eyes, you realize that there isn't
much there...

mobs.Name: m15037 prisoner murderer jack
mobs.LongDescription: Jack, the cowardly murderer is huddled in the corner.
mobs.Description:
This prisoner is guilty of luring and murdering the young, innocent, and
inexperienced.  Have no mercy for this coward, for he deserves none.

mobs.Name: m15038 prisoner burnt bread toast
mobs.LongDescription: A heinous prisoner, known only as burnt bread stands here.
mobs.Description:
One of the dungeons many captives stands before you, smelling faintly of
stale, cooked bread.  His crimes are otherworldly and unspeakable...
Things mortal man were not meant to understand, yet he is so irritating
you would not dream of questioning his imprisonment.

mobs.Name: m15039 prisoner pedro alonso lopez
mobs.ShortDescription: Pedro Alonso Lopez, "Monster of the Andes"
mobs.LongDescription: Pedro Alonso Lopez stands here, planning future slayings.
mobs.Description:
Estimated at killing over three hundred young girls, Lopez's childhood
is marked by his mother's prostitution, molesting his sister, and
finally his own sodomy by a pedophile.  He is truly a product of his
environment.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 grin;%10 lick;%10 cackle

mobs.Name: m15040 prisoner sadist king henry lee lucas
mobs.LongDescription: Henry Lee Lucas stands here, day dreaming about animals and corpses.
mobs.Description:
Lucas's nickname of "Sadist King" doesn't even begin to describe his
depravity.  Guilty of many, many murders, he also took pleasure in
matricide, necrophilia, and bestiality.  Forever linked with his partner
in crime, Ottis Toole.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 headache;%10 mutter;%10 twitch

mobs.Name: m15041 prisoner ottis toole generalissimo pain
mobs.LongDescription: Ottis Toole, the deeply psychotic retard, stands here.
mobs.Description:
Ottis Toole complements his partner in crime, Henry Lee Lucas, perfectly.
He is a transvestite mass murderer with a taste for human flesh.  He
also claims to be a close associate of Jim Jones.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 drool;%10 twitch;%10 emote eyes you, hungrily.

mobs.Name: m15042 prisoner doctor holmes dr
mobs.LongDescription: Dr. Holmes stands here, contemplating your demise.
mobs.Description:
Dr. Holmes started his career as a medical student by stealing corpses
from his University.  He used insurance fraud to raise enough money to
construct a castle filled with torturous devices, which he later had to
torch to destroy evidence of his murders.

mobs.Name: higglebottom Mrs. housekeeper m15043
mobs.LongDescription: Mrs. Higglebottom, King Welmar's housekeeper, bustles about tidying up.
mobs.Description:
Mrs. Higglebottom is a short, round woman of indeterminate age.  Her
title is honorary, as there is nothing to indicate there was ever a Mr.
Higglebottom.  She seems to have been at the castle forever.  She makes
sure the cleaning ladies do their jobs properly and that the castle is
run in an orderly fashion.

mobs.Name: m15044 advisor Parassus
mobs.LongDescription: Parassus, the king's advisor, wears a strange insignia around his neck.
mobs.Description:
A tall, gaunt human with long, dark hair, high cheekbones, and deep blue
eyes that never quite meet yours, Parassus has been the king's advisor
since Nilrem mysteriously disappeared.  King Welmar relies on him
absolutely, seemingly oblivious to the advisor's occasional (hiss) and
his fiery explosions of temper.

mobs.Name: court mage m15045
mobs.LongDescription: The mage dressed in forest green peers out from under bushy white brows.
mobs.Description:
Thick snow white hair floats wildly about the tall, slender mage's head,
effectively hiding the gentle points of his ears.  As Chief Mage to His
Majesty, King Welmar, he is allowed, even expected to have his
eccentricities.  Nobody knows that his preference for green comes from
his secret alliance with his brethern in the Free the Elves foundation.

mobs.Name: priest court highpriest m15046
mobs.LongDescription:
Trained by the avatar at a small temple near Moria, the High 
Priest is feared.
mobs.Description:
If ever there were a warrior priest, this man fulfills the description.
He is the second son of a Duke of the Realm of King Welmar.  He is quite
tall, well over six and a half feet (over 2m), and as broad of shoulder
as a minotaur.  His high forehead leads to long thick brown hair, tied
back with a leather thong.  The priest watches carefully over the
spiritual health of the castle inhabitants, and is likely to order a
flogging of a miscreant.

mobs.Name: prisoner thief
mobs.LongDescription: A captured thief is imprisoned here, wishing for death.
mobs.Description:
Standing at about 5'8", this thief doesn't seem very dangerous at all.
Perhaps he was just stealing some food for his family.  Since he still
has one hand he probably was only caught once.

mobs.Name: prisoner peeping tom
mobs.LongDescription: A peeping Tom wanders around here, looking embarassed.
mobs.Description:
Even minor crimes of perversion are punishable by life imprisonment in
Welmar's domain.  You better keep your eyes to yourself.

mobs.Name: prisoner political
mobs.LongDescription: A political prisoner runs around, frustrated by his capture.
mobs.Description:
This young man's life came to an accelerated end after being foolish
enough to support one of Welmar's opponents.  Let this be a lesson to
all would-be fanatics, "Don't mess with the King."
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 jump;%10 scream

mobs.Name: man young travelling warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A young man hurries towards Midgaard, determined to become a warrior.
mobs.Description:
All his life he has dreamed of becoming a warrior, fighting dragons
and rescuing maidens in distress. Now he is off to Midgaard to make
his dreams come true!

mobs.Name: dispatch runner
mobs.LongDescription: A dispatch runner hurries along the road, to deliver important messages.
mobs.Description:
The key to ruling a kingdom is communication. King Welmars dispatch 
runners travel all over the world delivering his missives.

mobs.Name: child adventurous
mobs.LongDescription: An adventurous young child is looking for excitement.
mobs.Description:
This mischevious child has sneaked away to look for adventure. Who knows?
Perhaps she will find it?

mobs.Name: soldier patrolling
mobs.LongDescription: A soldier is patrolling this area.
mobs.Description:
This confident looking soldier patrols the road between Midgaard and
King Welmars castle, protecting people from bandits.

mobs.Name: mage wandering apprentice
mobs.LongDescription: An apprentice mage is wandering along the road.
mobs.Description:
The mage doesnt look very powerful. Her hat is not very pointy and her
robe has only got a few straggly looking stars on it. She hopes to find
a powerful master on her travels and become his apprentice.

mobs.Name: fairy cheeky druid
mobs.LongDescription: A cheeky fairy pokes her tongue out at you!
mobs.Description: How rude! But you guess she's just teasing.

mobs.Name: elf elven ranger
mobs.LongDescription: A willowy elven ranger looks about, ready to disappear into the forest.
mobs.Description:
In his dark green clothing, and carrying his bow, he looks ready to 
vanish into the forest at a moments notice.

mobs.Name: priest
mobs.LongDescription: An old priest limps slowly towards Midgaard
mobs.Description:
Dressed in ragged priests robes, and clutching a gnarled walking staff
the priest slowly makes his way home towards Midgaard.

mobs.Name: guard guardsman welmars royal
mobs.LongDescription: An armored guardsman marches purposefully towards Welmars Castle.
mobs.Description:
He marches with a self importantly towards King Welmars castle, watching
the forest on all sides for brigands and thieves.

mobs.Name: brigand robber revolutionary
mobs.LongDescription: A rough looking young brigand is startled by your arrival.
mobs.Description:
Surely too young to be away from home, this idealistic young revolutionary 
has run away to join Iram Ashmar's anti-monarchy revolution. It is not all 
living in the forest and eating bark you know, sometimes they have to run 
away from soldiers too.

mobs.Name: neb nvar n'var revolutionary leader brigand
mobs.LongDescription: Neb N'var, the leader of the revolution, tries to bring you to his cause.
mobs.Description:
A very charismatic man, with a sharp moustache and quick smile. He 
immediately tries to convince you to join his band with a rakish smile and 
the promise of glory and justice for the common people.

mobs.Name: goblin slave
mobs.LongDescription: A goblin slave lies here asleep.
mobs.Description: The defenseless goblin begs for mercy.

mobs.Name: Drow commoner
mobs.LongDescription: A drow commoner is here, walking around on guard duty.
mobs.Description: I doubt he is the type to give directions.

mobs.Name: drow noble warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A drow warrior noble stands here guarding his home.
mobs.Description: He looks kind of p.o.ed!

mobs.Name: drow noble mage
mobs.LongDescription: A drow mage noble is here protecting his home.
mobs.Description: The mage prepares to cast a spell...at you!!

mobs.Name: drow priestess
mobs.LongDescription: A drow priestess is here shouting orders.
mobs.Description: I wouldn't want go get on her bad side!

mobs.Name: drow master
mobs.LongDescription: A drow master stares at you angrily.
mobs.Description: The drow master is ALWAYS ready for a fight.

mobs.Name: drow weaponsmaster
mobs.LongDescription: A drow weaponsmaster is here shadow boxing.
mobs.Description: He definitely know his way around in combat.

mobs.Name: drow matron mother
mobs.LongDescription: The Matron Mother of the house is standing here.
mobs.Description: She looks really p.o.ed!!!!

mobs.Name: drow matron mother
mobs.LongDescription: The Matron Mother of the first house is waiting for you.
mobs.Description: She looks like she is about to rip your head of and eat it.

mobs.Name: yochlol
mobs.LongDescription: A yochlol forms out of a swirling mist...
mobs.Description: The yochlol is not in a good mood.

mobs.Name: dervish raggity
mobs.LongDescription: A raggity dervish walks on aimlessly.
mobs.Description: Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use some rest.

mobs.Name: dervish large
mobs.LongDescription: A large dervish watches for signs of trouble.
mobs.Description: Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use LOTS of rest.

mobs.Name: snake coral
mobs.LongDescription: A brightly colored snake slithers along the sands.
mobs.Description:
This relatively harmless snake has bright alternating bands of red, yellow
and black.

mobs.Name: scorpion small
mobs.LongDescription: A small, red scorpion scuttles away at your approach.
mobs.Description: The little tail is mighty dangerous for such a small creature.

mobs.Name: worm giant purple
mobs.LongDescription: A giant, purple sand worm thrusts up out of the sand and attacks!
mobs.Description: He's big, mean, and purple.  Watch out!

mobs.Name: dragon brass
mobs.LongDescription:
A very large brass dragon steps out of the darkness and says "Hello".
Then adds to it, "Prepare to die, have a nice day!"

mobs.Name: nomad leader
mobs.LongDescription: The nomad leader sits silently in prayer.
mobs.Description:
He is clad in silk robes lined with gold thread. At his side is a large,
engraved cutlass.  He has an especially haughty air about him.

mobs.Name: nomad commander
mobs.LongDescription: The nomad commander stands here staring at you suspiciously.
mobs.Description:
This is the nomad leader's second in command.  His clothes are richly woven
of silk and gold thread.  A nasty cutlass hangs at his side.

mobs.Name: nomad warrior
mobs.LongDescription: A proud nomad warrior stands here.

mobs.Name: slave young
mobs.LongDescription: A young slave sits here staring at you with pleading eyes.

mobs.Name: dracolich lich
mobs.LongDescription: A pile of bones rises up to form a skeletal dracolich.
mobs.Description:
The dracolich is now only bone with pieces of flesh hanging from it.
Obviously it no longer fears death.

mobs.Name: drider drow
mobs.LongDescription: The drider looks at you viciously while it draws its sword.
mobs.Description: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.

mobs.Name: duergar dark dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A duergar is here mining precious stones with his pick.
mobs.Description: The duergar could crush your head as easily as it does those rocks.

mobs.Name: myconoid
mobs.LongDescription: A myconoid lumbers along peacefully.
mobs.Description:
The myconoid looks something like a giant mushroom (and probably has the same
effect).

mobs.Name: myconoid shaman
mobs.LongDescription: A rather large myconoid stands here chanting in a strange tongue.
mobs.Description: The shaman shoots spores into the air.

mobs.Name: dustdigger
mobs.LongDescription: A small oasis invites you to dive in.

mobs.Name: camel rabid
mobs.LongDescription: A very dangerous rabid camel snorts at you.
mobs.Description: Don't mess with this animal.

mobs.Name: poor mudder
mobs.LongDescription: A poor mudder, lost in this place.
mobs.Description: You will become her if you are not careful.

mobs.Name: star
mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful white star smiles at you.
mobs.Description: You can't tell what the star looks like, it is too bright!

mobs.Name: nebula young
mobs.LongDescription: A young nebula, waiting to become a star.
mobs.Description: It hasn't got a definite shape, it is just a cloud of mist.

mobs.Name: comet speedy
mobs.LongDescription: A speedy comet is waiting to crush your head in.
mobs.Description: You see the offspring of Halley's comet, here just to wipe everything out.

mobs.Name: red supergiant
mobs.LongDescription: An enormous, red supergiant is forced to protect the galaxy.
mobs.Description:
You notice the giant is not as tough as his name sounds ...
Still he can be very powerful.

mobs.Name: white dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A tiny white dwarf is trying to sneak away from duty.
mobs.Description:
Like the red giant, he is also appointed to stand guard for the galaxy.
But somehow he manages to escape.  Though tiny, it can take a lot of hits!

mobs.Name: horsehead nebula
mobs.LongDescription: A huge nebula is here, resembling a horsehead.
mobs.Description:
You can only make out its shape from the darkness.  He was cursed to stay in
here and his face may never be seen by anyone again.

mobs.Name: andromeda
mobs.LongDescription: The poor Andromeda is chained to the wall, suffering ...
mobs.Description:
She was once a princess of beauty.  However, her beauty has led to a Goddess's
jealousy and she has to suffer here endlessly until Perseus comes.

mobs.Name: guardian shadow
mobs.LongDescription: A shadow guardian screams a challenge and attacks.
mobs.Description: It seems to be made of nothing more than darkness ...

mobs.Name: adventurer lost
mobs.LongDescription: An emaciated adventurer is here looking lost and hopeless.
mobs.Description:
He looks haggard and sickly; no doubt he's been lost here for quite 
some time.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 sigh

mobs.Name: dewey human
mobs.LongDescription: Dewey the Human SpellStudent
mobs.Description: Dewey says 'pardon me, have you seen a god on lately?'
mobs.ActionScript: %%15 say pardon me, have you seen a god on lately?

mobs.Name: golem huge
mobs.LongDescription: A huge diamond golem is standing guard here.
mobs.Description: It looks quite strong.

mobs.Name: mage young
mobs.LongDescription: A young mage wanders about, oblivious to all.
mobs.Description:
He seems to be contemplating life, love and the mysteries of the universe.
Then again, he may just have a headache.

mobs.Name: midori bartender
mobs.LongDescription: Midori is here levitating drinks to his customers.
mobs.Description: He looks rather harmless, but then again so does a sleeping dragon.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 say Have you heard about the strange hole in the forest.;
%20 say I have heard that the hole is the entrance way to Hell it self.

mobs.Name: willy slick
mobs.LongDescription: Slick Willy the wizard is here counting his earnings.
mobs.Description: Slick Willy smiles and shows you his pasty white thighs.
mobs.ActionScript: %%15 smile

mobs.Name: emerald cook
mobs.LongDescription: Emerald the cook is here stirring a large pot of something.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 say You have to wait for the dinner, as all others have to!

mobs.Name: assistant cook
mobs.LongDescription: The cook's assistant is here assisting the cook.

mobs.Name: prisoner
mobs.LongDescription: A prisoner is chained to the wall here.
mobs.Description:
Though his clothes are all in rags, you can see that at one time they must
have been fine garments. A metal muzzle has been fitted over the poor
wretch's mouth, whether to keep him from screaming, or to silence his spell
casting you cannot tell.

He looks quite mad, no doubt he's been mistreated horribly.
mobs.ActionScript: %%15 say Please help me!, my father will reward you.

mobs.Name: jailor
mobs.LongDescription: The Jailor is here enjoying a comfortable nap.
mobs.Description: He looks rather dirty.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 snore

mobs.Name: broom
mobs.LongDescription: A straw broom is here leaning against the wall.
mobs.Description: The broom screams 'Take that you lout!'

mobs.Name: hands pair
mobs.LongDescription: A pair of disembodied hands floats in the air here.
mobs.Description: The hands twitch with anticipation of strangling someone.

mobs.Name: eyes pair
mobs.LongDescription: A pair of disembodied eyes floats here glaring at you.
mobs.Description: The eyes smolder with hatred.

mobs.Name: mage visiting
mobs.LongDescription: A visiting mage is here snoring away in peaceful slumber.
mobs.Description: He looks quite sleepy.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 snore

mobs.Name: apprentice mage young magic user
mobs.LongDescription: A young apprentice magic user is here doing magical studies.
mobs.Description: She looks quite intent on her studies.

mobs.Name: apprentice mage young
mobs.LongDescription: A young apprentice is here mumbling words of magic to himself.
mobs.Description: He looks to be oblivious to all but the spell he is memorizing.

mobs.Name: apprentice mage young
mobs.LongDescription: A young apprentice is sleeping here.
mobs.Description: He seems to be dreaming.

mobs.Name: apprentice mage young
mobs.LongDescription: A young apprentice is here teasing a cornered kitten.
mobs.Description: He looks like a mischievous youth.

mobs.Name: kitten small
mobs.LongDescription: A small kitten is here meowing in terror.
mobs.Description:
The little ball of fur looks very unhappy.  Singed fur and a few minor burn
mark its mottled coat.

mobs.Name: student
mobs.LongDescription: A student of spells is here looking quite bored.
mobs.Description: The student yawns.

mobs.Name: instructor
mobs.LongDescription: The instructor screams at your interruption and attacks you.
mobs.Description: He looks quite angry at your interruption.

mobs.Name: student
mobs.LongDescription: A student of spells is here trying to master invisibility.
mobs.Description: He blinks in and out of existence, trying to master the spell.

mobs.Name: teacher
mobs.LongDescription: A spell teacher screams at your interruption and attacks.

mobs.Name: student
mobs.LongDescription: A student of spells has fallen asleep at her desk here.
mobs.Description: She looks to have collapsed from sheer boredom.

mobs.Name: wizard old
mobs.LongDescription: An old wizard is here making a speech
mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 say The key to be a succesful mage is wisdom.;
%20 say Times change quickly and you need to be prepared.

mobs.Name: mage young
mobs.LongDescription: A young mage is here learning hand to hand combat.

mobs.Name: mistress battle
mobs.LongDescription: The battle mistress is here teaching the fine uses of a dagger.
mobs.Description:
She looks quite rugged. In fact, she more resembles a warrior than a magic
user.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 say Try to fight like MEN, ok again.

mobs.Name: teacher
mobs.LongDescription: A spell teacher is here relaxing.

mobs.Name: wizard aged
mobs.LongDescription: An aged wizard is sleeping here.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 snore

mobs.Name: scribe
mobs.LongDescription: A scribe is here working on some manuscripts.

mobs.Name: scribe
mobs.LongDescription: A scribe is here working diligently on some translations.
mobs.Description:
She's quite cute.  Too bad her only interest seems to be the words of
lore she is translating.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 say Artsre is Talon?;
%20 think

mobs.Name: master scribe
mobs.LongDescription: The master scribe is here looking a little upset.
mobs.Description:
He seems to be so old, his skin has become nothing but a giant wrinkle.
The master scribe screams 'How dare you interrupt my important work???'

mobs.Name: assistant scribe
mobs.LongDescription: The scribe's assistant is here folding parchments.

mobs.Name: enchanter
mobs.LongDescription: The Enchanter is here placing a dweomer upon well made sword.

mobs.Name: sword
mobs.LongDescription: A well crafted sword lies on the work table here.
mobs.Description: It looks quite sharp.

mobs.Name: alchemist mad
mobs.LongDescription: The Mad Alchemist babbles something incomprehensible and attacks.
mobs.Description:
He looks like he's been quaffing too many potions. His eyes dart around
wildly, and he starts to drool.

The Mad Alchemist throws back his head and cackles with insane glee!

mobs.Name: summoner master
mobs.LongDescription: The master summoner is here holding gateways open to other planes.

mobs.Name: charmer master
mobs.LongDescription: The master charmer utters the words, 'enimerauoy'.
mobs.Description: The master charmer sizes you up, always looking for a new pet.

mobs.Name: golem
mobs.LongDescription: A wooden golem stands a silent vigil here, guarding the stairs.
mobs.Description: He looks flammable.

mobs.Name: cave giant
mobs.LongDescription:
The female cave giant, guards her home with the strength of ten
men.
mobs.Description:
Born and raised within the caves of the underground. This giant
carries a boulder as a weapon and has great skill in using it.
Although the weakest of the race it could easily crush a human's
skull.

mobs.Name: cave giant
mobs.LongDescription:
The male cave giant, guards his home with the strength of ten
men.
mobs.Description:
Born and raised within the caves of the underground. This giant
carries a boulder as a weapon and has great skill in using it.
Although the weakest of the race it could easily crush a humans
skull.

mobs.Name: stone giant
mobs.LongDescription: The stone giant stares at you with a gaze as hard as stone.
mobs.Description:
As its name describes this creature is made entirely of stone.
It's powerful rock form is capable of receiving and dealing an
immense amount of damage. As it stares at you the urge to run
grows intense.

mobs.Name: frost giant
mobs.LongDescription: The frost giant commands the power of the arctic winds.
mobs.Description:
Generally found in the frozen wastelands of Calldorn these
giants possess awesome powers of cold magic. Frost giants
have white ivory skin and yellow hair. These creatures are 
usually found wearing some type of battle armor and are a 
true spectacle to see if you live to tell about it.

mobs.Name: fire giant
mobs.LongDescription: The fire giant holds a giant flaming sphere from the depths of hell.
mobs.Description:
Straight from the gates of hell is where this being comes from. In
a territory war this giant was banished to outer lands. His skin is
a coal black and his hair is flame red. He usually carries a large
flaming sword as weapon of choice against his victims. If you are
smart you wont be one of those victims.

mobs.Name: cloud giant
mobs.LongDescription: The cloud giant drifts along upon the winds of destiny.
mobs.Description:
Perhaps one of the more peaceful of the race is the cloud giant.
This  being usually resides in great castles or atop high
mountains. Cloud giants have pale blue skin and silver hair and
are usually wearing some type of valuable jewelry. Dont let there
somewhat peaceful demeanor fool you though because the huge
spiked club they carry is definitely not used to protect the
innocent.

mobs.Name: snow wolf
mobs.LongDescription: The snow wolf of the frozen wasteland searches for its next kill.
mobs.Description:
This trained pet of the frost giants is anything but nice and
cuddly. The snow wolf has dark blue fur and dark green eyes.
With stealth and cunning this is more than a worthy adversary
for even the toughest of fighters.

mobs.Name: flare beast wolf
mobs.LongDescription: A giant wolf covered in flames howls in your direction.
mobs.Description:
This trained pet of the fire giants is also a former creature of hell.
The beasts fur is a bright red or white when covered in flame and
its eyes are jet black. This trusted guardian of the fire giants has
both the power and the skills to back up the title of guardian as
well.

mobs.Name: storm giant
mobs.LongDescription: The storm giant commands the forces of thunder and lightning.
mobs.Description:
Master of the forces of nature and the elements is the storm
giant. It has pale green skin and dark green hair. Its emerald
green eyes burn a hole right through you and if you dont have
your lightning protected equipment on I suggest you run.

mobs.Name: giant Atrolicus
mobs.LongDescription: The master of all giants awaits as the foolish mortals enter.
mobs.Description:
As with age and wisdom comes power and you can tell that this
giant  is truly a powerful being. Atrolicus wears a huge crown
covered in gems of every kind known to man and at his side
rests a huge golden scepter the length of a man. His eyes burn
fiery red as if to burn right through you. As you enter he speaks
"who dares enter my land without my permission shall face my
wrath." Perhaps it was a good day to stay at home.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 emote stands here pointing a lightning bolt at your head.;
%5 cackle;%10 insult player

mobs.Name: bob alchemist man
mobs.LongDescription: A very strange looking man toying with various mixtures.
mobs.Description:
A strange man toying with different mixtures and potions and
wearing bright orange robes. He seems to have mixed the wrong
combination a  few times as his room is in ruins. His origin is
unknown but if you had to guess you would say he is not quite
right in the head.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%45 emote dances around the room like a raving lunatic.;%10
cackle

mobs.Name: queen bee insect
mobs.LongDescription: A very large flying insect is guarding its territory.
mobs.Description:
This is perhaps one of the largest flying creatures you have ever
seen in your life. Its large black eyes seem to stare right through
you, daring you to make a move. The only thing you notice other
than that is the very large stinger getting ready to spear you.

mobs.Name: displacer beast cat
mobs.LongDescription: A large black cat with spiked tentacles waits for its next meal.
mobs.Description:
This large black panther like cat is very quick and very deadly. Its
four tentacles are capable of dealing massive damage to anyone
who isnt fully alert. If your in its lair perhaps you should think
about leaving real soon.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%25 growl;%10 snarl;%15 emote stares at you with a hunger
in its eyes.

mobs.Name: bolt wolf
mobs.LongDescription: A huge white wolf with glowing white eyes prowls the darkness.
mobs.Description:
Trained pet of the storm giants, these creatures possess the
same deadly skills with lightning as their masters. Bolt wolfs are
completely white in color and have white eyes the color of a
lightning bolt. Their skills with lightning combined with their
ability to see in any type of light make them a very deadly foe.

mobs.Name: giant octopus creature
mobs.LongDescription: A stange creature slowly crawls towards you using its eight arms.
mobs.Description:
One of the great masters of the ocean is this creature. Its huge
head is truly a sight to look at but what is more immediately
noticeable is the eight tentacled arms coming towards you. As it
slowly inches closer you start to realize now may be a good time
to leave.

mobs.Name: mutated prisoner human being
mobs.LongDescription: A very grossly disfigured being looks at you in pain.
mobs.Description:
As you look upon this poor tortured soul you realize that this is
the finished product of the giants torture devices. All that is left 
of this being that resembles a human is half of its face. As a matter
of fact you dont even know whether its a man or a woman. The being 
seems to have lost all sorts of reason and is attacking anyone or 
anything that comes near.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 moan;%20 sulk;%20 whine

mobs.Name: jonas dungeon keeper giant
mobs.LongDescription: A large giant wearing a necklace that says Jonas stares at you coldly.
mobs.Description:
Jonas is know well in this land as his role as dungeon keeper.
What exactly is a dungeon keeper?...well thats the guy who
watches the territory he is in for unwanted visitors and removes
them if you get my meaning. His trusty battle axe is more than
up to the job too. As you approach he demands "WHO GOES
THERE!" then as he realizes you shouldnt be here, prepares
to...remove...you.

mobs.Name: mountain giant
mobs.LongDescription: A very large giant blocks your path with a boulder.
mobs.Description:
This giant is very similar in appearance to their cousins the cave
giants. The only difference is that they are a little larger.
Mountain giants are also know for their immense strength, as
they like to target people with boulders from time to time.

mobs.Name: mountain giant commander
mobs.LongDescription: A giant with a boulder in one hand stares at you coldly.
mobs.Description:
These giants are born and raised in the mountains and well
skilled in combat there too. The high rank they wear on there
vest is earned and highly respected by the lesser giants. Using a
boulder as weapon of choice they are very deadly.

mobs.Name: storm giant commander
mobs.LongDescription: The storm giant commander conjures up the forces of nature.
mobs.Description:
Master of the forces of nature and the elements is the storm
giant. It has pale green skin and dark green hair. Its emerald
green eyes burn a hole right through you and if you dont have
your lightning protected equipment on I suggest you run.

mobs.Name: cloud giant commander
mobs.LongDescription: The cloud giant commander drifts along upon the winds of destiny.
mobs.Description:
Perhaps one of the more peaceful of the race is the cloud giant.
This being usually resides in great castles or atop high
mountains. Cloud giants have pale blue skin and silver hair and
are usually wearing some type of valuable jewelry. Dont let there
somewhat peaceful demeanor fool you though because the huge
spiked club they carry is definitely not used to protect the
innocent.

mobs.Name: fire giant commander
mobs.LongDescription: The fire giant commander glares at you with a fiery rage.
mobs.Description:
Straight from the gates of hell is where this being comes from. In
a territory war this giant was banished to outer lands. His skin is
a coal black and his hair is flame red. He usually carries a large
flaming sword as weapon of choice against his victims. If you are
smart you wont be one of those victims.

mobs.Name: frost giant commander
mobs.LongDescription: The frost giant commander wields the power of the arctic winds.
mobs.Description:
Generally found in the frozen wastelands of Calldorn these
giants possess awesome powers of cold magic. Frost giants
have white ivory skin and yellow hair. These creatures are 
usually found wearing some type of battle armor and are a 
true spectacle to see if you live to tell about it.

mobs.Name: stone giant commander
mobs.LongDescription: The stone giant commander commands the rocky caverns below.
mobs.Description:
As its name describes this creature is made entirely of stone.
It's powerful rock form is capable of receiving and dealing an
immense amount of damage. As it stares at you the urge to run
grows intense.

mobs.Name: warg vicious
mobs.LongDescription: A vicious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
mobs.Description:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.

mobs.Name: warg ferocious
mobs.LongDescription: A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
mobs.Description:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.

mobs.Name: wolf grey
mobs.LongDescription: A large, grey wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
mobs.Description: The large, grey wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.

mobs.Name: wolf black
mobs.LongDescription: A large, black wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
mobs.Description: The large, black wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.

mobs.Name: tree ancient
mobs.LongDescription: A huge, ancient tree towers above you.
mobs.Description:
Its roots are extremely big and large parts of them are above ground. Something
about it makes you think that this is not a normal oak tree.

>
The enormous grey trunk shivers slightly, as if sighing deeply.

mobs.Name: tree ancient
mobs.LongDescription: A huge, ancient tree towers above you.
mobs.Description:
Its roots are extremely big and large parts of them are above ground. Something
about it makes you think that this is not a normal oak tree.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 The enormous grey trunk emits a deep, moaning sound.

mobs.Name: dragon green
mobs.LongDescription: A huge green dragon is here, its narrow yellow eyes glowing with rage.
mobs.Description:
This enormous winged serpent has dark green scales covering most of its
colossal body.  Numerous holes in its heavy wings tell of many fights as does
the nicks in the horns on its head.  It smells as disgusting as only dragons
do.

mobs.Name: spider poisonous
mobs.LongDescription: A huge, poisonous spider is here.
mobs.Description:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a human crawling on all four.  It
has eight hairy legs that gives it a tremendous speed on almost any surface
and sharp poisonous fangs to paralyze or kill its prey.

mobs.Name: queen spider
mobs.LongDescription: The huge, bulky Queen Spider is here.
mobs.Description:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a small elephant.  It has eight
huge, hairy legs that would give it a tremendous speed on almost any surface
if it wasn't so immensely fat.  Its large, bulbous eyes stare back at you.

mobs.Name: shargugh brownie
mobs.LongDescription: Shargugh the Forest Brownie is here, grinning broadly at you.
mobs.Description:
This little fellow is only three foot tall with wild matted brown hair and long
tangled brown beard.  He wears ragged brown and green clothing and looks as if
he is having great fun.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 grin;%5 say Dont disturb the green dragon!

mobs.Name: elder druid
mobs.LongDescription: The elder druid is here.  He looks very upset about your presence in his home.
mobs.Description:
The druid looks quite old.  You would think of him as venerable but yet you
know he would be a tough foe.
mobs.ActionScript: %%15 say Get out of here!

mobs.Name: john lumberjack
mobs.LongDescription: John the Lumberjack is here, looking for some trees to chop down.
mobs.Description:
He is six feet tall and looks quite strong, muscles bulging under his heavy,
chequered shirt.  His features are worn with hard work and his expression is
one of a peaceful man leading a simple life.

mobs.Name: rabbit
mobs.LongDescription: A small rabbit is foraging in the bushes here.
mobs.Description: It is a small, furry creature with long ears and big feet.

mobs.Name: bear
mobs.LongDescription: A big, brown, angry-looking bear is here.
mobs.Description:
The bear is a big, brown, furry animal with very large claws and very sharp
teeth.  It doesn't resemble those cute little dolls from toy shops at all.

mobs.Name: rabbit
mobs.LongDescription: A ferocious rabbit is here, glaring hungrily at you.
mobs.Description:
This small, furry creature with long ears and big feet has been attacked by
the dreaded rabbit rabies, a horrible disease that turns helpless and innocent
rabbits into ferocious and bloodthirsty monsters.

mobs.Name: deer
mobs.LongDescription: A fallow deer is grazing peacefully here.
mobs.Description:
She is a graceful creature on long, slender legs, and with large, brown eyes
looking back at you with an air of watchful interest.

mobs.Name: fox
mobs.LongDescription: A brown fox is stalking rabbits through the underbrush here.
mobs.Description: It is a large fox with beautiful, red-brown fur and a long, thick bushy tail.

mobs.Name: bird large
mobs.LongDescription: A large bird with a broken wing has been cornered here.
mobs.Description: The bird isn't going to live much longer, by the looks of it.

mobs.Name: bobcat cat
mobs.LongDescription: A medium sized bobcat is stalking a bird here.
mobs.Description:
The bobcat has sharp claws and teeth, and will probably eat you instead of the
bird if you give it the chance.

mobs.Name: sparrow
mobs.LongDescription: A sparrow is flapping around by the ground.
mobs.Description: The sparrow looks like it is enjoying life.

mobs.Name: robin
mobs.LongDescription: A robin is hopping around looking for bugs to eat.
mobs.Description: The robin looks quite intent on finding a bug or worm to eat.

mobs.Name: squirrel
mobs.LongDescription: A squirrel is here seeking refuge in it's nest.
mobs.Description:
It peers out of it's next at you anxiously, seeming to plead silently with you
to leave it alone.

mobs.Name: badger
mobs.LongDescription: A furry brown badger is curled up under a log here.
mobs.Description:
The badger is slowly awakening and peering up at you from it's burrow. You know
that it won't be moving this slow for long.  It's sharp claws and teeth catch
your attention when you consider killing it.

mobs.Name: grey squirrel
mobs.LongDescription: A grey squirrel with a bushy tail is foraging for nuts here.
mobs.Description:
This happy creature seems to pay you no heed as it goes about it's search for
nuts among the leaves and twigs on the ground here.

mobs.Name: chipmunk
mobs.LongDescription: A small brown-red chipmunk dashes from tree to tree here.
mobs.Description:
The absolute zenith of hyperactivity, this small rodent seems to never tire of
running up, down, and around the trees in this area.  If you could ever catch
it, you imagine it would make an easy meal.

mobs.Name: crow black bird
mobs.LongDescription: A large black crow flits about here, picking at bits of carrion.
mobs.Description: The bird eyes you warily, but continues with it's meal.

mobs.Name: grotesque vulture
mobs.LongDescription: A grotesque vulture covered in blood and gore is here feeding madly.
mobs.Description:
It sickens you to even look at this foul bird.  Bits of dried gore stick to
it's beak, and unidentifiable organs hang from it's talons and feathers.  
It sees you and attacks, protecting it's horrible feast!

mobs.Name: buck deer
mobs.LongDescription: A young 5-point buck is drinking from the lake here.
mobs.Description:
This young male deer is drinking from the edge of the lake and watching you
warily.  His antlers are not full size yet, and will no doubt be quite 
impressive in a few years.

mobs.Name: fish
mobs.LongDescription: A fish is swimming just below the surface here.

mobs.Name: rabbit
mobs.ShortDescription: the ferocious killer rabbit, Guardian of the graal
mobs.LongDescription: A very innocent (*giggle*) rabbit is here, glaring hungrily at you.
mobs.Description:
This small, furry creature with long ears and big feet has been attacked by
the dreaded rabbit rabies, a horrible disease that turns helpless and innocent
rabbits into ferocious and bloodthirsty monsters. Not to mention that this
one seems a bit mutated.

mobs.Name: binder
mobs.LongDescription: The master spell binder is here re-charging a blackened wand.
mobs.Description: The master spell binder snarls at you and attacks.

mobs.Name: maker
mobs.LongDescription: The golem maker is here chiseling some stone.

mobs.Name: golem
mobs.LongDescription: A granite golem stands here waiting to do its master's bidding.
mobs.Description: It looks like a statue, until you see it shamble towards you.

mobs.Name: golem
mobs.LongDescription: A bronze golem stands here shining in the light.
mobs.Description: He looks rather dim witted.

mobs.Name: golem
mobs.LongDescription: A flesh golem stands guard here
mobs.Description:
It looks to be made of a potpourri of different body parts; some don't even
resemble anything human.

mobs.Name: golem
mobs.LongDescription: A cloth golem wanders around here.
mobs.Description: It looks like a bunch of old rags, quite surprising it can actually walk.

mobs.Name: golem
mobs.LongDescription: An adamantite golem stands here looking very dangerous.
mobs.Description:
It seems to be forged of dark metal.  It looks strong and durable,
but somewhat un-intelligent.

mobs.Name: golem
mobs.LongDescription: A clay golem stands guard here.

mobs.Name: master
mobs.LongDescription: An enormous multi-colored three-headed dragon growls at you.
mobs.Description:
The image of an ugly dragon flickers slightly, and where the dragon was
now stands a small harmless looking old man.

mobs.Name: master necromancer
mobs.LongDescription: The Master Necromancer is here raising undead servants
mobs.Description:
Attired all in black, the Necromancer is tall and gangly, but still quite
an imposing figure.  A dark cowl shrouds most of his face, but two blazing
embers which serve as eyes can be seen through the shadow.
The Necromancer shrieks some obscenities and orders his minions to attack.

mobs.Name: skeleton
mobs.LongDescription: An animated skeleton screams silently and attacks.
mobs.Description: It feels no pain, and hacks at you ruthlessly.

mobs.Name: giant
mobs.LongDescription: An undead giant lumbers towards you.

mobs.Name: witch
mobs.LongDescription: An ugly witch is here crying out secrets.
mobs.Description:
She has no face at all, just blank skin, rather disturbing.  From about where
her mouth should be, comes a disgusting giggling sound that makes your skin
crawl with revulsion.

mobs.Name: librarian conan
mobs.LongDescription: Conan the Librarian stares at you from his desk here.
mobs.Description:
He looks like a rather large and powerful man.
He grins and says, 'Don't you know the Dewey Decimal System??!'
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 say You need something?

mobs.Name: apprentice
mobs.LongDescription: The master's apprentice leaps to halt your passage.
mobs.Description:
A powerful wizard in his own right, the apprentice of the master of balance
has given up his station in the mage guild hierarchy in order to serve the
great master in hopes of gleaning secrets one could never hope to uncover
alone.

mobs.Name: cat
mobs.LongDescription: A grey cat is lounging lazily here.
mobs.Description:
The grey cat cocks an ear towards you, sensing your scrutiny, then purrs
contentedly.  It looks rather harmless, until you notice its very large 
claws.

mobs.Name: master
mobs.LongDescription: The master of Neutrality stands here contemplating the balance.
mobs.Description: He looks quite peaceful.
mobs.ActionScript: %%25 say Neutral is the way to be!

mobs.Name: apprentice
mobs.LongDescription: A black robed apprentice jumps from the shadows and attacks.
mobs.Description:
She bears a wicked looking scar down the side of her face, though once she
must have been beautiful, now the scar combined with what seems to be a
permanent scowl make her looks quite fearsome.

mobs.Name: cat
mobs.LongDescription: A black cat with its fur up hisses at you.
mobs.Description:
It looks both mean and dangerous.  Petting seems to be completely out of
the question.

mobs.Name: master
mobs.ShortDescription: the master of the black robes
mobs.LongDescription: The master of the black robes is here plotting vile deeds.
mobs.Description: The master glares at you.
mobs.ActionScript: %%25 say Dont disturb me!

mobs.Name: apprentice
mobs.LongDescription: A white robed apprentice screams at your desecration of goodness.
mobs.Description:
He looks like a fanatic.
The apprentice screams 'Thou art unworthy of this honor!'

mobs.Name: cat
mobs.LongDescription: A white cat is here preening its fur.
mobs.Description: It seems to be nothing more than a large ball of fluff with claws.

mobs.Name: master
mobs.LongDescription: The master of goodness is here frowning at your intrusion.
mobs.Description: He looks like a self-righteous bastard.
mobs.ActionScript: %%25 say The only way to greatness is goodness!

mobs.Name: cat
mobs.LongDescription: A large calico cat is here
mobs.Description:
It looks incredibly large for a cat, no doubt a giant of its species.
A beautiful jewel encrusted collar about its neck is its only adornment.

mobs.Name: mistress
mobs.LongDescription: The Grand Mistress of Magic is sitting here.
mobs.Description:
She looks quite comfortable on her emerald throne. Amazingly young and
pretty for one of such stature in the guild, no doubt she has kept her
youthful appearance through the use of strong magics.
The Grand Master pets her cat and smiles at you in confidence.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 say Welcome to your doom!;
%20 cackle;%20 grin;%20 say Leave or DIE!

mobs.Name: fury flaming
mobs.LongDescription: A Flaming Fury greets you with a torching smile
mobs.Description:
The flaming Fury are physical emotions of the gods rage
that has taken shape and now reside here within the gauntlet.
Its body is covered in flames that urges to burn your skin.

mobs.Name: fury flaming
mobs.LongDescription: A Flaming Fury greets you with a torching smile
mobs.Description:
The flaming furys are physical emotions of the gods rage
that has taken shape and now reside here within the gauntlet.
Its body is covered in flames that urges to burn your skin.

mobs.Name: fury flaming
mobs.LongDescription: A Flaming Fury greets you with a torching smile
mobs.Description:
The flaming furys are physical emotions of the gods rage
that has taken shape and now reside here within the gauntlet.
Its body is covered in flames that urges to burn your skin.

mobs.Name: red man
mobs.LongDescription: A man slightly shivers, standing within a reddish aura.
mobs.Description:
The light of the room vastly enhances the scaling of his skin.
Each scale glimmers and changes color from pearl white to ruby red
as he advances towards you.

mobs.Name: Zeppo devine artist
mobs.LongDescription: Zeppo devine artist is singing a praise to peace and tranquility.
mobs.Description:
Zeppo skips around you, pointing at your feet, bonking your
head and taunting you, this guy is really begging for it.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote utters the words 'pzar'.

mobs.Name: Groucho obidient
mobs.LongDescription: Groucho is so obidient that he can not take any more orders.
mobs.Description:
Is that a fake nose or what? The glasses are half melted over
is sootened nose and his cigar is filling the air with a stench
so abhorrent that you have to breathe through your ears to get
a remote gasp.

mobs.Name: Harpo blessed
mobs.LongDescription: Harpo is blessed with the most useful skilll in the world.
mobs.Description:
And he can not tell you...

Uriel
mobs.ActionScript: %%8 frown;%8 mumble;%8 scratch;%8 ponder

mobs.Name: Gloria
mobs.LongDescription: Gloria, Gloria, Gloria!  The salvation have come! And you to receive!
mobs.Description:
C'mon now, sing it folks, Gloria states. A voice crackling with
false notes and rhymes that doesnt match, how can you not oblige
it?

mobs.Name: mclarry speedfreak speed freak
mobs.LongDescription: A destined man have taken aim and is now rushing towards the wall.
mobs.Description:
Once a respected jockey, now reduced to a babbling idiot since he
fell off his horse one too many times. His face is mangled and his
voice is nasal, but hey, he used to be the fastest, so be gentle.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote grins and says 'Can I try your mount ?';
%10 emote whispers quietly 'I am the fastest there is, you know.'

mobs.Name: wall death
mobs.LongDescription: A flat death awaits the destiny of McLarry.
mobs.Description:
This is what ended McLarry's carreer, According to McLarry,
the walled attacked him. The wall seems totally indifferent
with the accsations. What do you think?

mobs.Name: Henry
mobs.LongDescription: Henry is crossdressing (and this do not mean mixing up fashionstatements)
mobs.Description:
Nice high heels, glorious legs in thin laced stockings, a nice teddy,
a pare of cherry red lips and a big furry mustache. Henry refuses to
look ordinary, and will commit his charms upon you.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote smiles and winks suggestivly at you.

mobs.Name: Morgan dresser assistant
mobs.LongDescription: Beware, beware! Morgan is coming short of new (and odd) underwear.
mobs.Description:
Morgan is Henry's dressing assistant, as Henry's short arms cant reach
all the odds ends of himself. While Henry is out for fun, Morgan cultivates
his collection of underwear.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 giggle;%2 say can I have your underwear when you are done?

mobs.Name: Evil dragon
mobs.LongDescription: >From head to tail, there is pure evil through this dragon.
mobs.Description:
Black and white scales intertwine to form a pattern of pure hatred
across the dragons torso. Fierce teeth glimmer in the darkness high
above you and you realize that you may have gone just a bit too far.

mobs.Name: Good dragon
mobs.LongDescription: >From wingtip to wingtip, the dragon is but utter goodness.
mobs.Description:
White scales are exhanged with hues of blue, magnificent as the
sky itself. This dragon seems to have understood the wisdom of
live and let live, but you can never be certain, can you ?

mobs.Name: Neutral dragon spectral
mobs.LongDescription: The spectral dragon of balance shimmers in all colours and none.
mobs.Description:
Not quite here, not quite anyplace really, this dragon is the perfect
match in hunters knowledge, predatorian instincts and wise decisions.
At least its colors suggest that it has lived for more then you wish
to find out.

mobs.Name: pentagon first grandmaster
mobs.LongDescription: The First member of the Pentagon is sceming up yet another evil plan.
mobs.Description:
Once just a mage, now a grandmaster of a secret order called
the pentagon. His long beard flows in the wind he just conjured up
and you expect to see bolts of lightning any second now.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say The Pentagon does not accept failure.

mobs.Name: pentagon second
mobs.LongDescription: The Second member of the Pentagon is waiting on the grandmaster.
mobs.Description:
As the grandmasters apprentice he knows he is also second in command
and will inherit the power when the grandmaster dies of his old age
or the poisons carefully placed in his food.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say The Pentagon will not show mercy.

mobs.Name: pentagon third
mobs.LongDescription: The Third member of the Pentagon is hiding in the shadows.
mobs.Description:
Trained to be a stealth assassin for his order, the pentagon,
he has now decided to turn against it forthe riches they store.
If the old leader dies, he might be able to sneak into the treasury.

mobs.Name: pentagon fourth
mobs.LongDescription: The Fourth member of the Pentagon is trying to gain power for himself.
mobs.Description:
Greed can be a large temptation and it seems that this pentagon
member has succumbed to it. He plots and plans for his own elevation
within the order aswell as the elimiation of the competition.

mobs.Name: pentagon Fifth
mobs.LongDescription: The Fifth member of the Pentagon is sceming up yet another evil plan.
mobs.Description:
The fifth member of the pentagon tried to reach the seat of power
but was cut off by the second in command. Since then he has been
nursing a strong hate towards the apprentice and just waits for a
chance to place a dagger in his back.

mobs.Name: vamp
mobs.LongDescription: The Vamp is trying to please her beloved genious.
mobs.Description:
Black soft velvet covers the vamps body, all to please her
genious lover while he invents new ways to improve or destroy
the world....

mobs.Name: Pilates instructor aerobics
mobs.LongDescription: Pilates, the grand intructor of slimming aerobics stands before you!
mobs.Description:
Dancing around, or something to the beat of a drum seems to have brought
extasy to this thing. Pink tights, curled socks and a tank top, and a
hideous headband, her flying in the wind, and a stench of body odours
emanate from her. EEEEW!

mobs.Name: Stepup stepuppp
mobs.LongDescription: The Queen of power movement roars out 'StepUppp'.
mobs.Description:
Stepping up, and stepping down from a single stair. My, where did this
thing come from? Why walk a stair that doesnt lead anywhere ? Maybe
you should end her suffering right here and now?

mobs.Name: ChiTai chi tai
mobs.LongDescription: ChiTai the Prince of slow movement, just try to ignore your speed.
mobs.Description:
Clad in a pyjamas, moving so slow it seems he is frozen in time,
this Tai-Chi instructor slowly (VERY SLOWLY) advances towards you.
Why not take a short nap and wait for his arrival ?
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 yawn;%20 say Slow circular movements, thats it.;
%15 emote seems to move at least an inch.

mobs.Name: four fabolous guitar player guitarplayer*
mobs.LongDescription: The mismatched guitarplayer tries to take a clean chord.
mobs.Description:
Zebra striped boots, plaid pants and spotted shirt. This thing is
an orgy in mismatching colors that hurts your eyes. On top of that
he is abusing his guitar to really bring up a headache.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 growl;%5 moan;%10 emote swings his guitar in a raunchy movement
around his pelvis.

mobs.Name: four fabolous singer*
mobs.LongDescription: The singer waves his hands in the air, starting the crowd.
mobs.Description:
With bat wings and a bat painted in his face, the singer starts
to slobber all over you (YUCK!). At least he has a somewhat descent
voice, but regrettably, not much else.
mobs.ActionScript: %%40 emote shouts 'All together now!

mobs.Name: four fabolous drummer
mobs.LongDescription: The drunk drummer is trying to hit the drums at least once.
mobs.Description:
The drummer waves his sticks about frantically, his tongue halfway
out of a tooth free mouth. The stench of mead is almost touchable
around this wild thing. Suddenly he throws his sticks into your
face and grabs another pair.

mobs.Name: four fabolous baseplayer base player
mobs.LongDescription: An idiot baseplayer is ignoring the note sheets.
mobs.Description:
Deaf as a pole, intelligent as a worm and as subtle as a brick.
The perfect base player in other words. Nothing can stop him
from playing the base as he wants, not even the other band members.
mobs.ActionScript: %%30 emote laughs a wicked laugh.

mobs.Name: triad member mage holy
mobs.LongDescription: The grand Mage of the Holy TRIad, watches you with great intense.
mobs.Description:
The grandmage snorts in contempt at your gaze. At least he knows
he trancends you by miles. His arrogant ways are what recruited
him into the TRIad in the first place.

mobs.Name: thief cleric holy triad member
mobs.LongDescription: There is no peace to the war this clergyman fights within himself.
mobs.Description:
Dressed in wide white garments this member of the TRIad seems
to have at least one ounce of goodness in him, his smile warms
the room and then he attacks.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 say We come in peace, KILL IT FAST!;
%20 smile;%20 dance;%20 say Welcome, now please leave us.

mobs.Name: helper holy triad warrior member
mobs.LongDescription: The warrior of the TRIad is sharpening his boar-spear
mobs.Description:
WHOA. This thing is having an allergic reaction or something.
he has bulges all over his body and displays muscles you didn't
know existed. His broad, leaf-bladed spear definetly looks like
it can do serious damage.

mobs.Name: Robin bird duo
mobs.LongDescription: Robin is the latest bird in the Dynamic Duo.
mobs.Description:
He really is one rocking robin, but was misplaced by a nanny from being
a common sparrow. You can clearly see his grey feathers beneath the
red paint. Gently cracking a note he tries to look casual.

mobs.Name: Bruce man duo
mobs.LongDescription: Bruce likes to dress up in tight leather outfits, Dynamic Duo, you bet!
mobs.Description:
Bruce was supposed to be the dark knight, but some old mummy down in that
small temple in Moria beat him too it, so he has to settle for second best,
at least for a little while longer. He only needs one kill to be number one.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 flex

mobs.Name: Slafs pro protectorate
mobs.LongDescription: Slafs is but one part of the Gauntlets final Protectorate.
mobs.Description:
Consisting of a puddle of slimy liquid cant be that easy, but Slafs
has managed this far. Green, brown and some other colors you cant
really name is floating around within his liquid body, aswell as
the last visitor.

mobs.Name: stomp pro protectorate
mobs.LongDescription: Stomp is adding more power to the final Protectorate of the Gauntlet.
mobs.Description:
Stomp really isnt much of a looker, but hey, his feet is large enough
to stomp you into the ground and past breaking point, best be you watch
your step around him, and maybe he will mind his.

mobs.Name: Schlurp pro protectorate
mobs.LongDescription: The Protectorates own protegee, Schlurp, want to suck your life out.
mobs.Description:
Gibbering and giggling he runs to you and asks, can I keep you?
Then he runs around screaming about some giant ant in his nose.
You nervously look at the surroundings for that ant of his.

mobs.Name: arti demon fallen
mobs.LongDescription: The old fallen, wants to feed you #rFIRE#N!
mobs.Description:
Once a nobody, now fallen from grace, he tries to lure people
down in despair to shorten his own eternal lifespan. The gods
has granted him 20 years off his sentance for each soul he
gives them.

mobs.Name: divine intervention mistress
mobs.LongDescription: The mistress, is really an act of higher divinity.
mobs.Description:
A sight for sore eyes. Pherhaps a little too much sight, but
you can definetly get used to it, oh if only you had time to
ogle it some more.

mobs.Name: anti mass
mobs.LongDescription: The AntiMass is very much anti to masses.
mobs.Description:
With his anti body he tried to destroy the world, but was trapped
by trickery and put here, to guard the gauntlet forever, to stop
intruders and to be a tough challenge.

mobs.Name: blob
mobs.LongDescription: The Blob is at the end of the Gauntlets food chain.
mobs.Description:
A blob, much like those that surround Midgaard, but 50 times
their size has taken up its residence here. Gelatinous slime
covers the coating and it stenches like a slaughterhouse on 
a hot summers day. Suddenly a slimy tentacle rushes forward
to grasp and burn your leg away with its acid touch.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 Emote tries to devour you.
;%10 Emote welcomes you, in its very own special way, as dinner.
;%10 rasp

mobs.Name: killer rabbit bunny
mobs.LongDescription: A cute little bunny hops around this place.
mobs.Description:
The little bunny looks soft and fluffy with long pointy ears, you'd 
like to take it in your arms and hug it tenderly.

mobs.Name: knight ni
mobs.LongDescription: The knights who say "Ni!" are standing here.
mobs.Description:
We are now no longer the Knights who say "Ni!"
We are now the Knights who say "ekky-ekky-ekky-ekky-z'Bang,
zoom-Boing, z'nourrrwringmm".
Therefore we must give you a test.
Firstly, you must find....
                  ANOTHER SHRUBBERY!!!!
THEN...Then, when you have found the shrubbery, you must place
it here, beside this shrubbery, only slightly higher, so we get
the two-level effect with a little path running down the middle.
Then, when you have found the shrubbery, you must cut down the
mightiest tree in the forest...
Wiiiiiiithh....   A HERRING!
mobs.ActionScript: %%25 say Ni!;%5 say Ekky-ekky-ekky-ekky-z'Bang, zooom-boing, z'nourrrwringmm!;%5 say Then, when you have found the shrubbery, you must cut down the mightiest tree in the forest...Wiiiithh....A HERRING!

mobs.Name: knight ni
mobs.LongDescription: The knights who say "Ni!" are standing here.
mobs.Description:
We are the keepers of the sacred words: Ni, Ping, and Nee-womm!
The knights who say "Ni" demand.... a sacrifice!
Ni!  Ni!  Ni!  Ni!  Ni!  Ni!  Ni!
We shall say "Ni!" to you... if you do not appease us.
We want......
                    A SHRUBBERY!!!!
Ni!   Ni!!  Ni!  Ni!
You must return here with a shrubbery... or else you will never
pass through this wood... alive.
One that looks nice.
And not too expensive.
Noowwww.... GO!
mobs.ActionScript: %%50 say Ni!;%5 say Ping!;%5 say Nee-womm!;%10 say We want...    A SHRUBBERY!!!!!

mobs.Name: brother maynard
mobs.LongDescription: Brother Maynard is standing here.
mobs.Description:
Armaments, chapter two, versus nine to twenty-one.
"And Saint Atila raised the hand grenade up high,
saying, 'Oh, Lord, bless this thy hand grenade that with it thou
mayest blow thy enemies to tiny bits, in thy mercy.' And the Lord
did grin, and people did feast upon the lambs, and sloths, and carp, 
and anchovies, and orangutans, and breakfast cereals, and fruits bats,
and large ..."
"And the Lord spake, saying, 'First shalt thou take out the Holy Pin.
Then, shalt thou count to three, no more, no less. Three shall be the
number thou count, and the number of the counting shalt be three.
Four shalt thou not count, nor either count thou two, excepting that
thou then proceed to three. Five is right out. Once the number three,
being the third number, be reached, then lobbest thou thy Holy Hand
Grenade of Antioch towards thou foe, who being naughty in my sight,
shall snuff it.'"
Amen.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 say And Saint Atila raised the hand grenade up on high, saying, "Oh Lord, bless this thy hand grenade that with it thou mayest blow thy enemies to tiny bits, in thy mercy.";%30 say And the Lord did grin, and people did feast upon the lambs, and sloth

s, and carp, and anchovies, and orangutans, and breakfast cereals, and fruit bats, and large ...;%5 say Amen.

mobs.Name: roger shrubber
mobs.LongDescription: Roger the Shrubber is here, selling shrubberies.
mobs.Description:
Shrubberies are my trade, I am a shrubber.
My name is Roger the Shrubber.
I arrange, design, and sell shrubberies.

mobs.Name: keeper bridge
mobs.ShortDescription: the keeper of the Bridge of Death
mobs.LongDescription: The keeper of the Bridge of Death stands here.
mobs.Description:
Stop!
Who would cross the Bridge of Death must answer me these questions
three, 'ere the other side he see.

mobs.Name: tim enchanter
mobs.LongDescription: Tim the Enchanter appears in front of you out of thin air.
mobs.Description:
To the north lies a cave -- the cave of Kyre Banorg -- wherein,
carved in mystic runes upon the very living rock, the last words
of Ulfin Bedweer of Regett proclaim the last resting place of
the most Holy Grail.
Follow! But follow only if ye be men of valor, for the entrance
to this cave is guarded by a creature so foul, so cruel that no
man yet has fought with it and lived! Bones of four fifty men lie
strewn about his lair. So, brave knights, if you do doubt your
courage or your strength, come no further, for death awaits you
all with nasty big pointy teeth.
mobs.ActionScript: %%25 emote points at a rock in the near distance that sudden explodes in a big blast!;%15 emote raises his staff as a big burst of flames blows from the end of his staff.;%10 steps out of a big explosion just in front of you.

mobs.Name: mightiest tree forest
mobs.ShortDescription: the mightiest tree in the forest
mobs.LongDescription: #GThe mightiest tree in the forest.#N
mobs.Description:
The tree looks very old and,
offcourse very mighty.

mobs.Name: spider young
mobs.LongDescription: The young spider is ballooning by you.
mobs.Description:
He looks freshly hatched and sprightly.  His young fangs are just
growing in as of late.

mobs.Name: dragon Yevaud
mobs.LongDescription: Yevaud the Usurper of Midgaard is here, grinning evilly at you.
mobs.Description: Old, scaly, but still with a lot of bite in him left.
mobs.ActionScript: %1 l; %10 emote sets a small bush to fire.

mobs.Name: spider wolf
mobs.LongDescription: The Wolf Spider is here, licking its bloody fangs.
mobs.Description: The Wolf Spider is hairy, very hairy.

mobs.Name: orc
mobs.LongDescription: The orc is stuck in the web and he can't get out.
mobs.Description:
You notice an evil look in his eyes, but he seems quite drained of life, and
all he can do is glare at you while he's stuck in this web.

mobs.Name: wasp queen
mobs.LongDescription: The Queen Wasp is here, thinking how tasty you look.
mobs.Description: You notice a glazed look in her eyes.

mobs.Name: spider drone
mobs.LongDescription: A drone spider walks around doing its master's bidding.
mobs.Description: An ordinary drone spider.

mobs.Name: spider ethereal
mobs.LongDescription: An ethereal spider strides here, traveling to different worlds.
mobs.Description:
She winks in and out of reality.  It looks like it'd be difficult to hit her
without a magickal weapon.
mobs.ActionScript: %1 l;%20 emote fades into existence, but disapears again.

mobs.Name: slave human
mobs.LongDescription: A human slave of Arachnos works here relentlessly.
mobs.Description:
The slave does not mind you, but will fight like a warrior if attacked.  He
serves the spider Empress, Arachnos, though whether it is by choice or because
he was beguiled you are not fully certain.

mobs.Name: quasit
mobs.LongDescription: A quasit blinks in and out, grinning at you.
mobs.Description:
Demoniac in nature, but more mischievous.  He twiddles his thumbs
and creates a magickal treasure!

mobs.Name: spider bird
mobs.LongDescription: The Bird Spider snaps its powerful jaws.
mobs.Description: The Bird Spider has very powerful jaws.

mobs.Name: hermit
mobs.LongDescription: The Hermit sits here and warns, "Go back before it's too late!"
mobs.Description:
A dishevelled veteran warrior in disguise is what he is, but he
means well.

mobs.Name: donjonkeeper
mobs.LongDescription: The Donjonkeeper eyes you and wonders how pure your soul is.
mobs.Description:
He delves deeper into you as you stare at him.  Only those free of taint will
be allowed to remain here safely.

mobs.Name: guardian
mobs.LongDescription: The guardian is obviously not doing his job.
mobs.Description: He looks like a lazy bum who sleeps half the time.

mobs.Name: spider empress arachnos
mobs.LongDescription: Arachnos the Empress of Spiders welcomes you with an evil smile.
mobs.Description:
She is a very attractive spider with an ornate gown.  She tempts you
into being one of her many slaves.  She does not possess the venomous
fangs of normal spiders, but then, as you realize, she does not need
them.

mobs.Name: ki-rin
mobs.LongDescription: The Ki-Rin smiles good-naturedly to you.
mobs.Description:
She is the last bastion of good in this realm.  Her mission is to
someday free the slaves of the Empress.  She has been trapped here for
time eternal, and now the evil power of Arachnos feeds upon her intense
magickal energies.  She will never give up here fight against evil, though,
and will continue her work in whatever manner presents itself.

mobs.Name: dragon wormkin young
mobs.LongDescription: A wormkin with no teeth plays here.
mobs.Description: It is a rather small dragon, and you almost feel sad in killing it.

mobs.Name: dragon wormkin elder
mobs.LongDescription: A wormkin that has grown a bit stares at you inquisitively.
mobs.Description:
A medium-sized dragon -- seems it hasn't killed anything yet by itself, 
though there is a first time for everything...

mobs.Name: goat mountain
mobs.LongDescription: A mountain goat nibbles at a piece of grass here.
mobs.Description:
This goat is acclimated to the rugged terrain of the mountains.  It looks at
you and shies away a little.

mobs.Name: demon decay
mobs.LongDescription: A cloaked and clawed demon of decay comes at you viciously!
mobs.Description:
This demon has pure malevolence for anything living.  Oops!  You're living!
I guess that means you!

mobs.Name: book monster guardian
mobs.LongDescription: A mound of books rise up into a human shape and tries to hit you!
mobs.Description: Ironically enough, the book-monster's head is War and Peace.  Hmm.

mobs.Name: bad feeling
mobs.LongDescription: A bad feeling chokes your throat.
mobs.Description:
It resembles a lot of other bad feelings you've had, but a lot more
tangible....magic?

mobs.Name: nightmare
mobs.LongDescription: Your worst nightmare coalesces in front of you and attacks!
mobs.Description:
It looks like you deepest, darkest fears personified.  Wait a minute!  It IS
your deepest, darkest fears personified!

mobs.Name: guardian
mobs.LongDescription: A guardian guards the door.  It looks at you and attacks!
mobs.Description: The guardian guards the door.  That's about all its brain can handle: guarding.

mobs.Name: citizen minotaur
mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur citizen is here, hurrying through streets.
mobs.Description:
You see a rather ragged minotaur. It appears that it is in too much of a hurry
to stop and chat.

mobs.Name: guard minotaur
mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur guard patrols the area.
mobs.Description: This minotaur is not too happy at your appearance in his beloved city.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 whistle; %5 : looks around for troublemakers.

mobs.Name: warrior minotaur
mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur warrior is here looking for trouble.
mobs.Description:
You see a huge, musclebound minotaur that is covered in blood. The very sight
of him makes you cringe in terror.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 : grunts.

mobs.Name: minotaur gatekeeper
mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur is here guarding the Keep of Minotaurs.
mobs.Description:
The minotaur stands rigidly before the gates of the keep. It looks 
quite miserable, but then again with the recent layoffs and the lousy 
health benefents, so would you.

mobs.Name: minotaur high guard
mobs.LongDescription: The high minotaur guard is here guarding the Keep.
mobs.Description:
The high guard is dressed in glittering armor. She looks quite dangerous and
skilled.

mobs.Name: minotaur royal guard
mobs.LongDescription: The royal minotaur guard orders you to leave at once.
mobs.Description:
The royal guard is quite huge. He is dressed in magnicifant armor.  He does not
like pests.

mobs.Name: guard minotaur elite
mobs.LongDescription: The elite minotaur guard watches your every move.
mobs.Description: This minotaur does not look like the talkative type, better leave him alone.

mobs.Name: girl haremgirl harem slave
mobs.LongDescription: A harem girl cowers here in fear.
mobs.Description:
She looks quite attractive. Her low cut gown reveals why she was chosen to be
in the harem.

mobs.Name: butler minotaur
mobs.LongDescription: A minotaur butler stands here rigidly, awaiting orders.
mobs.Description: He looks quite regal and refined to be a minotaur.

mobs.Name: keeper minotaur keymaster
mobs.LongDescription: The Minotaur Keymaster stands guarding his post.
mobs.Description: He looks mean......what more is there to say?

mobs.Name: aegithus minotaur warrior
mobs.LongDescription: Aegithus, the Minotaur Warrior, is here practicing his skills.
mobs.Description: Aegithus is HUGE. His muscles are bigger than you!

mobs.Name: pythian minotaur mage
mobs.LongDescription: Pythian, the Minotaur Mage, stands here grinning wickedly.
mobs.Description:
Pythian is a living incarnation of evil. He radiates a dark aura, and 
a cold chill runs down your spine.

mobs.Name: creon minotaur cleric
mobs.LongDescription: Creon, the Minotaur Cleric, is here worshipping silently.
mobs.Description:
Creon is the minotaur incarnation of good. You feel safe and at ease in 
his presence.

mobs.Name: haemon minotaur mage
