the glade.  The branches are thick and strong, with many small branches
leading off each larger one.  The tree is covered with dark green
leaves, large and soft, and large pink and white blossoms.  The
fragrance from the blossoms is sweet, enticing.  The tree's bark is a
deep brown, with deep vertical wavy ridges.  Touching the tree fills
you with a sense of peace.

mobs.Name: mudsucker fish
mobs.LongDescription: This mudsucker swallows easy prey along the bottom of the lake.
mobs.Description:
The mudsucker is a sandy shade of brown, perfect for blending into her
surroundings.  A long, rounded fish with strangely glowing golden eyes,
the mudsucker moves slowly and as little as possible preferring instead
to wait for her prey to swim close to her.  She opens her mouth as you
swim by, perhaps hoping you will simply swim in?
mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 emote opens her many-toothed mouth wide, waiting for you to swim 
into her maw.

mobs.Name: bullywug
mobs.LongDescription: The bullywug's bulging golden eyes focus suddenly on you!
mobs.Description:
The bullywug reminds you of a frog, except you've never seen a frog
quite this big!  His skin is greenish - like a frog, and smooth except
for the occasional wart.  His hind legs are long and strong and
powerful.  His face gives no clue  to his thoughts - if indeed he has
any.  Suddenly his huge rim of a mouth opens and a long, pink,
snakelike tongue whips out and pulls an enormous insect into his maw.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%05 say Ribbit!;%05 emote whips another insect into her mouth with her 
long pink tongue.

mobs.Name: stickleback
mobs.LongDescription: The stickleback will defend his nest to the death (yours).
mobs.Description:
This stickleback is not a huge fish, but what he lacks in size he makes
up for in determination and intensity ... that and natural defenses.
His back is covered with sharp thorny spines that look like they might
hurt if you got too close.  His belly is a beautiful bright red, so you
know he's guarding his nest.  Sticklebacks are known to fight fish
several times their size - and win.  You hope he realizes that you are
NOT a fish and NO threat to his babies!

mobs.Name: mudskipper
mobs.LongDescription: Mr. Mudskipper skips toward you, mouth open to take a big bite!
mobs.Description:
The mudskipper looks a little like a long, thick snake with tentacles.
Comfortable in or out of water, he will merrily chase you wherever you
go.  His grey/green color blends in well with the weeds at the bottom
of this enormous lake, so watch out for him!

mobs.Name: lamprey eel
mobs.LongDescription: The lamprey eel attaches itself to you like an extra arm.
mobs.Description:
The lamprey looks like a long thick tube.  This one is about 40" long
(100cm).  It has a large round mouth lined with sharp thorny teeth that
it would like to use to attach itself to you.  "It is so much nicer if
your food provides you with locomotion and all you have to do is hang
on and suck", it thinks.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 emote sucks out all your life juices as it eats your flesh.

mobs.Name: bass fish
mobs.LongDescription: The large, wide-mouthed bass works his jaw up and down slowly.
mobs.Description:
The silver green bass swims in and out of the shadows, silently opening
and shutting its very large mouth, looking hungrily at you.  The bass
is covered in thick green and silver scales, and he propels himself
through the water by means of his powerful fins and his long, muscular
body.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 emote practices to take his first bite out of you.

mobs.Name: catfish fish
mobs.LongDescription: The catfish stares at you, unblinking, twirling his long wispy feelers.
mobs.Description:
The deep blue-green of this catfish tends to make him blend into the
deep blue-green of the lake.  The long, trailing feelers on each side
of his mouth give him the appearance of a wise, old elf, however he is
neither wise nor old, but he IS hungry ...

mobs.Name: carp fish
mobs.LongDescription: The ancient carp is gobbling up everything in its path.
mobs.Description:
This old carp has been living on the bottom of the lake for over a
century eating plants, insects, other fish and adventurers who look
like fish.  He has a blunt nose and a small, thick-lipped mouth, with 2
pairs of feelers dangling from his upper lip.   He has a wide, heavy
body covered with large scales.  He is olive green on back and his
sides are a dusky gold, his belly a bright yellow.

mobs.Name: fiddler crab
mobs.LongDescription: The fiddler crab plays a jaunty tune on his fiddle, luring you closer.
mobs.Description:
The fiddler crab has two long sharp claws that he manipulates with
amazing dexterity.  He plays happy songs on his fiddle, hoping you will
be distracted by the music and dance right into his claws.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote breaks in to a wild song on his fiddle.

mobs.Name: novice monk
mobs.LongDescription: The novice monk shops for the wiccan monastery on the hill.
mobs.Description:
Dressed in a long, dark green woolen robe tied at the waist with a
braided belt, the novice wanders from shop to shop looking for items
needed by his brothers at the monastery.  He is an elf of medium
height, his long blond hair tied back with a thong made from braided
grasses.  His deep blue eyes look out at you with intelligence.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 em peers about uncertainly.

mobs.Name: lake elf
mobs.LongDescription: The lake elf glides deftly through the water, rooting out evil.
mobs.Description:
He patrols this lake, protecting it from evil influences.  His
silver-blue hair floats about his silver-green, slender body, and he
seems to fade into his surroundings even as you look at him.  If you
look closely at him, you see the gill slits on his ribs, which allow
him to breathe easily underwater.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 wetfish

mobs.Name: swanmay
mobs.LongDescription: The snowy white swanmay glides on the surface of the water.
mobs.Description:
The swanmay in her swan form is striking in her beauty and grace.  She
is a pure white, and moves smoothly across the water.  You sense that
she will not allow evil to intrude on the beauty of the lake, and in
her human form she may be a fierce warrior.

mobs.Name: swordfish
mobs.LongDescription: The swordfish attacks you, brandishing his sword with great vigor!
mobs.Description:
This sword fish is much larger than you are!  It's 15' (4.6 meters)
long and weighs about 1000 pounds (454 kg).  It is all muscle and grace
in the water.  The front third of the fish is its sword, which could
easily ram you through.  It is a flat sort of sword, but still quite
sharp both at the point and on the edges.  You hope it is after the
herring and not you!

mobs.Name: nessie watermonster
mobs.LongDescription:
Her long graceful neck rising slowly up from the water, Nessie gazes
down at your puny form far below her.
mobs.Description:
Having tired of being pursued in that *other* lake where she used to
live, Nessie has settled here in Tynstri, where things magical are
accepted.  She is an extremely large water monster, with a fairly small
head on top of a long muscular neck.  Her body is large and graceful in
the water.  She is shy for a monster, and would prefer not to be
disturbed.

mobs.Name: scorpion water
mobs.LongDescription: The water scorpion eyes you scornfully as she waits for tastier prey.
mobs.Description:
The water scorpion has strongly grasping foreclaws to hold her victim
still while it is being eaten.  Her long curly tail enables her to
breathe beneath the water, although it is unusual to see her actually
*in* the water.  She is usually to be found on the bank, waiting for a
lunch to swim by.

mobs.Name: strider skater bug
mobs.LongDescription: The water strider zips across the surface of the water.
mobs.Description:
The water strider, or pond skater, has a long narrow body and six
spidery legs. Unlike the other water bugs, it never ventures
underwater. Its underside is covered with a water-repellent coat of
hair that keeps it afloat. Its middle legs propel it across the
surface, its hindlegs act as rudders and brakes, and its short forelegs
are used exclusively for catching prey - like you!

mobs.Name: water bug giant
mobs.LongDescription: The giant water bug paralyzes the fish with its poison, then eyes you!
mobs.Description:
This is the biggest water bug you have ever seen!  This waterbug is 40"
(100 cm) long.   It has two retractable appendages that, when held
together, form a breathing tube. It is  a strong flyer and formidable
hunter. It will paralyze its prey (you) by injecting a poison through
the beak, and in this manner it can overpower fish twice its own size.

mobs.Name: oyster
mobs.LongDescription: The huge oyster snaps its shell shut with a silent BANG!
mobs.Description:
The pearl inside this oyster must be ENORMOUS judging from the size of
the grayish white deeply ridged shell.  As the huge bivalve opens its
valve, the current formed by the rapidly moving hairs covering its
gills draws you relentlessly towards it.  You wonder what it would feel
like to be eaten by an oyster.

mobs.Name: yellow jacket bee bug
mobs.LongDescription: "Hey, you!" says the yellow jacket.  "Yeah, YOU!  With the ugly armor!"
mobs.Description:
The yellow jacket hornet, or wasp, likes living near to the monastery.
It buzzes around the compost heap and enjoys scaring away silly
adventurers who stumble into its part of the garden.  Very proud of its
bright yellow and black striped jacket, it enjoys verbally abusing
adventurers who drop by.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 say Ha! You couldn't hit a fly if it landed on your nose!;%1 
raspberry;%1 say even if you could hit me, idiot child, you're such a 
wimp you'd be instant toast :P

mobs.Name: drider
mobs.LongDescription: The drider weaves his evil web between two plants.  You're trapped!
mobs.Description:
In the drider, the body of an elf who has gone over to the dark side
has combined with the 8 long spindly legs of a spider into a kind of
evil spiderelf creature.

mobs.Name: thri-kreen bug mantis warrior
mobs.LongDescription: The mantis warrior looks hungrily at you.
mobs.Description:
The thri-kreen is roughly 7' (over 2m) tall at the shoulder, with six
arms/legs and enormous black eyes that seem to twirl in their sockets.
He is covered in a thick exoskeleton which rivals the hardest armor you
have seen on your many travels.  He looks at you with keen interest, as
if attempting to decide what to do with you.

mobs.Name: gargoyle
mobs.LongDescription: The monastery gargoyle glares menacingly at garden intruders.
mobs.Description:
The gargoyle is small and ugly beyond belief.  His golden-brown skin is
covered with a sparse coating of dull black hair.  He has a wide,
mobile mouth, but his grin has a strongly evil twitch to it.  His
small, deepset gray eyes watch you suspiciously.

mobs.Name: snapdragon
mobs.LongDescription: The snapdragon *snaps!* at you!
mobs.Description:
The deep purple color of the snapdragon is almost enough to make you
ignore the powerful jaws and bend over to sniff at it.  But you decide
you like your nose and would rather keep it for now.  The snapdragon
(antirrhinum majus) is, like all the plants in the monastery gardens,
unusually large and fortunately for you, quite content to grow and look
pretty.  At least, as long as you keep your nose outta his face!
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 snap

mobs.Name: tiger lily
mobs.LongDescription: The tiger lily roars beautifully.
mobs.Description:
The tiger lily (lilium lancifolium) purrs loudly in the sunshine.  She
knows her beautifully spotted orange flowers make her the queen of this
section of the gardens.  Besides, none of the other flowers have teeth
quite as long or as sharp as hers.

mobs.Name: elf brother dionysos
mobs.LongDescription: Brother Dionysos thoughtfully tastes the caraway wine.
mobs.Description:
Brother Dionysos tells you he's studying to be a wine taster.  He
samples each of the monastery's many wines on a daily basis, often
finishing late at night and actually er ... sleeping over his work.  He
has volunteered for this duty saying piously that it's a difficult job,
but someone has to do it.

mobs.Name: blond dryad strawberry nymph
mobs.LongDescription: Strawberry blond hair flies in a blur as the dryad whirls, dancing.
mobs.Description:
This wood nymph has hair an unusual color of pale red.  She is normally
the first to disappear when strangers find her part of the forest, but
she becomes at times very absorbed with her feelings of communion with
her tree and with the dance she performs to celebrate it.

mobs.Name: elf brother cleaning
mobs.LongDescription: The cleaning brother is scrubbing hard at the gray stone.
mobs.Description:
He looks busy.  With all the monks coming and going from dirt paths and
gardening, the grey stone floor of the monastery gets quite dirty.  It
is this monk's job to restore it to its natural cool gray color.

mobs.Name: elf brother wine master
mobs.LongDescription: The wine master turns the tap, pouring a bit of clear red wine.
mobs.Description:
The wine master is constantly testing and adjusting the wines which are
fermenting in this room.  Winemaking is more of an art - a magical art
here at the monastery - than a science.  Wines are made from many of
the fruit grown here at the monastery - not only the grapes.  The wine
master is a short, stout elf who wears a leather jacket over his habit
in the chill basement air.

mobs.Name: elf brother russ
mobs.LongDescription:
Brother Russ mumbles, "Waxing moon, waning moon? How could I forget
so soon?"
mobs.Description:
Brother Russ is a bit scatterbrained.  It is he who orders when
planting should start for certain crops, and when harvest should occur.
He instructs the young novices on the uses of herbs and their
relationship to magic and rainbows.

mobs.Name: elf brother john
mobs.LongDescription: Brother John  quietly weeps.  Why are you weeping, Brother John?
mobs.Description:
Brother John is a tall, stooped elderly monk.  When he was very young,
a great sorceress foretold of his pivotal role in the Great Dragon
Plague that would nearly wipe Tynstri from the face of the world.  He
has
dedicated his life to living up to this prophecy and if he is
occasionally sad, perhaps that is his right.

mobs.Name: elf brother novice monk gardener
mobs.LongDescription: The novice monk is chanting magical phrases as he weeds the garden.
mobs.Description:
The young elf joined the wiccan monastery drawn by its magic and the
chance to work more closely with nature.  He has studied hard, and part
of his studies includes his work in the garden, weeding.  He is
practicing the spells he has been learning as he weeds.  As he is as
yet imperfect at them, some of the results are unexpected.

mobs.Name: dragonfly pest insect
mobs.LongDescription: The dragonfly zooms swiftly from place to place, amazingly agile.
mobs.Description:
The dragonfly looks like a glowing lavendar broomhandle with 4 wings
made of sheer silk.  The long narrow wings are placed two per side
almost on top of each other.  This insect is much faster than his
heavier cousins, the dragons.

mobs.Name: lightning bug insect lightningbug
mobs.LongDescription: The lightning bug glows with a pale green light.
mobs.Description:
The lightning bug sheds just enough light to see when it's dark,
turning its lantern on and off to conserve its energy.  Although
normally a small, relatively harmless insect, the bug has been affected
by the wiccan magic and may now be considered "armed and dangerous"!

mobs.Name: garter snake
mobs.LongDescription: The little garter snake tries to blend into his surroundings.
mobs.Description:
The small garter snake is here looking for mice and other small
rodents.  He slithers rapidly from plant to plant, hoping you won't
notice him.

mobs.Name: elf shopper
mobs.LongDescription: The elven woman hurries through her shopping.
mobs.Description:
This tall young elf reluctantly left her forest home to come in to town
for some supplies - some special medicines from Seymour, some sweets
for her youngest and a new hat for herself.   Coming to town forces her
to mix with some non-elves, and she is not fond of that.

mobs.Name: runner elf
mobs.LongDescription:
Running in circles around the park, the lean, strong elf is keeping
fit.
mobs.Description:
Dressed in short, soft dark green pants, the elf makes his circuit of
the park over and over, around and around, building up his strength and
stamina.  He chants a magical spell as he runs to help him keep up his
pace.

mobs.Name: shadow
mobs.LongDescription: The shadow slips silently along, spying for his master.
mobs.Description:
The shadow has been well trained in the art of espionage.  A former
assassin, he will work for whomever pays him the most.  He is called
the shadow because of his uncanny ability to move unseen among groups
of elves.  For whom is he spying?  We may never know.

mobs.Name: fire ants bugs
mobs.LongDescription: Fire ants march towards you like an unstoppable red river.
mobs.Description:
The fire ants - hundreds of them - move together like one gigantic war
machine.  They devour everything  that lies in their path.  When those
in the front ranks are killed, the ones in the back merely march over
them and continue on their way, killing all with their fiery sting.

mobs.Name: novice monk
mobs.LongDescription: The novice monk studies nature, determined to harness its power.
mobs.Description:
Young male elves dedicate their lives to learning the wiccan way.
There is great power in the magic at the monastery, and they are bound
only by the law to do no harm.  The monks work long hours in the
gardens and on travels, gathering seeds and sprouts to bring back to
their garden.

mobs.Name: yeti
mobs.LongDescription: The yeti watches you curiously.
mobs.Description:
Over 6' (2m) tall and 300 lbs (136 kg), the yeti has a very ferocious
appearance.  He is covered with a matted, dirty white fur.  His
enormous feet end in long, thick sharp claws.  The yeti has long,
powerful arms which dangle down close to his knees and end in massive,
meaty hands.  For all his strength, the yeti would prefer not to be
seen.

mobs.Name: elf woman
mobs.LongDescription: Absorbed by her own thoughts, the elven woman seems not to notice you.
mobs.Description:
The elven woman seems abstracted.  Tiny by elf standards, she is only
about 5' (1.6 meters) tall.  Her pale blond hair hangs in soft curls
half-way down her back, and her ice blue eyes are weary.

mobs.Name: elf man
mobs.LongDescription: The elf is making a rare trip into town to trade herbs for armor.
mobs.Description:
On a rare jaunt into town, this elven man has brought herbs and plants
to trade with Seymour for cash to buy clothing and other items.  He is
a serious looking elf, with golden blond hair, grey/green eyes and pale
golden skin.

mobs.Name: hawthorn tree
mobs.LongDescription: #GThe hawthorn tree bends her weary branches toward you.#N
mobs.Description:
The hawthorn, also known as the Witches' Tree seems to watch you as you
walk along the path.  Hawthorns were once believed to be the
transformed bodies of witches, who had shapeshifted into tree form.  Is
the tree moving of its own accord or is it the breeze?

mobs.Name: dryad singing nymph
mobs.LongDescription: The earth stops to listen while the forest nymph sings.
mobs.Description:
This dryad is quite tall, with waist length chestnut colored hair,
emerald green eyes and fair, almost milk-white skin.  She sings
accompanied by the soft notes of the lute which she plays.

mobs.Name: trout fish
mobs.LongDescription:
The rainbow-colored trout is easy to see in the quiet underwater
colors.
mobs.Description:
The trout looks as if it were dipped in a rainbow.  Bright stripes of
magenta, pink, deep rose, violet, blue, green and yellow adorn his
short, agile body.  The trout looks good enough to eat!

mobs.Name: herring
mobs.LongDescription: The herring darts about the much larger fish.
mobs.Description:
Not a very large fish, this gray-green herring is about 18" (45cm)
long.  He is doing his best to hide among the larger fish, who pay no
attention to him.  Rumor has it that whole populations of arctic elves
have lived on a combination of herring and milk.  Here's the herring.
Got milk?

mobs.Name: elf chef cook
mobs.LongDescription: The chief chef of the monastery sharpens his carving knife.
mobs.Description:
You hope the rumors you have heard about the elven chef at the
monastery are not true. This sturdily built elf has muscles that would
look large on a minotaur.  What magic has made him this strong? It is
no wonder that the assassins are attempting to kidnap him.

mobs.Name: viper snake
mobs.LongDescription: The small but deadly viper whips swiftly towards you.
mobs.Description:
This small snake has an evil look about him.  He moves so swiftly that
you barely have time to run through your mental list of poisonous vs
non-poisonous snakes before he attacks you.

mobs.Name: monk serious elf
mobs.LongDescription: Chanting quietly to himself, the monk considers his vows seriously.
mobs.Description:
A serious student of nature and magic and the magic within nature, this
monk spends his days faithfully carrying out his duties as a monk of
the wiccan order.  He is tall and gaunt with a long narrow beard that
reaches nearly to his waist.  His head is totally bald.  He wears no
headcovering at all, preferring to feel the rain or sunshine that
nature sends on the bare skin of his scalp.

mobs.Name: dryad graceful
mobs.LongDescription: A graceful dryad is lost in communion with her tree.
mobs.Description:
This lovely dryad has hair of a deep green and her skin is a pale 
spring leaf color.  Although she looks quite young, she is nearly of 
an age with the ancient trees whom she worships.  She communes with
the spirits of the trees and is fierce in their defense.

mobs.Name: dryad singing nymph
mobs.LongDescription: The dryad sings ancient elven songs of incredible power and beauty.
mobs.Description:
This tiny dryad has hair the color of the bark on a black walnut 
tree and skin nearly as white as the first snow of winter.  There
is such incredible beauty in her voice that, although the words 
are in some ancient elven tongue, you know they are magic.

mobs.Name: Jasper dragon
mobs.LongDescription: The crystalline dragon glares fiercely at you, protecting his family.
mobs.Description:
Jasper has declared this area to be HIS, mainly because his dear 
Chaora has chosen to nest here.  There are many large eggs here ...
eggs a bit larger than you are.  Although few will hatch, all are 
precious to Jasper.

mobs.Name: Chaora dragon
mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful violet dragon dressed in black lace waits for something.
mobs.Description:
Chaora was named after the beautiful mineral Chaorite.  A beautiful
violet color, she is related to both the great purple dragon and 
to Pinky.  Unhappy with life in the dragon caves, she has chosen to
hatch her clutch right here in the trees.
mobs.ActionScript: %%05 emote carefully polishes her scales.; %5 fashion; %2 hum

mobs.Name: Malachi dragon
mobs.LongDescription: Malachi seems to be in constant motion, a swirl of green color.
mobs.Description:
Malachi has deep green, rough crocodile skin, with sworls of other
greens.  He is constantly restless, unwilling to settle down.  He
is large, but no larger than most dragons, which is to say, of course,
QUITE large.  If he was willing to talk to you (which he is not), he
could tell you about his extensive travels ...
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 land;%5 fly

mobs.Name: farmer m9900 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A farmer walks around, awed by all there is to do in Stanneg.
mobs.Description:
This farmer is a resident of Stanneg by the Mountains, and as such, is
one of the most boring people on earth.  Every day is pretty much the
same for him.  You wonder who is feeding his chickens while he is
wandering around town.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 yawn

mobs.Name: storekeeper m9901 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A bored storekeeper waits for you to do something.
mobs.Description:
The bored storekeeper keeps a lazy eye on you as he waits for you to
buy something.  Whee.

mobs.Name: Cowgirl m99
mobs.LongDescription: A cowgirl stands here ready to defend her horses...
mobs.Description:
This woman seems ready for anything you might do... she is truly a
woman to be reckoned with...

mobs.Name: horse m9903 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A horse does horsely things here.
mobs.Description:
This horse looks like a nice horse.  It looks at you with soft brown
eyes and you want to give it a carrot and tie ribbons in its mane.

mobs.Name: farmer's farmers wife m9904 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A farmer's wife offers you some vegetables.
mobs.Description:
This woman has many different types of fruits and vegetables for you to
buy.  She looks bored, though.

mobs.Name: Aglandiir dragon prince m9905 m99
mobs.LongDescription: The Dragon Prince, Aglandiir, sits here looking at you curiously.
mobs.Description:
Towering over his bodyguards, his scales glistening with a pearlescent
gleam that is somehow neither red nor black, but both together,
depending on the whim of the flickering torchlight.  Aglandiir lives in
the ancestral home of dragonkind, proud and fierce.  He has a taste for
the finer things civilization has to offer, and the cyclops, who toady
to him, are forever bringing him small treasures.  Aglandiir is as
magnificent as his surroundings suggest.

mobs.Name: Cyclops m9906 m99
mobs.LongDescription: The cyclops is trying to judge range with no depth perception.
mobs.Description:
This Cyclops throws rocks real good.  With one eye though, hitting the
target is another matter.  He looks at you and growls as he misses
again!

mobs.Name: Salle woman m9907 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A woman ignores you completely, so intent is she upon her sword.
mobs.Description:
She is a stunning woman, all hair and eyes, it seems.  Her clothing
is of the same tawny brown of her skin and hair.  Her blue eyes look at
you appraisingly, seemingly to show great intelligence.  Her mouth
twitches into a sneer...

mobs.Name: Duwick man m9908 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A truly immense man laughs at you, and draws his knife!
mobs.Description:
This has to be one of the biggest men you've ever seen.  He is a
full seven feet toe to head, and weighs a good three hundred pounds --
mostly on his biceps and pectorals it appears.  An ornate scabbard
slaps by his side, with the pommel of a silvered dagger sticking
out...a tiny weapon for such a large man!

mobs.Name: Receptionist m9909 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A receptionist offers you a room.
mobs.Description:
He looks like a retired farmer now making an honest living in an
inn.  More power to him!

mobs.Name: innkeeper m9910 m99
mobs.LongDescription: An aged innkeeper greets you as you enter.
mobs.Description:
He's old and graying, but seems to have been able to keep his mental
faculties through the years.  A large woolen sweater is wrapped about
him for warmth.  His blue eyes dance with amusement as he notices your
weapons, but he doesn't seem too terribly startled.

mobs.Name: hunter m9911 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A hunter strides along purposefully, looking neither right nor left.
mobs.Description:
He looks mean, as if the very personality of the mountains had
infected him with hardness.  His stride is purposeful, his face
weathered, his eyes cold and dark.  Others are standing out of his way
as he walks on by.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em lifts his bow, notching in an arrow.;%5 em takes careful aim
 down the shaft of his bow.

mobs.Name: waiter m9912 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A waiter rushes by, intent on his business.
mobs.Description:
He looks harried from the way he hastily takes orders and rushes in
the back to get food, and to the bar for drinks.  He doesn't even spare
you a glance as he passes by.

mobs.Name: waitress m9913 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A waitress rushes by, intent on her business.
mobs.Description:
She looks married from the way she hastily takes orders and rushes
in the back to get food, and to the bar for drinks.  She doesn't even
spare you a glance as she passes by.

mobs.Name: bartender m9914 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A bartender washes a glass idly here.
mobs.Description:
He nods, smiles, and asks you what you would like to drink.  As you
decide, he slowly polishes a glass with an old bar rag.  The glass is
completely clean, but he polishes it anyway.  Go figure.

mobs.Name: bandit m9915 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A bandit springs into action upon seeing you.
mobs.Description:
Whew!  Has this guy ever seen a bath?  His face, hands, arms...
nearly every bit of him is covered with grime, dust, dirt and decay.
His sword is polished and cleaned though...

mobs.Name: bandit guard m9916 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A bandit guard stands at attention here.
mobs.Description:
He may be a bandit, but he's no slacker.  You wonder who would be
able to keep these bandits in line enough to pull a good guard duty...
(Boy is this guy DIRTY!!!)

mobs.Name: miner worker slave m9917 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A slave here is mining out a new passageway.
mobs.Description:
The slave looks up at you with pleading eyes.  He wants his freedom.
The chains around his ankles are tight, and you wonder if you should
set him free, and if you even can.

mobs.Name: farmer m9918 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A farmer walks around, looking for something to do.
mobs.Description:
This farmer is a resident of Stanneg by the Mountains, and as such, is
one of the most boring people on earth.

mobs.Name: hunter m9919 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A hunter walks through the town streets on his own time.
mobs.Description:
He looks mean, as if the very personality of the mountains had
infected him with hardness.  His stride is purposeful, his face
weathered, his eyes cold and dark.  Others are standing out of his way
as he walks on by.

mobs.Name: apple grower m9920 m99
mobs.LongDescription: The apple grower is in town for the day, looking for excitement.
mobs.Description:
Tinted slightly green from eating too many green apples, this
half-orc is unimpressed with the sights and sounds of the tiny town of
Stanneg.  Perhaps he will start raising sheep for company instead of
apple trees.

mobs.Name: chambermaid m9921 m99
mobs.LongDescription: The little wood elf chambermaid is just too cute for words.
mobs.Description:
Well, the forest was just too boring, so the little elf hired on as
a chambermaid at the Stanneg Inn, in Stanneg.  She is young, pretty and
full of mischief.  She just wants to have fun.

mobs.Name: horse rancher m9922 m99
mobs.LongDescription: The half-orc horse rancher rode into town on his horse, Joe.
mobs.Description:
One of many horse ranchers / traders who live outside the small
rural town of Stanneg, this rancher raises warhorses for the many
knights.  He turns a tidy profit at it!

mobs.Name: highwayman m9923 m99
mobs.LongDescription: Although this is no highway, the highwayman will rob you just the same!
mobs.Description:
Although this path looks forgotten, it was once a major thoroughfare
between a major mining community (Stanneg by the Mountains) and the
thriving metropolis of Midgaard (by the Sea).  The highwaymen have not
forgotten! They will roam this path til they die!

mobs.Name: one-eyed jack m9924 m99
mobs.LongDescription: "Stand and deliver!", shouts One-eyed Jack.
mobs.Description:
The most feared of the highwaymen, One-Eyed Jack is ruthless and
cunning.  He's mean and he's evil.  And that one eye is right in the
middle of his forehead, making you think he's not quite right in the
head.
mobs.ActionScript: %%3 smirk

mobs.Name: guest m9925 m99
mobs.LongDescription: "How dare you barge in here!" screams the guest of the inn.
mobs.Description:
Well, can you blame him?  He paid for this rather shabby but
expensive room, and was all set to take a nice hot bath in the large
copper tub when you come barging in where you are obviously not wanted!
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 scream

mobs.Name: Nelly mindslayer m99 m9926
mobs.LongDescription: Nelly the Mind Bogglingly Magnificent Mindslayer tours Stanneg.
mobs.Description:
Nelly used to tour Major Capitals of the World!! (especially those
beginning with the letter "S")  She had a show of amazing "Feats of the
Magnificent Mind of the #gGnomish#N Miss Nelly!", however greater and
more wondrous mages were soon envious of the fortune she amassed with
her tour, and she was, alas, outclassed.  She now tours Small Towns of
the World!! (especially those beginning with the letter "S")

mobs.Name: O'rgile xorgyle minotaur m99 m9927
mobs.LongDescription: The town's only doctor is a fierce #RMinotaur#Y named O'Rgile.
mobs.Description:
Lust for blood sent this sharp-horned Minotaur to war as a mercenary.
He grew sad, losing so many of his comrades to battles, and vowed to
learn to heal as well as to kill.  He still has a pretty mean horn,
however, and he is not at all afraid to use it.

mobs.Name: O'Degra xodegra m9928 m99
mobs.LongDescription: O'Degra may be short, stocky and a bit furry, but he is quite strong.
mobs.Description:
O'Degra was the original lone Irish Dwarven miner to discover the seams
of mithril running through the mountains here in Stanneg.  He became
quite wealthy from his fabulous discovery, but he gave it all away and
now is quite poor.  He still roams the hills looking for another "find".

mobs.Name: high sheriff m9929 m99
mobs.LongDescription: The High Sheriff of Stanneg eyes you, fingering his badge of office.
mobs.Description:
If ever a political appointee there was, there was the High Sheriff of
Stanneg.  His heavy gold badge rests on his velvet-covered paunch.
Heavy eyebrows meet in the middle of a low forehead, and his scent is
faintly reminiscent of troll.  With bandits living near here, cyclops
roaming the hills, highwaymen on trail leading here and rumors of a
Dragon Prince living not far away, the Sheriff has clearly NOT been
doing a good job!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em fingers his badge of office thoughtfully.;
%5 rubs his palms over his enormous velvet clad belly.

mobs.Name: deputy dahwig m9930 m99
mobs.LongDescription: Deputy Dahwig just can't seem to get his sword sheathed properly.
mobs.Description:
Dressed in tattered trousers with a sword by his side, Deputy Sheriff
Dahwig is just the picture of incompetence.  He frequently misses the
scabbard for his sword, and adds yet another tear to his battered
clothing or a slight gash to his skin.

mobs.Name: aunt auntie tabitha m9931 m99
mobs.LongDescription: Auntie Tabitha keeps her cookie jar full for children who visit.
mobs.Description:
Auntie Tabitha is kind of an institution here in Stanneg.  She came here
as a young bride decades before the mining explosion.  She has vowed
never to leave, although Stanneg has become known for being "the most
boring town on earth".
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em asks, "Wanna cookie, honey ?";
%1 em asks, "Want some honey, cookie ?

mobs.Name: troll mean ol ugly m9932 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A bridge troll wonders if you will fit in her cooking pot.
mobs.Description:
Ever since a run in with a certain very LARGE billy goat gruff, this
troll has gone hungry.  She has been just waiting for someone to come
discover her little hidey hole and volunteer to be her dinner.  She
thanks you for volunteering.

mobs.Name: billygoat wee little billy goat gruff m9933 m99
mobs.ShortDescription: a wee little billy goat gruff
mobs.LongDescription: A wee little billy goat gruff looks for some sweet meadow grass.
mobs.Description:
A very tiny billy goat with a tiny white beard treads lightly, looking
for some sweet grass to eat.  He and his many billy goat brothers and
sisters feast on the grass on both sides of this small mountain canyon.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 em nudges you gently with his little head.

mobs.Name: billygoat billy goat middle middle-sized gruff m9934 m99
mobs.LongDescription: The middle-sized billy goat gruff says, "Wait for my big brother!"
mobs.Description:
The medium-sized billy goat wears a medium-sized bell on a medium-sized
leather collar around his medium sized billy goat gruff neck.  He is
getting tired of being medium sized, neither cute like his littlest
brothers, nor strong like his bigger brothers.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 em headbutts you none too gently.  Ouch!! That hurt!!!

mobs.Name: billygoat billy goat enormous gruff m9935 m99
mobs.LongDescription: The biggest billy goat gruff has two long, curved, sharp, wicked horns.
mobs.Description:
The enormous billy goat is a threat even (perhaps especially) to trolls.
A force to be reckoned with!  He could gore you with one of his horns,
or simply ram you down in a fierce headbutt.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote rams into you from behind, knocking you to the ground!;
%1 say Where's that troll been messin with my brothers?

mobs.Name: gnome tourist m9936 m99
mobs.LongDescription: The #gGnome#Y came to record the former glory of Stanneg for Glob, Inc.
mobs.Description:
This little gnome is fascinated by history.  The Descent of Stanneg from
prosperous mining town to this boring little place amazed her both for
its rapidity and its completeness.  She is talking to some of the
town's long time residents, planning to amaze her friends back at the
Glob, Inc. Information headquarters.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 peer

mobs.Name: fat friar francis m9937 m99
mobs.LongDescription: Fat Friar Francis watches you from shifty eyes.
mobs.Description:
Friar Francis has a passion for the good things of life, and
unfortunately has not the means to indulge in them.  How does he pay for
them then ?  Nobody knows for sure, but it is rumored he has a link with
the bandits living in caves near here.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 cast 'create waybread'

mobs.Name: kithy boy little sturdy m9938 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A sturdy little boy begs for choco cookies.
mobs.Description:
A very tall little boy with deep blue eyes looks up at you appealingly.
He has short, straight blond hair and an engaging smile.  You can sense
he's very good at scrounging cookies from the town's best cookie-bakers!
mobs.ActionScript: %%5say Gimme cookie!  Kithy want choco!

mobs.Name: granny higglebottom m9939 m99
mobs.LongDescription: Granny Higglebottom's daughter has left to work in the valley.
mobs.Description:
Ever since Granny Higglebottom's daughter went to work for "the Royals",
Granny H has been lonely, cranky and out of sorts.  Her thin, wispy
white hair forms a soft halo around her deeply lined face.

mobs.Name: sara m9940 m99 xsarastro
mobs.LongDescription: Long curly hair falls gracefully around the face of Stro's sister Sara.
mobs.Description:
Stro's twin sister Sara looks very much like her brother, except for her
long curly hair.  She and Stro are constantly together, and constantly
in trouble for some piece of mischief or another.  It is a full time job
for their big sister Rooth to keep an eye on them!

mobs.Name: stro m9941 xsarastro m99
mobs.LongDescription: Stro looks up at you through bright, mischievous green eyes.
mobs.Description:
Pale blond hair cut very short gives this athletic little boy a slightly
elfin look.  He and his twin sister Sara are active, curious children.

mobs.Name: rooth xrue m9942 m99
mobs.LongDescription: Rooth often takes the twins for walks through the hills near Stanneg.
mobs.Description:
Rooth loves her twin brother and sister, Sara and Stro, even though
their mischievous nature often lands all three of them in trouble.  The
three of them live on a farm outside Stanneg, where their family raises
goats for both the wool and the milk.

mobs.Name: floyd m9943 xkalsa m99
mobs.LongDescription: Floyd sings madrigals in in tight leather pants and a #mpink#Y shirt.
mobs.Description:
Remember when you were young, you shone like the sun
Now there's a look in your eyes, like black holes in the sky
You were caught in the crossfire of childhood and stardom
Blown on the steel breeze
Come on you target for far away laughter, come on you stranger,
you legend, you martyr, and shine!
You reached for the secret too soon
You cried for the moon
Shine on you crazy diamond
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 airguitar

mobs.Name: troll mean ol ugly m9944 m99
mobs.LongDescription: The bridge troll is drawn to you, drooling, dreaming of soup!
mobs.Description:
You sure look good enough to eat! At least to *this* troll.  But
don't let it go to your head.  He's so hungry he'd eat just about
anything!

mobs.Name: farmer's farmers wife m9905 m99
mobs.LongDescription: A farmer's wife came to town to see the sights.
mobs.Description:
After endless days and endless nights on one of the most boring farms in
the world, finally the farmer's wife gets to come to town to see the
sights.

mobs.Name: Grizzly Gus m99 m9946
mobs.LongDescription:
Grizzly Gus, the mountain man, he'll be roamin these mountains as long
as he can.
mobs.Description:
Grizzly Gus is a nasty old cuss.  He smells like he hasn't had a bath in
years, which he probably hasn't.  He doesn't see the need.  Gus is
happiest ALONE in his mountains.
mobs.ActionScript: %%15say GIT!!

mobs.Name: Helmet xhelm m9947 m99 m9947
mobs.LongDescription: #GGrandpa H's mining helmet glows demonically in a corner, forgotten.#N
mobs.Description:
A very large green helmet with a large glowing crystal sits quietly in a
corner.  During its heyday, all miners in Stanneg owned one of these
helmets.  It is very sturdy, providing a good deal of protection from
falling rocks, and the crystal provides a handy source of light for the
miners.  This particular one, however, looks somewhat ... demonic,
despite the eerie feline reflection in its surface.  

Grandpa Higglebottom (sadly no longer with us) was at the helm of the
Stanneg Mining and Exploration Company, a once profitable subdivision of
Glob, Inc.

mobs.Name: music box xmelody m99 m9948
mobs.LongDescription: #GThe music box plays a pretty little melody.#N
mobs.Description:
Crank up this music box with the wind-up arm and it will play a lovely
little song.  You have heard this tune before, but where ?

mobs.Name: bodyguard m99 m9949
mobs.LongDescription: The prince's bodyguard is a dark and glorious dragon.
mobs.Description:
Only the strongest, most fearsome dragons are allowed to guard the heir
to the dragon throne, Prince Aglandiir.  This one is deepest black,
except for the glowing golden eyes and the occasional tongue of flame.

mobs.Name: prospector m99 m9950
mobs.LongDescription: The wiry little gnomish prospector searches endlessly for mithril.
mobs.Description:
Determined to strike it rich in the mountains around Stanneg, confident
that the bandits won't bother him since he is so poor, the prospector
searches the hills and caves of the Stanneg mountains for hints of
mithril.
mobs.ActionScript: %%15say I know you! you're one o'them claim jumpers!;%10 glare

mobs.Name: man spry guy ol mountain m99 m9951
mobs.LongDescription: The spry old guy hides away on the mountain side.
mobs.Description:
Long years away from people has made the old coot even more distrustful
of the rest of the two-legged world than he was before.  He's living off
the bare pickings of the land, killing wild goats and squirrels, and
eating greens that others might call weeds.  His temper, like his breath
and his body odor, is most foul.

mobs.Name: wheel spinning m99 m9952 mimic
mobs.LongDescription: #GThe spinning wheel twirls hypnotically, entrancing you.
mobs.Description:
Auntie Tabitha says she uses this lovely old walnut spinning wheel to
spin yarn for Granny Higglebottom.  There is something not quite RIGHT
about Auntie T, however.  But nothing wrong with the goats, aside from
a little mischievous headbutting.  The goats roam the mountain valley
between here and Rome, and are gathered twice annually to be sheared.
The goathair is then spun into soft yarn.  Granny H has a passion for
soft knitted blankets, and has managed to capture a bit of tourist trade
selling them.

mobs.Name: explorer orcish m99 m9953
mobs.LongDescription: The Orcish explorer is searching for new lands and peoples to conquer.
mobs.Description:
The Orc explorer has left his cave to look for newer, larger caves here
in the played out mines of Stanneg.  If he happens to find one with a
bit of mithril left, look out! He will be making some pretty scary
weapons.

mobs.Name: wolf cub xnightwolf playful wolfcub m99 m9954
mobs.LongDescription: An adorable little wolf cub romps around in the sweet grass.
mobs.Description:
Thick jet-black fur covers this adorable little wolf cub.  He has
wandered away from his den for a frolic in the sunshine and adventures
chasing goats ... and perhaps chasing adventurers as well!

mobs.Name: guest phobic xphobos m9955
mobs.LongDescription: The slightly phobic guest of the Inn clutches the sheets in worry.
mobs.Description:
The poor guest quakes at the thought of the mountains around him.  What
if there is a quake?  And he is a bit nervous around goats ... and there
are so many of them.  So many phobias, hard to pick which one to worry
over!

mobs.Name: guest raven-haired xraven m9956 woman
mobs.LongDescription: The raven-haired guest looks about her warily.
mobs.Description:
She does her best to sooth her phobic companion, but finds it difficult
at times.  The guest has long, thick black hair, and an air of constant
awareness, a stirring restlessness that reminds you of a wild creature.
For some reason the wolfcub you passed on your way into Stanneg comes to
mind, as does the glimpse you had of some graceful, feral movement in
the trees.

mobs.Name: whale shark ocean
mobs.LongDescription: An enormous shark swims slowly beneath the surface of the water.
mobs.Description:
The whale shark is monstrous in size, and you thank all that is good
that she doesn't care to eat anything larger than plankton.  Just
stay away from her enormous mouth, she could probably swallow you
whole!

mobs.Name: shark great white ocean
mobs.LongDescription: A large fin cuts through the surface of the water, heading your way!
mobs.Description:
The great white shark has very sharp teeth, and extremely powerful
jaws.  He's an ancient predator, and he's maintained his place at the
top of the food chain because he is the perfect hunting machine.

mobs.Name: whale blue ocean
mobs.LongDescription: The blue whale rests at the surface as she pauses to feed her calf.
mobs.Description:
The blue whale is the uncontested ruler of the ocean.  No predators
will even attempt to take this queen of the ocean into battle.  Her
sheer size alone is enough to ward off any potential enemies.  She is
fiercely protective of her calf, because while he is quite large
himself, he is still defenseless.

mobs.Name: whale blue calf ocean
mobs.LongDescription: A young blue whale calf nurses contentedly at his mother's side.
mobs.Description:
While the young calf is enormous, he is still vulnerable to
predators.  He stays close to his mother's protective side, hoping
that he will be able to nurse uninterrupted.

mobs.Name: turtle leatherback ocean
mobs.LongDescription: Like a bird, the leatherback turtle flies slowly through the water.
mobs.Description:
This enormous turtle relies heavily on a diet of jellyfish.  Her
enormous flippers are perfect for life in the water, and she uses
them to swim through the ocean in search of her prey.

mobs.Name: lion sea sealion ocean
mobs.LongDescription: A sea lion frolicks playfully in the waves.
mobs.Description:
This sea lion loves to have his fun!  His sleek body and strong back
flippers are excellent for tearing through the water at incredible
speeds.  His front flippers act as a steering mechanism, allowing him
to make unbelievable mid-water turns.  Being the faborite snack of a
great white is dangerous, but life is good and there is fun to be
had!

mobs.Name: manowar man-o-war ocean
mobs.LongDescription: The float of an enormous man-o-war rides along on the current.
mobs.Description:
The man-o-war appears to be a single animal, but it is actually made
up of hundreds, or even thousands, of smaller specialized animals.
Each member of this well-organized colony has its own purpose -
food gathering, reproduction, defense, or locomotion.  It's best to
steer clear of the long stinging tentacles of the man-o-war, they can
easily kill you!

mobs.Name: jellyfish moon ocean
mobs.LongDescription: A small jellyfish swims quickly through the ocean.
mobs.Description:
The moon jellyfish is almost all jelly.  Its large bell is pushed
through the water by very short locomotive tentacles.  Those
tentacles can give a nasty sting to any would-be predators, but these
jellies are the favorite snack of the leatherback turtle!

mobs.Name: cobia fish ocean
mobs.LongDescription: A long, narrow fish swims past on his way to lunch.
mobs.Description:
The cobia is a long narrow fish with a protruding lower jaw and a
depressed head.  He wears dark stripes along his silvery white body,
making him appear even longer than he is.  He is probably on his way
to find some tasty squid.

mobs.Name: trout seatrout spotted fish ocean
mobs.LongDescription: A spotted seatrout surfaces as she chases a tasty snack.
mobs.Description:
The spotted seatrout has numerous distinct round spots on her back,
hence her name.  Her body is white on the bottom, and dark green on
the top.  She has a small set of canine teeth, which allow her to
grab hold of her tasty treats before they can escape.

mobs.Name: palometa fish ocean
mobs.LongDescription: A small, silvery palometa swims by quickly.
mobs.Description:
The palometa is a strange-looking fish indeed.  His long dorsal and
anal fins and compact body make him a sight to behold.  He has a
silvery body with bluish edges, and four narrow black bars along each
side.

mobs.Name: mako shark shortfin ocean
mobs.LongDescription: The mako shark races toward you, hoping you're as tasty as you smell.
mobs.Description:
The mako shark has a blue back and a white belly.  His short dorsal
fin cuts through the surface of the water as he races towards his
prey, which he grips firmly with his sharp teat and powerful jaws.

mobs.Name: kitten grey para miqi para'miqi feline
mobs.LongDescription: A grey ball of fur stalks a bowl of cream.
mobs.Description:
The grey ball of fur shows off as he pounces onto a bowl of cream,
spilling it everywhere!  This little fellow will someday become a
Para'miqi, a mischievious race of felines that inhabit dwellings and
steal goodies from them.  His green eyes have a glimmer of mischief
in them already, so he is well on his way to fulfilling his destiny.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 purr;%5 emote pounces on your big toe!

mobs.Name: kitten white rit'i feline
mobs.LongDescription: A snow white kitten stretches out to take a nap.
mobs.Description:
This kitten has a coat of the purest white.  He will someday become
one of the Rit'i, or snow cats, who live high in the mountains at the
edge of the jungle.  For now he just bides his time in the warmth of
the village, delighting in all the attention his lovely coat has
gotten him.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote grooms his beautiful coat.

mobs.Name: kitten spotted ch'ekche feline
mobs.LongDescription: A tiny spotted kitten is chasing the shadows out of the room.
mobs.Description:
This little ball of fur is covered with a golden coat that has been
sprinkled with black spots.  The fierce hunter in him is only now
showing itself, but he is only strong enough to stalk the shadows, or
the occassional tail of a littermate.  Someday he will become a
Ch'ekche, the race of felines that inhabit the jungles of the east.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote stalks his littermates tail!

mobs.Name: kitten black malki feline
mobs.LongDescription: Hiding in the shadows, a small black kitten prepares to pounce!
mobs.Description:
As black as night, this kitten will someday become a Malki.  His race
inhabits the jungles of the west, hiding in the trees until nightfall
when they are the most lethal of all jungle beasts.  He practices his
pouncing skills on his littermates for now, and he's gotten quite
good at attacking dustballs!
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote pounces on a dustball.;%5 lick nursemaid

mobs.Name: kitten golden paqu feline
mobs.LongDescription:
Like a ray of sunshine, the golden kitten lights up the room with his 
smile.
mobs.Description:
While most of the felines of Miqi'erke prefer the night, this little
fellow is comfortable in the daylight.  His tiny paws hold the
beginnings of very powerful claws, and his little head is just
starting to show a majestic mane.  He will someday become a Paqu, the
race of felines that moved from the jungles into the open plains. 
There his kind is feared by all.  Here in the village, he just brings
a little bit of sunshine into the otherwise dark jungle.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile

mobs.Name: kitten striped suwa feline
mobs.LongDescription: As stealthy as a thief, the striped kitten steals a piece of meat.
mobs.Description:
He stalks the nursery much like his race of Suwa stalk the jungle. 
His kind is the striped hunter with powerful claws and an attitude to
match.  For now he is just a nuisance to his littermates, always
stealing their food until the nursemaid catches him in the act.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 blink;%5 emote steals a piece of meat from his littermate.

mobs.Name: nursemaid malki feline
mobs.LongDescription: Smiling gently, the feline nursemaid watches after the kittens.
mobs.Description:
The feline nursemaid has been charged by Yanaquri with the duty of
caring for all the kittens.  She takes her job very seriously, and
she will protect them fiercely as if they were her own.  Like most of
the villagers, she is unable to bear her own, relying on the grace of
Yanaquri to populate Miqi'erke.  The nursemaid wears a coat of the
purest black fur, indicating that she is of the Malki race.  Her
emerald green eyes are fierce at first glance, but as you gaze into
them you relize her true nature.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote smiles pleasantly.

mobs.Name: oqe grey feline
mobs.LongDescription: Smiling innocently, the grey feline looks like mischief itself.
mobs.Description:
Oqe is the ever-smiling feline that is always playing tricks on the
villagers.  He is a patriarch of the Para'miqi, whose stories are
told by many races.  Oqe is one of the Juq'wawa, or first generation,
of Miqi'erke.  It was his litter that originally founded all of the
wild feline races.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 grin;%5 stare;%5 emote tries to look innocent.

mobs.Name: yuraq white feline
mobs.LongDescription: Yuraq stands before you, grooming her beautiful white coat.
mobs.Description:
Yuraq wears a coat of the purest white.  Her emerald green eyes are
the only bits of color that adorn her body.  She is a matriarch of
the Rit'i, or the mountain felines.  She has returned to Miqi'erke to
assist with the initiation of the newest litter into the secret order
of Yanaquri.  She will soon return to her mountain home with a new
generation of Rit'i.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 purr;%5 stretch

mobs.Name: mikhu black feline
mobs.LongDescription: As black as the jungle night, the black feline wears an aura of power.
mobs.Description:
The bringer of night, Mikhu is one of the companions of Tuta.  She is
the mother of a powerful race of jungle felines, known as the Malki. 
A direct descendant of Tuta herself, Mikhu is one of the Juq'wawa, or
first generation of Miqi'erke.  Her offspring have inhabited this
very jungle and protected it for thousands of generations.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote looks deep into your eyes.

mobs.Name: phuyu spotted feline
mobs.LongDescription: With a flick of his tail, the spotted feline lands silently.
mobs.Description:
The mighty Phuyu is the patriarch of the Ch'ekche race.  His kind
have lived in the trees for many generations, always ready to pounce
down onto unsuspecting prey.  He has a golden coat, covered with
black spots, and emerald green eyes.  As with the other adults of
this village, he is able to walk upright in the manner of Yanaquri. 
He can change his shape at will however, and with the blink of an eye
he may just disappear into the jungle.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote disappears suddenly!;%5 hide

mobs.Name: rey golden feline
mobs.LongDescription: A majestic beast stands before you, wearing his golden mane proudly.
mobs.Description:
King of the beasts in his own domain, Rey is a majestic creature
worthy of his title.  He is the son of Yanaquri and P'unqay, the
goddess of the day.  He is patriarch of the Paqu, the felines that
live in the golden sunlight.  His golden mane is quite majestic
indeed, and his powerful claws seem to serve as a reminder of his
authority.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote unleashes a tremendous roar!

mobs.Name: tigri striped feline
mobs.LongDescription: The feline thief grins mischieviously.
mobs.Description:
The stealthy thief of the jungle, Tigri smiles quietly knowing he
could steal your very soul if he so desired.  His beatuful striped
coat allows him to hide quietly in the forest, waiting for his next
victim to come along.  Tigri is the patriarch of the Suwa felines,
who inhabit the jungles of the east.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote moves quickly, and you notice your underwear is gone!;%5
blink

mobs.Name: infant wawa feline
mobs.LongDescription: An infant crawls along the floor, meowing pitifully.
mobs.Description:
The infant wears only what she came into the world with.  She has
tawny fur and bright green eyes.  Her tiny paws hold the beginnings
of claws that will someday make her quite the huntress.  She is Wawa,
the infant, and she represents the beginnings of the Miqi'erke.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 cry

mobs.Name: child erk'e feline
mobs.LongDescription: A Miqi'erke child purrs contentedly as she plays.
mobs.Description:
The young child has only recently grown large enough to adventure on
her own, but she knows she must return to the safety of her family
before too long.  Her tawny fur is starting to show dark brown
stripes, which will someday allow her to blend perfectly with the
foliage of her jungle home.  She is Erk'e, the child, and she
represents the youth of Miqi'erke.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile

mobs.Name: adolescent sipas feline
mobs.LongDescription: An adolescent purrs quietly as she grooms her beautiful coat.
mobs.Description:
With her tawny coat and dark brown stripes, this adolescent may blend
perfectly with the foliage of her jungle home.  Her green eyes
sparkle with the light of youth, but she is learning quickly and will
soon be an adult.  She is Sipas, the adolescent, and she represents
the time of life between youth and adulthood.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 purr

mobs.Name: woman adult warmi feline
mobs.LongDescription: Almost hidden in the shadows, an adult watches you intently.
mobs.Description:
A tawny coat and dark brown stripes allow this adult Miqi'erke to
blend perfectly with her shadowy surroundings.  She is a child of
night, preferring the cool darkness of the jungle to the opressive
heat of day.  Her long sharp claws are ready for attack, just in case
she needs them. She is Warmi, the woman, and she represents
adulthood.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote watches your every move.

mobs.Name: paya old woman feline
mobs.LongDescription: Deceptively quiet, an ancient feline stands watch over her domain.
mobs.Description:
The wisdom of the ages seems to reside with this ancient feline.  She
is strong and lean, at the peak of her power, but she knows that
death lies around the next corner.  She is Paya, the old woman, and
she represents the elders and wise ones.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote smiles knowingly.;%5 emote quietly grooms her coat.

mobs.Name: qoyllor star feline
mobs.LongDescription: Shinging brightly, Qoyllor is ready to ascend to Tuta.
mobs.Description:
As the Miqi'erke grow weary of the life of a mortal, they are allowed
to ascend into the night sky to live with Tuta.  There they live for
an eternity, returning to the jungle only at night in the guise of
Qoyllor.  Some choose to return eventually as Wawa, starting with a
new mortal life.

mobs.Name: tuta night sky dark goddess statue feline
mobs.Description:
Tuta, the night, rules over the realm of darkness in the jungle.  Her
statue depicts a woman dressed in black, with hair the color of night
and eyes the color of the jungle.  Her outstreched arms seem to be
reaching to embrace her children, the inhabitants of the dark jungle.

mobs.Name: feline god yanaquri statue
mobs.Description:
The fierce protector of the jungle, Yanaquri is the patron of the
Miqi'erke.  He is quite feline, wearing a coat the color of night,
and a mane of pure gold.  His long tail is covered with a roseated
pattern, and his sharp claws are held within paws of the darkest
black.  His fierce green eyes shine with the light of the moon, and
he wears a gentle smile that shows off his sharp teeth.  While he
wears a fierce facade, Yanaquri is known by his disciples to be a
kind and just god.

mobs.Name: mikuna chef cook feline
mobs.LongDescription: A large, and rather heavy feline stands stirring over a large pot.
mobs.Description:
Mikuna is a jovial fellow, always smiling as he prepares his
culinary delights for Miqi'erke.  He smells of his own delicious
concoctions, bits of which are stuck in the thick fur around his
mouth.  He smiles gently as he offers a whiff of his latest culinary
masterpiece.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote pats his ample belly.;%5 emote tastes a bit of stew from
 his pot.;%5 'How would you like to sample some of my tasty treats?

mobs.Name: miski sweets feline
mobs.LongDescription: Stuffing her ample mouth with sweets, Miski smiles happily.
mobs.Description:
Miski seems to taste more of her delicious treats than she sells!
She is very large, and very round.  Her gray coat has bits of fruit
stuck to it, and her hands are covered with sugar.  She smiles
innocently as she pulls a bit of candy from the fur on her chest.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 smile;%5 emote eats a candied fairy wing.;%5 blush;%5 'Hello
 sweetie!  How would you like to try one of my delicious bug bars?

mobs.Name: feline bibu bartender
mobs.LongDescription: Bibu shtaggersh ofer and offersh you a pint *hic* of hish finesht.
mobs.Description:
Bibu loves his drink, and he drinks as much of it as he possibly can.
He is a Para'miqi, son of Oqe, which is easy to tell by his soft grey
coat.  This mischievious fellow smells very strongly of ale and stale
smoke, but he doesn't seem to mind as he leans in closely to offer
you a pint of hish finesht.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 hic;%5 emote staggers over to the bar.;%5 giggle;%5 'Shay buddy!
 Howshabout a tashte of shome catnip juish?

mobs.Name: feline villager miqi'erken
mobs.LongDescription: A villager heads towards the temple to worship his god.
mobs.Description:
The Miqi'erken villager is almost invisible as he uses the shadows to
cover his movement.  He has a beautiful black coat and emerald green
eyes, and his powerful muscles ripple with every movement.

mobs.Name: feline worshipper miqi'erken
mobs.LongDescription: Bowing low before her god's likeness, the Miqi'erken chants softly.
mobs.Description:
With her golden coat arranged around her, the Miqi'erken bows low
before the statue of her god, thanking him for his protection.  She
chants softly in a language made of words and sounds of the jungle.

mobs.Name: villager feline miqi'erken
mobs.LongDescription: A Miqi'erken wanders quietly through his village.
mobs.Description:
The villager nods his noble head at your approach, signifying that he
means you no ill will, and hoping that you feel the same way.  His
golden mane rests majestically around his shoulders, signifying that
he is a Paqu, descended from Rey.

mobs.Name: priestess tuta feline
mobs.LongDescription: Black as night, the priestess tends to her duties and to Tuta.
mobs.Description:
Chosen for her likeness to her ancestor Mikhu, the priestess guides
the villagers in their worship of Tuta.  She is tall and strong, with
a coat the color of night and eyes the color of the jungle.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 worsh goddess;%5 emote puts some flowers before the statue of Tuta.

mobs.Name: priest yanaquri feline
mobs.LongDescription: Bowing his head in reverance, the priest tends to his duties.
mobs.Description:
To serve Yanaquri as a priest is a great honor for a Miqi'erke.  This
young feline knows the responsibility well, and he performs his
duties to the best of his ability.  He is tall and strong, with a
coat of pure gold.  His large eyes have a yellowish tint, and appear
to be very wise despite the priest's youthful appearance.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 worsh yanaquri;%5 emote bows his head.

mobs.Name: mud monster mudmonster
mobs.LongDescription: A horrifying Mudmonster is slowly evolving from the mud...
mobs.Description:
It sure looks like something out of a horror movie.  It strongly resembles
a huge figure made up from mud alone, and it sure looks like it had human 
flesh for breakfast and is strongly intent on having the same for dinner
- Perhaps you?

mobs.Name: bat
mobs.LongDescription: The small fierce-looking bat is hanging from the ceiling, obviously sleeping.
mobs.Description:
You have never in your entire life seen such a mean looking small creature,
though it looks rather peaceful, hanging there, sleeping.  The thought of 
arousing this cruel creature doesn't sit well in your bones.

mobs.Name: rat
mobs.LongDescription: The huge hungry-looking sewer rat sits here.

mobs.Name: spider
mobs.LongDescription: The small hairy Spider is here, busy with its web.

mobs.Name: beetle
mobs.LongDescription: The giant, mean-looking earth beetle is here.

mobs.Name: maggot
mobs.LongDescription: The giant maggot is here, simply existing.

mobs.Name: snake
mobs.LongDescription: The snake slithers towards you. It looks very mean.

mobs.Name: wanderer
mobs.LongDescription: The evil wanderer stares at you with a piercing gaze.
mobs.Description:
The evil wanderer is very thin.  He is dressed in a grey cloak.  He doesn't
look like he'd be your first choice as a travelling companion.

mobs.Name: homunculus homo
mobs.LongDescription: The creature homunculus is here, looking at you with an evil look.
mobs.Description:
The Homunculus appears in a man-like form, about 18" tall, has a greenish,
reptilian skin, leathery wings, and a batlike mouth, with teeth passing on
a venom.

mobs.Name: grand knight paladin
mobs.LongDescription: The Grand Knight is standing here, waiting for someone to help.
mobs.Description:
The Knight is standing here, smiling at you.  He is dressed all in white, blue
and silver.  He looks VERY strong, as he stands here, ready to help the
innocent.

mobs.Name: chr-eff'n chr
mobs.LongDescription: The chr-eff'n are crawling here, looking around with its yellow eyes.
mobs.Description:
The head and torso of a chr-eff'n is copper-covered, with yellow,
glowing eyes.  The lower body is in an orange shading.

mobs.Name: morkoth
mobs.LongDescription: The morkoth are standing here, waiting for someone to KILL!
mobs.Description:
It's a five feet tall, shadow monster. This has the shape between
a human and a rat.  It breaths very heavily while it stares at you.

mobs.Name: red dragon
mobs.LongDescription: The Red fierce-looking dragon stares at you angrily.
mobs.Description:
The red dragon stares at you, angrily, as it wakes when you arrive.  It says
'Oh, human YOU woke me up...Hsssss', while it moves closer, 'Can one NEVER
sleep in peace...Hssss'.

mobs.Name: sea hag
mobs.LongDescription: The Sea Hag is here, swimming around.
mobs.Description:
The sea hag is so ghastly looking that you feel the deepest fear: Big yellow
eyes and sharp teeth.  Its ears are very big, and it has small sharp horns.
This type of monster is one of the greatest haters of beauty (next after
Medusa).

mobs.Name: guardian naga
mobs.LongDescription: The Guardian Naga looks kindly at you.
mobs.Description:
The naga are a snake-liked creature.  She is covered in green-gold scales with
silvery triangles along her back.  Her eyes are golden.  She notices that you
are staring at her, and she says: 'Watch out.  This way leads to some evil
creatures'.

mobs.Name: scaled basilisk
mobs.LongDescription: The scaled Basilisk crawls towards you slowly.
mobs.Description:
The basilisk is a reptilian monster.  It has eight legs, and a strong, toothy
jaws.  It is dull brown with yellowish underbelly.  Its eyes are glowing pale
green.

mobs.Name: lemure blob
mobs.LongDescription: The lemure blob slithers towards you for an attack!
mobs.Description:
This looks like a vaguely human blob.  Big black yellow eyes, and a mouth going
a little bit out from the face.  The lemure does not look interested in you at
all, but it attacks anyway.  It looks like its mind has been burned out.

mobs.Name: jones cruncher ettin
mobs.LongDescription: Jones is standing here glaring at you.
mobs.Description:
At the first sight you thought Jones was an Orc, but when it came closer you
saw his second head.  He wears an animal skin dress, filthy and moth eaten. 
Jones really stinks...

mobs.Name: herald mouse killer ettin
mobs.LongDescription: Herald is standing here looking confused at you.
mobs.Description:
When you look at Herald, you feel petty.  His clothes are really poor, and one
of his heads hangs down.  At the rope around his stomach hangs dead mice and
rats.  He does not smell good.

mobs.Name: dwarf dwarven guard miner
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven guard shifts from foot to foot, bored.
mobs.Description:
Perhaps the smartly golden yellow uniform laden with gold braid and
bright ribbons of honor is a point of pride with the guard, or perhaps
he simply takes his job quite seriously.  In either case, the uniform is
spotless, the beard neatly combed and braided, the boots spit-shined.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 em snaps to attention.
;%5 em eyes you suspiciously.

mobs.Name: Hagbard dwarf dwarven worker miner
mobs.LongDescription: Fortunately for Hagbard the Helpless, Hermann the homely heals him.
mobs.Description:
Hagbard the Helpless is not really helpless at all, of course, but he is
frequently hurt by the many hazards the miners face on a daily basis.
Somehow, fate has a way of finding him when there is a cave-in, noxious
gasses fill the tunnels or a boulder decides to roll off in search of a
dwarf to crush.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 em tugs at your sleeve, looking piteous.

mobs.Name: dwarf angel mining
mobs.LongDescription:
An angel servant of Kwazihuatl makes the world glow before your very
eyes.
mobs.Description:
Mining is a hard and dangerous job.  Who needs a guardian angel more than
those who seek to rip the flesh from Mother Earth?  This little angel is
never seen, but he has the thick beard, thick calloused fingers and
stocky build of a veteran miner.  He wears the mark of Kwazihuatl, god of
dwarf miners.
mobs.ActionScript: %%cast 3 miner

mobs.Name: holgarth storekeeper
mobs.LongDescription: Holgarth the Singing #wShopkeeper#Y waits for you to make up your mind.
mobs.Description:
Holgarth likes to sing, especially in the interior caverns of the
mountain, where the acoustics are often unpredictable.  Since his last
aria deep underground was abruptly ended by the loud rumble of a
cave-in, his king has asked that he restrict his songs to soft croons.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 hum

mobs.Name: baker
mobs.LongDescription: Granite Head is known for bread hard as the iron dug from the mountain.
mobs.Description:
Granite Head is a tall, strong dwarf wearing a large white apron.  He is
well-dusted with white flour, spices and ground rock.  As he is the only
baker in the area, the miners rely on him for their daily meals.  He
also furnishes the bar with their small list of edible fare.

mobs.Name: lizard
mobs.LongDescription: A giant cave lizard is foraging for food along the cavern floor.
mobs.Description:
Godzilla?  No, just an overgrown cave lizard.  He thrives on the many
insects and small animals that dwell here under the mountain.  His cool,
dark green skin looks firm and spiky in places, and you can see the
muscles rippling beneath.  His long forked tongue whips out to sample
the air.

mobs.Name: giant
mobs.LongDescription: A giant is wandering around the mountainside, looking for food.
mobs.Description:
The giant is about 18 feet tall, with arms of steel, and looks in
excellent physical condition.  It takes a lot to keep that small
mountain of muscle and flesh in peak condition, and so he's not too
picky about what (or who) he eats.

mobs.Name: dwarven dwarf miner mineworker worker
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven mineworker whistles while he works.
mobs.Description:
The mineworker is quite tired, but he enjoys the whistle of breath
through his mustache, and the way the whistle echoes throughout the
cavern.

mobs.Name: dwarven mineleader dwarf mine leader miner
mobs.LongDescription: The mine leader can out-dwarf any of his mineworkers.
mobs.Description:
Out-dwarf?  He can out-drink the most bottomless of them.  With a dull
pick-axe and a played-out vein of ore he can outproduce the swiftest.
And when he combs out his luxuriant blond beard, you can see it's the
longest.  No wonder he's the leader!

mobs.Name: doctor dwarf healer
mobs.LongDescription: Amazingly, this dwarf is as barecheeked as a newborn (non-dwarf) babe.
mobs.Description:
Very unusual - most likely unique among dwarves, this dwarf is smooth
cheeked and recently shaven.  He looks at you with an air of fatherly
concern, and when he fingers his beard-trimming shears you note the
twinkle in his merry brown eyes.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 say Open wide!
;%5 say Take a deep breath!
;%5 say That beard is going to have to go, I'm afraid.
;%5 say Tsk! Tsk!

mobs.Name: ill dwarf miner
mobs.LongDescription: Hope what this dwarf's got isn't catching, whatever it is!
mobs.Description:
With his pasty skin and wispy beard, it's clear this miner is not well.
Most dwarves would rather suffer their many illnesses than risk a visit
to this doctor, known for his large sets of beard-trimming shears and
razors.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 sneeze;
%14 cough

mobs.Name: ypeels miner sleepy dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: Yawning loudly, the miner wonders why you're in his dream.
mobs.Description:
With no daylight and no moonlight, time loses meaning and the miners
often sleep unusual hours.  This one has been asleep for about an hour,
and is convinced you are part of his nightmare.  Beware!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 yawn;
%5 snore

mobs.Name: dwarf sick miner
mobs.LongDescription: Miraculously, the dwarf in the pool of blood on the floor still lives.
mobs.Description:
Bleeding profusely from his many wounds, the dwarf awaits the doctor's
healing touch.  He must be desperate to be here, because the doctor is
known for his (*cringe*) shaving gear.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 bleed

mobs.Name: offduty guard miner
mobs.LongDescription: The guard sits with his feet propped up on the table in front of him.
mobs.Description:
Bored by his companion's lies, yet secretly wanting to believe them, the
guard shares some lies of his own.  It's all part of a long-standing
game they play, seeing who can tell the most outrageous but unprovably
false tales.

mobs.Name: offduty guard miner
mobs.LongDescription: An offduty guard sits back, swapping lies with his buddies.
mobs.Description:
Ale in hand, calculating look in his eye, the offduty guard tells his
buddies about all the giants he has killed, wenches he has seduced, and
secret veins of gold he has discovered.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%8 say And then there was this mountain troll ... got 'im with me axe, I
did!
;%5 say Caught this little giant boy red handed, up to his ears in the
ale!
;%5 say 'ave you 'eard what they're usin' fer labor down at the mill?!

mobs.Name: guard miner
mobs.LongDescription: Glaring out at you from under his helmet, the guard looks fierce!
mobs.Description:
Clearly you've wandered into a part of the mine where you shouldn't be.
There were no "VERBOTEN!" signs, nothing that actually SAID "off
limits", but from the look on this guard's face, you'd better go back
the way you came - and fast!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%8 grumble
;%5 say I coulda been a sergeant by now if'n I'd worked guard duty up at
the mill.

mobs.Name: guard miner
mobs.LongDescription: The guard looks menacing in the full glory of his heavy chainmail.
mobs.Description:
Dwarven chainmail protects the bulging biceps and massive thigh muscles
of the mining guard.  It's not clear what he's guarding against, or who,
but his size and his uniform are pretty awesome.
mobs.ActionScript: %%8 spit

mobs.Name: giant snake sssnake
mobs.LongDescription: The giant sssnake looksss about for a ledge from which to hang.
mobs.Description:
Hisssss!  Thissss sssnake can ssssee in the dark, ssssso watch out!  It
lookssss much to large to ssssettle for mere mice, indeed, it looksss
large enough to swallow a dwarf, whole.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%8 em hissssssses.
;%6 em looks you over, looking for a nice juicy bare spot on your skin to
sink
his fangs.

mobs.Name: queen Gwandolyn dwarven dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: Queen Gwandolyn idly picks at her nose-wart, making it bleed.
mobs.Description:
In truth, even the dragons could not abide Gwandolyn's rather nasty
temper.  They didn't bother to toast her, but they would much rather
not live near this perpetually cranky dwarf.  The mining dwarves
remain mellow, however, drenched in their marvelous ale.

mobs.Name: king Kwathoum wide-bottom
mobs.LongDescription: King Kwathoum the wide-bottomed wipes drops of ale from his beard.
mobs.Description:
King Kwathoum the Wide-Bottomed son of Raktwein the Orc-Hunter is fairly
diminutive for a dwarf.  Far below the normal stature for his race, he
barely reaches shoulder height on his queen.  The dominant feature of
this little dwarf is his truly immense nose.  Point of pride for
Kwathoum, it looms out over his long, luxuriously golden beard which,
itself, curls merrily down towards his knees.
mobs.ActionScript: %%6 tango queen;%8 daydream

mobs.Name: sleep sleeping sleeper miner
mobs.LongDescription: A miner sleeps sprawled out over his pallet on the mine floor.
mobs.Description:
Impervious to rumblings deep in the belly of the mountain, loud snores
from other sleeping dwarves, and the odd, awe-full, noisome smells of
many unwashed bodies (and socks), the miner is so-o-o tired that he
sleeps deeply, dreaming, perhaps, of finding the hidden vein of gold in
this mountain.

mobs.Name: egil dragon sleeping
mobs.LongDescription: Let sleeping dragons lie.  (Old Dwarven Saying)
mobs.Description:
Egil is a very very old dragon, centuries old, older than most other
dragons in this world.  He is the source and the keeper of dragon tales,
dragon history.  He is revered by other dragons.  The dwarves both fear
and respect him, and leave him in peace.  He is their totem, their
cave-god, lord of all beneath the surface of the earth.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 snore

mobs.Name: shy lfuhsab dwarf miner
mobs.LongDescription: One dwarf is hiding behind a metal fern wreathed in blue smoke.
mobs.Description:
To enhance the ambiance in this little hole-in-the-(rock)-wall bar, the
management has spread about many plants.  Without sunshine, real plants
would die, so metal plants have taken their place.  This dwarf is
uncomfortable in the bar (nobody knows his name), and is shyly hiding
behind the metal fern.
mobs.ActionScript: %%8 blush

mobs.Name: yzeens dwarf miner
mobs.LongDescription: A bright red nose and droopy eyes warn you to stay clear of this miner.
mobs.Description:
Wiping his painfully red nose on the rough woolen sleeve of his tunic,
the miner wonders idly if he is allergic to the mine dust, the smoke
from his pipe, or simply life.  He is strong and in good spirits,
though, and not a dwarf to trifle with!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 sneeze
;%8 em rubs a nice clean hankerchief against his reddened, dripping nose.

mobs.Name: yppah dwarf gronlgrg gr#<oe>nlgrg
