mobs.LongDescription: Singing, Gr#<oe>nlgrg works at separating rock from mountain.
mobs.Description:
His fellow dwarves duck and work up quick excuses when they see
Gr#<oe>nlgrg coming.  His persistent cheeriness, smiles and ready
laughter are like a dull pickaxe scraping along smooth rock to the
others.  It is hard for even a dwarf to be mean spirited to
Gr#<oe>nlgrg, mostly because he is impervious to such behavior.
mobs.ActionScript: %%8 sing

mobs.Name: yepdo dwarf miner
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarf sits in the dark, wondering why he can't see.
mobs.Description:
While he's not very clever for a dwarf, still, his lack of brilliance
generally doesn't lead him into trouble.  Indeed, he has a fool's own
luck, just not the intelligence to take advantage of it.
mobs.ActionScript: %%8 twitch

mobs.Name: miner dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: The mighty dwarf enjoys reaping iron ore from the heart of the mountain.
mobs.Description:
Putting his massive back into each swing of his pickaxe, the hardworking
dwarf gets into a steady rhythm reminiscent of a heartbeat as he chips
away at the heart of the mountain.  As with his brethren, this dwarf was
born to the life, born to carve out his domain beneath the surface of
the earth.

mobs.Name: miner handsome dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: The very handsome dwarf spends a moment to stroke his beard.
mobs.Description:
He is average height for a dwarf, about 4', or about 1.25 m (as
the European dwarves would measure him).  His hair is lushly thick and
the golden color of the ale he loves.  His body hair is also thick, so
much that his eyebrows seem to join over his nose, forming a single
ridge of hair.  His beard is likewise thick and long, and full of odd
objects, insects and bugs that have yet to be combed away.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%7 admire handsome;
%5 holdhand handsome

mobs.Name: giant Thorvald
mobs.LongDescription: Thorvald yawns, accidently swallowing a small bird.
mobs.Description:
Thorvald doesn't notice.  He's a bit tired, and a bit hungover, and not
too bright, in any case.  The bird was flying nearby and got sucked in
by Thorvald's mighty yawn.  Thorvald may notice a bit of a fluttering in
his stomach.  But probably not.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 say chirp!

mobs.Name: Hermann cod
mobs.LongDescription: Hermann the Homely has helped Hagbard heal his wounds.
mobs.Description:
Hermann would have liked to be THE healer, but a relative of Gwandolyn
the queen was given the post.  He is a kind dwarf with a gentle, if
exceedingly homely face.  The dwarves believe that the devil sickness is
frightened away by Hermann's homeliness.  Perhaps it is so.

mobs.Name: death
mobs.LongDescription: Death haunts the subterranean regions of the mine.
mobs.Description:
A miner's life is often cut short by the many things that may go wrong,
from poisonous gas, to a cave in, a slip of the axe or the fire of an
awakened cave-dragon.  Death is always with them, hidden in the dark
underground passages.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em looks you over craftily, measuring the days you have left to your
 pathetic life.
;%8 em tells you, "I hear Harold the Undertaker has a good deal on now.
Maybe you should take advantage of it and save your family some money."
;%8 em silently sharpens his scythe, waiting for your hourglass to empty.

mobs.Name: Magnus giant
mobs.LongDescription: Magnus the Merciless flexes his magnificent muscles.
mobs.Description:
Magnus the Merciless crushes all before him.  Standing tall, even for a
giant, he spends some months out of each year lifting huge iron bars at
the dwarven steel mill.  Besides the plentiful food, the mill gives him
an opportunity to develop and tone his beautiful musculature.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em admires his magnificent biceps.
;%5 flex
;%5 sing magnus

mobs.Name: Gr#<oe>tben grotben giant
mobs.LongDescription: Dragging his leg, Gr#<oe>tben tries to finish his meal while on patrol.
mobs.Description:
Grog, greasy pig meat, grainy wholemeal bread, Gr#<oe>tben gobbles it
all down while gimping along on patrol.  Gr#<oe>tben is on the lookout
for grog-thieves and other greedy souls.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 yell #rFee #cFie #gFoobar #mFumble#W
;%8 em picks a small nit out of his body hair and sticks it in his
sandwich.

mobs.Name: Uzhumer ypmurg dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: Uzhumer the Cranky growls, "Get back where you belong, dirtwalker."
mobs.Description:
Uzhumer the Unhumorous ... Uzhumer the Cranky ... Uzhumer who would eat
iron ore before he would say thing remotely cheerful.  A dwarf of middle
years, his thick, wildly wavy black hair has grown a small halo of gray.
His face is deeply lined, all lines pointing down of course, from his
perpetual glower.  Still, he is a good friend for those who can endure
his eternal pessimism.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 grumble
;%4 say What do you think you're looking at?
;%5 say Get back where you belong, dirtwalker.
;%5 glare
;%3 raspberry

mobs.Name: gnome Nell
mobs.LongDescription: Cmdr Nell, Chief of Gnomish Spy Operations, hunts for her cookie stash.
mobs.Description:
Nell is a very commanding little gnome (other gnomes call her bossy).
She takes her job as Chief of Gnomish Spy Operations (GSO) and Overseer
of Ballooning (OB) very seriously.  She and Kith are on a mission to
Discover the Lost Gnomes.  A small party of gnomes left GnomeHome some
(few hundred) years ago never to be seen again.  They were to assist
(for a princely fee) the dwarves in their mining operations, about which
they had an intense (and intensely gnomish) curiosity.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 say  WHO FORGOT THE COOKIES???

mobs.Name: gnome Kith
mobs.LongDescription: Kith's in charge of Watching Over Nell, who often thinks she's Xena.
mobs.Description:
Kith is one of the Sensible Gnomes (yes, there are a few, mostly from a
Sensible Gnome village just northeast of Midgaard).  It is his duty to
see that when Nell starts playing Warrior Princess, she comes to no
harm.  He is also actively searching for The Lost Gnomes, who left the
yak farm where they were brought up to seek adventure in the wide world,
and to Help the Dwarves.

mobs.Name: gnome Martha
mobs.LongDescription: Martha, Junior Gnomish Spy, waits for her turn with the spyglass.
mobs.Description:
From their landing place high in a Giant Tree, the gnomes can see much
of the mountain.  They have brought a spyglass, and Martha is itching to
get her delicate gnomish fingers on it.  The gnome who discovers the
Lost Gnomes will be famous in Gnomish History.  Martha is small and
delicate, even for a gnome.  Her skin is smooth, soft, the color of
aging parchment.  She is the youngest of the Gnomish Spy Group.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%3drop stick
;%3 rem stick
;%1 get stick
%5 say Lemme see! Lemme see! Have you found them??

mobs.Name: Bint gnome
mobs.LongDescription: Bint listens, enraptured, as her friends frighten her with stories.
mobs.Description:
Bint sits in the dark at the back of the small hut, listening in
fascination as her friends weave tales of horror and mystery, brave
adventures of derring-do and narrow escapes through rifts in the fabric
of time.  She has long since forgotten WHY she is hidden away here.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5em munches away on a chocolate cookie.

mobs.Name: Ernie
mobs.LongDescription: Ernie became lost in his own story, a tale of 4 gnomes underground.
mobs.Description:
Ernie, Magnificent Storyteller, is part of the famous Legend of the
Lost Gnomes.  He is a gnome of many years, and his fair hair now grows
in small wisps atop his head.  His clothing is covered in several years
of accumulated dust.  His current tale, one of the adventures of 4
gnomes living under a great mountain, is one of his best.  Then again,
it's also all quite true.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%8 say ... and then, one of the dwarves told them the Legend of the
Great
Cookie Jar ...

mobs.Name: Genna gnome lost
mobs.LongDescription: Genna looks hungrily at the cookie jar, which holds the remaining stash.
mobs.Description:
Genna agreed to a Gnomish Story Swap as a prelude to a Gnomish Cookie
Feast, but the Story Swap, although fascinating, is taking
f-o-r-e-v-e-r, and she is #rhungry#N!  She is a very chubby little
gnome, covered with a hundred years or so of accumulated dust (which she
doesn't notice nor, if she did, would she mind).  Her turn at
storytelling is next, and she is thinking of a story involving 4 little
gnomes who perish of hunger in the middle of a storytelling fest!
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 em blushes as her stomach growls loudly.

mobs.Name: Squish lost gnome
mobs.LongDescription: Squish shivers in fear at the tale of gnomish ghosts haunting.
mobs.Description:
The stories are deliciously scary, spooky and frightening.  Squish
likes best stories about ancient, evil gnomes coming back as ghosts,
haunting the living.  Although, truth be told, he's never known a truly
evil gnome, he's fully prepared to believe they exist.  Squish was
but a lad of 173 when his expedition left on a Great Adventure in the
Underground Land of the Dwarves.  He fully expects to be part of a Great
Gnomish Legend himself one day!
mobs.ActionScript: %%8 em shivers, moving a little closer to the other gnomes.

mobs.Name: termite
mobs.LongDescription: A giant termite flies at you spitting acid, fangs ready for your throat.
mobs.Description:
This is a termite like you've never seen before!  Termites should be
small and easily quashed.  This one is as big as you are, with the
armature and weaponry of the fierce insect that he is.  Got any bug
spray?
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 say I never met a tree I didn't like ... to bite!

mobs.Name: Hrugnar giant
mobs.LongDescription: Hrugnar swallows his potent grog more easily than his buddies' tales.
mobs.Description:
After all, Hrugnar has spun some of the same tales himself.  Hrugnar is
a larger than average, well respected giant, with shoulder-length thick
blond hair that he wears tied back with a dragon-leather thong.  He
loves to go stomping with his fellow giants, and brags about the many
dragons he has slain.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5em picks a really big louse out of his beard and flicks it away.

mobs.Name: Olaf giant
mobs.LongDescription: Olaf shouts up to Astrid, "C'mon, sugar-pie, I won't be gone long!"
mobs.Description:
Olaf is large, even for a giant, with a big, hairy barrel chest, a large
grog-belly, and thighs like tree trunks.  He loves to go out stompin
with his friends, which basically means getting roaring drunk and
creating as much havoc as possible in Stanneg, Tynstri and any of the
other small villages they stumble into.  Astrid tries hard to make a
good husband and a good provider out of him, but the raw material she
has to work with is lacking a LOT.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 belch
;%8 say Awww, Astrid, angel-face, I've just #wgotta#N go stompin' with
the guys!

mobs.Name: Lodur lefty
mobs.LongDescription: Lodur the Left Handed looks for someone to loot.
mobs.Description:
Lodur the sLy, "Lefty Lodur" as the wanted posters call him.  A very
sinister looking man, he hides among the large lilies of the valley,
preying on lone travelers, leering at them from behind large lilies,
lunging out at them, looting them, then leaving them leaking blood.
mobs.ActionScript: %%8 em deftly slips his hand into your backpack and grabs some gold.

mobs.Name: Astrid
mobs.LongDescription: Astrid yells down to Olaf, "Don't you sugar-pie me, you little worm!"
mobs.Description:
Well, I suppose only another giant could call Olaf "little".  Astrid is
a small, feminine giantess with lush curves in all the right places (at
least, Olaf thinks so).  Her pale blond hair is kept firmly braided and
wound around her head like a coronet.  Her eyes are the deep blue of a
summer sky, as Olaf tells her when he's been out stomping.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em yells down to Olaf, "You get up off your lazy hairy bottom, Olaf
 and get up here and DO something about that boy of yours!"
;%5 em yells down at the "boys", "You just take yourselves off to the
 Stubbies Steel Mill and find yourselves an #whonest#W job and stop
 all that #wstompin!#N
;%8 em yells to Olaf, "You stomp any more dirt in here and #wI'll stomp
 all over you, I will!!#N"

mobs.Name: Gullveig giant girl
mobs.LongDescription: Gullveig has looked EVERYWHERE for her Nelly doll, so it must be hiding.
mobs.Description:
Gullveig looks much like a younger version of her mother, Astrid.  She
is small, fair, with long blond braids that end, usually, in a dirty
ribbon.  Her deep blue eyes look out at you with interest from a face
with very regular features, cool creamy-white skin and a very determined
expression.  She radiates confidence in herself and her abilities to
make the world grant her desires.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5em says, "Nelly!  Where are you Nelly?  C'mere Nelly!"
;%5 pout
;%5 sulk

mobs.Name: Nelly doll
mobs.LongDescription: The Nelly doll looks furtively out from under Astrid's bed.
mobs.Description:
The doll is, indeed, hiding from Gullveig.  And she hopes fervently that
Gullveig will NEVER find her.  Indeed, she's been working hard on a
"forgetting" spell so Gullveig will forget she ever HAD a Nelly doll.
Nelly is dressed as the real Nelly does for her Mind Bogglingly
Magnificent Mindslayer act.  Her rainbow cape hides many magic
treasures.  Although she is a doll, she is (hopefully WAS) the toy of a
giant girl, and so she is quite as large as an average human, larger
than Nelly the Gnome. Nelly's  brief flame of fame led every little girl
to want a Nelly doll.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em peeks nervously out from under the quilt on the bed.
;%5 em tells one of the Lost Argyles to stay lost.

mobs.Name: guard Gunnar giant
mobs.LongDescription: It's not clear whether Gunnar is guarding the gate or his grog.
mobs.Description:
Gunnar's favorite position is rocking back on the back two legs of his
chair, feet propped up on the desk, grog in hand, staring up at his
favorite pinup girl (Helga).  The road sees little activity beyond the
occasional lost tourist (quickly dispatched for a snack) or a small
expedition of giants out for a good stomp.  This suits Gunnar's
personality quite well.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em gulps down another tankard of grog.
;%5 spit
;%5 sing

mobs.Name: Ymer
mobs.LongDescription: Ymer the Stout lumbers about trying to stay upright after the grogfest.
mobs.Description:
Of course there is always something to celebrate, and this time Ymer
really tyed one on.  He's not too sure how much grog he swallowed,
although he has a vague memory of heading down to the cellar for another
barrel and being startled there by a tiny person wearing spectacles.
Not that gnomes or dwarves are unknown to him, but they rarely make it
into the stronghold without being eaten.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 hiccup
;%5 em puts his head in his hands and moans.

mobs.Name: Gunhild
mobs.LongDescription: Redhaired Gunhild stays busy sweeping the gallery floor.
mobs.Description:
Gunhild's deep red hair tells you something about her temper.  The giant
children are rather naughty about leaving their things over the floor,
and Gunhild sweeps them right off the floor, through the railing that
runs around the U shaped floor and onto the heads of the giants below.
This is very distressing to the children.  The giants, when they are in
the hall below, don't seem to notice.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%8 em shakes her broom at you threateningly.
;%8 mutters, "Children should be kept outside, where they belong!"
;%15 spank Stanley

mobs.Name: Stanley
mobs.LongDescription: Stanley shouts "Stop!", seeing small sweets slide slowly away.
mobs.Description:
Stanley is a small (for a giant) and very nasty little boy.  His mother
Astrid is constantly attempting to placate him with sweets, but he
continues to whine.  He is a VERY fat little boy, with rotten teeth and
breath (from all the sweets) and a tendency to throw very loud temper
tantrums.  His father is very proud of Stanley's lungs.  If Gunhild
continues to sweep Stanley's sweets off the floor, and if Astrid
succeeds in keeping Olaf home, then Olaf will undoubtedly get to hear a
LOT more of his son's powerful voice.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 fart;%10 tantrum;%3 innocent

mobs.Name: Ulfar
mobs.LongDescription: Idly polishing his mighty war-axe, Ulfar glares down at you.
mobs.Description:
Ulfar is one of the mightiest of the giants who live at this stronghold.
He is probably the only one who combines both intelligence and size.
Unfortunately he also believes bathing is a conspiracy foisted by
smaller races upon the mighty, and he steadfastly refuses to
participate.  Of course, the other giants are not big fans of bathing
either, but they occasionally DO swim - or at least fall into large
bodies of water.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 em idly picks at his lice.

mobs.Name: rugrat
mobs.LongDescription: All whiskers and long tail, the rugrat watches the world walk by.
mobs.Description:
All grey and brown fur (and dust), the rugrats love to roll around in
the dust beneath the bed, playing with the small toys that they filch
from Stanley.  They are clever little rugrats, blending into the carpet
when they need to hide, but sneaking out when nobody is looking to
steal candy and small treasures.
mobs.ActionScript: %%3 rub

mobs.Name: argyle argy sock
mobs.LongDescription: Argyle the Sock isn't really lost, he's just on vacation.
mobs.Description:
Let's face it.  Being a sock is NOT the World's Best Job!  You encase
something whose odor is the source of endless jokes, and you become
yourself, seeped in that odor.  You are constantly trod upon in the hot
humid darkness inside a shoe.  You never get to SEE anything beyond the
inside of a drawer, but have to rely on the shoe's description of the
world.  Once used, you're flung aside to be tramped on until you are
thrown into a large vat of water and drowned, only to go through the
entire cycle again.  Argy and his brother have escaped this terrible
fate by the simple strategem of separating.  Only one of them had to
hide.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 twitch

mobs.Name: dog hound wardog
mobs.LongDescription: The vicious wardog is dreaming of tearing prey limb from limb.
mobs.Description:
One of Ulfar's favorites, the dog (Ulfar calls him "Dog") stands half
again as tall as a normal human (if there is such a thing).  Ulfar says
if he had a half dozen dogs like this one, the giants would Rule the
World instead of just using it for their plaything.
mobs.ActionScript: %%2 growl

mobs.Name: bnarkl dwarf spy
mobs.LongDescription: Bnarkl silently observes, making mental notes of all he sees.
mobs.Description:
Bnarkl is the Ultimate Dwarven Spy, sent to keep an eye on the giants
via the fake barrel of grog in the cellar of their stronghold. Bnarkl's
beard and mustache are well-trimmed and well-waxed.  He is slender for a
dwarf, but as a spy, he is continually needing to get out of "tight
spots". He is not sure why he was told to spy on the giants, but he
reports back on their grog supplies and occasionally makes a small hole
in one of the kegs.  The giants (like everyone else) buy their ale from
the dwarves.
mobs.ActionScript: %%4 peer;%5 pace

mobs.Name: Biff brewmaster
mobs.LongDescription: Brewmaster Biff glares sternly at you. "You can buy your ale next door."
mobs.Description:
Ooops!  You've stepped into the private (and very busy) domain of Master
BrewMaster Biff the Fat.  Gnomish hops and a secret, ancient dwarven
recipe are used to brew the best and most potent ale known to dwarf (or
gnome or man).  Grog, a byproduct of the process and considered by the
dwarves to be not-worth-bothering-with, is sold to the giants who live
northeast of here.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 glare;%5 threaten

mobs.Name: gnomish gnome farmer
mobs.LongDescription: The farmer polishes the twirly horn of his favorite yak.
mobs.Description:
A small group of communal gnomes farms the rich pastures near the
dwarven mountains.  They provide the dwarves with flour, hops, and
advice on the steel mill machinery, and the dwarves give them the finest
ploughs and steel wool (for polishing the yak horns) that exist in this
world.
mobs.ActionScript: %%8 praise yak;%5 admire yak

mobs.Name: yak
mobs.LongDescription: The magnificently hairy yak likes to yak it up with fellow yaks.
mobs.Description:
At 2 m. (6'6") high at the shoulder, covered with thick, meaty muscles
and thick, wildly growing hair, with two long, curving horns that stick
w-a-y out in front of him, the yak believes himself to be a very sexy
beast.  With a small horde of awestruck gnomes to cater to his every
whim, brush his hair till it shines, feed him raspberries and celery,
and polish his rainbow horns, life seems pretty fine to the yak and his
herd.
mobs.ActionScript: %%7 twitch

mobs.Name: Brunhilde giant B
mobs.LongDescription: Brunhilde leans on the railing, trading insults with the giants below.
mobs.Description:
Giant courtship rituals are bizarre, aren't they?  Brunhilde ("B" to her
friends) is a large giantess, with broad shoulders, strong arms, and a
will of iron.  Her carrot-red hair falls in two long braids down to her
waist.  She has been flirting with many of the male giants for years
now in this fashion, but life near Astrid and Olaf has convinced her
never to marry.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%3 flirt;%5 chuckle
;%5 say Ha! Not all of you is so giant, Ulfar!
;%5 say I've seen more hair on a chicken, Bjarke!

mobs.Name: Bjarke giant
mobs.LongDescription: Bjarke thumps his friend hard on his back, nearly toppling him.
mobs.Description:
A giant of great good cheer, Bjarke is the result of a life with no
fear.  He is a giant among giants, tall and powerful with rippling
muscles and a constitution strong as the iron the dwarves labor so hard
to reap from their beloved underground.  Because he has known no fear,
and even misfortune has never dared cross his path, Bjarke is easy-going
and rarely cranky.  Given his size, it might be a good idea to keep him
that way.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%8 guffaw
%3 em laughs heartily.

mobs.Name: Jilly gnome
mobs.LongDescription: Jilly rolls out the cookie dough to cut into fantastical shapes.
mobs.Description:
Cook(ie Baker) Jilly loves baking pepparkakor cookies for the little
(and not-so-little) gnomes at Christmastime - and most other times.  The
little gnomes help her cut out the gingerbread-gnomes and trees and
snowflakes and yaks and moons and stars and anything else they can
imagine.  Once baked, the ones that are not immediately gobbled are
decorated with Jilly's special white icing.

mobs.Name: Thobias
mobs.LongDescription: Thobias pauses in the path, puffing on his briar pipe.
mobs.Description:
Tobias has been busily negotiating the sale of the tobacco the dwarves
love so much in exchange for some fine ale brewed especially for the
halflings.  He is a middle-sized halfling of middle years, round and
chubby, with a special vest and jacket to hold his travelling pipes.

mobs.Name: gnomish sleeper gnome
mobs.LongDescription: Shhh! Don't wake the sleepers!  They've had a long day.
mobs.Description:
A farmer's day is long and hard, even if you're a gnomish yak farmer.
During the long spring and summer, crops are planted to feed the yaks
through the winter.  The farm is mostly self-sufficient, so food and
material for clothing must be grown and then canned or processed.
mobs.ActionScript: %%4 snore

mobs.Name: Razzl
mobs.LongDescription: Razzl grabs a basket and heads off towards the berry fields.
mobs.Description:
Razzl is a small, neatly turned out gnome, with a bright pink dress, a
long white apron and wide-brimmed straw hat trimmed with a bright pink
ribbon.  Razzl is headed off to pick strawberries, which Jilly will use
to make jam.  Yum!  Extra strawberries will go to the yaks, who actually
purr when fed strawberries and cream.

mobs.Name: Dazzl
mobs.LongDescription: Dazzl trudges off to pick raspberries, well-stained basket in hand.
mobs.Description:
Dazzl would rather be skinny dipping in the creek, but the yaks and the
gnomes both thrive on the raspberries, so she's off to fill her basket
before it gets dark.  Dazzl, Razzl's twin sister, is about average
height for a gnome, which is to say, not so very tall.  She has a bounce
in her step (when she's not headed for the raspberry patch) and a
twinkle in her eye.

mobs.Name: Znugl
mobs.LongDescription: Znugl barks playfully, announcing your arrival.
mobs.Description:
Znugl is one of the many yak herding dogs kept and trained by the yak
farming gnomes.  She is about mid-thigh height for an adult gnome, but
due to her training she believes strongly she is the head yak,
responsible for keeping the rest of the yaks in order. She is a
cheerful, playful, noisy part of the farm.
mobs.ActionScript: %%9 bark

mobs.Name: gnome explorer
mobs.LongDescription: The Gnomish explorer is out to discover the world.  Wherever it is.
mobs.Description:
Having packed up all that he can into his small backpack, dressed warmly
in yak's wool trousers and vest, with a small leather cap, the explorer
has set out to discover the world.  Not many travellers make it to his
off-the-beaten-track yak farm, but enough to stir his innate gnomish
curiosity.  The bespectacled gnome walks boldly, hoping to go Where No
Gnome has Gone Before.

mobs.Name: runner Thialfi
mobs.LongDescription: Thialfi races past you in a blur of motion.
mobs.Description:
A young blond lad with a passion for goat meat, Thialfi is the fastest
man alive.  He has a runner's build, lean with long legs. Thialfi and
his sister Roskva were presents to Thor, when Thor was a guest at their
cottage.  Thialfi disobeyed Thor, and it was a narrow thing, whether he
would be killed on the spot or not.  Thor has a rather nasty temper!

mobs.Name: Gupfo
mobs.LongDescription: Gupfo gathers the gardening gnomes, giving good instructions.
mobs.Description:
Gupfo is Chief of Gnomish Gardeners, in charge of Growing Green things.
Needless to say, he especially loves glossy eggplant, geraniums,
greengage pears and giant squash.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%8 daydream
;%1 say Geeeee ...

mobs.Name: farmer gnomish gnome
mobs.LongDescription: Farming the fertile plateau fascinates the gnomish farmer.
mobs.Description:
Well, most EVERYTHING fascinates the curious gnomes.  The farmer has
been hardened by the active life of waking at dawn, working with the
land and with his small herd of yaks and other farm animals.  His skin
is dark from the sun and quite tough and leathery.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 say Fine field of fenugreek there!

mobs.Name: chicken
mobs.LongDescription: The chicken flaps her wings wildly, as if she is about to lay an egg.
mobs.Description:
This is an ordinary, dumber-than-celery chicken with dirty white
feathers.  Her life has been spared thus far, although she has yet to
produce her first egg.

mobs.Name: rooster
mobs.LongDescription: The rooster struts, master of all he surveys.
mobs.Description:
Or at least, master of all the hens he surveys.  Which is all he really
cares about.  And since he is the only rooster around, it's likely he
will remain Chief Rooster.  Unless he becomes Chief Fried Chicken some
evening when one of the War Gnomes gets tired of his boasting.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 strut

mobs.Name: miner
mobs.LongDescription: The miner is looking forward to spending some of his gold on ale.
mobs.Description:
Back and arms rippling with muscles from years of heavy labor under the
crust of the earth, encrusted himself, head to toe, with a bit of that
earth, this miner is looking forward to a night drinking ale and talking
with his buddies.

mobs.Name: sleeping guard
mobs.LongDescription: Shhh! This guard was out on patrol all night and must sleep now!
mobs.Description:
Well, okay, it's hard to say when you're underground whether you are up
all day or all night.  The dwarf comes from a family which proudly
traces their ancestry back to Ratootl the Big-Eared Goblin Muncher.  He
definitely has the ears.

mobs.Name: guard
mobs.LongDescription: The guard struggles to get the cave-grit off his boots before sleep.
mobs.Description:
The Chief Officer Dwarf has a fetish for well-shined boots, so the
dwarves try to at least get most of the dust from their boots before
they sleep.  No polishing materials are provided, so they simply rely on
the ready supply of discarded socks and underwear littering the floor.

mobs.Name: Scruffy wardog dog
mobs.LongDescription: Scruffy the vicious wardog is out looking for a wild adventure.
mobs.Description:
And if she gets caught by Ulfar she'll be dog-stew in no time.  Scruffy
sneaked out the green door when Gr#<oe>tben left to go on patrol, and
she has no intention of going back soon.  Tail high, sniffing the
breeze, she's one happy wardog.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em lifts up her chin and sniffs delicately at the air.;%5 em looks
around for some nice dead animal to roll in.

mobs.Name: Brandy wardog dog
mobs.LongDescription: Brandy the escapee wardog races along the road, head and tail held high.
mobs.Description:
Brandy escaped the giants' stronghold where Ulfar was trying hard to
turn her into a vicious war dog.  With tail held high and waving like a
war banner, she sniffs delightedly at all the wonderful scents.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 growl

mobs.Name: corndog dog
mobs.LongDescription: The corndog snaps at you as you brush past the corn.
mobs.Description:
The corndog is a deep, golden brown and kind of chubby from a life of
determined indolence.  He is extremely large, about as tall as the
average adult male gnome, and his size alone generally is enough
deterrent to keep hands (and beaks) off the corn.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 bark
;%5 growl
;%5 say Stay out of the corn!
;%5 emote is a Dog of the Corn.

mobs.Name: lab tech gnome
mobs.LongDescription: The lab tech hurries about taking samples and making notes.
mobs.Description:
The lab technician's longish pointed ears poke out from his wispy brown
hair.  He wears a dirty white cotton lab coat with plenty of pockets to
hold his notepads and pens and samples of plants.  The lab tech is
putting himself through College of Gnome by his work here at PARC.

mobs.Name: wentworth crazy
mobs.LongDescription: Crazy Wentworth wildly waves a smoking beaker in your direction.
mobs.Description:
You may have no concrete idea what is in the beaker that Crazy
Wentworth, the mad scientist is waving about, but you should know enough
to stay out of his way.  Wentworth has gone off the deep end ... too
many hours here and too many samples of some of his new fungi.

mobs.Name: farmer gnome gnomish
mobs.LongDescription: The #ggnome#Y farmer tenderly cares for his sunshine loving plants.
mobs.Description:
The farmer's face is weathered a deep brown but is amazingly free of
lines.  The warm radiant heat and the healthy joy of the sunflowers have
given him a relaxed strength beyond what one might expect of a small
gnome.
mobs.ActionScript: %%3 em smiles brightly at the plant.;%3 say Good morning, Sunshine!

mobs.Name: sunflower plant sun
mobs.LongDescription: The sunflower lifts its face to the sun, reflecting radiance onto you.
mobs.Description:
Bright yellow petals fringe the huge deep brown face of the giant
sunflower plant.  The sunflower absorbs massive amounts of the sun's
rays and reflects them back out at the world.

mobs.Name: dragon onyx
mobs.LongDescription: #GThe sculptor captured this dragon in a moment of hot fury.#N
mobs.Description:
This sculpture is so lifelike you can almost feel the heat of the
dragonflame shooting from the dragon's mouth.  The dragon is reared up
high, front paws clawing the air, long dragontail forming a sinuous
curve behind.

mobs.Name: viking giant boy
mobs.LongDescription: Late at night the giant boys sneak ale from dwarf storage.
mobs.Description:
Once their folks are asleep (in their beds or in their grog), the boys
sneak out and follow the secret passageway down to where King Kwathoum
keeps his Private Reserve.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 burp

mobs.Name: j noble lady
mobs.LongDescription: Lady J from the court of King Welmar is touring the countryside.
mobs.Description:
In a fancy coach, accompanied by a retinue of servants, Lady J. has
decided to take a rest from the intrigues of court life and enjoy a
visit to the country.  At least, that is what people back at court were
told.  But many rumors are afloat about her ... Where is she headed?  A
secret rendez-vous with someone?  Who?

mobs.Name: guard court Reginald
mobs.LongDescription: Reginald's rings flash in the light as he drums his fingers restlessly.
mobs.Description:
All the nobles of the Court of Welmar travel with an escort, of course.
While he is a well-loved ruler, still every kingdom has its malcontents
and there are assassins known to be lurking along well-travelled routes.
The guards are chosen to match in height and build, and they are all
about 6' tall and quite muscular.  The ladies are all quite fond of
them, but they are only fond of each other.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 em drums a little beat with his fingers.

mobs.Name: dresser
mobs.LongDescription: Lady J's personal dresser is as neat as a pin.
mobs.Description:
Brought along to take care of Lady J's priceless silk dresses and keep
her jewelery in order, the dresser works long, hard hours, but takes
immense pride in her lady's appearance. Lady J counts on her dresser to
handle the small details of matching slippers to gloves, packing and
unpacking.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 frown

mobs.Name: servant
mobs.LongDescription: King Welmar always sends Lady J off with a large staff of servants.
mobs.Description:
Anxious that Lady J be cared for as she would if she had remained at
court, good King Welmar insists that she bring a number of the castle
staff with her when she travels.  This small gnome will server several
purposes during the trip, from brushing the dirt from a walkway before
Lady J steps on it to running ahead to find an inn for the night.

mobs.Name: chef
mobs.LongDescription: Lady J's private chef sharpens his knife as he looks for local edibles.
mobs.Description:
"Eet must be fresh!  Fresh for ze lady!" screams the chef, who has
dreams of being famous one day.  He forces the guards to stop frequently
so that he may gather fresh herbs in fields that they pass, or orders
them to kill some innocent animal for fresh meat.  He is a small, hefty
man with a large girth, missing teeth, and very bad breath.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em hopes nobody is looking as he sneaks another one of Jilly's
cookies out of his pack.

mobs.Name: juggler
mobs.LongDescription: A juggler lightly tosses apples into the air.
mobs.Description:
The juggler's empty hat lies on the ground in front of him, ready for
your tossed coins.  He is a light and agile fellow, quick witted as well
as quick fingered.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 beg
;%5 say A few coins in the hat, may your piglets all be fat!
;%5 say Tis good luck to give in to that urge to drop some pennies in.

mobs.Name: tobacco trader halfling
mobs.LongDescription: The halfling trader heads off to turn his wagon of tobacco into gold.
mobs.Description:
Hobbit tobacco is known the world over.  This halfling has a full wagon
of well aged, golden tobacco.  He will sell it or trade it to the
dwarves for fine metal work, to the gnomes for perhaps some fresh yak
butter and he will probably try to avoid the giant settlement.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 say What'll it be, friend?  A little hobbit tobacco to ease your
 day?
;%8 em lovingly rubs his briar pipe.
;%8 puffs away at his small pipe, filling the air with a sweet tobacco
scent.

mobs.Name: assassin
mobs.LongDescription: The assassin waits in hiding for a wealthy member of the court to pass.
mobs.Description:
The long track connecting the kingdom of King Welmar with the Kingdom of
the Dwarves is one of few well formed paths in this world, and so it is
a good bet that if she waits long enough, a clever assassin may capture
a bit of the wealth that travels this road.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%8 em eyes you quietly from his hiding place in the shadows.
;%8 em looks you over, wondering how much loot you are carrying.

mobs.Name: root
mobs.LongDescription: A hairy root gropes for you in the dark.
mobs.Description:
Growing from who-knows-what kind of plant, this root is sentient, and it
senses some nice juicy prey ... YOU!  Small fingerlike projections cover
its tentacles and they are reaching for you ...
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 grope

mobs.Name: myconoid
mobs.LongDescription: The myconoid fungi love the damp, dark mustiness of the cellar.
mobs.Description:
You've seen this fungi growing in cellars and dark, damp places all over
the world.  They are gross, fuzzy little beings, making disgusting
little noises and smelling vaguely of laundry that someone forgot to
hang out to dry.

mobs.Name: goat
mobs.LongDescription: The long horned mountain goat jumps nimbly over rocks.
mobs.Description:
This goat is one of a small herd that is still looking for the sweet
meadow grass on the other side of a bridge.  For this reason they seem
always to be hopping around, on the move.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em hops about from rock to rock.
;%5 em gently headbutts you, prodding you with his small horns.

mobs.Name: trader halfling
mobs.LongDescription: Carrying a burden of dwarven-made pots and shovels, the trader is weary.
mobs.Description:
The halfling trader always dreads this part of his journey, although he
is by nature cheerful.  At least during the uphill journey his burden is
light ... tobacco, yak butter and milk, corn and other food supplies.
The metal products from the dwarven kingdom are quite heavy though, and
the burden is difficult.

mobs.Name: viking giant boy
mobs.LongDescription: The giant boy swallows ale a barrel at a time.
mobs.Description:
Once their folks are asleep (in their beds or in their grog), the boys
sneak out and follow the secret passageway down to where King Kwathoum
keeps his Private Reserve.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 beer
;%5 dizzy

mobs.Name: louse
mobs.LongDescription: The little louse hops from giant to giant to dog to ... YOU!
mobs.Description:
The giants who live here bathe somewhat irregularly and their unwashed
bodies offer a generous home to the lice that inhabit them.  Since the
giants are frequently drunk and the lice feed off of them, the lice are
a pretty laid back group of insects.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%8 hop
;%3 bite
;%5 em sinks his pointy little snout into your flesh and sucks out a nice
satisfying meal of blood.

mobs.Name: guard court George soldier
mobs.LongDescription: George is a brave soldier in the service of King Welmar.
mobs.Description:
All the nobles of the Court of Welmar travel with an escort, of course.
While he is a well-loved ruler, still every kingdom has its malcontents
and there are assassins known to be lurking along well-travelled routes.
The guards are chosen to match in height and build, and they are all
about 6' tall and quite muscular.  The ladies are all quite fond of
them, but they are only fond of each other.

mobs.Name: guard court Paul
mobs.LongDescription: Paul, a guard of the Court of Welmar, searches for danger.
mobs.Description:
All the nobles of the Court of Welmar travel with an escort, of course.
While he is a well-loved ruler, still every kingdom has its malcontents
and there are assassins known to be lurking along well-travelled routes.
The guards are chosen to match in height and build, and they are all
about 6' tall and quite muscular.  The ladies are all quite fond of
them, but they are only fond of each other.

mobs.Name: guard court John
mobs.LongDescription: John wears the colors of the Court of Welmar.
mobs.Description:
All the nobles of the Court of Welmar travel with an escort, of course.
While he is a well-loved ruler, still every kingdom has its malcontents
and there are assassins known to be lurking along well-travelled routes.
The guards are chosen to match in height and build, and they are all
about 6' tall and quite muscular.  The ladies are all quite fond of
them, but they are only fond of each other.
mobs.ActionScript: %%3 airguitar

mobs.Name: twins tina gina
mobs.LongDescription: In the corner, Gina and Tina are making raspberry-blueberry ice cream.
mobs.Description:
Gina and Tina are twins.  It is their job to turn cream from the
contented yaks into ice cream.  They add fresh raspberries and
blueberries - the ones that Razzl and Dazzl collect.  Yummmy!
mobs.ActionScript:
%%8 em stick their fingers into the ice cream for a taste test.
;%5 say Do you want some ice cream? It'll be ready real soon!
;%8 say Have you met our cousin, the Brat Boy?
;%8 giggle

mobs.Name: Gloria dwarf mother
mobs.LongDescription: The anxious mother wonder if you have seen her brat son.
mobs.Description:
As a dwarven mother with a daredevil son, Gloria is a constant nerve
wreck and with those kind of stunt her son pulls, one can not but agree
with her worries. Apart from that she looks like a nice woman with a well
cared for beard. A good sample of the mountains female dwarfs.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 say Have you seen my son?
;%10 south
;%10 north
;%10 emote seems worried.
;%10 emote sighs slightly.
;%10 emote looks around looking for her son.

mobs.Name: Brat dwarf boy daredevil
mobs.LongDescription: Young and without fright a little boy dances around madly.
mobs.Description:
The little boy dances around you like a wild. He even tries to climb
anything close to while doing so. He must be completely out of his mind
or just very persistent in NOT going to bed as his mother would suggest.
Not so strange when you are young and has a lot of extra energy.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote does a little pirouette on the ropes.

;%10 north
;%10 west
;%10 east
;%10 emote sings out 'Nananananana Nananananana  Brat-Boy!'
;%10 emote jumps between the ropes.
;%10 emote teases you for being such a coward.

mobs.Name: gnome ropeweaver shopkeeper fritz
mobs.LongDescription: A little gnome dangles his legs over the edge of the chasm.
mobs.Description:
The small gnome looks rather old, or old compared to other gnomes at
least, never seen a young gnome come to think about it. Maybe they are
born old. He holds a small pipe in one of his very callous hands. He must
have worked a lot with his hands to achieve that status. Maybe what is
inside his little house will explain how they became so used.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote whistles innocently.

;%10 emote wonders how his twin brother is doing.
;%10 emote takes a little puff on his pipe.
;%10 emote asks you 'Are you ready for a new experience?'

mobs.Name: guard
mobs.LongDescription: A big brute of a Mill guard is patrolling the premises and found YOU...
mobs.Description:
If the ordinary dwarf is stocky compared with human standards he
still would look like a thin thread compared with this hunk of a dwarf.
Worth noticing is that he does not hold any rank implying that his
superiors would be worse. The guards are under strict orders to remove
(in any way possible) any trespassers and nothing will make these highly
trained guards disobey. Guess the punishment for disobedience is worse
than anything you can muster up.

mobs.Name: guard
mobs.LongDescription: A compact mill guard awaits YOU where he stands.
mobs.Description:
If the ordinary dwarf is stocky compared with human standards he
still would look like a thin thread compared with this hunk of a dwarf.
Worth noticing is that he does not hold any rank implying that his
superiors would be worse. The guards are under strict orders to remove

mobs.Name: janitor dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven mill janitor worker obidiently cleans the steps around him.
mobs.Description:
Well a dwarf is a dwarf is a dwarf is a dwarf is a .... *sigh*
This one is no different than the rest of them, short and stocky with a
big beard worn clearly visible no matter what happens. He glares at you
angrily for walking on his newly clean surrounding.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote cleans away a bit of dirt.
;%10 up
;%10 down
;%10 emote shoves a lot of dust out of sight.
;%10 emote ignores you as long as you do not dirty things up.
;%3 emote is going to tell his friend he saw you.Pray its not a guard.

mobs.Name: wraith
mobs.LongDescription: You just can not see the wraith.
mobs.Description:
A disturbance in the air alerts you to the fact that you are not alone.
It's difficult to describe the feeling, a combination of the microhairs
all over your body springing to alert, the hard hammering of your heart
and a sudden queasiness in your stomach.

mobs.Name: dwarf dwarven guard
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven guard is here.
mobs.Description:
The guard looks very tough and mean. He wears his beard long, and he smells
like he hasn't bathed in over a month.

mobs.Name: dwarf dwarven worker
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven mining worker is here.
mobs.Description: He is very dirty, and looks extremely over-worked.

mobs.Name: wraith
mobs.LongDescription: A wraith is awaiting your first move here.
mobs.Description: A black, almost transparent wraith.

mobs.Name: storekeeper
mobs.LongDescription: The Hide & Tooth storekeeper is standing here, waiting patiently.
mobs.Description: The storekeeper is very rotund, but looks in excellent condition.

mobs.Name: baker
mobs.LongDescription: Granite Head, the baker, is waiting for a customer here.
mobs.Description: Granite Head is covered with flour and grains.

mobs.Name: lizard
mobs.LongDescription: A giant lizard is foraging for food along the cavern floor here.
mobs.Description:
This scaly creature looks like it is well adapted to it's underground
habitat.  He looks very powerful.

mobs.Name: giant
mobs.LongDescription: A giant is wandering around the mountainside here.
mobs.Description:
The giant is about 18 feet tall, with arms of steel, and looks in
excellent physical condition.

mobs.Name: dwarven dwarf miner mineworker worker
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven mineworker is here.
mobs.Description: The mineworker is very tired, and very dirty, and he has bulging muscles.

mobs.Name: dwarven mineleader dwarf mine leader
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven mine leader is here, supervising the work.
mobs.Description:
The mine leader is very big and very strong, though he must be fairly bright
also, to have gotten this job.

mobs.Name: dwarven healer
mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven healer is here, aiding the sick of his people.
mobs.Description: He is a very skilled healer, and extremely faithful to his god.

mobs.Name: dwarven peon
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven peon is awaiting help here.

mobs.Name: dwarf
mobs.LongDescription: A dwarf is here.

mobs.Name: barrack guard
mobs.LongDescription: A barrack guard is here, lounging around while off duty.

mobs.Name: mazekeeper
mobs.LongDescription: A mazekeeper is here.
mobs.Description: He looks VERY tough.

mobs.Name: giant snake
mobs.LongDescription: There is a giant snake here.

mobs.Name: mountain climber mountainclimber
mobs.LongDescription: A mountain climber is making the same trek that you are.
mobs.Description: He wants to see what's on the other side of the mountain too.

mobs.Name: cyclops
mobs.LongDescription: A hungry cyclops snarls at you!
mobs.Description: He looks like he's about to have dinner. (Maybe it's you?)

mobs.Name: tiny elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A tiny elemental form wanders about.
mobs.Description: Rather small for an elemental form, looks like a reject.

mobs.Name: elemental guardian
mobs.LongDescription: An elemental guardian of the canyon is here.
mobs.Description: You can't tell which kind of elemental it is, maybe it's a bit of all of them?

mobs.Name: small elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A small, rather non-descript elemental is here.
mobs.Description: The small elemental is a resident of the canyon.

mobs.Name: medium elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A medium-sized elemental wanders about.
mobs.Description: The medium elemental is a resident of the canyon.

mobs.Name: large elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A large elemental stands here.
mobs.Description: The large elemental is a resident of the canyon.

mobs.Name: earth elemental ruler
mobs.LongDescription: The ruler of the earth elementals sits here.
mobs.Description:
It looks as old as the earth itself. It seems to know all the secrets and
knowledge of the Earth. You can't really tell where it begins and the rock 
wall ends.
mobs.ActionScript: %25 emote rumbles.;%25 emote creates an earthquake somewhere in the world...

mobs.Name: fire elemental ruler
mobs.LongDescription: The ruler of the fire elementals flickers here.
mobs.Description: As you look at it, it seems to blend in with the fire in its throne.
mobs.ActionScript: %25 emote flares up and singes you with blistering heat.;%25 flares up and illuminates the room with the light of a million candles.

mobs.Name: air elemental ruler
mobs.LongDescription: The ruler of the air elementals is here, staring upwards.
mobs.Description: As you peer at it, you seem to be looking at the sky itself.
mobs.ActionScript: %25 stare;%25 emote swirls around, making you feel rather dizzy when you watch it.

mobs.Name: lightning elemental ruler
mobs.LongDescription: The ruler of the lightning elementals is here.
mobs.Description:
As you examine it there is a blinding flash of light and a deafening boom! 
You rub your eyes and look and the ruler is there grinning at you.
mobs.ActionScript: %25 emote explodes in a blinding flash of light!;%25 emote explodes with a deafening boom!

mobs.Name: water elemental ruler
mobs.LongDescription: The ruler of the water elementals is here.
mobs.Description:
As you look at it, it changes to mist, which swirls around 
you. Just as you get scared, it reforms in elemental form.
mobs.ActionScript: %25 emote splashes around. You feel you can almost hear the ocean.;%25 emote transforms into a cloud of mist.

mobs.Name: water puddle elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A small puddle of water is here.
mobs.Description: It trickles along the ground and gets your feet wet.

mobs.Name: fire flame elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A small flickering flame burns on the ground.
mobs.Description: It smolders along the grass aimlessly.

mobs.Name: snowflake snow flake elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A frozen snowflake floats in the air.
mobs.Description: It looks a little blue.

mobs.Name: pebble rock elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A small rock is lying here on the ground.
mobs.Description: It seems to be a small living pebble!

mobs.Name: spark electricity elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A spark of electricity fizzles here.
mobs.Description: Zipping from place to place at the speed of light is tough work.

mobs.Name: acid blob elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A blob of acid eats away at the stone aimlessly.
mobs.Description: The magical blob of acid is a cross between lightning and water.

mobs.Name: lava beast elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A lava beast spews from place to place.
mobs.Description: The magical lava beast is a cross between fire and earth.

mobs.Name: mud monster elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A mud monster slops around.
mobs.Description: The magical mud monster is a cross between water and earth.

mobs.Name: mist elemental
mobs.LongDescription: The air is magically misty here.
mobs.Description: The magical mist is a cross between water and air.

mobs.Name: particle elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A sub-atomic particle is too small for you to see.
mobs.Description: It is the magical manifestation of energy.

mobs.Name: dust elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A dust cloud blowing by makes you sneeze.
mobs.Description: The magical dust cloud is a cross between air and earth.

mobs.Name: eddie eddy elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A small eddy current swirls junk around here.
mobs.Description: The magical eddy current is a manifestation of an air elemental.

mobs.Name: blue flame
mobs.LongDescription: A blue flame burns mysteriously here.
mobs.Description:
As you look you see what seems to be a face and almost 
a humanoid figure somehow trapped in the fire.

mobs.Name: magneto
mobs.LongDescription: The magneto considers zapping you for the heck of it.
mobs.Description: A humanoid figure seems to be trapped in the field of the magneto.

mobs.Name: ice bandit
mobs.LongDescription: The ice bandit strikes cold fear in your heart.
mobs.Description: You see a humanoid figure encased in ice but still apparently alive.

mobs.Name: rock monster
mobs.LongDescription: The Rock Monster considers you in stoney silence.
mobs.Description: A humanoid figure trapped in stone seems alive.

mobs.Name: hurricane
mobs.LongDescription: A hurricane rages across the sky.
mobs.Description: A humanoid figure is trapped in the rushing wind.

mobs.Name: magician
mobs.LongDescription: An elemental magician seeks magical stones for a spell.
mobs.Description:
The elemental magician has come here in search of the fabled
Stone of Surrender which can be used to render opponents senseless.

mobs.Name: rainbow warrior cult
mobs.LongDescription: A warrior of the Rainbow Cult swears his loyalty.
mobs.Description:
The Rainbow Cult has received special powers 
for it's service to the elemental forces.

mobs.Name: illusionist
mobs.LongDescription: The illusionist seeks the aid of the elemental forces.
mobs.Description: She seeks their aid for a powerful new spell of deception.

mobs.Name: alchemist
mobs.LongDescription: An alchemist wanders by in search of magical herbs.
mobs.Description: Rare herbs are rumoured to grow only in the canyon.

mobs.Name: baby rainbow dragon
mobs.LongDescription: A baby rainbow dragon plays among the elements here.
mobs.Description: It's only a baby by dragon standards.

mobs.Name: imp
mobs.LongDescription: A little imp runs along being annoying.
mobs.Description: The little bugger steals stuff and is generally obnoxious.

mobs.Name: HUGE elemental
mobs.LongDescription: A HUGE elemental form stands here.
mobs.Description: HUGE, need I say more?

mobs.Name: vendor
mobs.LongDescription: A vendor is willing to sell you elixirs.
mobs.Description:
This lavender clad warrior smiles and says, 
'I WOULD NOT suggest you attack me...!'
mobs.ActionScript: %50 say Dont even think about attacking me...

mobs.Name: bicycle
mobs.LongDescription: Avalons shiny new bicycle is standing against the wall here.
mobs.Description:
This is Avalons bicycle (X45SMF Super Mega Fast) it has 55 gears and
large rubber tires that can't be punctured. Don't even think about 
using it without Avalon's permission.

mobs.Name: dragon storm
mobs.LongDescription: A huge storm dragon is looking at you with hunger in his yellow eyes.
mobs.Description:
Before you stand one of the mighty storm dragons. His red scales
are glistening in the sun.

mobs.Name: air ruler elemental
mobs.LongDescription: The ruler of the air elementals is here, staring upwards.
mobs.Description: As you peer at it, you seem to be looking at the sky itself.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%25 state; %25 emote swirls around, making you feel rather dizzy when you 
watch it.

mobs.Name: macaw blue jungle
mobs.LongDescription: A blue macaw flies past on his way through the trees.
mobs.Description:
The blue macaw wears a beautiful azure coat that has been decorated
with patches of jewel-colored accents.  He has a strong beack, and
equally strong claws.  His poweful wings are capable of carrying him
to the tops of the jungle trees.

mobs.Name: macaw scarlet jungle
mobs.LongDescription: A scarlet macaw calls to her feathered friends above.
mobs.Description:
The scarlet macaw proudly wears feathers the color of freshly drawn
blood.  Her powerful beak and claws allow her to eat anything from
seeds to small animals.

mobs.Name: jaguar black jungle
mobs.LongDescription: The black jaguar crouches low, awaiting her next meal.
mobs.Description:
With a coat the color of night, the black jaguar easily blends into the
darkness of the jungle.  She has extremely sharp teeth and claws, which
allow her to tear through living flesh with the greatest of ease.  Her
emerald green eyes stare back at you, and you just know she is thinking,
"Mmmm...lunch!"

mobs.Name: peccary boar wild jungle
mobs.LongDescription: A peccary runs out from the underbrush and attacks!
mobs.Description:
The peccary is compactly built, but very powerful indeed.  His tawny
hide covers a powerhouse of rippling muscles.  His small tusks can
gore anything he points his head at.  You thank your lucky stars that
this beast prefers the taste of plants, but don't count yourself
blessed yet -- he defends his territory with terrible ferocity!

mobs.Name: frog poison bright arrow blue jungle
mobs.LongDescription: A brightly colored frog calls to his mate.
mobs.Description:
The bright color of the poison-arrow frog serves as a warning to any
would-be predators.  He may be small, but the toxins in his skin pack a
powerful punch.

mobs.Name: ant fire drone jungle
mobs.LongDescription: A fire ant drone runs through the forest looking for food.
mobs.Description:
The fire ant has powerful jaws, but they are not her only means of
defense.  She is filled with an acidic poison that can burn the very
flesh from intruders.  You better hope she is alone, because as soon
as she calls for an attack, hundreds of her sister drones will attack
you, leaving only bits of hair and bone.

mobs.Name: ant leaf cutter drone jungle
mobs.LongDescription: A small leaf runs through the forest.
mobs.Description:
As you look a bit more closely at the leaf, you notice that it is
actually moving atop a tiny ant.  This little creature can cut apart
the forest with her powerful jaws.  She can also carry the resulting
pieces through miles of jungle back to her colony's farm, where the
leaves are buried to feed a crop of fungi.

mobs.Name: runa man tribesman jungle
mobs.LongDescription: Spear in hand, the Runa tribesman hunts for survival.
mobs.Description:
This man of the jungle hunts only for the survival of his tribe.  His
people learned long ago that anything more would incur the wrath of
the jungle.  He is short and stocky, built for life on the jungle
floor.  His dark skin glistens with the humidity of the jungle, but
his sweat glands stopped working generations ago.  No point in
perspiring when the oppressive humidity of the jungle won't allow for
evaporation!

mobs.Name: runa woman tribeswoman jungle
mobs.LongDescription: The Runa woman wanders through her jungle home.
mobs.Description:
The woman of the jungle has learned to live in harmony with nature.  She
gathers medicinal leaves for her tribe, taking only as much as they will
need.

mobs.Name: monkey titi jungle
mobs.LongDescription: A small monkey scurries through the trees.
mobs.Description:
This small monkey sits high above the jungle floor, escaping many of the
larger predators found below.  She is covered with a golden brown fur,
which has been matted along her tail.  While she may be small, she has a
fierce bite, and her mate is probably not too far from her.

mobs.Name: iguana green jungle
mobs.LongDescription: An emerald green iguana climbs slowly through the trees.
mobs.Description:
The large iguana munches lazily on the bounty of leaves in his jungle
home.  While he doesn't care much for the taste of flesh, he is quite
capable of defending himself with his enormous muscular tail.

mobs.Name: anteater giant ant jungle
mobs.LongDescription: A giant anteater tracks down some tasty morsels with his long snout.
mobs.Description:
The giant anteater is covered with coarse gray fur, accentuated with
stripes of black and white.  He has a small head and a long,
pronounced snout, which is just perfect for hunting down his favorite
food - ants!  His long claws are excellent for digging into an
underground colony, and in order to protect them from damage, he
walks with his front feet turned on their sides.

mobs.Name: sloth three toed three-toed jungle
mobs.LongDescription: Covered in moss, the three-toed sloth climbs lazily through the trees.
mobs.Description:
This tree-dwelling animal has hook-like claws, enabling him to climb
through the trees quite comfortably.  His reddish brown fur is covered
with moss, which has been able to take hold on him because he moves so
slowly!

mobs.Name: tapir jungle
mobs.LongDescription: The tapir munches his way through the tasty underbrush.
mobs.Description:
This relative of the modern horse looks a bit more like a pig than
anything else.  He is short and stout, with a moveable nose, which he
uses to sniff out his favorite meal.

mobs.Name: crab
mobs.LongDescription: A crab is crawling around here looking for toes to pinch.
mobs.Description: The crab has a hard, brightly brown shell and two BIG pinchers.

mobs.Name: fat man
mobs.LongDescription: A fat man is sunbathing here.
mobs.Description: His skin has a nice tan because he is using a new sun lotion.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 say Go away! Can't you see i'm busy?!

mobs.Name: mitch baywatch
mobs.LongDescription: Mitch the Baywatch is standing here, trying to look muscular.
mobs.Description: He is staring at the people bathing here, always ready to help a poor swimmer.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 say Hello folks!;%10 emote looks at you.

mobs.Name: fat woman
mobs.LongDescription: A fat woman is sunbathing here.
mobs.Description: She looks at you angrily as you are standing between her and the sun.

mobs.Name: turtle
mobs.LongDescription: A green turtle is crawling around on the beach here.
mobs.Description: The turtle has an extremely hard and beautifull shell and a small head.

mobs.Name: captain kidd
mobs.LongDescription: Captain Kidd is here selling boats and icecreams.
mobs.Description: He looks very mean and quite capable of chopping you to pieces if he wanted to.

mobs.Name: surfer orc
mobs.LongDescription: An orc surfer is here, riding the waves with some difficulty.
mobs.Description:
The orc is surfing around on a surfing board made in the dark caves of moria.
As you watch him surfing around on the waves you notice that he is cursing the
dark water all the time.
mobs.ActionScript:
%10 emote shudders at the sight of the water.;
%10 emote wobbles uneasily on his board.

mobs.Name: surfer elf
mobs.LongDescription: An elf surfer is riding the waves here.
mobs.Description:
He is quite comfident in his ability in surfing the waves. His long blond hair
is ruffling in the wind as he make spectacular turns.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 emote combs his hair.

mobs.Name: white shark big
mobs.LongDescription: A big white fin just above the waterline is moving straight at you!
mobs.Description:
Arghhh ! Suddenly you remember those old movies about this horrible creature.
The big white shark that killed hundreds of people bathing on nice beaches all
over the world.

mobs.Name: seagull
mobs.LongDescription: A seagull is flying around here.
mobs.Description:
The seagull is circling around your head some 5 meters above you. It looks 
really angry and screams at you in a highpitched voice.
mobs.ActionScript: %10 emote screams angrily at everyone.

mobs.Name: shopkeeper reina
mobs.LongDescription: Reina, the Divine Cafe Proprietor, stands behind the counter.
mobs.Description:
While conducting some research on the Elder Gods of Elite, The 
Institution of Global Research and Development at the Academy 
accidentally summoned Reina, last in the long line of Concubines of IO 
the Overgod. The Institution members thought that such a mighty Goddess 
must be of enormous help to them in their studies. Unfortunately, it 
turned out the only help she was capable of giving them was serving 
tea...

mobs.Name: guard hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: The hobgoblin guard attacks first, thinks later.
mobs.Description:
This is an extra large, extra ugly goblin like creature.  He grins evilly
as he attempts to brain you.

mobs.Name: soldier hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A hobgoblin soldier stands here.
mobs.Description:
This is just a low life hobgoblin, who couldn't make it to the ranks
of the elite guards.  He looks pissed.

mobs.Name: bodyguard hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A hobgoblin bodyguard guards the king with his life.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the elite hobgoblin guards.  He stands tall for his short
stature.  He grins a toothy grin as he prepares to attack.

mobs.Name: king hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: There is a great king here, sitting in his throne.
mobs.Description:
The king is a silly looking hobgoblin whose muscles bulge out of his robes,
destroying the sophisticated effect he was trying to create.

mobs.Name: miner hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A hobgoblin miner stands here looking for gold.
mobs.Description: The miner is totally covered in dust.

mobs.Name: treasurer hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A treasurer is here counting out money.
mobs.Description:
The hobgoblin treasurer is an old goblin with glasses.  It appears that he
can only see a couple feet in front of him.

mobs.Name: prisoner gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome prisoner is here resting in the straw.
mobs.Description: The prisoner is just barely alive.

mobs.Name: prisoner human
mobs.LongDescription: A human prisoner is here resting in the straw.
mobs.Description: The prisoner is just barely alive.

mobs.Name: hermit crab
mobs.LongDescription: A hermit crab crawls towards you.
mobs.Description:
The hermit crab is about 5 feet high and looks mad that you had the nerve
to wake it up.

mobs.Name: cook hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A hobgoblin cook stands here cooking something.
mobs.Description:
The cook is a dirty and fat hobgoblin.  He burps as he stirs up something
in a pot.

mobs.Name: assassin guard sentry
mobs.LongDescription: An assassin stands here, guarding the entrance to the ancient hideout.
mobs.Description: He is completely dressed in black and looks very agile.

mobs.Name: assassin cloak figure
mobs.LongDescription: You see a a figure in the shadows floating at you.
mobs.Description: All you can see is a the two yellow dots that must be the eyes.

mobs.Name: shadow
mobs.LongDescription: A shadow is moving around in the smoke.
mobs.Description: Hmm a shadow without form? That must be it.

mobs.Name: elf slave cook
mobs.LongDescription: An elf slave is making a dinner here.
mobs.Description:
The elf slave looks very depressed and must be constantly threatened by
the foul assassins.

mobs.Name: poisonlord poison lord
mobs.LongDescription: He grins at you and attacks!

mobs.Name: torturer
mobs.LongDescription: The torturer wants to try some new tools on you.
mobs.Description: The torturer wears his standard outfit, red clothing and a black hood.

mobs.Name: Gontran Master
mobs.LongDescription: Gontran, Master of the Assassins, circles around you!
mobs.Description:
Gontran is very muscular but looks quite agile too. He has a strange 
tattoe on the forehead that glows in evilly red.

mobs.Name: assassin
mobs.LongDescription: An assassin is sneaking around here.

mobs.Name: statue
mobs.LongDescription: A finelooking statue is standing here.
mobs.Description:
The statues are carved out of the rock with excellent expertise. Maybe they are
made by a dwarven artist, captured by the wicked assassins.

mobs.Name: priest dark cleric
mobs.LongDescription: The dark priest stands here, eager to conjure up some demons.
mobs.Description:
The look in his eyes make you think he is a real fanatic. The tattoes all over
his body seems to move around on his skin.

mobs.Name: shade
mobs.LongDescription: An assassin stands here in all the blood, grinning evilly at his awful deeds.

mobs.Name: assassin man mirror
mobs.LongDescription: You see a figure walking around in the reflections of the mirrors.
mobs.Description: The figure looks quite unreal. It is dressed just like you!

mobs.Name: hengist poor man
mobs.LongDescription: A badly wounded man rests here, bearing the marks of the torturers tools.
mobs.Description: He is in very bad condition.

mobs.Name: child gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome child is playing around here.
mobs.Description:
The little tyke looks so innocent playing with his boomerang that you 
just want to pick him up and hug him.

mobs.Name: woman gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful gnome woman is standing here, looking for somebody.
mobs.Description:
The woman is short and gnarled, but acts like a woman several times her
beauty. She's starting to look pretty attractive to you ...

mobs.Name: man gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome man is walking, on his way to work.
mobs.Description:
This is a prime example of a gnome.  He looks short and weak, but at the
same time an intelligent creature who could outsmart you.

mobs.Name: gnome armourer
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome armourer wanders around deep in thought.
mobs.Description:
You see a gnome who is lost deep into some invention that he is about
to make. His hair is white, but he looks fairly strong.

mobs.Name: guard gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome guard looks fiercely at you, not sure whether to let you pass.
mobs.Description:
This is a well trained gnome.  He might not have a lot of strength but
he makes up for it with his weapons skill.

mobs.Name: chief gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A powerful looking gnome stands here wearing ornate clothes.
mobs.Description:
The Chief looks like he could whap you hard.  He looks not only powerful
but wise and resourceful.  You better not mess with him.

mobs.Name: troll small
mobs.LongDescription: A small troll grunts as he takes a swing at you.
mobs.Description:
The small troll is a short and stocky beast with a human-like face
but with the eyes and fangs of a wild beast.

mobs.Name: mouse field
mobs.LongDescription: A small mouse wonders, "If I build it, will they come?"
mobs.Description: The Mouse is a cute little creature.

mobs.Name: rat
mobs.LongDescription: A small rat shrieks and runs around.
mobs.Description: The rat is a little evil creature that deserves death.

mobs.Name: rat large
mobs.LongDescription: A large rat runs up to you and nibbles on your boots.
mobs.Description: You have the urge to kill this vile creature.

mobs.Name: rat giant
mobs.LongDescription: A giant rat growls at you and prepares to attack.
mobs.Description: This rat has grown up to be the size of an average dog.

mobs.Name: troll
mobs.LongDescription: A giant troll lumbers around.
mobs.Description:
You see before you a huge mass of living flesh.  You cringe in fear as
he lifts his powerful arm to bludgeon you.

mobs.Name: bat black
mobs.LongDescription: A black bat hangs from the ceiling.
mobs.Description: The bat is a grotesque little creature with large wings and fangs.

mobs.Name: zombie gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A zombie gnome shuffles his way towards you.
mobs.Description:
This is a creature which has passed away long ago.  His body has been
pulled out of its resting place by some evil force.

mobs.Name: bat fire
mobs.LongDescription: The fire bat flames brightly and prepares to attack.
mobs.Description:
You see a huge flame which resembles the shape of a bat.  The creature
hangs from the ceiling and bites at you.

mobs.Name: gnome weaponsmith
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome weaponsmith wanders around deep in thought.
mobs.Description:
You see a gnome who is lost deep into some invention that he is about
to make. His hair is white, but he looks fairly strong.

mobs.Name: gnome storekeeper
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome storekeeper wanders around deep in thought.
mobs.Description:
You see a gnome who is lost deep into some invention that he is about
to make. His hair is white, but he looks fairly strong.

mobs.Name: gnome scientist
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome scientist wanders around deep in thought.
mobs.Description:
You see a gnome who is lost deep into some invention that he is about
to make. His hair is white, but he looks fairly strong.

mobs.Name: gnome tavernkeeper
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome tavernkeeper stands here deep in thought.
mobs.Description:
This gnome has seen many winters, his beard is grey and his face
scarred. He looks very friendly though.

mobs.Name: baker
mobs.LongDescription: The Baker looks at you calmly, wiping flour from his face with one hand.
mobs.Description:
A fat, nice looking baker. But you can see that he has many scars on his
body.

mobs.Name: guildmaster master
mobs.LongDescription: The ancient gnomish mage has eyes that seem to see right through you.
mobs.Description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine magic
clothing, and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

mobs.Name: guildmaster master
mobs.LongDescription: The ancient priestess prepares herself to teach yet another generation.
mobs.Description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine magic
clothing, and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

mobs.Name: guildmaster master
mobs.LongDescription: The ancient assassin still knows a trick or two more than you do.
mobs.Description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine magic
clothing, and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

mobs.Name: guildmaster master
mobs.LongDescription: The esteemed General will help you learn the secret art of gnomish warfare.
mobs.Description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge he possesses.  He is wearing a uniform of the
Gnomish Imperial Guard (GIG), and he has been much decorated.

mobs.Name: yak
mobs.LongDescription:
The yak wanders aimlessly through the meadows in search of the perfect
flower.
mobs.Description:
Tall and mighty enough not to fret much about strangers in her environment,
the yak spends much of her time grazing in the sweet meadow grasses that
are a feature of this plateau.  As she grazes, she looks for pretty flowers
to bring to her lover, THE yak.

mobs.Name: gnome ancient old yakherder
mobs.LongDescription: The extremely ancient, nearly decrepit old gnome watches out over his yaks.
mobs.Description:
Actually, of course, it is the yaks who watch out over this ancient gnome.
They are very protective of the old man, and have secretly gifted him with
many protective spells.  He has been with them almost since his birth and
has long since become a bit daft.

mobs.Name: yak Yakkity-yak yakkity
mobs.LongDescription: Yakkity yak likes to bask in the sunshine and the adoration of his harem.
mobs.Description:
Known to the others of his clan as simply "THE yak", Yakkity is a yak in
the prime of his life.  He has a hornspan that is the envy of every other
male yak, and the twirling curve of each horn is graceful beyond
expectation.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 say Don't talk back!

mobs.Name: dragon
mobs.LongDescription: High overhead a dragon lazily circles, waiting for the grasses to dry.
mobs.Description:
The mischievous dragon is looking forward to late autumn, when the summer
sun will have turned the sweet grasses to dry hay, and a little fire
artfully applied will turn the meadow into a spectacular display.  Sorry
little dragon, this is an enchanted meadow, and will be forever green and
juicy.

mobs.Name: apprentice yakherder
mobs.LongDescription: The apprentice yakherder is just learning how to yak.
mobs.Description:
He's become very good at polishing horns, however.  The young gnome studied
yak husbandry at college and came home to tend the clan yak farm.  He has
become very attached to his yaks, now, and does most of the actual work of
caring for them.

mobs.Name: yolanda yak
mobs.LongDescription: Yolanda Yak floats lightly over the meadowflowers.
mobs.Description:
An unfortunate accident of birth, cursed by a wicked fairy, Yolanda was
born with a horrible disfiguration.  On her back she has grown a pair of
wings.  Now, Yolanda is a substantial-sized yak, so she cannot simply fly
off, but she is pleased not to bruise the flowers she does not eat.

mobs.Name: yvan yak
mobs.LongDescription:
Yvan Yak stretches his mighty head w-a-y down to munch some sweet
meadowgrass.
mobs.Description:
Although the meadowgrass on the plateau grows quite tall, unfortunately so
did Yvan.  It is difficult for him to get his fill of the grass without
sitting down to reach it.  Since a yak must protect his pride, and since a
yak also looks pretty silly sitting down, Yvan goes hungry way too often.

mobs.Name: bigmama yak
mobs.LongDescription: BigMama yak IS the mother of all yaks.
mobs.Description:
BigMama is a mighty fine female yak.  Powerful muscles ripple visibly
beneath a smooth glossy black coat of longish fur.  Her horns gleam
brightly, polished daily by her gnome.  Mother of All Yaks, she is truly
magnificent.

mobs.Name: yseult yak
mobs.LongDescription: Yseult slinks sexily through the softly caressing grasses.
mobs.Description:
Yseult knows herself to be the favorite of THE yak, and feels even the
meadow grasses bow down to her beauty.  She sways through the grasses,
giving her yakkish hips a slight wiggle.

mobs.Name: veerle gnome
mobs.LongDescription: Veerle sunbathes in her teenie weenie bikini.
mobs.Description:
Long blond hair streaming out behind her, well annointed with oil, 
Veerle is the very picture of summer abandon.  Having spent the winter 
months in exercise and close attention to her diet, she radiates 
self-confidence, and has already attracted the attention of several 
tall gnomish musclemen.

mobs.Name: swimmer
mobs.LongDescription: The swimmer's slightly blue skin is covered with tiny bumps from the cold.
mobs.Description:
The young gnome is quite athletic, and determined to play his part in the
Clan Olympics this year.  He trains daily, swimming continually upstream in
this frigid little stream.

mobs.Name: mouse field
mobs.LongDescription: The little mouse chortles merrily at the trick he will play on Mr. Troll.
mobs.Description: The Mouse is a cute little rodent, similar to a Rat.

mobs.Name: gnome
mobs.LongDescription: The pot-bellied gnome adds driftwood to his fire to cook his fish.
mobs.Description:
This gnome is aging, but clearly still active.  He has a habit of 
guzzling brew each night (and all day Saturday) and that and time have 
added an unwanted curve to his otherwise fit self.  He enjoys coming 
down to the river beach to fish with his son, who loves to swim.

mobs.Name: climber gnome
mobs.LongDescription: The gnome may be small, but his wiry strength makes him a good climber.
mobs.Description:
Toes braced in crevices too small for human feet, clinging to bushes too
fragile to hold a troll's hat, the gnome bravely makes his way up the
mountain.

mobs.Name: frog
mobs.LongDescription: A lonely frog hops from lily pad to lily pad, wishing he were a prince.
mobs.Description:
r-r-r-r-i-b-b-b-b-i-t-t-t-t! The frog's been looking everywhere for a
little crown, not so he can get kissed by some human female, but so someone
will believe that he's really a prince of a fellow and reward him with lots
of nice juicy flies and some really fine female frogs.

mobs.Name: knight lieutenant sir aaron crimson
mobs.LongDescription: #yA tall young knight in crimson plate says 'Hey! Who are you?'#N
mobs.Description:
Knight Lieutenant Sir Aaron spends his time in this chamber, when 
he is not training in the basement - drilling his men, and practicing 
with sword and lance. Sir Aaron is the youngest of the Crimson Fist 
officers, having risen through the ranks due to his skill and intense 
loyalty towards the chapter. He commands the first company of the 
Crimson Fists - known as the Young Bloods.

mobs.Name: knight sergeant gilbert crimson
mobs.LongDescription: Knight Sergeant Gilbert stands around barking orders.
mobs.Description: #RKnight Sergeant Gilbert yells, 'WHAT ARE YOU LOOKING AT! MOVE IT!'#N

mobs.Name: knight sergeant jem crimson
mobs.LongDescription: A powerful looking Knight Sergeant glares at you.
mobs.Description:
Knight Sergeant Jem is in charge of training the Crimson Fist soldiers 
in the use of all civilised weapons. He is a master with them all, but
