he is best with a longsword, or a flail. Jem is very powerfully built, 
glaring about him at the drilling soldiers, occasionally shouting a few 
words of encouragement.

mobs.Name: knight lieutenant sir cindar crimson
mobs.LongDescription: A wild looking Knight paces furiously up and down.
mobs.Description:
Knight Lieutenant Sir Cindar has a barely contained savagery to him. To 
the casual observer he is extremely scruffy, his hair is long and hangs 
loosely halfway down his back. A closer inspection however shows that 
his armour is well oiled and his sword is very sharp. You think if would 
be best not to antagonise him.

mobs.Name: knight captain sir rowland crimson
mobs.LongDescription: Knight Captain Sir Rowland regards you suspiciously from across the room.
mobs.Description:
One of the older knights in the order, Sir Rowland has risen on the tide 
of his own skill and dedication to be second in command of the Crimson 
Fists. Although he is now one of the older Knights, he has lost none of 
his speed and skill, which is now tempered with the wisdom of an older 
man.

mobs.Name: knight HUGE lieutenant sir gravin crimson
mobs.LongDescription: A HUGE knight in crimson armour turns to stare at you as you enter the room.
mobs.Description:
Knight Lieutenant Sir Gravin must be the largest knight you have ever seen, 
standing more than a foot taller than any of the other knights in the 
citadel. As if his height were not intimidating enough, he is built as wide 
as a barn door, and has an angry looking scar running down the right hand 
side of his face. You doubted the stories that he had slain the bannerman 
and primarch of the Emperor's Children single handed - looking at him you 
wonder that he didn't kill the entire army.

mobs.Name: knight captain sir stephen crimson bannerman
mobs.LongDescription: A wise looking Knight Captain waits patiently for you to introduce yourself.
mobs.Description:
Knight Captain Sir Stephen is the bannerman of the Crimson Fists. When the 
Order rides into battle, he carries their standard before them, giving them 
courage to face their foes. At one time Sir Stephen was a priest, and he 
still spends a great deal of time in prayer. As you might expect from a 
bannerman he is very solidly build, and looks like he doesn't put up with 
any nonsense.

mobs.Name: knight lieutenant sir azig crimson
mobs.LongDescription: A wiry looking knight in crimson armour scrutinises an old book.
mobs.Description:
Knight Lieutenant Sir Azig doesn't look like the campaigning type, being 
slightly built and wearing a scratched pair of spectacles as he reads. Sir 
Azig is something of a scholar and spends all his spare time reading old 
books and scrolls. Never fear however - he can handle a sword as well as 
any of his fellow knights, and he is unsurpassed with the lance.

mobs.Name: primarch morgan crimson fist knight
mobs.LongDescription:
The supreme commander of the Crimson Fists, Primarch Morgan, looks down on 
you from his throne.
mobs.Description:
Primarch Morgan sits impassively on his throne, gazing down on you with a 
calm expression on his face. He is a well built handsome man, with wide 
shoulders and the sure movements of an accomplished fighting man.

mobs.Name: chaplain crimson order fist
mobs.LongDescription: A pious man serves as chaplain to the Crimson Fist.
mobs.Description:
The Chaplain is a portly fellow, almost unable to reach round his impressive 
girth, or count his chins. As well as seeing to the spiritual well being of 
the young knights, he has been known to crack a few heads.

mobs.Name: ghost apparition crimson
mobs.LongDescription: A crimson apparition floats before you.
mobs.Description:
You can see through him, but you notice that the claws on the end of his 
arms look very solid.

mobs.Name: bat red reddish
mobs.LongDescription: A vicious looking bat swoops down on you from the darkness.
mobs.Description:
He looks like a fairly normal bat, except for the reddish tint to his fur, 
and the malevolent glow in his eyes.

mobs.Name: servant pale
mobs.LongDescription: A pale servant hurries about his business.
mobs.Description:
Doesn't look like he gets out much, probably too busy seeing to the needs 
of his masters.

mobs.Name: soldier training crimson clad
mobs.LongDescription: A young soldier works hard, practicing his fighting skills.
mobs.Description:
He looks exhausted, but one glance at the stern Knight Sergeant is 
all he needs to discover those hidden reserves of energy. Besides - he 
wouldn't dare let his company down.

mobs.Name: knight crimson fist
mobs.LongDescription: A knight in crimson plate stands guard here.
mobs.Description: He looks like he knows how to handle himself, better not mess with him.

mobs.Name: stone chapterhouse guardian crimson
mobs.LongDescription: #GA reddish stone guardian blocks the gate to the citadel.#N
mobs.Description:
A large statue in the shape of a man blocks your progress. It's very 
detailed, and appears to be clutching a small crimson amulet.

mobs.Name: knight crimson fist
mobs.LongDescription: A knight in crimson plate wanders around the citadel.
mobs.Description: He looks like he knows how to handle himself, better not mess with him.

mobs.Name: ghoul crimson
mobs.LongDescription: A hideous crimson ghoul pounces on you.
mobs.Description:
He smells like an old corpse, and his clawed hands grasp hungrily for you
throat. Time to make an escape perhaps?

mobs.Name: child gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome child is playing around here.
mobs.Description:
The little tyke looks so innocent playing with his boomerang that you 
just want to pick him up and hug him.

mobs.Name: woman gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome woman is standing here, trying to look beautiful.
mobs.Description:
The woman is short and gnarled, but acts like a woman several times her beauty.
She's starting to look pretty attractive to you ...

mobs.Name: man gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome man is walking here, on his way to work.
mobs.Description:
This is a prime example of a gnome.  He looks short and weak, but at the
same time an intelligent creature who could outsmart you.

mobs.Name: scientist gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A scientist wanders around deep in thought.
mobs.Description:
You see a gnome who is lost deep into some invention that he is about
to make.  His hair is white, but he looks fairly strong.

mobs.Name: guard gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome guard stands here guarding something.
mobs.Description:
This is a well trained gnome.  He might not have a lot of strength but
he makes up for it with his weapons skill.

mobs.Name: chief gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A powerful looking gnome stands here wearing ornate clothes.
mobs.Description:
The Chief looks like he could whap you hard.  He looks not only powerful
but wise and resourceful.  You better not mess with him.

mobs.Name: troll small
mobs.LongDescription: A small troll grunts as he takes a swing at you.
mobs.Description:
The small troll is a short and stocky beast with a human-like face
but with the eyes and fangs of a wild beast.

mobs.Name: mouse field
mobs.LongDescription: A small mouse runs across your foot.
mobs.Description: The Mouse is a cute little creature.

mobs.Name: rat
mobs.LongDescription: A small rat shrieks and runs around.
mobs.Description: The rat is a little evil creature that deserves death.

mobs.Name: rat large
mobs.LongDescription: A large rat runs up to you and nibbles on your boots.
mobs.Description: You have the urge to kill this vile creature.

mobs.Name: rat giant
mobs.LongDescription: A giant rat growls at you and prepares to attack.
mobs.Description: This rat has grown up to be the size of an average dog.

mobs.Name: troll
mobs.LongDescription: A giant troll lumbers around.
mobs.Description:
You see before you a huge mass of living flesh.  You cringe in fear as
he lifts his powerful arm to bludgeon you.

mobs.Name: bat black
mobs.LongDescription: A black bat hangs from the ceiling.
mobs.Description: The bat is a grotesque little creature with large wings and fangs.

mobs.Name: zombie gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A zombie gnome shuffles his way towards you.
mobs.Description:
This is a creature which has passed away long ago.  His body has been
pulled out of its resting place by some evil force.

mobs.Name: bat fire
mobs.LongDescription: The fire bat flames brightly and prepares to attack.
mobs.Description:
You see a huge flame which resembles the shape of a bat.  The creature
hangs from the ceiling and bites at you.

mobs.Name: guard hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: The hobgoblin guard attacks first, thinks later.
mobs.Description:
This is an extra large, extra ugly goblin like creature.  He grins evilly
as he attempts to brain you.

mobs.Name: soldier hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A hobgoblin soldier stands here.
mobs.Description:
This is just a low life hobgoblin, who couldn't make it to the ranks
of the elite guards.  He looks pissed.

mobs.Name: bodyguard hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A hobgoblin bodyguard guards the king with his life.
mobs.Description:
This is one of the elite hobgoblin guards.  He stands tall for his short
stature.  He grins a toothy grin as he prepares to attack.

mobs.Name: king hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: There is a great king here, sitting in his throne.
mobs.Description:
The king is a silly looking hobgoblin whose muscles bulge out of his robes,
destroying the sophisticated effect he was trying to create.

mobs.Name: miner hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A hobgoblin miner stands here looking for gold.
mobs.Description: The miner is totally covered in dust.

mobs.Name: treasurer hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A treasurer is here counting out money.
mobs.Description:
The hobgoblin treasurer is an old goblin with glasses.  It appears that he
can only see a couple feet in front of him.

mobs.Name: prisoner gnome
mobs.LongDescription: A gnome prisoner is here resting in the straw.
mobs.Description: The prisoner is just barely alive.

mobs.Name: prisoner human
mobs.LongDescription: A human prisoner is here resting in the straw.
mobs.Description: The prisoner is just barely alive.

mobs.Name: hermit crab
mobs.LongDescription: A hermit crab crawls towards you.
mobs.Description:
The hermit crab is about 5 feet high and looks mad that you had the nerve
to wake it up.

mobs.Name: cook hobgoblin
mobs.LongDescription: A hobgoblin cook stands here cooking something.
mobs.Description:
The cook is a dirty and fat hobgoblin.  He burps as he stirs up something
in a pot.

mobs.Name: librarian library
mobs.LongDescription: A librarian wanders through the stacks.
mobs.Description:
The librarian wears her long hair back in a tight bun, apparently in
the style common to all female librarians.  She smiles quietly as she
goes about her business, glaring at any troublemakers and noisy
patrons.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 emote holds her finger to her pursed lips and hisses, 'Shhhh!'

mobs.Name: student girl
mobs.LongDescription: A young girl sits quietly, studying for an exam.
mobs.Description:
The young girl must be a student.  She sits quietly with her books,
studying as if her life (or at least her grades) depended on it.  She
appears to be oblivious to anything going on around her.
mobs.ActionScript: %%20 emote flips through the pages of her book.

mobs.Name: boy little
mobs.LongDescription: A little boy stares in awe at the life-like pictures in his book.
mobs.Description:
The wide-eyed fellow smiles with glee as he flips through his
favorite picture book.  He learned the joys of literature at an early
age, and hopefully he will continue to make use of the library as he
grows older.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 giggle;%10 smile;%5 gasp

mobs.Name: librarian head
mobs.LongDescription: The head librarian monitors all activity in the library.
mobs.Description:
The head librarian loves her job.  She enjoys wandering through the
stacks of books, sifting through the scrolls and papers, and watching
the patrons wander through "her" library.
mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 smile;%5 'Can I help you find anything?;%5 'This library has a
wonderful collection.  We have something for everyone.

mobs.Name: circulation lady librarian head
mobs.LongDescription: A pretty young lady sits behind the desk selling library cards.
mobs.Description:
This young lady is the person to see if you'd like to check out any
books in the library.  She controls the circulation of books in the
library, and sells the library cards needed to check the books out.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 'Can I help you?

mobs.Name: merkin gatherer
mobs.LongDescription: A leathery-skinned merkin hunts around for something good to eat.
mobs.Description:
The merkin is wearing only a tattered leathery loincloth, and a
yellow chord around his upper arm. His greenish slimy skin is 
splattered with mud and his ears twitch eagerly as he concentrates
on searching for worms and berries.

mobs.Name: merkin gatherer maid maiden
mobs.LongDescription: The lovely merkin maid scans the ground for snails and nuts.
mobs.Description:
She may be lovely by merkin standards, but she is pretty ugly 
by any normal standards. She has dark greenish skin, and a wide
flat nose. In an attempt to attract a mate, she has pierced
her pointed leathery ears with half a dozen colourful feathers, 
and she wears a copper band about her wrist.

mobs.Name: merkin
mobs.LongDescription: A leathery faced merkin stares blankly at you.
mobs.Description:
He has slitted yellow eyes (like a cat perhaps), that show 
barely a glimmer of intelligence. It has been said that merkins 
are really not much more advanced than primates, although they 
have mastered the use of tools, and their building work is 
fairly advanced.

mobs.Name: merkin
mobs.LongDescription: A yellow-eyed merkin squints suspiciously at you.
mobs.Description:
He blinks uncertainly as you stare at him, the white inner-lids
flashing across from either edge of his eyes as the green 
leathery main eyelids close. His wide lip-less mouth hangs
slightly open in slack-jawed wonder at your strange appearance.

mobs.Name: merkin maid female
mobs.LongDescription: A female merkin stands shuffles warily through the village
mobs.Description:
A blanket with a hole cut in the centre serves to protect her from
the elements, and she holds it around herself with her long three-
fingered hands. The fingers are especially knobbly, with what look
like little suckers on the tips. How strange!

mobs.Name: nurse merkin
mobs.LongDescription: A protective merkin stands between you and her spawnlings.
mobs.Description:
Most merkins have no real maternal instincts, but some may have 
the irresistible urge to look after new spawnlings until they 
mature. Any predator trying to lay their hands on the village
sprogs and spawnlings will have to get by this fierce creature 
first!

mobs.Name: sprog merkin
mobs.LongDescription: A tiny merkin slops about in a pen of stagnant mud.
mobs.Description:
This is a merkin sprog - an adolescent of the species you 
suppose. Its tail has all but disappeared, and its bulging eyes
and long leathery ears are almost fully formed. It is still 
too soon to determine gender, but in a few more weeks, this
will be a fully grown merkin.

mobs.Name: spawnling merkin
mobs.LongDescription: A wriggling spawnling slithers around the hatching pond.
mobs.Description:
It looks a little bit like an over-large tadpole, but not very
much. It is about eight inches long already, with deep dark 
eyes, four paddle-like limbs, and a long flat tail, which it 
uses to flounder around in the mucky water.

mobs.Name: merkin lover
mobs.LongDescription: The young merkin is in the mood for love.
mobs.Description:
Merkins can be hopeless romantics, and this fellow is the 
perfect example. A row of bright feathers are looped through
the holes along the lower edges of his ears, and he is even 
wearing some bog-goblin teeth on a string around his neck.

mobs.Name: merkin lover maiden maid
mobs.LongDescription: A lovely merkin-maiden waits to find a mate.
mobs.Description:
There comes a time in every merkin maidens life, when the urge
to reproduce becomes too strong to resist. She plasters herself
in the freshest marsh-mud, ties the most colourful feathers
around her neck, and lurks along lovers lane for the most
virile merkin mate.

mobs.Name: elder merkin
mobs.LongDescription: An old merkin licks his lips and stares at you.
mobs.Description:
Having lived a good long time, this elder merkin has seen plenty
of strange things, and earned a number of scars. His leathery
yellow-green skin hangs in wrinkly folds around his belly and
chinless face. His ears are ragged, but still sporting dozens
of colourful metal loops and feathers, and his eyes are rheumy
and pale.

mobs.Name: merkin chieftain
mobs.LongDescription: A well-built merkin looks up as you wander into his home!
mobs.Description:
There is a stately calm about the way in which this merkin gazes
at you, as if he had actually invited you into his home! This 
merkin wears a brightly coloured loincloth, and a number of 
animal teeth on a string around his neck. There are even some
gold rings in his ears, and on his fingers.

mobs.Name: merkin shaman
mobs.LongDescription: A filthy merkin prances around cackling insanely.
mobs.Description:
The shaman is completely naked, except for being daubed in dark
and light patches of mud and sprinkled with dry moss. (Hey, he's
a shaman, he's allowed to be weird.) He doesn't wear any feathers
in his ears, but there are several acorns and oak leaves instead.

mobs.Name: young merkin
mobs.LongDescription: A young merkin stares at you in wide-eyed amazement.
mobs.Description:
The young merkin shifts uncertainly from one foot to the other
as you stare at her - ready to waddle off on her stumpy little
legs at the first sign of trouble.

mobs.Name: fierce merkin guard
mobs.LongDescription: A well muscled merkin scowls at you and takes a firmer grip on his weapon.
mobs.Description:
Without any protective armour, the unwary adventurer might think that
this pot-bellied, web-footed amphibian might be an easy target. But his
arms are very powerful and sinewy - so you better watch out!

mobs.Name: merkin hunter
mobs.LongDescription: A merkin shuffles around, hunting something.
mobs.Description:
The merkin folk live on the edge of subsistence, so a great portion
of their time is spent hunting for food (worms, berries, nuts and
the like) to put into the village food supply.

mobs.Name: merkin hunter
mobs.LongDescription: A merkin waddles around, minding her own business.
mobs.Description:
The merkin folk live on the edge of subsistence, so a great portion
of their time is spent hunting for food (worms, berries, nuts and
the like) to put into the village food supply.

mobs.Name: boggoblin bog goblin
mobs.LongDescription: A filthy bog-goblin lurks about the marsh.
mobs.Description:
The bog-goblin is a peculiar breed of goblin, adapted for living
in the damp watery environs of the marsh. They have dark red-rimmed
eyes and dark green leathery skin, covered in coarse dark hair. Their
yellowy teeth are pointed like fangs - ideal for rending flesh.

mobs.Name: boggoblin bog goblin
mobs.LongDescription: A sly looking bog-goblin lunges at you from the mist.
mobs.Description:
The bog-goblin is a peculiar breed of goblin, adapted for living
in the damp watery environs of the marsh. They have dark red-rimmed
eyes and dark green leathery skin, covered in coarse dark hair. Their
yellowy teeth are pointed like fangs - ideal for rending flesh.

mobs.Name: boggoblin bog goblin king
mobs.LongDescription: A mighty bog-goblin chews idly on a still-twitching creature.
mobs.Description:
The bog-goblin king is the most vile and repulsive of all the 
bog-goblins. His throne was won by slaughtering anyone who did
not grovel piteously before him, and now he spends his time
eating and killing anything that annoys him.

mobs.Name: judderman man
mobs.LongDescription: A spindle-limbed man makes signs of warding with his long fingers.
mobs.Description:
Ancient legends speak of the Judderman, who walks the bog on winter
nights, when there is a full moon. He is impossibly thin, with 
limbs and fingers like oak twigs, and a long pointed nose. His 
fingers dance as he weaves his magic summoning spells.

mobs.Name: truffla tree
mobs.LongDescription: #GA tall lonely tree, with a fluffy blue foliage grows here.#Y
mobs.Description:
This is the last of the truffla trees, which once made a huge
forest in this area. Their foliage was far too useful though, 
and the poor trees were harvested to the brink of extinction.

mobs.Name: leech
mobs.LongDescription: A long leech lingers here, looking for lunch.
mobs.Description:
It is not an especially big leech, but still a good foot long, 
with hungry teeth at each end. It has no eyes, but by the way
it is flailing around, it must know you are there.

mobs.Name: greater stench beast
mobs.LongDescription: A formless cloud of stench wraps itself around you.
mobs.Description:
The stench beast has no corporeal form, but exists only as a dense
foul-smelling cloud. The wounds it causes are very real however, 
and nearby animal and bog-goblin corpses have had their skin
flayed.

mobs.Name: witch
mobs.LongDescription: A wily witch whistles while walking within the weird woods.
mobs.Description:
Well, witches must find their ingredients somewhere, and where better
for finding poisonous berries and strange little creatures than in
a swamp. It is obvious when you think about it.

mobs.Name: pixie
mobs.LongDescription: A little pixie flits about on gossamer wings.
mobs.Description:
He is only very tiny, as high as your boots and carrying the smallest
dagger you have ever seen tucked into his belt. His clothes are brightly
coloured, and his little wings make a high-pitched humming as he floats
about.

mobs.Name: pixie queen
mobs.LongDescription: The pixie queen rests on a throne of dewdrops.
mobs.Description:
The pixie queen is the cutest little thing, with a perfect heart-shaped
face, and an expression of such joy. In the pixie queens realm, there is
only laughter and joy and it radiates from her suffusing this area.

mobs.Name: swamp hopper squat bird
mobs.LongDescription: A squat flightless bird hops about here.
mobs.Description:
This plump swamp hopper is a tasty treat for any hunting merkin, and
as such is always on the lookout for predators. It has wide flat feet, 
perfect for avoiding sinking into the mud of the swamp. Although unable
to fly, he has short stubby wings which help to accelerate him over
short distances, and away from attackers.

mobs.Name: bog otter
mobs.LongDescription: A slinky otter skims across the bog.
mobs.Description:
As you watch her, she cleans her bristly whiskers with her paws and
glances around for a convenient escape route. She has eyes like
pools of pure midnight and her coat is slick with swamp water.

mobs.Name: shadow cat shadowcat
mobs.LongDescription: A vicious shadowcat appears from the darkness and bites into you!
mobs.Description:
The shadowcat is an extremely rare and vicious predator. Every part
of it is black, and his feet are softly padded so that he makes no 
sound as he stalks his prey.

mobs.Name: demon lord demonlord lesser
mobs.LongDescription: A man-sized, but incredibly ugly demon dives into the attack!
mobs.Description:
Although he is only a lesser demonlord, he is still pretty
tough, and pretty angry. Summoning demons is dangerous at the
best of times - they are always angry, and the worst thing
anyone could possibly do is break the circle of warding.

mobs.Name: verina battle mage retired
mobs.LongDescription: Verina the retired Battle Mage stands here cleaning some old items.
mobs.Description:
This old Mage looks too young for her age, her severe expression makes you
believe that ur not welcome, though you gain some extra guts and move forth
to what really took you to such a weird place.

mobs.Name: hobbit
mobs.LongDescription: A hobbit is strolling around here.
mobs.Description: A short, fat hobbit is strolling along here, talking to himself.

mobs.Name: hobbit
mobs.LongDescription: A fat hobbit is here, gathering tobacco.
mobs.Description: A short fat hobbit is here, gathering tobacco. He seems to like his work.

mobs.Name: bilbo hobbit
mobs.LongDescription: Bilbo Baggings is here, daydreaming.
mobs.Description: Bilbo stands here, daydreaming about long gone adventures.

mobs.Name: frodo hobbit
mobs.LongDescription: Frodo is standing here, smoking his pipe.
mobs.Description: Frodo seems to be a nice hobbit with his big belly and hairy feet.

mobs.Name: sam hobbit
mobs.LongDescription: Sam, Frodo's gardener is here mowing the lawn.
mobs.Description:
Sam seems to be a kind hobbit. He is short and fat and shouldn't be that hard
to squash.

mobs.Name: merry hobbit
mobs.LongDescription: Merry is standing here, looking almost as mean as his cousin Pippin.
mobs.Description:
Merry is standing here. He's a tall and muscular hobbit and he DOES look mean.
If you are going to fight a hobbit, don't fight this guy.

mobs.Name: pippin hobbit
mobs.LongDescription: Pippin is standing here, looking almost as mean as his cousin Merry.
mobs.Description:
Pippin is a tall muscular hobbit who just LOVES to fight. Challange him if you
want to but I wouldn't reccomend it.

mobs.Name: bogo hobbit
mobs.LongDescription: Bogo is standing here with a bottle to his mouth as usual.
mobs.Description:
Bogo the hobbit drunk is here, drinking as usual. He doesn't look too tough. 
Maybe you should put an end to his misery.

mobs.Name: rosa female hobbit
mobs.LongDescription: Rosa is here, looking for her beloved Sam.
mobs.Description: Rosa, Sam's wife-to-be is standing here, wondering where Sam is.

mobs.Name: took hobbit
mobs.LongDescription: Took is standing here, mumbling some magic words.
mobs.Description:
Took, an old experienced hobbit is standing here. This hobbit saw adventures 
before you were even born. Some hobbits say he knows his way around magic but
of course, that is just rumours.

mobs.Name: mayor hobbit
mobs.LongDescription: The hobbit mayor is here, looking busy.
mobs.Description:
The mayor of the hobbits is here, trying hard to look busy. He is a tough built
hobbit, although he seems to be kind. He controls the hobbit village with a
firm but fair hand.

mobs.Name: karo dog
mobs.LongDescription: Karo, the mayor's loyal watchdog is here.
mobs.Description:
Karo, the hobbit mayor's loyal watchdog is here, looking confused. This dog
appears to have a problem with both his IQ and his weight. However, he is big
and you have the feeling that he bites hard.

mobs.Name: mouse small
mobs.LongDescription: The small mouse is scampering around here.
mobs.Description:
The mouse leads a boring existance. However, he seems to be
cheerful and merry as he scampers along the ground.

mobs.Name: rat rodent
mobs.LongDescription: The rat scurries along looking for anything to scavenge.
mobs.Description:
The rat is a long tailed rodent which resembles mice, but is
a little big larger. The rat scurries along the ground.

mobs.Name: squirrel
mobs.LongDescription: The squirrel is here collecting nuts.
mobs.Description:
A brown furry squirrel. The squirrel has a long flexible,
bushy tail. The squirrel is here searching for nuts.

mobs.Name: raccoon racoon coon
mobs.LongDescription: The raccoon is here showing little fear of you.
mobs.Description:
The raccoon has grayish-brown fur with black masklike
facial markings, and a bushy, black-ringed tail.

mobs.Name: cardinal bird
mobs.LongDescription: The cardinal is perched on a nearby tree branch.
mobs.Description:
The cardinal is a beautiful red bird with a
crested head and a short, thick bill.

mobs.Name: blue jay bird
mobs.LongDescription: The blue jay is perched on a nearby tree branch.
mobs.Description:
The blue jay is beautiful bird with a crested head
and predominantly blue plumage.

mobs.Name: robin bird
mobs.LongDescription: The robin is perched nearby whistling a delightful song.
mobs.Description: The robin has a orange breast and a brown back.

mobs.Name: eagle bird
mobs.LongDescription: The eagle is resting on a large branch nearby.
mobs.Description:
The eagle has a powerful hooked bill, long broad
wings, and strong, soaring flight.

mobs.Name: owl bird
mobs.LongDescription: The owl is perched here on a nearby branch.
mobs.Description:
The owl has hooked and feathered talons, a large head with 
short hooked beaks, and eyes set in a frontal facial plane.

mobs.Name: black crow bird
mobs.LongDescription: The black crow is here shrieking his raucous call.
mobs.Description:
The black crow is large glossy, black bird. The crow is
scavenger who will feast on any corpse he encounters.

mobs.Name: bat
mobs.LongDescription: The bat is here hanging from the ceiling.
mobs.Description:
The bat is a nocturnal creature, sleeping all day and only
moving about at night. The bat has membranous wings that extend
from the forelimbs to the hind limbs or tail.

mobs.Name: cave bear
mobs.LongDescription: The cave bear is sleeping here in his cave.
mobs.Description:
The cave bear is about 15 feet tall with reddish brown fur. Cave
bears are harmless when sleeping, but be careful not to wake them.

mobs.Name: black bear
mobs.LongDescription: The black bear is here wandering about.
mobs.Description:
The black bear is about 6 feet tall with dark black fur. Black
bears tend do not attack unless provoked.

mobs.Name: grizzly bear
mobs.LongDescription: The grizzly bear is resting here.
mobs.Description:
The grizzly bear stands about 9 feet tall and has silver-tipped
brown fur. Grizzly bears are fond of meat, however this one looks
as if he has just finished a meal. Lucky for you!

mobs.Name: wild boar
mobs.LongDescription: The wild boar is here minding his own business.
mobs.Description:
The wild boar is an omnivorous creature, but tends to mind its own
business. However, they have extremely nasty tempers when disturbed.

mobs.Name: mountain lion cat
mobs.LongDescription: The mountain lion is here wandering around the mountain side.
mobs.Description:
The mountain lion is a tawny-furred creature. The lion weakest of
the family of the great cats. As many of the creatures in its family,
the mountian lion is a playful creature, but is subject to violent
changes of temper.

mobs.Name: wild big horn mountain ram
mobs.ShortDescription: the wild big horn mountain ram
mobs.LongDescription: The wild big horn mountain ram is moving easily upon the mountain side.
mobs.Description:
The wild big horn mountain ram has large spiral horns. The ram is long
legged and very agile as you can tell from the way he easily moves up
and down the mountain side.

mobs.Name: weasel
mobs.LongDescription: The weasel is here searching for some small prey.
mobs.Description:
The weasel is a short but long creature, measuring 4 to 5 feet in length.
The look rather harmless, though you do not feel so safe when you see
there sharp teeth.

mobs.Name: giant weasel
mobs.LongDescription: The giant weasel is here looking at you hungrily.
mobs.Description:
The giant weasel looks similar to his smaller counterpart, except for
the fact that he is twice the length, measuring 10 feet in length.
One other thing you notice is that he is much more dangerous looking.

mobs.Name: sabre tooth tiger cat
mobs.LongDescription: The Sabre-Tooth Tiger stands peering at his next meal.
mobs.Description:
The Sabre-Tooth Tiger are larger than most cats in the same family.
You instanly notice the oversized fangs, from which the cat is named.

mobs.Name: wolf
mobs.LongDescription: The wolf is standing here studying his surroundings.
mobs.Description:
The wolf is a beautiful animal, resembling that cute puppy you saw last
time you wandered by the pet store. Don't forget that this is a vicous
predator when provoked!

mobs.Name: goat
mobs.LongDescription: The goat is standing here nibbling on some grass.
mobs.Description:
The goat is a rather dull animal. He does little other than wander
around nibbling on grass.

mobs.Name: sheep
mobs.LongDescription: The sheep is standing here grazing.
mobs.Description:
The sheep has a large wool covering over it's body. The sheep also
has split hoofs, making it cloven-footed.

mobs.Name: cow
mobs.LongDescription: The cow is standing in the grazing on nearby grass.
mobs.Description:
The cow is a decent sized animal. He is white with large black
spots all over his body. The cow looks pretty harmless.

mobs.Name: pig
mobs.LongDescription: The pig is here playing in the mud.
mobs.Description:
The pig is a very intelligent animal. Though the pig is not the
world's prettiest animal, he does have some good qualities.

mobs.Name: horse
mobs.LongDescription: The horse is standing here tall and proud.
mobs.Description: The horse is a beautiful animal standing a little of more than 6 feet tall.

mobs.Name: deer
mobs.LongDescription: The deer is wandering around.
mobs.Description:
The deer is a beautiful animal. His antlers raise high above his head.
The deer is a very quick and agile animal.

mobs.Name: moose
mobs.LongDescription: The moose is here wandering around looking at his surroundings.
mobs.Description:
The moose is the largest living deer. The moose has a heavy body,
long legs, and short neck and tail. The moose can move quickly
though his looks would seem to make you believe otherwise.

mobs.Name: bunny hare rabbit
mobs.LongDescription: The bunny rabbit is here as cute as ever.
mobs.Description:
The bunny rabbit is a cute creature which you would like to
pick up and hold. The bunny looks so harmless you feel like
a jerk even thinking about harming it.

mobs.Name: farmer
mobs.LongDescription: The Farmer is here thinking about the chores to be done today.
mobs.Description:
The farmer is a middle aged man. He is of medium height and is
pretty thin. You can tell that he has worked hard on the farm
all his life.

mobs.Name: farmer wife
mobs.LongDescription: The farmer's wife is standing here preparing a meal.
mobs.Description:
The farmer's wife is a well rounded woman. You can tell she has
spent many days in the kitchen.

mobs.Name: daughter girl
mobs.LongDescription: The farmer's daughter is standing here looking as hot as ever.
mobs.Description:
The Farmer's Daughter is one of the most beautiful creatures you have
ever seen in you life. As she notices you looking at her, she gives
you a little wink!

mobs.Name: farmer
mobs.LongDescription: The farmer smiles happily as he dances a jig.
mobs.Description:
The farmer smells of sweat and manure, but he appears to be happy
enough.  His overalls look like they haven't been washed in weeks,
and you fear that standing too close to him may very well make you
pass out!

mobs.Name: pig
mobs.LongDescription: Strange, but true, this pig is dancing!
mobs.Description:
This little fellow has pink skin, which has been covered almost
completely in mud.  He smells terrible, but he has the cutest little
face, and boy can he dance!

mobs.Name: georgie peorgie boy
mobs.LongDescription: Georgie Peorgie puckers up to give you a big wet kiss!
mobs.Description:
Georgie Peorgie is quite the lady's man, but he doesn't seem to care
too much to let his playmates know.  He's short and stout, probably
from eating too much pie.  His dirty blonde hair is unkempt and could
probably use a good washing.

mobs.Name: mouse
mobs.LongDescription: A small mouse runs up the clock.
mobs.Description:
The small mouse has a soft grey coat and long black whiskers.  His
giant ears look rather comical atop his tiny little head.  He stares
at you, twitching his tiny little tail.

mobs.Name: baker
mobs.LongDescription: The baker stands here, working magic on a piece of dough.
mobs.Description:
The baker is an enormous man, who has an almost perfectly round
shape.  You imagine he probably got that way from eating a few too
many of his delicious baked goods.

mobs.Name: jack man
mobs.LongDescription: Jack smiles proudly at his handiwork.
mobs.Description:
Jack stands tall in his dusty overalls.  His hair is covered with
sawdust and bits of wood.  He considers himself to be a master
builder, but one look at his handiwork and you know better!

mobs.Name: old man
mobs.LongDescription: An old man snores loudly as he sleeps the day away.
mobs.Description:
This old man looks like he's had a rough time.  He has a huge bump on
his head, and he's snoring loud enough to wake the dead!  Might not
be a good idea to wake him, he doesn't look much like a morning
person.

mobs.Name: jack boy
mobs.LongDescription: A young boy carries his pail to the top of the hill.
mobs.Description:
Jack is a handsome young fellow, full of energy and life.  He better
watch his step though, the steep hill looks quite treacherous.  Jack
probably wouldn't take too well to falling down!

mobs.Name: jill girl
mobs.LongDescription: Singing happily, a young girl climbs the steep hill.
mobs.Description:
Jill is a pretty young girl, with smiling blue eyes and golden hair.
She appears to be walking a bit too quickly, and she better be
careful that she doesn't come tumbling down on her pretty little
head!

mobs.Name: jack man
mobs.LongDescription: A young man runs around with his pants on fire!
mobs.Description:
Uh oh!  It seems that Jack got a little too close to the flame as he
jumped over the candlestick!  His pants are on fire, and he's
frantically trying to put them out.

mobs.Name: jack sprat man husband
mobs.LongDescription: An extremely thin man sits at the table, eating only the lean.
mobs.Description:
Jack Sprat must eat no fat, he's ever so thin indeed!  His long, lean
frame appears almost skeletal.  Jack better start eating something
other than the lean, or he'll waste away to nothing.

mobs.Name: wife jack sprat woman
mobs.LongDescription: A portly, yet pretty, woman sits at the table stuffing her face.
mobs.Description:
Jack Sprat's wife eats just about anything she can get her hands on,
and it certainly shows.  She's about four times the size of her
rail-thin husband.  Luckily for her (and for Jack) she's as pretty as
she is large.

mobs.Name: kookaburra bird
mobs.LongDescription: A large bird sits in the tree, eating all the gumdrops he can see.
mobs.Description:
The kookaburra is a strange-looking bird, with a laugh to match.  He
sits high in the tree, eating all the tasty gumdrops.  Better hope he
saves some for you!

mobs.Name: little bo peep girl
mobs.LongDescription: A young girl stands crying in the pasture.
mobs.Description:
Poor Little Bo Peep!  She fell asleep beneath a cozy tree, and her
sheep all wandered off.  Now she'll have to go home and explain that
to her parents.

mobs.Name: little bunny foo
mobs.LongDescription:
Laughing wildly, a small bunny picks up a field mouse and BOPS it on
the head!
mobs.Description:
With his long ears and wiggly nose, Little Bunny Foo Foo looks
innocent enough, but one look in his eyes and you know this rabbit is
a maniac!  He takes joy in that pain of field mice - what a sicko!

mobs.Name: mary girl
mobs.LongDescription: A young girl plays with her classmates.
mobs.Description:
Mary is a pretty young girl, wearing a frilly pink dress with
matching petticoat.  Her curly brown hair and big green eyes seem to
complete the picture.  What you can't tell from her appearance, is
that Mary has a thing for young sheep!

mobs.Name: mary contrary gardener lady
mobs.LongDescription: Tending to her garden, the young lady doesn't even notice you.
mobs.Description:
Mary is quite the gardener.  She can grow anything almost anywhere,
and she's won numerous awards from the local gardening club.  Humming
softly to herself, she tends her magnificent garden.

mobs.Name: michael boy
mobs.LongDescription: A young boy is rowing across the river as fast as he can.
mobs.Description:
Michael is very much the athlete, and he often rows himself across
the river to keep in shape.  This time however, he's rowing across
the river to see what he can of the promised land.

mobs.Name: old king cole man
mobs.LongDescription: Old King Cole watches over the festivities, chewing on his pipe.
mobs.Description:
Old King Cole is a handsome old man, with twinkling grey eyes and a
perpetual smile.  He's dressed in the finest clothing available, and
while he has a bit of a belly, his outfit fits him quite well.

mobs.Name: ant worker m11200
mobs.LongDescription: A tiny worker ant glares at you for being in its way.
mobs.Description:
This ant scurries about with the rest of his colony preparing 
grain for the winter. He seems very determined to get his job 
done efficiently, and he doesn't look too happy now that you've
managed to get in his way.

mobs.Name: grasshopper grass m11201
mobs.LongDescription: The grasshopper begs you for some food.
mobs.Description:
Although he once sang cheerily in the summer evenings, famine has 
caused this grasshopper to look sickly and weak. His antennae 
hang droopily and his skin has turned a strange yellowish green 
color. Perhaps one of the ants will be kind enough to give him 
some food to last him the winter.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 shiver;%5 say Please, sir, can I have some more?

mobs.Name: traveller m11202
mobs.LongDescription: A man is telling tales to anybody who will listen.
mobs.Description:
From the suitcase at his feet to the trinkets in his pockets, you 
can tell that this man has been on numerous journeys.  The most 
impressive souveneir that he has brought home, though, are the tall 
tales that are tumbling out of his mouth.

mobs.Name: mouse m11203
mobs.LongDescription: You think you see two eyes peering at you through a hole in the wall.
mobs.Description:
After being terrorized by that awful cat, it's no wonder the mice 
here are so frightened. It's difficult to get a good look at them 
as they go scurrying across the floor, and the only thing you see 
is a scrawny tail disappearing into a hole in the wall.
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote squeeks frightfully.

mobs.Name: cat m11204
mobs.LongDescription: A dead cat is hanging from a peg on the wall.
mobs.Description:
At first glance, this beautiful calico kitty appears to be dead, 
but upon closer examination you see that she is very much alive. 
Every now and then she peeks at the mouse hole with one eye to 
see if the mice have fallen for her trick.

mobs.Name: dog hound m11205
mobs.LongDescription: A hound dog playfully chases a hare across the hillside.
mobs.Description:
This puppy is full of energy, and it's obvious that he just wants 
to play with his new friend, the hare. He looks at you with big 
brown eyes and wags his tail in an invitation to come play with him.
mobs.ActionScript: %%15 bark

mobs.Name: hare m11206
mobs.LongDescription: The hare runs as fast as she possibly can away from the hound.
mobs.Description:
This poor hare just can't seem to get away from her pursuer, 
despite her powerful legs and natural agility. Her long ears 
start to twitch with fright as the hound dog closes in on her. He 
wouldn't really eat her... would he?

mobs.Name: eagle m11207
mobs.LongDescription: An eagle mourns the loss of her young.
mobs.Description:
This eagle sits in the place where her nest once sat, high above 
the ground nestled in the branches of a tall tree. The once proud 
eagle silently ruffles her feathers as she looks down at the fox 
with her beady eyes. At one time, the two of them had been close 
friends, now it appears they are mortal enemies.

mobs.Name: fox vixen m11208
mobs.LongDescription: A childless vixen seeks revenge against the eagle.
mobs.Description:
Everybody knows that the fox is the most clever creature in the 
world, and this one is no exception. She knows that mourning for 
the loss of her children is not going to bring them back, and 
instead seeks retribution. Don't double cross this fox unless you 
want to feel the heat of her ire.

mobs.Name: fox m11209
mobs.LongDescription: A starving fox mutters something about sour grapes.
mobs.Description:
Something in this fox's eyes makes you want to run in the 
opposite direction; perhaps it is because she looks bitter and 
hungry, not a good combination in a fox. While foxes are known 
for being swift and cunning, this one obviously couldn't figure 
out how to get those grapes down.

mobs.Name: goat m11210
mobs.LongDescription: A goat has meandered away from its flock.
mobs.Description:
This goat wanders around the mountainside nibbling on the grass, 
not really paying attention to anything else around him. Upon 
closer inspection you notice that one of his horns has been 
broken by someone or something. Perhaps the inattentiveness of 
the goat has gotten him into trouble before.

mobs.Name: goatherd boy m11211
mobs.LongDescription: #cThe guilty goatherd whispers to you, 'I'm in trouble...'#N
mobs.Description:
A boy of no more than fifteen or sixteen looks at you with a 
guilty look on his face. His ruddy complexion indicates that he 
must spend a lot of time on this mountain with his goats. Every 
now and then he checks to make sure the flock is still together. 
Maybe he knows what has happened to the goat with the broken horn.

mobs.Name: tortoise m11212
mobs.LongDescription: A tortoise walks steadily past you with a determined look on her face.
mobs.Description:
This tortoise won't let anything get in the way of her goal - the 
finish line! She ambles slowly down the path with her stumpy legs, 
not even flinching as the hare speeds past her.

mobs.Name: hare m11213
mobs.LongDescription: You hear a hare snoring as he sleeps under a tree.
mobs.Description:
Looking peaceful and contented, this hare sleeps away the 
afternoon under a huge tree.  His long ears hang down and every 
now and then you see his nose twitch. It is hard to imagine that 
this hare plans on winning a race by sleeping, especially 
considering that his opponent is just coming around the bend.

mobs.Name: mouse m11214
mobs.LongDescription: A mouse tries desperately to save his friend, the lion.
mobs.Description:
This little gray mouse scampers about as he attempts to chew the 
lion out of trouble. One would never think that a timid mouse 
would be able to aid a brave and mighty lion, but the proof is 
right in front of you.

mobs.Name: lion m11215
mobs.LongDescription: A lion seems to have been outsmarted by giant ropes.
mobs.Description:
The lion roars angrily at the rope that has ensnared him, which 
only traps him more. His golden mane is tangled and his teeth are 
bared... maybe you should leave before he becomes free and attacks
the closest living thing - YOU!
mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote roars in your general direction.

mobs.Name: man m11216
mobs.LongDescription: You flinch as the light reflects off this man's head.
mobs.Description:
This finely dressed man stands here frowning, probably due to the 
fact that he no longer has any hair on his head.  Rumor has it 
that he got himself into trouble with the ladies, and that's never 
a good sign.

mobs.Name: wind north m11217
mobs.LongDescription: You feel a sudden gust of air as the North Wind greets you.
mobs.Description:
The North Wind picks up anything it can that stands in its path 
and chills everything else.  Just looking at it makes you want to 
pile on some more clothes.

mobs.Name: sun m11218
mobs.LongDescription: An intense heat fills your body as the Sun shines down upon you.
mobs.Description:
Not paying any attention to all those warnings about looking 
directly at the sun has proved to be a very dumb thing to do. 
The only thing that you manage to notice before having to turn 
away is that it's just bright... very, very bright.

mobs.Name: peacock bird m11219
mobs.LongDescription: A peacock struts about, showing off his plumage with pride.
mobs.Description:
This beautiful bird can't last a single day without showing off 
his feathers to everyone around him. They are a radiant blue and 
green with just a touch of yellow, and they make you want to 
reach out and take one... but you wouldn't dare do that, would you?

mobs.Name: frog m11220
mobs.LongDescription: A frog rushes up to you claiming that he can heal all your wounds.
mobs.Description:
This "cure-all" doctor needs to listen to his own advice - he 
walks with a crutch and has wrinkles all over his body. He seems 
friendly enough, if not a little bit looney in the head.
mobs.ActionScript: %%5 say Ribbit! Ribbit Ribbit!

mobs.Name: boy shepherd m11221
mobs.LongDescription: The shepherd boy mourns the loss of his flock.
mobs.Description:
This young man will never forget the lesson he learned the night 
that awful wolf devoured his flock right before his eyes. He 
watches cautiously over the meadow and is always looking over 
his shoulder for any signs of danger.

mobs.Name: thief m11222
mobs.LongDescription: A thief tries to look innocent as he breaks into somebody's house.
mobs.Description:
This HUGE man manages to make himself look small and stealthily moves  
along the wall of this unsuspecting person's house. He doesn't look 
like someone you should be messing around with, so maybe you should 
keep moving and pretend you never saw a thing.

mobs.Name: lioness lion m11223
mobs.LongDescription: A lioness holds and cuddles her cub in her arms.
mobs.Description:
Obviously, this lioness is proud of her only cub, and she makes 
sure it is well cared for. She looks at the little cub, and the 
only thing you can see in her big brown eyes is pure love and 
affection.

mobs.Name: wolf m11224
mobs.LongDescription: An odd-looking sheep stands out from the rest of the flock.
mobs.Description:
As you approach the odd sheep, you realize that it is actually a 
wolf in a sheep's skin. The disguise is an excellent one... or 
else these are very gullible sheep!

mobs.Name: mini mutant meatball rahlsmob
mobs.LongDescription: The Mini Mutant Meatball is standing here looking fierce.
mobs.Description:
You feel his bigger cousin might get angry is you attack
this small MMM.
